chapters.title: Chapter 751 - 740: Saint-Grade Golden Core
paragraphs: Droplets of Martial Dao True Water fell into the dantian.
In no time at all,
one hundred drops had fallen.
Followed by another hundred.
When it reached two hundred drops, the Martial Dao True Water had not yet formed a core and continued to wildly absorb various energies from the broken Golden Core.
drops.
drops.
drops!

At 250 drops, Ding Ling was just shy of his limit, so he harnessed the power of the Human Emperor Saber, stabbing it into the Demon Realm’s portal, absorbing a large amount of Demon Qi, and began frantically refining it.
The Demon Qi from the Demon Realm varied in texture, and Ding Ling absorbed for a long time before finally condensing a drop of True Water in his dantian.
Once this True Water was formed,
Ding Ling finally felt he had reached his limit.
To continue absorbing would likely cause his body to explode.
Whoosh!
Amidst the storms, as the Martial Dao True Understanding ran at lightning speed, droplets of True Water quickly gathered together, like a thunderbolt forging iron, under the booming sounds.
A pill emitting a chaotic glow began to slowly forge and condense into shape.
This forming process lasted for three days and nights.
Three days later.
Boom!
A thunderbolt streaked across the otherworldly space.
The whole world seemed to tremble, as an earth-shattering aura surged from Ding Ling’s body.
As this aura emerged,

the ground shook and mountains quaked, horrific storms rose up from flat ground, resembling Star Shifting and Earth Collapsing, with rumbling thunders descending from the sky, ringing in Xiong Ba and the Female Drought Demon’s ears, leaving them momentarily dazed.
"This, this, what kind of aura is this?!"
"It actually causes the heavens and earth to tremble! This is truly an unheard-of phenomenon! Could it be... Ding Ling succeeded?!"
The Female Drought Demon showed a look of joy.
"The legendary Saint-Grade Golden Core, could it really be appearing?! Am I, the Female Drought Demon, witnessing history at this moment?"
With such a display from the Female Drought Demon,
Xiong Ba was even more astounded.
Facing this soul-stirring, bird-and-beast-startling aura, he felt like a fisherman caught in monstrous waves, filled with helplessness, fear, and awe!
’So strong! Just the pressure alone is beyond what I can bear. If Ding Ling attacked, wouldn’t he crush me to powder in an instant?!’
Just the thought of it made Xiong Ba’s heart race uncontrollably.
"Has the gap widened to such an extent?! Before, I could still fend off one or two moves from Ding Ling."
He was an immortal Fire Zombie.
Yet even so, he felt as if death could come at any moment; the pressure Ding Ling exerted on him was enormous beyond imagination.
Boom!
As the sounds of thunderous explosions faded.
Ding Ling suddenly opened his eyes, his bright gaze condensed into light, shooting out with a crackling sound in the void.
Now, every move and breath he took seemed able to harness the power of heaven and earth.
This otherworldly space seemed unable to bear the full display of his power anymore.
A single punch from him might cause this otherworldly space to shatter.
"How do you feel?"
The Female Drought Demon eagerly asked.
"I succeeded."
"I really did it."
The Female Drought Demon beamed with delight:
"That’s wonderful. You actually accomplished what countless Ancient Divine Beings of this world couldn’t. Ding Ling, I am proud of you!"
"Also, many thanks to the senior for guarding me."
Ding Ling smiled.
He also breathed a sigh of relief.
With thrills and no danger.
Finally, it was done.
This Saint-Grade Golden Core is more than ten times stronger than a First-Grade Golden Core.
A First-Grade Golden Core requires only 191 drops of True Water to condense successfully.
Ding Ling’s previous First-Grade Golden Core was condensed from 195 drops of True Water.
Extremely powerful, it could slaughter Limu and other Martial Arts Third and Fourth Grade Golden Core strongmen with ease!
This current Golden Core was condensed from 251 drops of True Water!
In terms of quantity alone, it crushes a First-Grade Golden Core.

Not to mention, these True Waters, after transformation, have become Martial Dao True Water. Though each drop of Martial Dao True Water has shrunk significantly, they easily surpass the previous True Waters.
Along with cultivation techniques and other aspects, the Saint-Grade Golden Core also crushes the First-Grade Golden Core.
’With this Saint-Grade Golden Core, I can probably cross into a higher realm and fight!’
’Unless I face a similarly talented First-Grade Golden Core strongman or a Saint-Grade Golden Core strongman, otherwise, I can easily counter ordinary Martial Arts Primordial Spirit strongmen.’
With the cultivation technique at full level,
Ding Ling has already comprehended all the esoteric truths and essence of this cultivation technique.
In his eyes,
he clearly knew how to step into the realms of Primordial Spirit, Dharma Aspect, and War Immortal!
Because of this clarity,
he naturally also understood the realm of the Martial Arts Golden Core.
The Martial Arts Golden Core is divided into Initial Tier, Middle Tier, High Tier, Perfection, and Great Perfection levels.
Each advancement only requires 50 drops of True Water to merge into the Golden Core.
Ordinary Martial Arts Golden Core strongmen generally have a foundation built on 111 drops of True Water.
First-Grade Golden Core strongmen generally start with 191 drops.
This is the foundational power, which cannot be changed.
Once the foundation is set, to change it would require smashing the core and re-condensing it, as Ding Ling did!
But how many people can successfully smash their core and re-condense it? Not many can do this. Even if they do succeed, the probability of successfully re-cultivating it is very low.

"After establishing the foundation, an ordinary Golden Core strongman’s Initial Tier True Water is 111 drops. Middle Tier is 161 drops. High Tier is 211 drops. Perfection is 261 drops. Great Perfection is 311 drops."
"A First-Grade Golden Core strongman’s Initial Tier True Water is 191 drops, and Middle Tier is 241 drops. And so on."
Thus,
Ding Ling currently has 251 drops of Initial Tier True Water. His Middle Tier will be 301 drops.
The number for his Middle Tier can compare with an ordinary Golden Core strongman’s Great Perfection.
Not to mention the crushing quality, cultivation technique levels, and so forth.
Therefore,
Ding Ling’s potential is immense, it can be imagined!
"It’s like building houses. My foundation is as deep and sturdy as a mountain; naturally, the houses I can build in the future will be taller and more stable!"
Ding Ling was very satisfied.
When he was at the Initial Tier of the Martial Arts Golden Core, he could already use the power of a First-Grade Golden Core to crush Third and Fourth Grade Golden Core strongmen.
Now, with a Saint-Grade, crossing into a higher realm to fight is quite likely!
Therefore,
Ding Ling now has some confidence in defeating the Demon Emperor!
He roughly explained his situation to the Female Drought Demon.
The Female Drought Demon joyously exclaimed:

"Since that’s the case, there’s no time to lose. I will now send you back into the Divine Realm, and then you can go through the Celestial Realm’s portal to the Demon Realm. First, eliminate ordinary demons to enhance yourself. When you reach the limit and can no longer improve, go to the Demon Emperor Palace to join forces with me; we’ll work together to kill the Demon Emperor."
"Yes!"
Ding Ling promptly arose.
Then!
With the cooperation of the Female Drought Demon,
he entered the Divine Realm’s portal once more.
He ascended the Celestial Ladder again.
The activation of this Celestial Ladder indeed required energy, and if the energy were depleted, it would automatically retract.

But Ding Ling didn’t need to worry about the Celestial Ladder retracting before reaching the Divine Realm because the Female Drought Demon was guarding the other end. She could roughly sense whether the ladder had transported someone to the Divine Realm.
If it did,
she would then stop infusing energy into the ladder.
Tap tap!
Ding Ling briskly walked up the Celestial Ladder.
After a while, he reached the Sea of Space-Time again.

chapters.title: Chapter 752 - 741: Celestial Cry Saber Technique
paragraphs: This time, the Sea of Space-Time is vastly different from the last.
Last time, the Sea of Space-Time surged forward majestically, and upon reaching a position a thousand feet from the right of the Celestial Ladder, a fork would appear.
Two ’waterways’ branched off from the fork.
One was illusory and faint, like the moon in a well.
The other seemed like a mirage about to become real.
Now, the illusory waterway at the fork has directly disappeared.
Only one truly condensed, incredibly solid path remains.
Therefore, at this moment, the Sea of Space-Time looks boundless and endless at a glance, with no visible forks or endpoints.
"Sure enough, there has been a significant change."
Ding Ling was relieved.

When he was in the Nine Void Realm, trying to suppress Emperor Shitian across space-time, he suddenly encountered strong resistance. At that time, he sensed that there must have been a violent change in the Sea of Space-Time.
Now it seems.
Indeed, he wasn’t wrong.
"Ah!"
A long sigh suddenly echoed from above the Sea of Space-Time.
This voice was filled with pain, anger, resentment, confusion, and a killing intent. Before the sound even landed, a phantom figure suddenly punched heavily towards Ding Ling’s position, rumbling!

The punch seemed to smash through space-time! A spiral storm blended with a peculiar power of space-time flew out from the Sea of Space-Time, transforming into a sky-devouring serpent, rushing towards Ding Ling as if it wanted to swallow him whole!
"Half-God!"
Ding Ling immediately recognized the figure.
Unlike the first encounter.

Now the Half-God seemed to be without a physical body, only a phantom spirit body, appearing on the verge of decaying, yet such an existence seemed empowered by the divine power of time and space, punching out unrestricted by a physical body, actually unleashing a space-time spiritual killing storm with a punch.
Ding Ling felt it.
If he were hit by this punch, his physical body might remain intact, but his spirit could wither away.
He frowned, drew his saber sharply, and countered with a reverse slash!
Celestial Cry Saber Technique!
Heaven and Earth Shattered!
With one slash, small Qiankun Worlds seemed to form at the tip of the saber, accompanied by a dazzling thousand-foot saber beam, falling at the speed of light into the Sea of Space-Time.

The next moment! The Qiankun World met the sky-devouring serpent, and upon contact, a world-shattering explosion occurred, rumbling! Like meteors colliding, a powerful energy storm expanded in all directions from the center between the two.
Where it passed.
The Sea of Space-Time was in constant turmoil, surging with overwhelming waves.
The Half-God was the first to bear the brunt, being knocked back over a hundred feet by the force of the aftermath.
He looked shocked:
"How can it be?! How did you become so strong in such a short time?!"
He found it incredible.
Ding Ling held the Human Emperor Saber, stepped forward, and walked above the Sea of Space-Time.
He had already discovered.
This area differs from other places, allowing a brief step without harm.
The void in other areas has strong corrosive and piercing power, capable of eroding and destroying everything!
But perhaps due to the relation to the Sea of Space-Time, the force of time prevails here, meaning the force of decay hasn’t intruded.
Unless one’s power exceeds the world’s limits, stepping here will still lead to ’assimilation’ by the power of time, resulting in rapid loss and death.
But Ding Ling and the Half-God’s powers have already surpassed the earthly limits, reaching Golden Core Level, truly becoming God of Gods!
On earth, one at Shattering Level can be called a god.
Aren’t they both God of Gods?
"After multiple ambushes on me. This time, I must kill you."
Ding Ling decisively acted, swinging another saber slash.
Celestial Cry Saber Technique!
Six Paths of Annihilation!
As the move was unleashed, a desolate aura of annihilation spread rapidly towards the Half-God along with the saber beam.
The Half-God had no doubt that if enveloped by this annihilation aura, he would instantly disintegrate into dust and vanish completely from the world.
"What kind of saber technique is this?!"
The Half-God’s scalp tingled with terror:
"Why have I never heard or seen such a saber technique in the future?!"
"Your future is all illusion. It’s not real. It’s normal you can’t see it."
Ding Ling kept slashing.
Celestial Cry Saber Technique.
As the name suggests.
When mastered to the extreme.
Even the heavens can weep for it! It would bring down a cataclysm!

And each move of this saber technique is capable of destroying worlds, each mastered to the extreme is no weaker than the Twenty-Third Sword! In fact, most of the saber moves are stronger than the Twenty-Third Sword.
This is because Ding Ling’s saber moves can easily destroy both the body and the soul!
Whether it’s the Six Paths of Annihilation or Heaven and Earth Shattered, it’s the same.
Clang!
The Half-God fought back fiercely, using everything he had learned in his life, but still was no match. Shocked, he didn’t hesitate to dive into a seam in the Sea of Space-Time.
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow, sheathed his saber, and followed with a step forward. The next moment, he stepped into the Sea of Space-Time, seeming to shift stars and transform space-time.
It was as if a long time had passed, yet like just a blink of an eye.
Ding Ling’s eyes brightened, and upon looking again, he seemed to be in another space-time.
He scanned the surroundings.
The sky was blue, and the water was clear.
Below was a sea.
A few small islands dotted the sea.

The Half-God had landed on one of the islands, hidden in a crevice among the rocks, his presence almost indistinguishable from a stone. Even if the ruler of the Demon Realm came and didn’t look carefully, he would definitely not find the Half-God.
This was because he only had a phantom spirit body left, and this spirit body was still in a state of constant birth and death, much like the moon in the sea.
With such a figure, if he wanted to hide, who could find him?
But Ding Ling’s Martial Dao True Understanding included a paired martial art: ’Seeking Truth Dao Eye’!
Once activated, this Seeking Truth Dao Eye.
Can find and lock on to any creature under the Heavenly Dao, anything that has existed.
At this moment, Ding Ling’s eyes glowed brightly, his whole being shrouded in the Qi of time and space, making him appear hazy, mysterious, and powerful.
He suddenly targeted the island below and struck with a palm.
Heaven-Flipping Palm!
All Things Return to Void!

With this palm, an immense Qi force accompanied by the rolling Power of Wind and Cloud was unleashed, transforming midair into a colossal palm capable of annihilating everything, slamming down on the island with a thunderous sound!
The island shattered into countless pieces as a result.
Faintly.
Ding Ling seemed to hear a cry of agony and a voice of curse from the Half-God.
"I’m unwilling~~"
"How can he be so strong!"
The voice was faint, barely audible unless listened to attentively.
[Received C-level Achievement Medal: Intimidate the Half-God.]

[Note: The Half-God had a fortunate encounter, merging with the Time Gear, becoming nearly immortal. But due to the collapse of his space-time, he became a non-existent person. If he leaves the Sea of Space-Time, he will completely annihilate. To deal with you, he even made a deal with demons...]

chapters.title: Chapter 753 - 742: The Buddha Might Be Dead
paragraphs: [...The body and spirit of the Half-God have become the possessions of the demon. This allows him to traverse the gaps in the Sea of Space-Time. However, even so, he still died by your hand. Before his death, he was filled with despair, unwillingness, pain, anger, and sorrow! Only because his wish, his task, were not completed!]
Hearing the prompt sound.
Ding Ling, feeling relieved, couldn’t help but think:

"Originally, the Space-Time World where the Half-God resided was real, but the continuous arrival of players and ascenders made the future space-time of the Half-God increasingly unreal, until recently when a closed time loop formed, their time-space completely vanished, and the Half-God became a nonexistent person of the future."
This future person can only exist within the Sea of Space-Time.
If it weren’t for merging with the Time Gear, he might have completely vanished into nothingness.
Thinking of the Time Gear.
Ding Ling activated the Seeking Truth Dao Eye, and within an instant, locked onto the radiant, exceedingly unreal wheel deep in the sea.

He reached out to grab this gear, but suddenly from another dimension above the sky, a shocking Demon Palm emerged, slapping heavily towards Ding Ling’s head, seemingly trying to crush Ding Ling into broken mud!
"Such familiar qi sensation."
Ding Ling also slapped down with a palm, boom!
The two gigantic palms clashed in the void, colliding, the Ultimate True Intent flooded and surged at the sky’s peak, tearing even the sky apart with massive cracks!
"Fierce Demon!"

Ding Ling raised an eyebrow, recognizing the owner of the demon palm as the demon who had previously destroyed the World Association. He prepared to strike down this demon, suddenly sensing the strong rejection of the Power of Space-Time, the world also seemed angry due to his action in Different Space-Time, rumble! An Eye of Celestial Punishment appeared indistinctly in the depths of the void.
The demon palm seemed frightened, and with a flash, retracted to an unknown Earth Realm.
"Ding Ling. Let me handle him. You can go to the Divine Realm first without worry."
A gentle voice suddenly entered his ear.

Ding Ling was startled, looking up, he vaguely saw the Great Sun Buddha smiling at him with a flower in hand, Ding Ling felt relieved, needless to say this Fierce Demon must be the great demon from the Demon Realm, even the Great Sun Buddha of this space-time was alarmed.
Ding Ling hesitated no more, jumped up, and in the next instant, was out of this Space-Time Realm.
Not long after he left.
On a smaller island not far from the one he shattered.
Stood a dignified and tall man, staring dumbfoundedly at everything happening.
He was none other than...
Lü Bu!
"Oh my heavens!"
Lü Bu felt his scalp tingle, his liver and gall split, as if his soul was lost, murmuring:

"Is this world so terrifying?! If I’d known, I wouldn’t have ascended. It’s too terrifying. The aftermath alone is enough to easily crush ten thousand of me to death! Despite thinking I could dominate a side even in the Upper Realm, now it seems, I’ve thought too much."
A cold wind blew.
He involuntarily shivered, upon closer sensing, he realized he was drenched in cold sweat, the sweat soaking his clothes:
"I must find a backer! Otherwise, relying on my own strength, to become such a strong person, when will that happen during the Year of the Monkey?! Who to rely on?"
A silhouette instinctively emerged in Lü Bu’s mind.
It was the prince Ding Ling who had rampaged invincibly in the Three Kingdoms world!
"Prince..."
"He should be very strong!"

"Seems he was invincible in the Lower Realm. With his talent and capabilities, he should also be very strong in the Upper Realm. I’ll inquire and find out. If he truly is in this world, and doing well, I must go to him! This world is too frightening. Without a pillar, how can I sleep well!"
Ding Ling came and went swiftly.
And at the time, the Seeking Truth Dao Eye locked onto the Half-God with just a glance.
Hence, he didn’t carefully observe the surrounding people, objects.
Therefore, he didn’t know about Lü Bu.
Though even if he knew, he wouldn’t care much.
He was already the strongest in the Human Realm, so he needn’t overly concern what his subordinates think.
He just needs to ensure that this subordinate can be a good general, lead soldiers well, manage one region properly.
He is the Human Emperor!
He is the world’s strongest, with his presence, the world won’t be chaotic!
Tap tap!
Ding Ling returned to the Celestial Ladder once more.
He hurried along the Celestial Ladder tap tap.
A period of time later.
Arriving at the Divine Realm.
Ding Ling shouted loudly:
"Buddha, Buddha!"
A golden line appeared out of thin air, falling straight in front of Ding Ling.
Ding Ling bowed respectfully, then said:

"I wish to inquire of my Buddha. Who exactly was the owner of that Demon Palm I encountered in Different Space-Time just now? Why did he appear at the World Association to wreak havoc? And intend to kill me?"
The golden line trembled, turning into a brush, beginning to write in the air.
Lines of golden characters rapidly appeared in the void.
Ding Ling carefully looked at them.
It turned out the master of Demon Realm is named Poxun.
Poxun is the Yu Realm King of the sky he transformed. He is the origin of all ’demons’ in this world!
With him present, demons won’t be extinguished.
Only by vanquishing him can demons gradually disappear into nothingness, and all calamities, tribulations, naturally fade away too.
Conversely.
If Poxun doesn’t die, the Future World’s annihilation, humanity’s total extinction, will almost become an inevitable fact, simply because Poxun is the demon of the sky he transformed.
He is the true Demon King not existing among these dimensions!
The descending Poxun to this world.
Is merely a thought of the Demon King.
"So, could my Buddha also be a thought?"
Ding Ling was horrified.
"You could say that."
The pen formed from the golden line wrote swiftly:
"But I have long lost contact with the true self. Maybe the true self has died, for all I know."
Ding Ling didn’t believe the Great Sun Buddha would die.
That is the Buddha of the Western World!
Transcending immeasurable space-time, above Daluo Immortal!
Of course, this is the Great Sun Buddha Ding Ling learned about from novels, movies, TV dramas, etc.

In his impression, understanding, the Great Sun Buddha is extremely powerful, terrifying, but now a ’clone’ formed from a thought of the Great Sun Buddha says the true self has died?! Does that sound absurd?
[I know you don’t believe it. I also hope it’s not true, otherwise, it’d be too frightening.]
The ’Golden Pen’ quickly wrote characters in the void.
The true Great Sun Buddha hasn’t appeared, indicating he is still suppressing demon nature, unable to split his focus.

[But I am now truly an independent entity. After countless years, I have long since developed my own soul, body, and thoughts. I am no longer just a thought of the Great Sun Buddha. I can also be considered a person!]
[I both hope the true self is dead and hope he is not.]
[If he dies, I can truly live for all eternity without perishing. If he lives, he can easily destroy and melt me with just a thought!]

chapters.title: Chapter 754 - 743: Tathagata’s Full-level Dharma Body
paragraphs: Ding Ling saw this.
He was solemn and silent.
The Golden Pen continued to write swiftly.

"But I also do not wish him dead. For if he were to die, the Buddha would dwindle while demons flourish; the inevitable decay and corruption by demons like those of autonomous realms would pervade the Ten Thousand Realms, and by then, no world, including mine, could escape this fate. Hence, I hope he can live well."
Ding Ling was puzzled.
"If the Buddha were to die, how could Poxun be safe?"
"This I do not know," it wrote with a slight tremor of the golden line, and continued,
"After all, it’s highly likely that Poxun is just a thought of the lord of the autonomous realms. I cannot sense whether the true being, or Poxun for that matter, is truly dead."
"Who was the fierce demon I clashed with in the Different Space-Time?"

"He is the Evil Body Yann Da, one among the trinity split from Poxun. He is a sinful incarnation of Poxun from the Demon Realm, full of the will to slaughter and destroy, aiming to overthrow the entire world!"
"Trinity?"

"Indeed, Poxun consists of the Evil Body Yann Da, Wisdom Body Midada, and Nüti Nüya. But that’s Poxun of long ago. Since the ancient war of gods and demons, Poxun has changed greatly in form. Now, whether he still remains a trinity, I am unsure. But one thing is certain, Yann Da’s evil ventures persist, forcing me to send forth a Good Buddha to combat him."
"Oh?"
Though enlightened, Ding Ling still puzzled:
"If the Buddha is entangled with Yann Da, then why did he appear at the World Association?"

"This brings up the matter of his capability. He possesses extremely high offensive power, and appears and disappears like a phantom, but before the great battle of gods and demons, he still lacked the ability to sense spacetime oscillations. Yet, at some unknown point, he acquired this skill, easily sensing spacetime disturbances, leaping from one plane of existence to another.
His arrival at the World Association, undoubtedly due to sensing spacetime ripples. Needless to say, you were there at the World Association, hence your disruption caused Poxun’s sudden emergence."
"I see."
Ding Ling resolved his inner doubts, yet felt a bit uneasy.
It turned out the Sword Saint’s death was directly caused by him.
And the calamity that befell the people of the World Association was indirectly caused by him too; had he not traversed spacetime, none of these causes and effects would have arisen!
"Don’t blame yourself. You needn’t overthink it."
The Golden Pen swiftly inscribed:

"In destiny’s binding, all unfolds as it shall. The battle I fought against the Evil Body Yann Da lasted long, and he was wounded, necessitating the absorption of others’ evil thoughts and fears to restore himself. Even if he did not slaughter at the World Association, he certainly would have targeted another group.
Therefore, do not fault yourself. There is no need for remorse."
At hearing the Great Sun Buddha speak these words,
Ding Ling’s heart steadied somewhat, and he inquired,
"With this understanding, do you know the whereabouts of Yann Da now?"
"He lives within me."
The Golden Pen wrote:
"He and I have merged. It comes to either his demise or my survival!
Ding Ling was filled with admiration.
The surviving ancient predecessors, many of whom deserved his respect.
He promptly declared his intention to head to the Demon Realm.
"May your journey be smooth,"
The Golden Pen rapidly penned mantras and heart techniques:
"These are basic methods I know, remember and study them well."
Ding Ling glanced through them one by one.
Quickly.
"Wisdom Fist Seal Full Level"
"Dharma Seal Full Level"
"Vajra Realm Seal of Freedom Full Level"
Dozens of Martial Arts Primordial Spirit Level skills.
"Tathagata’s Full-level Dharma Body"
"Great Sun Buddha’s Light Scripture Full Level"
These are the two Primordial Spirit-level techniques.
Comparable to the Inner Canon of Huangdi and the Xuanyuan Heart Scripture.
One focuses on Body Refining.
Another on Buddhist cultivation.
To reach full level, the difficulty is as high as ascending to the heavens.

But in a flash, Ding Ling attained full level in all, his entire being radiating with golden light, with trails of Buddha Light rising from his body, and circles of Buddha Rings forming behind his head.
Rendering Ding Ling akin to the arrival of a true Buddha.
The Golden Pen trembled, plainly, the Great Sun Buddha was equally astonished, and directly wrote:

"I always knew your talent surpasses those of ancient times, unmatched by anyone. To witness it today allows me to broaden my horizon. Ding Ling, I can no longer spare attention elsewhere. Even the Golden Pen is beyond control now. Carry this Golden Pen. Should you obliterate Poxun, I shall surely sense it and come to congratulate you then."
As soon as this line was written,
The Golden Pen softly fell from mid-air.
Ding Ling reached out and caught the pen.
It felt as light as a feather, without weight, yet solid as a Divine Weapon, the tip sharp enough to pierce through the Void World, clearly a Buddha Treasure.
He bowed towards the void, then proceeded towards the Celestial Realm without hesitation.
Whoosh!
He used the Flowing Light Escape Skill, transforming himself into a beam of light between heaven and earth, covering dozens of miles in mere moments to arrive in the Celestial Realm.
The Celestial Realm still evoked a sense of vastness, solemnity, and grandeur.
Ding Ling’s gaze surveyed the surroundings, aligning at the main seat in the Main Hall of the Celestial Realm.
There sat a person.
Reduced to nothing but bones, yet merely sitting there imposed the aura of the master of the Ten Thousand Realms, an unmatched presence.
"So the Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan is truly dead."
Ding Ling meticulously searched but no longer saw that wisp of remaining spirit, he lamented deeply in his heart.
That wisp had imparted the Xuanyuan Heart Scripture to him before dispersing right after recounting its words.
Needless to say.
Had it not imparted its knowledge to him.
This last soul could have persisted longer.
And yet, even so, it unhesitatingly emerged to pass on its teachings to Ding Ling, because it regarded him highly, placing all hope and wagers upon him.
"Even if for myself, I am determined to annihilate this notion of Poxun! Not to mention that upon my shoulders lie the expectations and hopes of all these predecessors!"
Ding Ling solemnly bowed to the remains of the Yellow Emperor, then transformed and vanished within the realm.
Moments later.
Ding Ling reached the Demon Realm.
He began a rampant slaughter.
Boom!
With each Celestial Patrol Step he took, he traversed seven to eight miles, casually flipping a Heaven-Flipping Palm to abolish all things, causing swathes of demonic beings to perish.
The Martial Dao True Understanding within him vigorously operated, absorbing the demon qi from afar.
Although Grandmaster level demon soldiers and Shattering level demon generals were of no use to Ding Ling, incapable of enhancing him,
Tens and hundreds were ineffective,
Yet thousands and tens of thousands couldn’t be discounted!
Sometimes, from sheer numbers,
These energies, fully purified and refined by Martial Dao True Understanding, could still produce a strand of Martial Arts True Qi.
And such a strand of Qi could penetrate and collapse a Shattering Great Perfection expert with ease!
Woosh, woosh!
Ding Ling’s presence was like a hurricane passing through, akin to a natural disaster descending.
With one Heaven-Flipping Palm of All Things Returning to Void,
Everything shattered and returned to the ruins!

chapters.title: Chapter 755 - 744: Breaking Through the Demon Realm
paragraphs: The cries of agony, roars, and howls echoed incessantly, resounding at Heaven’s Edge.
Ding Ling ignored them.
He struck down one giant palm after another, chasing and killing these demons.
A period passed without encounter.
This group of demons once again spread everywhere, swarming densely, seemingly endless.
There were too many.
Once Ding Ling killed all these demons, his power would surely increase significantly.
[Inner Power Value +1]
[Inner Power Value +1]
The Martial Dao True Understanding is indeed worthy of being a War Immortal Level technique!
It absorbed strands of demon qi from a distance effortlessly.
If it were the original Xuanyuan Heart Scripture or Demon Scripture, it would definitely not achieve this.
In the past.
Ding Ling needed to get close, place his hand on them, to absorb and refine their overwhelming demon qi, while ensuring their body’s main part was not too damaged.
Things were different now.
Ding Ling directly blew them apart!
The demon qi within their bodies would disperse into the void.
Even so, it would still be completely absorbed and refined by the ever-turning Martial Dao True Understanding!
Most of these demons were Grandmasters, Shattering Initial Tier Level.
To Ding Ling.
Their demon qi’s quality and level were too low, far too low.
They were simply trash, utterly useless.
But the Martial Dao True Understanding is powerful because even if it’s trash, it can extract a strand of essence!
Thus.
Wherever Ding Ling passed, not a single demon was wasted, all were smashed and crushed!
All Things Return to Ruins!
Raging Sea and Furious Waves!
Wind-Rolling Clouds!
The various moves of the Heaven-Flipping Palm were unleashed by Ding Ling one by one.
A casual palm strike could change the color of the sky and earth, and every palm drop was like a descending celestial tribulation, leaving the demons defenseless and inescapable!
They died amidst wails and roars.
"Dust returns to dust, soil returns to soil. Since they have succumbed to the demons and lost their minds, why linger in the world to assist evil?"
Ding Ling sighed.
These Celestial Soldiers and Generals demons were once heroes.
What a pity.
Ding Ling struck down with a palm, transforming it into a thousand-zhang giant palm, boom! Hitting the ground, often easily destroying tens of thousands of tightly packed demons!
If magnified tenfold, Ding Ling could even cast a ten-thousand-zhang giant palm, but this consumed too much True Qi, it wasn’t necessary to waste it here.
Ding Ling intended to save it for dealing with true experts!
Earlier, he used the ten-thousand-zhang giant palm to prevent the Half-God from escaping.

After all, the Half-God had fused with the Time Gear, making it as elusive as ghosts and gods, immortal, extremely peculiar, Ding Ling directly chose to annihilate Ten Thousand Techniques with one forceful blow! Once covered with a slap, as expected, the Half-God was killed by him!
Compared to the Half-God, these demons were naturally incredibly weak.
Ding Ling dealing with them did not require his full strength.
A small test of the ox blade.
He easily harvested swaths, groups at a time.
[Inner Power Value +1]
[Inner Power Value +1]
With a palm strike, tens of thousands of Demon Soldiers and Generals were smashed into broken mud! Powder!

The thousand-zhang giant palm swooped across, as if Heaven itself were raging, palm after palm booming down, rocking the Demon Realm with tremors, upheaving Heaven and Earth, a cacophony of ghostly wails and wolfish howls resounded throughout the Demon Realm.
"This feeling isn’t bad."
Ding Ling raised his brows slightly:

"Other than me being able to enter the Demon Realm, no one else can. Now only I can exterminate these demons. Therefore, I must sweep all demons clean here first. Let’s clear out the places thick with demons first."
This feeling of killing tens of thousands, even hundreds of thousands of demons with one palm strike.
Is truly satisfying!
Even the unrivaled act of mowing down doesn’t compare to this.
"Now if I return to the real world and get angry, with a tenfold increment, a single palm strike might easily smash a small town, no?"
Ding Ling was moved:
"This is just the Golden Core Level. What if I reach the Primordial Spirit level, will my every move be akin to a walking atomic bomb?!"
"Unknowingly, I have evolved and grown to this state."
Ding Ling’s confidence soared.
His sense of security skyrocketed to a great height.
Previously, he hid around in the real world, afraid of being targeted by enemies, or being watched by overly curious foreign capitalists.
He didn’t want to waste time dealing with these people.
Hence, he stayed hidden in the deep mountains and forests, with little contact with outsiders.
Especially as he grew stronger and stronger.
He could go ten days or half a month without food, and contact with outsiders became even less.
"The higher level the Achievement Medal, the more powerful the energy contained."
"If I exchange power back to reality, I only need to use the high-level Achievement Medals, and I won’t worry about energy issues."
As Ding Ling grew stronger.
His understanding of Achievement Medals naturally deepened.
He didn’t have a clear distinction before.
But since he last exchanged power back to reality.
He sensed a great influx of abundant energy into his body, which was energy from the Achievement Medals.
This very energy caused his power to rise rapidly, also relieving the problem of hunger.
But if he used the lowest-level ordinary medals to exchange for power.
The energy would be insufficient, possibly needing ’rice’ and ’meat’ to supplement the energy.
And lately, Ding Ling has been using high-tier Achievement Medals, so he doesn’t have this trouble.
"Game, reality..."
"Truly amazing!
Ding Ling marveled not just once.
Boom!
He continued to strike at the demons.
Now he lived quite well in the deep mountains and forests, so there was no need to return to the cities of the real world, he didn’t forget his goal, immortality, unrivaled across the heavens!
Currently, his lifespan is only thirty-two thousand years.
There’s still a long way to immortality!
He must keep striving.
Boom boom boom!
Thousands upon thousands of demons were effortlessly killed and crushed by Ding Ling, his power soared like a rising tide, climbing continuously.
As he killed from east to west, from west to north, from north to south.
After almost a full circle around the entire Demon Realm.
[True Power Value: 302 drops]
He forcibly increased by 51 drops of True Water.
Rising from 251 drops to 302 drops.
Crossing a whole tier.
"Middle Tier Golden Core."
Reaching Middle Tier Golden Core.
Ding Ling’s power multiplied!
Not only has his True Qi’s tier, quality, and True Intent become stronger and higher.
But his skills have also risen along with it, able to unleash higher tier might.
The previous skills could only exhibit basic power.
Now they can unleash Initial Tier power.
Future progression to unleashing Middle Tier power is also within reach.
"Very good."
Ding Ling was thoroughly satisfied.
This time he circled the Demon Realm once.
The number of demons killed is immense.
He himself couldn’t recall how many he killed.
But it’s estimated to be at least tens of billions.
"Tens of billions of demons..."
Ding Ling took a breath.
"How long was I killing?"
Roughly calculating.
It was merely a few days.
This shows Ding Ling’s efficiency in killing enemies is incredibly high, even mowing down grass isn’t this quick!
"Now it’s time to go to that Heaven-Reaching Demon Mountain."
Ding Ling deliberately avoided the Demon Mountain while killing enemies.
To avoid unnecessary problems, to deal with the Demon Emperor and others after becoming stronger.

chapters.title: Chapter 756 - 745: Rain Master of the Divine Race
paragraphs: Nowadays, Ding Ling’s strength has made great progress.
The various techniques previously transmitted by the Great Sun Buddha were perfectly melded with the Martial Dao True Understanding.
Now the Martial Dao True Understanding has become even stronger.
It possesses all the essence of the Tathagata’s Dharma Body, Great Sun Buddha’s Sutra of Radiant Light, Dharma Seal, and Vajra Realm Seal of Freedom.
As Ding Ling’s thought moved,
the current Protective Gang Qi naturally carries the protective effect of the Tathagata’s Dharma Body, dispelling evil demons and radiating Buddha Light!
"The Great Sun Buddha’s magic and skill are still somewhat low-level. It seems the thought-based Great Sun Buddha didn’t receive the true inheritance of the Great Sun Buddha himself."
Ding Ling pondered:
"I wonder what thought the Great Sun Buddha himself has. Why didn’t he pass down something more powerful?"
Too stingy.
Not even one Martial Immortal-level technique and skill was passed down.
This makes it difficult for the likes of the Great Sun Buddha to break through the world’s shackles and transcend to other worlds, doesn’t it?
"Could it be deliberate? Just to keep the thought of the Great Sun Buddha in this realm?"
Ding Ling couldn’t think clearly and didn’t dwell on it.
Instead, he took steps toward the Heaven-Reaching Demon Mountain.
Not long after he left, two figures appeared amid the wind and rain, none other than the Nine Heavens Profound Lady and the Rain Master.
Both were as beautiful as celestial beings, with extraordinary grace, embodying both divinity and demon nature.
At this moment, they looked at Ding Ling’s distant figure with shock, murmuring:
"This man is terrifying!"
The Rain Master looked at the Nine Heavens Profound Lady:
"Sister, you fought him before. Was he this strong at that time?"
"No."
The Nine Heavens Profound Lady shook her head in disbelief:
"It’s been such a short time, yet he’s evolved to this level! It’s somewhat hard to believe."
"How much progress has he made?"
"His strength has at least increased a hundredfold!"
The Nine Heavens Profound Lady spoke with certainty:

"Before, I could still fight him for a few rounds. Now, I don’t even have the courage to face him! He now gives me an immeasurably grand sense of supremacy, much like when we face the Demon Emperor, very powerless!"
The Rain Master was frightened, her eyes wide open:
"Strength increased a hundredfold in such a short period. How did he do it?!"
"I’m curious too."
The Nine Heavens Profound Lady’s expression was dazed:

"But I don’t dare to deal with him anymore. If we hadn’t joined forces to transform into clouds and rain in the sky just now, we would have long been discovered and killed by him. Better not get too close to him."
"But sister, we are demons."
The Rain Master worried:
"If the Demon Realm collapses, where will we go?"
"We’ll take it one step at a time."
The Nine Heavens Profound Lady was confused:

"Now besides the Demon Emperor Mountain Range, the other places in the Demon Realm are almost devoid of demons. Even if there are some, they are deeply hidden and adept at concealment. Ding Ling doesn’t want to waste time dealing with them, but once he kills the Demon Emperor, he will surely have time to sweep through the Demon Realm again. At that time, those demons who escaped calamity will surely face death again."
"What about us then?"
The Rain Master was fearful:
"Won’t we be targeted by Ding Ling too?"
They knew Ding Ling’s name through interactions with Demon Emperor Poxun.
And Poxun was quite knowledgeable about Ding Ling’s situation, allowing the Rain Master and Nine Heavens Profound Lady to indirectly understand Ding Ling.
"It’s highly likely."
"...Sister, I don’t want to die."
The Rain Master, tears in her eyes, cried with pity:
"I want to live well."
"I don’t want to die either."
The Nine Heavens Profound Lady pondered:
"If nothing else works, maybe we should surrender to Ding Ling."
"But he’s a righteous person. As the Jiuzhou Human Emperor, he’s completely at odds with us demons. Would he take us in?"
The Rain Master worried.
"...I don’t know either."
The Nine Heavens Profound Lady frowned:
"I had a conflict with him before. If he holds grudges, surrendering may not be a pleasant experience."
"He’s the Jiuzhou Human Emperor; magnanimity and tolerance should be his nature. I’m not worried about that."
The Rain Master, with beautiful eyes, and elegant demeanor, looked at the demon energy rising from her palm:
"What I’m most worried about is our inherent difference; one is human, one is demon. Historically, humans and demons have been incompatible. He wouldn’t allow us demon leaders into the Mortal World."
"We could suggest guarding the Demon Realm for him?"
"That’s a good idea."
The Rain Master’s eyes lit up but quickly dimmed:
"But we are demons."
"What about being demons?"
The Nine Heavens Profound Lady glanced deeply in the direction of the Demon Emperor Mountain Range:

"Whether Ding Ling can defeat Poxun is still a question. If Ding Ling is killed, then we needn’t worry anymore. If he wins, and we have no choice, we’ll flee to the Celestial Realm, then the Divine Realm."
"We are demons. We’ll die if we go to the Celestial Realm."
The Rain Master was terrified, as if recalling something, shook her head repeatedly:
"I won’t go to the Celestial Realm.
[Obtained D-level Achievement Medal: You intimidated the Nine Heavens Profound Lady.]
[Obtained C-level Achievement Medal: You intimidated the Rain Master.]
[Note: The two witnessed you effortlessly shock to death the tens of billions of Demon Realm Great Army. Your awe penetrated their bones!]
Hmm?!
Just as Ding Ling stepped into the Demon Emperor Mountain Range, he heard a notification sound, startled.
He knows the Nine Heavens Profound Lady.
He obtained an Achievement Medal from her before.
Now getting another one, but it dropped to D-level.
And the Rain Master?
"Is she the Palace Master of the Demon Palace? Or who?"
This time Ding Ling pulverized the tens of billions Demon Realm Great Army.
Also intimidated two Palace Masters of the Demon Palace, obtaining two C-level Achievement Medals.
These two Palace Masters were suppressing the south and west as two Demon Kings.
They reached the Golden Core Realm but didn’t condense the Golden Core, ranking as C-level experts.
They, along with tens of thousands of demons, were easily killed by one slap from Ding Ling.
There are four such Palace Masters.
The Wind God suppressed the east, serving as the Eastern Demon Palace Master.
This Wind God was the one Ding Ling killed the first time he stepped into the Demon Realm, and it took quite an effort to deal with him.
But now?
Ding Ling killed two Palace Masters of the same level as the Wind God with just a slap!
He consecutively suppressed three Palace Masters.
But he hasn’t found the fourth Palace Master.
Thinking now, the Rain Master is most likely the Palace Master of the northern Demon Realm.
He rampaged in the north, slapping tens of thousands of demons dozens of times, ultimately crushing a subterranean Demon Palace.
He didn’t hear any notification then.
He realized the Palace Master might have already fled. It seems he was right.
"Where did she run off to?"
Ding Ling looked back, and the world was filled with rolling demon energy, mist shrouding the sky, and unpredictable winds and rain.
"Is there still rain in the Demon Realm?"
Ding Ling turned to investigate further.

chapters.title: Chapter 757 - 746: Growing Stronger
paragraphs: Suddenly, the storm expanded rapidly, then instantly dissipated, leaving nothing behind.
Ding Ling paused, hesitated for a moment, then once again stepped into the Demon Emperor Mountain Range:
"Let me deal with the numerous magic creatures in this Demon Emperor Mountain Range before addressing other issues."
Ding Ling was well aware that many magic creatures in the Demon Realm had not yet been slain by him.
But on the surface, he had eliminated them all.
The Demon Realm was vast, nearly equivalent to half the earth.
Ding Ling was in a hurry, so he roughly struck out in all directions, sweeping through the regions with brutal force.
Thus, he did not meticulously check or search the ten directions.
The same was true in this Demon Emperor Mountain Range.
Ding Ling dashed into a cave.
Then delivered a punch!
Divine Emperor Fist!
Ice and Fire Dual Heaven!
As the punch landed.
A huge fist seal, enveloped with the power of ice and fire, lightning-fast charged into the cave, then began to erupt thunderously, with just one punch!
It shattered countless magic creatures in the cave, numbering no less than two hundred thousand!
This punch was akin to an ’enhanced bulldozer’, plowing through everything relentlessly;
More like an autumn breeze sweeping away fallen leaves, carrying with it an Unrivaled Skill!
[Inner Power Value +1]
[Inner Power Value +1]
Ding Ling absorbed the swirling Demon Qi from the air.

The Demon Qi from a full two hundred thousand Shattering Level magic creatures was absorbed by the Martial Dao True Understanding into his body, then rapidly refined into a strand of Martial Arts True Qi!
Ding Ling was very satisfied.
Because the quality of the magic creatures here was much higher.
"Most of the magic creatures outside are at the Grandmaster Level, with a few at the Shattering Level."

"Killing such magic creatures undoubtedly improves efficiency!"
Ding Ling delved into one cave after another.
Punch after punch!
Ice and Fire Dual Heaven!
Wind and Thunder Wings!
Overwhelming Clouds!
Solitary Peak Cold Plum!
Mountains and Seas Inverted!
The Vastness of Heaven!
Each supreme technique of the Divine Emperor Fist was unleashed by Ding Ling, with each punch embodying the true meaning of fist dao, capable of easily smashing tens of thousands of magic creatures.
In open ground with a palm, the attack range was vast! The efficiency of killing enemies was high!
In the narrow, dim caves, using a punch, one strike, similar to a lightning bolt, thundered in, amid the crackling sounds, tens of thousands of magic creatures shattered!
In these caves, undoubtedly, using fists was more appropriate.
Ding Ling moved from one cave to another.
Punch after punch, killing hundreds of thousands to millions of magic creatures, as easily and naturally as eating and drinking.
As he kept on.
The magic creatures were completely terrified and frantically fleeing.
But how could they be faster than Ding Ling?
Ding Ling unleashed the Wind and Thunder Wings.

The fist radiance seemed to have grown wings, carrying the power of wind and thunder, swiftly catching up with the large army of magic creatures, then thunderously penetrating through and smashing them!»
"No wonder it’s a War Immortal Level fist skill."

This fist skill was only initially unlocked; if fully unlocked, the power it would unleash could only be imagined.
The reason it was only initially unlocked.
Was naturally due to Ding Ling’s insufficient cultivation strength, not enough to wield the ’full form’ of this Divine Emperor Fist!
[Inner Power Value +1]
[Inner Power Value +1]
Drop by drop of True Water condensed in the Dantian.
Then slowly merged into the Saint-Grade Golden Core.
The Saint-Grade Golden Core became increasingly hard, pure, and powerful!
By the time Ding Ling slew from the mountain foot to the peak that pierced the clouds, he had already killed billions of magic creatures.
The quality and level of these magic creatures were far higher than those on the plain.

The True Water still accumulated up to 47 points.
[True Power Value: 349 points]
Only two points away from the High Tier of the Golden Core.
"Still lacking a bit. Unfortunately, the magic creatures here have all been slaughtered by me."

Now the Initial Tier of Fourth-Grade Golden Core Demon Gods could only contribute about 300 points.
The Initial Tier of Ninth-Grade Golden Core Demon Gods might only give about 150 points!
The Initial Tier of the Golden Core is also divided into varying strengths.
The strong ones like First-Grade could overwhelm Third and Fourth Grades.
The Third and Fourth Grades could overwhelm the Ninth Grade.
Thus, the Initial Tier of Ninth-Grade Golden Core cultivators didn’t provide much assistance to Ding Ling anymore.

But at most, he could only challenge strong opponents at the Initial Tier of Ninth-Grade Golden Core Primordial Spirit.
But now, as he was about to step into the High Tier.
He could already challenge strong opponents at the Initial Tier of the Second-Grade Golden Core Primordial Spirit!
"Second-Grade?
Ding Ling looked towards the direction of the Demon Emperor Palace:

"According to Senior Female Drought Demon, the Ancient Gods’ Golden Cores were mostly Third, Fourth, and Fifth Grades. Only the strongest like the Great Sun Buddha and Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan were Second and First Grades. So what grade would this Demon Emperor Poxun be?"
Ding Ling pondered the words of the Great Sun Buddha.
He speculated that Poxun might be a First-Grade.
"If Poxun is a First-Grade, it would be best if I step into the High Tier form to truly defeat him!"
After Ding Ling’s Martial Dao True Understanding reached Full Level, he had become very knowledgeable about these phases of the Golden Core, Primordial Spirit, Dharma Aspect, and War Immortal.
Therefore.
He could approximately sense the level of his current combat power stage.
"Continue!"
Ding Ling charged towards the direction of the Demon Emperor Palace.
Sure enough.
This time he saw several Guardians again.
Ding Ling was not surprised but pleased.
He employed a capture technique, void-handling these magic creatures, effortlessly killing them with a slap.

[Inner Power Value +280]
[Inner Power Value +160]
Three heads of magic creatures.
The stronger one was at the Initial Tier of Third-Grade Golden Core.

From beginning to end, these magic creatures never reacted.

These were all well-known figures among the Ancient Divine Race.

An even stronger Martial Dao True Intent explosively surged from Ding Ling’s body.

Reaching this level now,
He had a premonition.
That he could suppress strong opponents at the Initial Tier of First-Grade Primordial Spirit!
And the Demon Emperor?
According to the Great Sun Buddha, it was merely at the Initial Tier of the Primordial Spirit Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 758 - 747: Demon Emperor Poxun
paragraphs: Ding Ling took a step to the very center of the square of the Demon Emperor Palace, his eyes blazing as he looked towards the depths of the Demon Emperor Palace.
Sure enough.
The next instant.
A gigantic hand reached out from the depths, coming down to strike him directly!
Rumble!
This palm covered the sky, as if the heavens were collapsing, seemingly about to overturn the entire Heaven and Earth Realm!
Ding Ling took a deep breath, drew his saber like lightning, and slashed heavily forward!
Celestial Cry Saber Technique!
All Things Return to One!
Clang!
Clang, clang, clang!

In the blink of an eye, thousands upon thousands of sharp and dazzling saber lights appeared in the void. Some slashed horizontally, some vertically, some diagonally. Thousands upon thousands of saber lights appeared, each embodying a different sword intent, each aiming to strike the massive hand in its own way.
In just an instant.

The saber lights violently collided with the giant hand amidst a thunderous roar! This collision was like a massive clash between the sky and the earth, with an extreme energy shockwave emanating from the point of their intersection, destroying everything in its path.

To the naked eye, the exquisite and luxurious Demon Emperor Palace began to crumble and shatter, and the cavernous world, like a little world, began to tremble continuously. Cracks appeared with creaking sounds on the ceiling of the cave!
"How is this possible?!"
In a voice filled with astonishment.
Boom!

The ten thousand blades that clashed evenly with the gigantic hand suddenly merged into an unprecedented giant saber. With a cracking sound, the giant hand was split in two, and the giant saber continued its downward path, with a booming sound, it directly split the Demon Emperor Palace wide open!
Revealing the inner Heaven and Earth Realm.
In the depths of the Demon Emperor Palace, in the center of the throne in the main hall, sat a person, looking incredulously at Ding Ling.
He had one head, four faces.
One face was ferocious, a fierce demon Ding Ling had seen earlier.
One face was soft and charming, a woman’s form.
One face was cunning and yin-soft.
One face was benevolent like a Buddha.
His body intertwined with demon nature, divinity, and Buddha-nature, appearing extremely strange, making it difficult to discern his true form!
"Demon Emperor Poxun?!"
Ding Ling flashed to the main hall, his eyes like blades staring at the person on the throne:
"Four in one? It seems a great transformation has indeed occurred within you!
Poxun paused, scrutinizing Ding Ling with an expression full of shock and uncertainty:
"What on earth happened to you?! How could you become so terrifying in such a short time?!"
"Are you Poxun? Then there’s no mistake."
Ding Ling didn’t want to waste words with Poxun and directly swung his saber to strike again!
Celestial Cry Saber Technique!
Six Paths of Annihilation!
The dazzling saber qi transformed into six paths that seemed capable of decaying and withering everything, spreading swiftly toward Poxun like lightning.
"This kind of sword skill?!"
Poxun was shocked:
"Never seen or heard of it! How could a mere mortal possess a skill that transcends the Martial Arts Primordial Spirit Realm and execute it to such flawless perfection?! Who exactly are you?!"

Poxun dared not resist the saber and opted to escape into the void, his form instantly transforming into dots of black light, dissipating within the main hall. In the next instant, he appeared on the square.
Rumble!
The saber qi landed where Poxun had just been seated, instantly decaying everything into emptiness! Turning to wind!
Half of the grand hall vanished into thin air under this saber.
As if it had never existed, snatched away in large part!
"This sword skill!"
Poxun was flabbergasted, unable to believe:

"As the Demon Emperor of the Demon Realm! The strongest in the Three Realms and Six Dao, even the Nine Heavens Profound Lady, Limu, and other divine beings submit to my command! Even Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan, Great Sun Buddha have been defeated by me! How can a mere boy like you possibly defeat me?!"
He couldn’t believe it; enraged, he struck a powerful palm toward Ding Ling!
Heaven-Destroying Fierce Palm!
As the palm struck, even the sky seemed to collapse, and a force of ultimate destruction condensed in the palm wind, landing in front of Ding Ling in a flash of lightning and fire.
Ding Ling countered with a saber strike.
Celestial Cry Saber Technique!
Three Reincarnations!

As the saber technique was unleashed, one could see the palm wind of the Heaven-Destroying Fierce Palm starting to swirl backward impossibly, spinning back with increased speed, slamming into Poxun with the strange saber qi, erupting in a roaring sound.
This saber, formless and silent, yet powerful enough to overturn reincarnation!
Poxun, caught off guard, felt as if he had spun three times in reincarnation.
The four-in-one Dharma body.
Three incarnations were obliterated in an instant.
Leaving a single, soft and charming female form of Poxun.
She was Nüya, one of the four-in-one forms of Poxun!
But still retained Poxun’s consciousness body.
At this moment, all consciousness bodies of the four-in-one existed in Nüya’s mind; she looked at Ding Ling in shock:
"What sort of saber skill is this?! How can it reincarnate me three times?! Deplete the power I painstakingly accumulated over countless years! Transform me into Nüya form?!"
Poxun’s skills and laws were also very strong.
Both had reached the Peak of Primordial Spirit.
But when faced with Ding Ling’s Martial Immortal Level skill, he was utterly outmatched.
Ding Ling now in cultivation could contend with Poxun.
And in skill level, he completely crushed Poxun.
Which resulted in the current situation.
Ding Ling had no need to join forces with the Female Drought Demon.
He single-handedly overpowered Poxun.
Seeing his success.
Ding Ling laughed heartily, each saber strike swifter than the last, aiming at Poxun.
Celestial Cry Saber Technique!
Thunderous Slash!
The saber slashed out like a thunderbolt, too fast for the naked eye to discern. In an instant, the void was densely packed with saber light, the saber light like a net descending toward Poxun.
Poxun wanted to flee.

But he was confined near the Demon Emperor Palace, unable to escape further; realizing there was no escape, he roared and executed the supreme skill ’Forest of Ten Thousand Transformations,’ transforming into a grand Senluo Hall, crushing toward Ding Ling.
Yet he knew the chance of victory was slim, intending to perish together.
Ding Ling saw clearly and was unafraid, casually wielding various sword techniques!
Heaven and Earth Shattered!
Leaves Fall in the Cold of Autumn!
Three Reincarnations!

The sword techniques unleashed, sometimes shattering heaven and earth, exploding the hall, sometimes freezing, piercing the entire hall! With Three Reincarnations falling again in the center of the hall.
Poxun’s last form of Nüya was instantly transformed by this saber into a girl, and then through several more transformations, into a resplendently blooming flower.
The flower rooted in the depths of the void, hanging in mid-air, swaying, bewitching and beautiful.
"After three reincarnations, Poxun has become a flower? What kind of flower is this?"

chapters.title: Chapter 759 - 748: Immortal Flower
paragraphs: After carefully sensing there was no danger, Ding Ling plucked the flower.
He stared at the flower, examining it.
He rummaged through various ancient books, histories, and biographies in his mind, unable to find a matching flower.
"Poxun was struck twice by my Celestial Cry Saber Technique, reincarnated six times, and then transformed into a flower! If it continues to reincarnate, will this flower simply vanish into thin air?"
Ding Ling raised his eyebrows, thinking it very likely.
Chiyou was also transformed into air when enveloped by the Reincarnation Blade Intent from the Ten Tribulations of the Evil King.

Yet, the Three Reincarnations of the Celestial Cry Saber Technique are far stronger than the Ten Tribulations of the Evil King. Even ordinary immortals struck by Ding Ling’s move cannot avoid falling from the immortal position! Because this is a Martial Immortal Level skill!
Far surpassing the Primordial Spirit Level skill of the Ten Tribulations of the Evil King!
If the Reincarnation Blade Intent of the Ten Tribulations can instantly reincarnate someone into their childhood;
the Reincarnation Blade Intent of the Celestial Cry Saber Technique can directly reincarnate someone into nothingness!
"Poxun is four entities in one, equivalent to having four lives. With one slash, I made him lose three lives! Then another slash sent him back to his original era."
This flower...
Ding Ling held it in his hand, unable to comprehend it, and glanced at the hint panel.
[Received C-level Achievement Medal: Intimidated Poxun.]

[Annotation: As the sole emperor of the Demon Realm, and the origin of ’demon’ in this land, he is unbelievably powerful to ordinary people. With just one thought, he can make ordinary people wish they were dead and fall into the Demon Dao, serving him!
At first, he ignored you completely. He even disdained to inquire about your information.
Later, once you acquired the legacies of the Great Sun Buddha, Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan, and Chiyou, he started to give you some attention, thinking your existence might be troublesome.
But that’s all.
He still underestimated you. During that time, even a hundred of you wouldn’t be his match.
As time changes.
This time you came prepared and defeated him easily!
Shattered his pride and dignity.
Shook his life view and world view!
He couldn’t believe someone in this world could defeat him so comfortably! Until his death, he remained bewildered, puzzled, and curious, particularly wanting to ask you how you became so strong!]
"No other hints?"
Ding Ling felt a bit regretful.
But earning an achievement medal isn’t bad.
Compared to the C-level Golden Core Level medal.
This C-level Achievement Medal at the Primordial Spirit Level contains energy at least ten times stronger!
To describe it properly, this Primordial Spirit Level Achievement Medal should be C+ level.
Unfortunately, this game hint doesn’t deal with C+, C— labels. It’s straight-up C.
Evidently, C— and C+ both belong to the C category.
"Does this flower seem to automatically absorb some kind of energy from the depths of the void to grow?

Ding Ling stared at the flower, temporarily calling it the Poxun Flower, with four colors and intertwined energies of demon, buddha, dao, and ghost weaving among the petals. It sprouts only four roots underneath, seemingly weightless, yet appears capable of anchoring into the deep void.
As for exactly where the roots are?
Ding Ling actually cannot perceive it!
"This is an Immortal Flower!"
Ding Ling categorized it:
"In such a short time, it absorbed quite a lot of special energy."
Ding Ling ran his Martial Dao True Understanding and directly drained the special energy within the Poxun Flower.
[Inner Power Value +1]
[Inner Power Value +1]
"Hmm."
Ding Ling’s eyes gleamed:

"This special energy is so pure. It’s countless times better than the demon qi of Golden Core Strongman from the outside world! If I could absorb and refine this energy daily, breaking through to become a Primordial Spirit wouldn’t be difficult."
At this moment.
Ding Ling finally understood why Poxun had become the Demon Emperor.
This kind of divine ability and capability is simply unbeatable.
"Not bad, not bad."
Ding Ling was quite satisfied, placing the flower inside the Storage Pouch.
Even stored within the pouch.
This flower can still root deep into the void, truly extraordinary.
"No wonder it could contend back-and-forth with the thoughts of the Great Sun Buddha, even slightly gaining the upper hand as the king in the Demon Realm!"
However, this Poxun seems to merely be the thought of the true high-dimensional autonomous heavens sun lord.
Thinking about it.
Ding Ling felt somewhat terrified.
"Responsibilities are heavy and the road is long; I’m still too weak."
Realizing Poxun was a thought transformed by a superior entity, Ding Ling’s initial joyous mood calmed down.
"There’s still a long way for me to go; I can’t let this get to my head, I must strive forward in the flow and put in my best effort!"
Ding Ling took a deep breath.
He glanced at the Demon Emperor Palace, activated the Seeking Truth Dao Eye, instantly locating a concealed door in the sky.
He instantly flashed in front of the door, knocking on it.
Bang bang bang!
Like pebbles falling into the water, waves of splashing bang sounds echoed all around.
After a while.
The voice of the Female Drought Demon rang out:
"Ding Ling. How is it you?! I just sensed the revival of the Demon Emperor, and while I was exerting all my effort to suppress him, his aura suddenly disappeared. What exactly happened?
Ding Ling felt relieved.
He was puzzled about why the Female Drought Demon hadn’t appeared.
Turns out she was busy suppressing Demon Emperor Poxun.
This also explains well why Poxun, facing Ding Ling’s overwhelming Three Reincarnations, did not run but chose to fight.
It’s not that Poxun didn’t want to escape.
He couldn’t escape!
Thinking upon this.
Ding Ling briefly explained the cause and effect.
The Female Drought Demon listened, her eyes widening in shock, her face full of dazed disbelief:
"This, this, this, is this true?!"
Due to extreme shock.
Her hair curled!
"It is true."
"Incredible."
Bang!
The door opened wide.
The Female Drought Demon dispelled the Techniques and Laws used to suppress the Demon Emperor Palace, feeling noticeably more relaxed in that instant.

It turns out that she had been using her own essence to suppress the Demon Emperor Palace, and upon confirming Poxun’s death, she withdrew some of her essence; originally withered, she suddenly regained a lot of spirit.
With this wave of essence renewal.
Plus the Martial Dao True Understanding that Ding Ling passed on to her for refining.
As an Immortal Zombie Ancestor, she’s now very hard to kill.
She fears no demon qi of the Demon Realm, thus this time she walked straight through the door, entering the Demon Emperor Palace, carefully observing everywhere, becoming more and more moved:
"Unbelievable! You, you, you..."
She looked Ding Ling up and down:
"Remarkable young generation! Truly worthy of being an extraordinary figure of the new era, worthy of being Jiuzhou’s Human Emperor, the beacon of hope favored by the Great Sun Buddha and my father."
She spoke with growing happiness:
"I’m thinking my father and the others will be speechless with excitement upon hearing of your accomplishment."
Impatiently:
"I’ll go share this achievement with the Great Sun Buddha and the others now."
Without waiting for Ding Ling to stop her.
She already vanished inside the door, with a brief bang sound; Ding Ling knew the Female Drought Demon had set foot on the Celestial Ladder path leading to the Divine Realm.

He stared at the flower, examining it.
He rummaged through various ancient books, histories, and biographies in his mind, unable to find a matching flower.
"Poxun was struck twice by my Celestial Cry Saber Technique, reincarnated six times, and then transformed into a flower!

chapters.title: Chapter 760 - 749: Meeting Tathāgata
paragraphs: Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan is dead.
Ding Ling originally wanted to say these words, but the Female Drought Demon had already left, so Ding Ling remained silent.
This matter can only be realized by the Female Drought Demon herself, perhaps it would be better that way.
But now Poxun is dead.
The Great Sun Buddha should soon be liberated too.
Poxun in his fourfold form.
The evil body Yann Da, who had committed countless crimes outside, was suppressed to death by the Great Sun Buddha!
Now he is even suppressed deep in the heart of the Great Sun Buddha.
With the death of Poxun, Yann Da, only one part of the whole, will also vanish into emptiness.
After all...
Poxun was struck by the Three Reincarnations.
There’s no way Yann Da could still survive.
"Although I don’t know why Poxun, having clearly split off Yann Da, could still be in a fourfold form, I think the death of the true body must influence the external entities."
He isn’t the Great Sun Buddha’s true body across countless worlds.
But merely a martial dao primordial spirit level expert in this world’s realm.
How mighty could the split-off Yann Da possibly be?
Yet the Great Sun Buddha still had to strive desperately to suppress him, which shows the Great Sun Buddha must also be extremely weakened.
As is the Female Drought Demon.
Using portals, otherworldly spaces, divine coffins, and extremely powerful arrays to suppress the Demon Emperor Palace was barely possible, let alone defeating Demon Emperor Poxun.
Thus.

The Female Drought Demon and her companions have intentions to remove demons, but no power to rescue the world. As they awaited the world’s decay in desperation, Ding Ling emerged, causing the Female Drought Demon unimaginable excitement and joy.
Now Ding Ling has truly succeeded.
Surely the Female Drought Demon would eagerly share this victory with the Great Sun Buddha and others, which is only natural.
"It’s time to sweep the Demon Realm."
With one step, Ding Ling stepped out of the Demon Emperor Palace again, arriving within the cave of the Demon Emperor Mountain Range.
In various parts of the cave, there were still some demons who had luckily escaped his slaughter.
Ding Ling activated the Seeking Truth Dao Eye, beginning to lock onto the sources of the demon qi fluctuations.
Once locked onto, the Flowing Light Escape Skill activated, spanning thirty miles in an instant, hardly any demon could evade his punches!
"The speed is getting faster."
Before entering the Demon Realm.
He could only span a dozen miles in an instant.
Now it’s thirty miles.
This is still the ordinary speed without a tenfold amplification.
If amplified, it would be even faster!

But amplification consumes too much true qi! Ding Ling couldn’t endure it for long, simply because the Flowing Light Escape Skill is an immortal level skill, amplifying such an immortal level skill consumes energy immensely.
But as long as he dashes in ordinary speed, Ding Ling does not have to worry about energy consumption, simply because the ordinary skill pairs perfectly with the Martial Dao True Understanding.
Almost as the technique is concluded, the Martial Dao True Understanding automatically runs to recover.
The recovery speed is fast enough to balance the consumption.
Thus in an ordinary state battle, Ding Ling could fight for months! Even years!
But with a tenfold amplification, the consumption could not keep up with recovery, hence it could not last long.
Days later.
Ding Ling met with the Great Sun Buddha and the Female Drought Demon in the Demon Realm.
They actively summoned Ding Ling.
So Ding Ling followed the call.
When he saw the Great Sun Buddha again, his spirit was radiant, his body was full of Buddha light, and his face returned to normal, no longer half demon, half Buddha in a bizarre form.
He joined his palms and said ’Amitabha Buddha,’ then smiled:

"Truth be told, I have much to thank you for, Ding Ling. Had it not been for you, I would likely have perished with the evil body Yann Da. Now because you vanquished Poxun, Yann Da is like rootless water; I wore him down over several days and thoroughly eradicated him!"
He seemed to be very pleased:

"Now I’ve achieved great freedom and liberation. All of this I owe to you, Ding Ling. I heard from the Female Drought Demon that you wish to learn magic and skill. Later when I have the time. You come to find me, I will teach you all I have learned and known."
Ding Ling expressed his gratitude.
The Great Sun Buddha returned the gesture:

"I dare not say so, I dare not say so. Indeed, Ding Ling, you are the Jiuzhou Human Emperor, the leader of the human realm. In the ancient era, your position was akin to the Master of the Celestial Realm. How can I accept your bow? In the future, we shall interact as equals. You need not be so polite to me, just call me the Buddha."
Ding Ling’s strength is unrivaled.
Completely aweing the Great Sun Buddha.
He had considered Ding Ling partnering with the Female Drought Demon might be slain by Poxun.
Or perhaps at best heavily injure Poxun, causing him to slumber for millennia, shelving for millennia of peace and tranquility.
Never had he dared to imagine Ding Ling might perish along with Poxun!
Let alone Ding Ling outright killing Poxun;
Thus.
When the Female Drought Demon recounted Ding Ling’s combat results, the Great Sun Buddha was astounded!
At the same time, he suddenly comprehended why the evil body Yann Da had suddenly retreated and refused to battle, it turned out Yann Da’s true body Poxun was dead!
At the time, he was surprised and overjoyed.
Though he had encouraged Ding Ling many times, wishing Ding Ling victory.
He was merely encouraging, hoping.
He could not believe this junior Ding Ling could defeat such a monstrous figure like Poxun!
After all, even the Ancient Gods could not defeat the great demon, how could Ding Ling achieve victory single-handedly?
But the results were indeed a slap in the face!
[Received C-Level Achievement Medal: You have earned the deep admiration and recognition of the Great Sun Buddha!]

[Comment: Your combat achievements are glorious and brilliant! And so unbelievable, so incomprehensible! The Great Sun Buddha is extremely amazed and impressed! His emotion is extraordinarily intense, unprecedented, and he may find it difficult to calm down his mind soon!]
Upon hearing the notification.
Ding Ling was relieved, seeing the Great Sun Buddha insist, he changed to calling him ’the Buddha.’
The Female Drought Demon also intimated that Ding Ling need not call her elder, just her name.
Ding Ling accordingly changed and called the Female Drought Demon by her name directly.
As for Ding Ling.
The Female Demon and the Great Sun Buddha found him exceptionally pleasing to the eye in every respect.
After lavishing Ding Ling with praises, they discussed the matter of the Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan, evidently having many mysteries regarding him too.
Ding Ling then revealed the truth, even relating verbatim the words Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan had spoken to him.
The Female Drought Demon and the Great Sun Buddha listened quietly.
The Great Sun Buddha joined his palms:

"Amitabha Buddha, Good indeed, good indeed. For the Three Realms and Six Paths, countless common souls, the Master of the Celestial Realm willingly sacrificed himself, truly great selflessness, great virtue!"
"Father."
The Female Drought Demon’s beautiful eyes seemed to shimmer with tears, becoming blurred, but only briefly, she collected this melancholy emotion, gazing at Ding Ling:
"With the Xuanyuan Sword and Xuanyuan Heart Scripture having an heir like you, surely my father in the heavens would also be incredibly comforted."
After the three of them talked for a while.
They began to sweep through the Demon Realm again.
All three are strong.
Especially Ding Ling, once the Seeking Truth Dao Eye is activated, no demon can escape his ’magic eye’!
Many demons skilled in concealment were detected and killed by him.
The Nine Heavens Profound Lady and Rain Master hidden in the high heavens, amidst clouds and rain, were forced into corners by Ding Ling’s Seeking Truth Dao Eye.
