chapters.title: Chapter 761 - 750: I Am a God, Not a Demon
paragraphs: It seemed unavoidable now.
The Rain Master trembled with fear, tearfully clutching the Nine Heavens Profound Lady, her voice quivering:
"Sister, I don’t want to die."
The matter of Ding Ling killing the Demon Emperor.
The Rain Master was the first to sense it.
Because the Demon Palace and the Demon Emperor Palace were closely connected.
As the master of the Northern Demon Palace, she naturally knew most clearly about the situation in the Demon Emperor Palace’s territory.
Although she couldn’t fully sense the condition of the Demon Emperor, she could clearly feel that the connection between her and the Demon Emperor Palace had been severed.
After that.

She saw Ding Ling rush out of the Demon Emperor Mountain Range, stepping on the void, his eyes blazing as he scanned the surroundings, hunting the experts of the Demon Realm! Yet, the Demon Emperor was nowhere to be seen.
There was only one conclusion:
That the Demon Emperor Poxun had been killed by Ding Ling!
"Who wants to die?"
The Nine Heavens Profound Lady sighed, her beautiful eyes full of shock:
"The mighty Demon Emperor Poxun, an unrivaled being with four lives! How did he die?"
"Exactly."
The Rain Master’s enchanting face was etched with panic:
"Even the combined might of top experts from the Celestial Realm, Demon Realm, Divine Realm, and the Human Realm lost to Poxun. How did Ding Ling kill Poxun all by himself?!"

"It is indeed perplexing to think about. Although the Celestial Realm and others joined forces to suppress Poxun in this tiny space of the Demon Emperor Palace, preventing him from leaving, one could say that the Celestial Realm won. But in essence, it was Poxun who won because he was unharmed. Meanwhile, the Celestial Realm, Demon Realm, Human Realm, and other realms became shattered and their status fell several levels!"
The Nine Heavens Profound Lady was bewildered, confused:

"Until now, only the Celestial Realm, Demon Realm, and Divine Realm can host a Supreme Venerable Level being! And their existence is unique, bound to certain special divine objects of their respective worlds. Without this binding, they cannot reach such a Supreme Realm!
Meaning, Ding Ling likely defeated Poxun, who was at the Primordial Spirit Realm with four lives, while still at the Golden Core Stage."
"This is unbelievable."
The Rain Master was shockingly timid:
"How much of a prodigy and monster must Ding Ling be to succeed in reverse ascension to such a degree?!"
"He is indeed a terrifying human.
The eyes of the Nine Heavens Profound Lady flashed with a deep-seated fear:
"If he were born in the Ancient Era, he would definitely have become a Sovereign at the Primordial Spirit level. We..."
The Nine Heavens Profound Lady didn’t finish her sentence, as the Rain Master suddenly tugged on her sleeve, pointing to the Lower Realm, her beautiful eyes tearing up, trembling uncontrollably:
"Sister, he, he, he’s coming."
Boom!
Ding Ling indeed noticed the commotion above the Nine Heavens, then without hesitation, he threw a punch.
Divine Emperor Fist!
Heaven-Scorching Earth-Burning!

This punch unleashed an extremely fierce flame of pure, righteous energy, turning into blazing fire, shooting straight up the sky like a meteor, scorching and piercing through all demon energy and clouds in its path.
This aggressive and blazing fist was the nemesis of demon energy.

The Nine Heavens Profound Lady and the Rain Master, always cautious of Ding Ling, quickly dodged sideways when they saw him throw a punch, but even so, they couldn’t help crying out miserably when they were brushed by the aftershocks of the punch, blood oozing from the corners of their mouths, unable to maintain their cloud-and-rain state, plummeting from the high sky.
Still in mid-air, they saw Ding Ling preparing to punch them again, and both were frightened to death.
The Rain Master directly knelt in the void, bowing to Ding Ling, shouting loudly:
"Human Emperor, spare my life, Human Emperor, spare my life, I am the Rain Master of the Divine Race, I am willing to surrender!"
Her whole body was shrouded in shifting mist and rain.
Her presence was divine, demonic, and saintly, truly a demoness among demons, seductive and stunning to the extreme.
Her kneeling caused endless rain to pour from the Demon Realm.
It was the source within her acting up, being the Rain Master, with rain following wherever she went, which was the norm.

Her whole being seemed made of water. As she knelt and cried, it was as if the whole sky wept with her, with rain furiously pouring down, except the area around the Rain Master, which was the same as usual elsewhere.
This anomaly naturally caught the attention of the Female Drought Demon and the Great Sun Buddha.
After seeing clearly the Rain Master and the Nine Heavens Profound Lady kneeling in the void, their expressions were extremely subtle.
"Humph."

Ding Ling, with a heart of stone, was unmoved, ready to throw another punch to obliterate the two demonesses. The Rain Master and the Nine Heavens Profound Lady were terrified, and the Rain Master wept more intensely:
"Human Emperor, spare my life..."

Seeing Ding Ling’s expressionless face, the Rain Master instinctively looked to the side and saw the Female Drought Demon and the Great Sun Buddha rushing over. She cried out as if finding her savior:
"Sister Female Drought Demon, save me!"

The Rain Master’s call to the Female Drought Demon as "sister" resonated deeply within the Female Drought Demon, making her reminisce about their past friendship, and with a long sigh, she dashed in an instant to stand before Ding Ling, speaking gently:
"Ding Ling, perhaps you shouldn’t kill them."
"Why?"
Ding Ling was puzzled:
"They are demons."
"But they are also gods."
"Female Drought Demon, didn’t you say that when the Divine Race falls to demonification, they are beyond salvation?"
Ding Ling was even more confused.
"There is salvation, there is!"

The Rain Master’s ears had been attentively listening to Ding Ling and the Female Drought Demon’s conversation. Upon hearing this, without waiting for the Female Drought Demon to speak, she interjected:
"My obsession is merely to survive different from others in the Divine Race. So I am salvable."
"Indeed."
The Female Drought Demon added:

"If there are no other demonic thoughts or desires, only the obsession to survive, then it’s easier to resolve the demon within her heart. Especially now that Poxun, the root of all demons, has perished, this world is no longer the source of demon energy. As long as the Rain Master diligently practices the Buddhist technique, nurturing herself with Buddha Qi, over time, the demonic energy within her will be purged, restoring her to the Divine Race."
"Yes, yes, yes!"
The Rain Master nodded vigorously:
"I am a god, not a demon!"
"Alright."

Ding Ling, upon hearing the Female Drought Demon’s words and seeing the Rain Master trembling with fear and tearful, couldn’t help but use his observing people skill, which was full level, to see that the Rain Master wasn’t pretending.
He found it strangely fascinating.
The Rain Master was actually a woman, and such a cowardly, frightened, and clever woman at that.

It seemed that habits are hard to change, and the Rain Master’s cowardly nature must be innate, so it’s understandable that under the fear of death, she was tainted by demon energy and became a demon.
Fortunately, Golden Core Stage demons still retain their intelligence, and after Poxun, the ’root of all demons’, died, the other demons are like rootless water, with a slight hope of recovery.
Demons below the Golden Core Realm are completely insane, lacking any intelligence, and thus have no hope of salvation.
"What about her?"
Ding Ling pointed at the Nine Heavens Profound Lady.

chapters.title: Chapter 762 - 751: Inheriting the Buddhist Technique
paragraphs: The Nine Heavens Profound Lady’s expression changed slightly, she couldn’t help but tug on the Rain Master’s sleeve, hoping the Rain Master would say a few good words to help.
The Rain Master looked pitifully at the Female Drought Demon and Great Sun Buddha:

"Sister Female Drought Demon, Buddha, Sister Profound Lady has always taken good care of me. Moreover, her mind has been becoming clearer and far superior to many people in the Divine Race. I believe she can recover by herself."
"The Nine Heavens Profound Lady had remarkable achievements in the Ancient Era. Her assistance to the human realm was also immense."
Great Sun Buddha joined his palms together and said:

"If one can recognize their mistakes and improve, nothing is greater. Although the Nine Heavens Profound Lady is a demon, Poxun is now dead, and the demonic nature in her heart has become like rootless water. As long as she practices righteous techniques and Buddhist techniques day and night in the Celestial Realm, purifying her heart of demon Qi with Heaven and Earth’s Righteous Qi, we can consider forgiving her."
The Female Drought Demon also spoke from the side.
Ding Ling thought for a moment and agreed.
The Nine Heavens Profound Lady and the Rain Master are both people from the Ancient Divine Race.
Just as Great Sun Buddha said.
Their help to the Human Race is not to be ignored.
Giving them a chance is not impossible.
The Nine Heavens Profound Lady and the Rain Master were overjoyed to see Ding Ling agree, quickly falling to the ground, kneeling, kowtowing to Ding Ling:
"Thank you, Human Emperor, for sparing us, thank you!"
"You should ascend to the heavens yourselves."
Ding Ling coldly glanced at the two women:
"If you haven’t eradicated the demonic nature in your hearts and dare to corrupt the human realm, I won’t forgive you."
"I wouldn’t dare, I wouldn’t dare."
The Rain Master turned pale with fright:

"I will definitely heed the Human Emperor’s words. Absolutely won’t run around. However, my abilities are relatively weak, and I dare not go to the Celestial Realm where righteous Qi flows vigorously, I’m afraid I’ll turn to ashes."
"I will lend you a helping hand."
The Female Drought Demon said:

"Bitter medicine cures disease. Your demonic nature is deep, and only in a place with such vigorous righteous Qi as the Celestial Realm can you thoroughly cleanse your inner demonic nature, awaken true divinity, and become a member of the Divine Race again."
Ding Ling initially wanted to kill the Nine Heavens Profound Lady and the Rain Master.
But the Female Drought Demon and Great Sun Buddha seem to have quite a good relationship with them.
Ding Ling may not give face to the Rain Master, but he must give face to the Female Drought Demon and Great Sun Buddha.
Moreover, they promised that without reawakening the divinity in the two women, they would never let them leave the Celestial Realm, so Ding Ling trusted them.
Thereafter.
Great Sun Buddha and Ding Ling went aside, spending days and nights to impart all his knowledge and Buddhist techniques to Ding Ling.
[Buddha Qi +9 paths]
After listening to Great Sun Buddha’s teachings on various high-tier Buddhist scriptures and studies, Ding Ling’s Buddha Qi surged by 9 paths, and his other techniques all reached full level.
Under the vast Buddha Qi, he appeared even more solemn and majestic, resembling a living Buddha.
Great Sun Buddha praised:
"If Ding Ling, you had been born at the top of the Infinite Realm, where my true body resides, with your status, becoming a true Buddha is just a matter of time."
Ding Ling agreed.
He has cheats.
Whatever he learns reaches full level.
He is confident that even if he goes to high-tier worlds like Journey to the West, he can instantly reach full level in various immortal and Buddhist techniques.
However, this game world must be conquered level by level and cannot directly jump to high-tier worlds like Journey to the West.
Ultimately, it lies in.
Building a deep, solid foundation.

If one directly masters immortal and Buddhist techniques without a solid foundation, Ding Ling would still be strong, but with a solid foundation, mastering Buddhist and immortal techniques would take him even further.
This is easy to understand; the path one can walk with or without a foundation is naturally different.
"I’ve said all the techniques I needed to. I should take the Nine Heavens Profound Lady to the Celestial Realm."
Great Sun Buddha joined his palms together, looked at Ding Ling, and smiled slightly:

"The fact that this world can give birth to a genius like Ding Ling is truly the blessing of the people and the fortune of the heavens and earth. It’s also fortunate for me, Great Sun Buddha, and the Female Drought Demon! If you have any matters in Jiuzhou, you can come to the Celestial Realm to find me, and I’ll help if I can."
"Alright."
Ding Ling nodded and said:
"We’ll meet again."
Great Sun Buddha and the Female Drought Demon took the Nine Heavens Profound Lady and the Rain Master away.
The Rain Master and Nine Heavens Profound Lady almost leaped away, as if they were being pursued by fierce beasts, which showed their deep fear of Ding Ling that had reached their souls and bones.
When they flew far away.
The Rain Master then looked at Great Sun Buddha:
"Buddha, you taught the Human Emperor just now, but he seemed to understand everything instantly and cultivated the Buddhist techniques and studies to Great Perfection. Is my perception mistaken?!"
The Nine Heavens Profound Lady turned her gaze; she also sensed the same, and at first thought it was an illusion, but how could one continue to have illusions for several days?
So by the end, she was increasingly shocked and numb, with her amazement, admiration, awe, and fear towards Ding Ling growing day by day!
"You didn’t perceive incorrectly."
Great Sun Buddha said respectfully:
"Ding Ling is the most gifted, extraordinary talent I’ve seen in my lifetime! His comprehension and talent are incredibly strong, to an unbelievable extent!"
"Really?!"
The Rain Master gaped and marveled:
"How can someone be so powerful that they instantly reach Great Perfection in the Buddhist techniques and studies you’ve learned? This is too irrational."
"Indeed."
The Female Drought Demon also wore an amazed expression:

"As everyone knows, The Buddha’s Buddhist techniques and studies are the most profound and difficult to understand. In the Ancient Era, few Buddhist disciples were able to cultivate Buddhist techniques to Great Perfection, let alone all Buddhist techniques to be Great Perfection. But Ding Ling did it. In just a few days, all Buddhist techniques reached Great Perfection; it’s terrifying."

"There’s nothing strange under the skies. But someone as unique and extraordinary as Ding Ling is truly hard to find a similar example throughout ancient and modern times. Ding Ling is one of a kind, and special."
"No wonder he’s the Human Emperor who can overthrow and kill Poxun."
The Rain Master looked relieved:

"With such powerful talent, it’s no surprise he can reverse defeat Poxun, doing what the Ancient Gods could not. If in the Ancient Era, our gods had someone like Ding Ling to assist, many of our Divine Race wouldn’t have turned to demon nature."
"Yes, why didn’t Ding Ling appear earlier..."
After sweeping through the Demon Realm, Ding Ling.
Returned to the human realm.
He reorganized the court, handled accumulated major affairs, and then began to let Little Zhao preside over state governance.
Little Zhao couldn’t believe it:
"Your Majesty, you..."
"I might soon ascend and leave."
Ding Ling smiled at Little Zhao:

"I trust your character and abilities. Plus, with the Emperor’s Sword I gave you, you will manage the human realm with ease. If you really encounter trouble, you can follow the path I laid out for you to reach the Otherworldly Space and seek help from Senior Female Drought Demon and the others. They will lend you a hand."

chapters.title: Chapter 763 - 752: Empress Little Zhao
paragraphs: The issue of succession for the Human Emperor in the Wind and Cloud World.
Ding Ling contemplated giving it to Nie Feng and others, but ultimately he chose Little Zhao.

Not for any other reason, just because Little Zhao, besides being his empress and one of his own, is most importantly, strong enough to stabilize the human realm, with no one daring to act recklessly.
In Jiuzhou, the Ascenders are numerous, and players are becoming more and more.
Without absolute strength, it’s impossible to hold this group of pivotal figures.

You must know, among these figures, there is no shortage of ambitious and rebellious individuals. Their willingness to submit to Ding Ling does not mean they would be willing to submit to Nie Feng and others.
Normally, they are ministers of the court with equivalent status, suddenly elevating Nie Feng to the emperor would make anyone feel unbalanced!
But if Little Zhao becomes empress, that’s another matter entirely.
After all, Little Zhao is the empress, so succeeding as empress is perfectly logical, isn’t it?
Of course.

Besides her status and strength, it’s also because Little Zhao possesses the demeanor of a great general, intelligent and clever, totally not inferior to women like Zhao Min, willing to take responsibility, with a strong sense of duty, and extremely gentle and kind.
Such an empress is perfectly suited to be the ruler during a flourishing era!
Little Zhao initially refused.
But Ding Ling insisted.
So she complied with Ding Ling and chose to accept.
Ding Ling was worried that Little Zhao would become too responsible, so he gave a couple of admonitions:

"Although you have become empress, ordinarily you can delegate tasks to the Prime Minister and others, all you need to do is control the general direction and ensure no chaos arises in the human realm. Don’t forget, our goal is immortality."
The Magic and Skill of the Martial Dao True Understanding.
Ding Ling also passed it to Little Zhao.
After spending some time, Little Zhao successfully transitioned to cultivate the Martial Dao True Understanding.
Now her strength is formidable enough to crush Emperor Shitian!
Not to mention, Ding Ling also gave her the Emperor’s Sword.
With the fiftyfold amplification from the Emperor’s Sword, Little Zhao’s strength is comparable to strong individuals at the Second Grade even First Grade Golden Core Stage!
Of course.
At the First Grade Golden Core Stage, it’s almost impossible for the Emperor’s Sword to amplify further.
This is why Ding Ling did not continue using the Emperor’s Sword.
The limit of the Emperor’s Sword is around the Initial Tier of the First Grade Golden Core.
Ding Ling holding it is like holding an ordinary treasure sword, so it’s better to give it to Little Zhao, with this Divine Sword and fiftyfold amplification, she can roam the human realm, unmatched!
"I will listen to Your Majesty."
Little Zhao gazed at Ding Ling, her eyes as gentle as water, and softly said:
"I want to be with Your Majesty for a thousand, ten thousand, a hundred thousand years, forever and ever."
After she finished speaking, her face suddenly blushed and she said:
"Your Majesty, it’s getting late. Let’s rest."
She paused, suppressing her shyness, and said:
"Let Little Zhao properly take care of you."
Ten days later.
Little Zhao successfully ascended the throne.
Becoming the Empress of the Wind and Cloud World!
"Long live Our Emperor!"

Nie Feng, Bu Jingyun, Duann Lang, Zhao Min, Youruo, Divine Calculator, Shangguan Jinhong, God of Capture, Wuming, Mingyue, Zhang Wuji, Lü Bu, Guan Yu, Wang Bodang, and others, all gathered in the main hall of the court, kneeling before Little Zhao, with solemn expressions, each calling out to Our Emperor.
"Beloved ministers, you may rise."

Little Zhao, draped in an imperial robe and crowned, her stunning face revealing a blush that might be excitement, anticipation, or possibly all three. Her grandeur and grace, her sharp eyes holding a powerful, mind-reading presence, scanned the entire room as she waved her wide sleeve, an unparalleled majestic aura emanating from her.
Nie Feng, Bu Jingyun, and other ministers, captivated by her presence, bowed deeply:
’Thank you, Our Emperor!’
Ding Ling concealed himself on one side, watching clearly, understanding completely, he nodded quietly to himself:
"I truly chose the right person. Compared to Little Dragon Girl, Diao Chan, and others, Little Zhao is more suitable to be an empress!"
Little Zhao is very gentle and considerate but can also remain calm, clever, and resolute in times of change.
At this moment, these qualities are magnified, making her exceedingly dignified, like a grand river flowing fiercely, or the mighty spine of a dragon guarding the mountains!

Seeing Little Zhao become more adept at handling court affairs, gradually dispelling negative emotions like nervousness, Ding Ling became increasingly satisfied and quietly withdrew his attention, turned, and left.
After dealing with government affairs, Little Zhao took off her robes and crown and went to find Ding Ling.
As for the ministers of the court, they left the main hall and discussed among themselves.
Zhao Min, walking with Zhang Wuji, Xie Xun, and others, sighed:
"Our founding emperor of Great Ming was truly wise and insightful. To think of making a woman emperor, from ancient times until now, since Wu Zetian, now I see another empress, truly wonderful."
She was very thrilled.
Because this proved that women can be as powerful as men.

"Your Majesty does not stick to conventions when choosing talents. Talents are selected regardless of relation, appointing worthy individuals without favoritism. On this point alone, how many emperors can be surpassed?
Zhang Wuji glanced around and softly said:
"I know Your Majesty has many concubines in the Lower Realm, but has never heard of letting any of them become emperor, showing Your Majesty’s choices are well-considered."

"Your Majesty’s chosen generals are truly dragons among men. Look at Nie Feng, Duann Lang, Lü Bu, Guan Yu, and others, which one is not a hero of distinguished reputation across Jiuzhou? From here, you can see Your Majesty’s extraordinary vision and courage."
It was not only Zhao Min, Zhang Wuji, and others discussing.
Wuming with his three servants.
Huaikong, Huaimie, Bai Ling with their master Iron God.
Guan Yu with Wang Bodang and others.
Lü Bu with Divine Calculator and others.
Nie Feng, Bu Jingyun, Duann Lang, Mingyue, and others.
Everyone was discussing.
Jiuzhou suddenly changed.
A female emperor now reigns above.
This feeling was very profound.
"Have you not sensed that the current Empress, Her Majesty, has such high strength, capable of easily crushing all of us present?"
Duann Lang suddenly chimed in with a sentence:
"Moreover, in her hands is that legendary Emperor’s Sword that can amplify one’s battle strength by fiftyfold!!"
"I noticed that a long time ago."
Bu Jingyun glanced at Duann Lang and said:

"It is natural that His Majesty would have the Empress ascend to control the court and dominate Jiuzhou, not for no reason. Only those with strength unrivaled in Jiuzhou have the qualification to govern this vast realm! Only such an empress can command my respect, Bu Jingyun!"
For ordinary people.
Bu Jingyun completely disregards them.
But the supreme aura from Little Zhao exerts immense pressure on Bu Jingyun, unparalleled indeed.
He admits that even if it were ten, a hundred of him together, they would not be a match for Little Zhao, how could he not submit?
"His Majesty is truly remarkable, able to personally cultivate such a powerful empress!"
Nie Renwang and Marshal Duann said in unison, then turned to Nie Feng and Duann Lang:
"Your strength is too weak, you must strive harder in cultivation! Aim to reach the pinnacle of the human realm soon!"

Ding Ling contemplated giving it to Nie Feng and others, but ultimately he chose Little Zhao.

Not for any other reason, just because Little Zhao, besides being his empress and one of his own, is most importantly, strong enough to stabilize the human realm, with no one daring to act recklessly.
In Jiuzhou, the Ascenders are numerous, and players are becoming more and more.
Without absolute strength, it’s impossible to hold this group of pivotal figures.
You must know, among these figures, there is no shortage of ambitious and rebellious individuals.
Their willingness to submit to Ding Ling does not mean they would be willing to submit to Nie Feng and others.
Normally, they are ministers of the court with equivalent status, suddenly elevating Nie Feng to the emperor would make anyone feel unbalanced!
But if Little Zhao becomes empress, that’s another matter entirely.
After all, Little Zhao is the empress, so succeeding as empress is perfectly logical, isn’t it?
Of course.

Besides her status and strength, it’s also because Little Zhao possesses the demeanor of a great general, intelligent and clever, totally not inferior to women like Zhao Min, willing to take responsibility, with a strong sense of duty, and extremely gentle and kind.
Such an empress is perfectly suited to be the ruler during a flourishing era!

But Ding Ling insisted.

chapters.title: Chapter 764 - 753: Return to the Three Kingdoms World
paragraphs: "Yes, Father."
Nie Feng and Duann Lang exchanged a glance and then replied in unison.
After spending a few quiet days with Little Zhao, Ding Ling chose to return to the Three Kingdoms.
The chosen location was just outside Luoyang City.
The time was a full moon night.
The reason for choosing this time, naturally, was to avoid disturbing the other ministers.
Accompanying Ding Ling were only Little Zhao and two horses.

Unlike the daytime image of the Empress, both majestic and grand, at night, Little Zhao by Ding Ling’s side was particularly quiet and gentle, her eyes filled with a tenderness as soft as water as she looked at Ding Ling:
"Your Majesty, can’t you take me with you to the Lower Realm this time? I really want to see Little Dragon Girl, Sister Diao Chan, and the others."
Little Zhao had long since thoroughly inquired about Ding Ling’s matters in the Lower Realm.
Only because of Ding Ling’s deeds, few players would not know about them.
Those with intention, after a little bribing of some players, could not possibly not know about Ding Ling having a few concubines.

Although Little Zhao hadn’t deliberately sought out the information, as the Empress, there were naturally players wanting to curry favor with her, so she saw detailed information about Ding Ling in the players’ ’memorials’!
For the women like Diao Chan who accompanied Ding Ling’s rise from humble beginnings, she was naturally extremely curious.
"I can only go to the Lower Realm wearing just one set of clothes, not even weapons can be taken."
Ding Ling sighed:
"So I cannot bring you to the Lower Realm."
"If that’s the case, Your Majesty, you don’t have to feel embarrassed. When the time comes, I believe there will naturally be a day to meet the sisters."
Little Zhao turned around to comfort Ding Ling.
As the Empress.
Sharing a husband with other women.

Little Zhao didn’t think much of it, because she knew that everything she had now was brought to her by Ding Ling; if it weren’t for Ding Ling, she would have been dead long ago. She decided very early on that the rest of her life would be dedicated to living for Ding Ling, so she didn’t care about the grievances of other ministers.
These ministers were representatives of Little Zhao’s feminist supporters, including both players and natives, obviously hoping for Little Zhao to rise and monopolize Ding Ling.
But Little Zhao sharply rebuked these players and natives!

After being reprimanded twice, they realized they had been flattering up the wrong tree. Knowing Little Zhao’s feelings and attitude towards Ding Ling, they dared not say anything disgruntled, though privately there was certainly no lack of discontentment.
Among them, saying that Ding Ling has means to actually subdue the Empress Little Zhao was said to be ’as numerous as cartloads’.
To this, Ding Ling paid no mind.
Not to be envied is mediocrity!
Along his journey, countless people have envied and hated him, if he were to concern himself with all of them, wouldn’t he tire himself to death?
"Mm, it’s best if you think this way."
Ding Ling smiled and rubbed Little Zhao’s head, handed over the Storage Pouch and other items to her, then glanced at the two horses.
These two horses were precisely those Ferghana Horses transformed from eating a Half Qilin Egg.
Nowadays, their scales were increasingly dense, their presence increasingly rich and powerful, already reaching a level that could rival a Grandmaster.
A horse being able to contend against a Martial Arts Grandmaster, crushing countless Innate Experts, what an incredible thing?
Therefore, their speed now was as swift as wind and lightning, unimaginably fast by others!
But even so.
They were almost of no help to Ding Ling.
Therefore, Ding Ling chose to let them each swallow another Qilin Egg.

This time, instead of falling into slumber, with the help of Ding Ling and Little Zhao, their ability to absorb and refine the Qilin Egg increased significantly, with the belief that this Qilin Egg would be digested faster.
Ding Ling had already informed Little Zhao of the method to assist in refining the Qilin Eggs.
In the upcoming period.
Little Zhao would let these two Ferghana Horses consume and refine the remaining Qilin Eggs.
Believing that upon their next meeting, they would have completed a true heavenly transformation.
"Aowoo!"
The two horses neighed affectionately at Ding Ling.
Their voices like a dragon’s roar or a tiger’s growl, just hearing them would be enough to intimidate the courage of enemies.
After exchanging a few words with the two horses, Ding Ling finally hugged Little Zhao and prepared to choose to return to the Three Kingdoms.
[Player Ding Ling, would you like to return to the Three Kingdoms World now?]
[Note 1: There is only one round-trip opportunity. Time is unlimited. And only one set of clothing can be brought to the Lower Realm.]
[Note 2: Please select a fixed location for the round-trip. The world travel location is fixed, no longer random.]
Yes!
[Choice confirmed. Location fixed. Portal opening.]
Kong!
A portal composed of golden light materialized out of thin air.
Ding Ling glanced at Little Zhao and the two horses, then turned around and stepped inside.
In the next instant.
After a dizzying sensation, when he looked again, Ding Ling found himself already standing on the ground.
Surveying his surroundings.
Familiar scenic environment.
"This is Luoyang, isn’t it?"
It’s still Luoyang.
Even the sky was still a full moon night.
"The Wind and Cloud Realm is almost identical to the Three Kingdoms Realm. The only two differences are the concentration of Spiritual Vitality and the differences in forests, plants, and buildings."
Ding Ling took a breath.
Easily absorbing all the Spiritual Vitality within a radius of several hundred meters!
Compared to the vastness of the Wind and Cloud World.
This Three Kingdoms World was like a small pond.
To breed Golden Core Level experts here was almost impossible.
Only because the concentration of Spiritual Vitality was too low.
"Let’s just say the Historical World is the Historical World. It is very suitable for Body Refining, but obviously lacking for Qi Cultivation."
Ding Ling slightly clenched his fist, using a little more force, crackling! The void began to tear apart into black fissures like those of Hongyuan!
Rumble!

An unexpected thunder roared! As if even the Heavenly Dao was shocked and furious, emitting deafening peals of thundering explosions, the initially clear full moon sky swiftly turned into thick clouds, with countless lightnings flashing, and heavy rain pouring down from the sky in no time.
"This world is truly fragile."
Ding Ling was taken aback, realizing that this change in the world was entirely because he hadn’t controlled his strength just now:
"Really afraid of accidentally breaking this world."
In this moment.
Ding Ling comprehended why he couldn’t bring the Human Emperor Saber and other Divine Weapons from the Wind and Cloud World to the Lower Realm.
Humans can freely control their own Vigorous Qi.
Divine Weapons cannot.
Perhaps the Divine Weapon, being too sharp, would directly pierce through the earth and sky, causing severe damage to the world’s heaven and earth!
If that time came and the Heavenly Dao got angry, Ding Ling would suffer misfortune, wouldn’t he?
Although he wasn’t overly afraid of this Historical World’s heavens now.
But if he could avoid conflict with the heavens, that was naturally the best.

After all, at the beginning, the Heavenly Dao was very kind to him, bestowing various Celestial Might blessings, making his life, combat power, defense, speed, etc., extremely strong, enabling him to dominate the Three Kingdoms, becoming an unrivaled force capable of suppressing a nation single-handedly!
"I don’t really need such Celestial Might blessings now."

chapters.title: Chapter 765 - 754: Crossing Hundreds of Miles in an Instant
paragraphs: Ding Ling sensed it very clearly.

Currently, he is a Martial Arts Saint Golden Core high-level strong person, and in terms of cultivation, he can rival a strong person at the Initial Tier of Martial Arts First-Grade Primordial Spirit. In terms of skill, he even crushes Primordial Spirit strong persons.
He is so powerful that he can easily cleave through this sky and shatter this earth.
He has already become a true God and Demon!
And is no longer a ’pseudo-god’ formed only with the support of Celestial Might!
"Even so, one must not forget one’s roots. This world has given me a lot of support and help. I’d better not harm it."
Ding Ling took a deep breath and began to restrain his terrifying Martial Arts True Qi.
These True Qi.
Even a random shot can cleave through mountains thousands of feet high and pierce through the thick ground!
The more worlds he travels through.
The more Ding Ling feels the fragility, poverty, and brittleness of this Historical World!
"The mountains here are pitifully weak."
Compared to the mountains of the Wind and Cloud World.
The mountains here, in terms of texture, layers, etc., are like tofu dregs. Ding Ling feels like he could blow over a small mountain with just a breath.
"Previously, when ascending layer by layer, I didn’t feel much. But suddenly returning to the Three Kingdoms World from the Wind and Cloud World, the feeling is too obvious."
It’s like a person studying, moving from primary school to junior high, and then to high school and university, gradually progressing, without much feeling.
But if a doctoral student suddenly returns to the first grade, it would suddenly become clear how basic and simple it all is.
Ding Ling now has that strong feeling.
It’s like a king who has cleared all levels returning to kindergarten!
And he is not an ordinary king.
But an All-Purpose King with Immortal Level techniques and skills! Far superior to ordinary kings who have cleared the levels!
Therefore, coming here, the feeling of this world’s weakness is even stronger and more lucid!

"It seems unrealistic for Diao Chan and the others to endure in the Three Kingdoms until the Golden Core or even the Primordial Spirit stages. I can only impart skills to them, assist them in building a solid foundation, and then let them ascend to other worlds."
Ding Ling’s descent this time was to teach the Martial Dao True Understanding version 1.0 to Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, so they could cultivate to a certain level smoothly.
That way, they can extend their lifespan by thousands, even tens of thousands of years!
They won’t age and perish quickly, and Ding Ling can pursue strategy in other Xianxia Worlds with peace of mind; otherwise, he would always be worried about them, which is not ideal.
"This time, descending, I must ensure that Diao Chan and the others learn the Martial Dao True Understanding and build a solid foundation!"
"In this way, their lifespan will be indefinitely extended. I won’t have to worry about coming back in a hundred years to find them already reduced to a pile of White Bone."
The world of martial arts is simpler to discuss.
In cultivation, one tends to count by hundreds of years.

Although Ding Ling is overpowered, he worries that if he is not careful, a hundred or even several hundred years may pass, and by then, his beloved could vanish like the wind, which would be his greatest pain.
He cannot accept this.
Therefore.
After forging an earth-shattering Martial Arts Immortal Level technique in the Martial Arts Melting Furnace, Ding Ling couldn’t wait to pass it on to Diao Chan and the others.
Now, as he was about to meet Diao Chan and the other women.
Ding Ling’s mood was quite joyful.
"As far as I know, Diao Chan and the others seem to be nearing the end of their cultivation. In a few months, they might collectively ascend to the Upper Realm. My timing is just right."
Compared to Diao Chan and the others.

The cultivation progress of Zhen Jiang and others is quite slow, but under the guidance of masters like Wang Yue, Tong Yuan, and with the ’infusion’ of unlimited resources, after a few years of training, they are about to reach the level of a Super-Elite Fierce General.
Once they all reach this level, they will ascend and leave.
This is a conclusion Ding Ling deduced by leveraging the intelligence of natives like Guan Yu, Lü Bu in the Three Kingdoms, and various players, as well as self-verification through online research.
"Time to go to Chang’an City."
Ding Ling glanced in the direction of Luoyang.
He hasn’t returned to the Three Kingdoms for years.
Upon seeing it again, Luoyang City had already been reconstructed and rebuilt, splendid in grandeur, no less imposing than an ordinary Royal City.
Ding Ling did not enter the city.
His purpose in returning this time was very clear, which was to help Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, Zhen Jiang, and others cultivate the Martial Dao True Understanding and extend their lifespans!
Therefore.
He did not delay much time. With an Instant Step, he traveled thousands of feet, seemingly teleporting through the void, crossing hundreds of miles in just two breaths to reach another city.
"So fast, so fast.
Ding Ling was moved, contemplating:

"It seems that speed, attack power, and such are indeed related to the solidity of the world. The solidity of this Historical World’s plane is quite ordinary compared to the Wind and Cloud World, lacking in unknown numbers of levels. Therefore, I can easily shatter the void, stepping forward without regard for spatial constraints, akin to teleportation, easily covering two hundred miles in an instant. This speed already resembles that of a Ghost God."
Not only can his attack power easily cut through the Celestial Palace, split open the earth.

Even the speed, without exerting full strength, can cover two hundred miles in an instant, crossing three to four hundred miles in less than two breaths, akin to moving through space-time; this feeling is extremely fantastic.
"Unknowingly, I’ve grown to such an extent."
In the past, Ding Ling needed to rely on Celestial Might to become extremely strong.
But now, he doesn’t need Celestial Might, yet he is a hundred, a thousand, ten thousand times stronger than when relying on Celestial Might!
This is his own actual strength!
Only the power that belongs to oneself can be exercised to the most perfect degree, ignoring the rules of the Heavenly Dao!
"Where is this place?"
Ding Ling thought about it and decided to find someone to ask.
Just now, he indeed did not foresee that he would travel so fast, unable to stop at all, and when he came to his senses, he was already three or four hundred miles away.
Now in the city, he started to walk around.
As he looked around.
There was no one in sight.
Only flickering candlelights shimmering in some households.
"It’s not particularly late now."
Ding Ling checked the time, estimating it to be around seven or eight o’clock in the evening.
But he didn’t ponder too much; he just kept walking, taking a few steps when suddenly, thud! Thud! Thud!

A sound of hooves echoed from ahead, and a squad of Light Cavalry was rapidly approaching Ding Ling’s location. Leading them was a man with a sinister face, eyes filled with malice, and a cunning nature. Upon seeing Ding Ling, his eyes lit up slightly, and he laughed heartily, riding up to Ding Ling. Without hesitation, he flicked his long spear toward Ding Ling’s shoulder. This thrust, filled with sharp intent, swept through the air, clearly aiming to seriously injure Ding Ling.
Ding Ling frowned slightly and did not dodge.
Peng!
The spear struck Ding Ling’s shoulder as if hitting a ball of thunder and fire, accompanied by a crackling sound, the spearhead shattered into dozens of pieces in an instant.

Currently, he is a Martial Arts Saint Golden Core high-level strong person, and in terms of cultivation, he can rival a strong person at the Initial Tier of Martial Arts First-Grade Primordial Spirit.
In terms of skill, he even crushes Primordial Spirit strong persons.
He is so powerful that he can easily cleave through this sky and shatter this earth.
He has already become a true God and Demon!
And is no longer a ’pseudo-god’ formed only with the support of Celestial Might!
"Even so, one must not forget one’s roots.
This world has given me a lot of support and help.
I’d better not harm it."

The mountains here, in terms of texture, layers, etc., are like tofu dregs.

chapters.title: Chapter 766 - 755: Automatic Rebound Kills the Governor
paragraphs: Swoosh swoosh!
The shattered spearhead fragmented into dozens of ’flying shards’, shooting towards the light cavalry unit like flying knives, accompanied by a series of piercing sounds and over a dozen screams.
Plop!
Plop!
Over a dozen cavalrymen fell to the ground.

The leader was even struck so hard that he spat blood and was flung back several dozen yards off his horse, crashing heavily onto the ground, rolling over a dozen times before he barely managed to stop his momentum.
Staggering to get up, he found it difficult to muster strength in his limbs, and involuntarily looked at Ding Ling’s direction, both shocked and terrified:
"You, you, who exactly are you?!"
He was so frightened, with his heart in trepidation, that he stammered and couldn’t utter a complete sentence.
Ding Ling did not reply, merely glanced at the Cavalry General and said calmly:
"Who are you, then, to attack me without reason?"

"I, I am Changg Xi. I’m, I’m the Defense Officer of Hu County. There’s a curfew tonight. I’m responsible for patrolling the area, and if I find anyone suspicious, I can arrest them on the spot. Your presence in the city seemed suspicious, so I, I..."
The more he talked, the more fluently he spoke, but towards the end, he began to stammer once more.
"Changg Xi, is it?"
Ding Ling recalled the name:
"Mount Tai Bandit?"
"I have been a court official for years now."
Changg Xi’s expression changed slightly, seemingly ashamed of his past as a bandit, and he spoke again fluently:

"Including my brother and over a dozen others, we are now all local Defender Generals! And there are quite a few influential people supporting and winning us over in the court! I, Changg Xi, am not an unknown nobody, nor am I a Mount Tai Bandit. Please do not insult me."
These words were both boastful and threatening.
He was subtly implying to Ding Ling that he too had backing and shouldn’t be easily trifled with, or it would be very troublesome.
But Ding Ling remained unmoved, looking at Changg Xi with a calm expression:

"Just because you have some power, does it allow you to oppress the good and honest citizens in the city? If I hadn’t had some martial power earlier, would you not have already severely injured me? How many common folks could withstand your attack?"
Changg Xi’s face turned unsightly:
"You are highly skilled in martial arts, I admit defeat. Can we let this matter drop today?"

"As a court official, you act without distinguishing right from wrong, resorting to severely injuring others at the drop of a hat. Considering you didn’t outright try to take someone’s life just now, I’ll break one of your legs today."
Ding Ling picked up a spear from the ground and threw it towards Changg Xi. Swoosh! The spear shot through the air like a meteor, in the next instant!
Thud!
The spear pierced through Changg Xi’s kneecap, breaking his leg in an instant.
"Ah!"
Changg Xi screamed, clutching his leg, his face twisted in agony, glaring angrily at Ding Ling:
"You, you’ve gone too far!"
"I never disturb others if they don’t disturb me. General Changg wanted to severely injure my arm, so I severely injure your leg in return. An eye for an eye. It’s only fair."
Ding Ling didn’t wish to waste any more words with Changg Xi, he raised his leg to leave.
He would spare Changg Xi.

Only because Changg Xi was a General of the Great Wei Kingdom, enforcing the law, and he didn’t strike Ding Ling’s vital points earlier. Otherwise, breaking a leg would be the least of Changg Xi’s worries.
Even during a curfew, there must be a limit.
And not wield power recklessly!

The Great Wei Kingdom is currently in a peaceful era, yet Changg Xi still acts so recklessly, disregarding people’s lives, and severely injuring others at will. If a commoner was severely injured, could they even be saved?
Nine times out of ten, it would still end in death.
Precisely because of this, Ding Ling thought to cripple Changg Xi. Such bandits, even if made generals, seem incapable of discarding their bandit nature!
Clip-clop!
Unexpectedly, just as Ding Ling raised his leg, another cavalry squad suddenly charged out from the right path.
This time, the squad had more than fifty people.

Leading them was a more robust and tall middle-aged General. Seeing Changg Xi’s miserable state and Ding Ling standing unscathed as if about to leave, he couldn’t help but shout loudly, thrusting a spear like a dragon towards Ding Ling without further ado:
"Damned scoundrel! How dare you cripple my Great Wei Kingdom’s General! I’ll see you pay with your life, stay here!"
"Hmm?"
Ding Ling raised his eyebrows, neither dodging nor avoiding, allowing the middle-aged General’s spear to land at his chest, the next instant, boom!
The Thunderfire Power automatically activated and rebounded, shattering the opponent’s spearhead in an instant!

The spearhead shattered into more than a dozen pieces, each one like a flying knife, shooting back towards the middle-aged General and his men with a swoosh, and in the next moment, amidst the clanging and piercing sounds that cut through the night sky!
Dozens of soldiers fell from their horses simultaneously.
The leading General died, while the rest of the soldiers were all severely injured, unable to move.
"Sunx Kang!"
Changg Xi screamed, looking at Ding Ling in disbelief:
"You, you, you killed Governor Sunx! You, you, you are finished, neither heaven nor earth, nor even Immortals can save you now!"
"Governor Sunx, Sunx Kang?
Ding Ling vaguely remembered him.

It seems he and Zang Ba, Changg Xi, Sunx Guan, and others were initially Mount Tai Bandits. Now it seems they have all pledged allegiance to the Great Wei Kingdom, and Sunx Kang seemingly became the Governor of this place.
This feat is quite remarkable.
Now having killed a Governor.
Ding Ling couldn’t help but frown slightly, had Sunx Kang not aimed for his heart, he wouldn’t have died.
After all, Ding Ling’s Martial Dao True Understanding Protective Gang Qi Shield naturally rebounds, if someone strikes him somewhere, it will rebound with the same force back to them.
Sunx Kang targeted his heart, and the force rebounded back, striking Sunx Kang right in the heart.
His death was entirely expected.
Who in this world could withstand the rebound attack of Ding Ling’s protective shield?

This was with his Martial Arts True Qi restrained, leaving only a wisp of Protective Gang Qi for personal defense! Otherwise, the rebound attack from Martial Dao True Understanding would easily crush a mountain! A giant city!
"I didn’t expect to be away for only about five years, and it seems the world has forgotten me."
Ding Ling shook his head, filled with emotion.
He didn’t know Changg Xi or Sunx Kang.

At that time, he was high and mighty, the First-Rank Prince, the Guardian God, Sword God, National Preceptor, Grand General, and Prince of the Great Wei Kingdom! How could he meet and talk with every General?
Someone like Changg Xi, a mere officer, was not even qualified to see Ding Ling!
Now perhaps they were.
A few years ago, Changg Xi and his ilk were absolutely unqualified.
But now that Changg Xi had risen to the position of General, apart from his abilities being decent, it probably was also related to many renowned Generals of the Great Wei Kingdom having ascended!
Cao Mengde, known for employing talent regardless of their origin, would understandably promote someone like Changg Xi during a period of talent shortage.
Clip-clop!
More and more hoofbeats arose.
Someone had secretly sent a signal, causing the entire city’s forces to converge here.
Soon after.
Ding Ling was surrounded by thousands of soldiers and horses.
The leading General was extremely robust and tall, with a resolute appearance. He studied Ding Ling for a moment, and suddenly his expression changed.

chapters.title: Chapter 767 - 756: Zang Ba
paragraphs: The leading general’s expression changed, he dismounted and knelt on the ground, shouting loudly;
"Is the person ahead the First-Rank Prince of the Great Wei Kingdom?"
"First-Rank Prince?!"
Changg Xi glared wide-eyed at the leading general:
"Zang Ba, are you out of your mind! How could the King of Qi, who has ascended, suddenly appear in our Hu County?!"
The entire Great Wei Kingdom.
Besides Ding Ling, there was no other First-Rank Prince.
Therefore, as soon as Changg Xi heard Zang Ba’s words, he knew he was referring to the King of Qi, Ding Ling! He was involuntarily shocked.
"I can’t believe it either."
Zang Ba carefully examined Ding Ling, becoming more nervous the longer he looked:
"But, this person truly looks exactly like the First-Rank Prince? Haven’t you seen the portrait of the First-Rank Prince? It’s hanging right in my home!"
"Hmm?!"
Changg Xi began to ponder deeply, thinking while observing Ding Ling, and this thought along with the sight made his hair stand on end with shock and fear:
"Your... your honor, is it really, truly the King of Qi?!"
He changed his address to ’your honor.’
Apparently, Changg Xi had some impression of that portrait.
At this moment.
Changg Xi’s heart was full of regret and remorse.

If he had, like Zang Ba, bought a portrait of Ding Ling from an artist in Chang’an City and hung it at home to admire, he surely could have recognized Ding Ling in an instant, rather than foolishly mistaking Ding Ling for an ordinary person!
Now, Changg Xi was the first to unwittingly offend Ding Ling.

Thinking about it, Changg Xi broke out in a cold sweat, disregarding the pain in his broken leg, he hurriedly drew his long spear, endured the excruciating pain as he prostrated on the ground, saying:

"If it is indeed the King of Qi, please forgive Changg Xi for the offense just now. It was Changg Xi who had eyes but failed to recognize the prince, hoping for the prince’s magnanimity and pardon, I... I am bowing to you."
Still not sure if Ding Ling was the real one.
Changg Xi was already scared out of his wits.
This demonstrated Ding Ling’s enormous influence in this world.
"So, someone still recognizes me?"
Ding Ling glanced at Zang Ba, saying blandly:
"Changg Xi used the pretext of a curfew to stab passers-by with a long spear, treating a feather as an arrow, I hope General Zang Ba, you can handle this matter properly."
"Rest assured, prince.
Zang Ba’s forehead was drenched in cold sweat, speaking with determination:
"I will surely rectify this area well to ensure your satisfaction, Your Highness."
"Hmm."
Ding Ling did not intend to linger here. After learning this place was Hu County, he took a step west, and in the next instant, he was hundreds of miles away.
In just an instant, like a flash of light, he vanished before everyone’s eyes, disappearing in a way that they couldn’t even discern.
There was not even a sound of the wind.
Nor a trace of flying into the sky.
He just disappeared so suddenly.
Zang Ba and Changg Xi exchanged shocked glances, clearly seeing the astonishment in each other’s eyes.
After a long moment.
Zang Ba gasped, muttering:
"The prince is becoming more terrifying, already at a point where even we mortals can’t catch a glimpse of his silhouette!"
He sharply looked at Changg Xi, filled with both anger and contempt:
"Changg Xi, of all people to provoke, you actually provoked a prince like a deity! You, you are really lucky to be alive!"
"Yes, lucky indeed, lucky indeed."
Changg Xi nodded in agreement, but quickly wore a forlorn expression and sighed deeply:
"Laozi has really hit a streak of bad luck, encountering someone whom not even ghost gods dare to confront, the prince!"
He lamented, full of anger and grief:

"Had I known he was the prince, you could lend me a hundred guts, and I still wouldn’t dare act. At the time, given that situation, even if it were you, Zang Ba, you wouldn’t have guessed he would be the prince!"
"Hmph."
Zang Ba snorted coldly, saying:

"Unlike you, I revere the prince as a god from the bottom of my heart. So, I can definitely recognize him at a glance whenever I see him. Unlike you, having had a confrontation with the prince and still failing to recognize him."

Changg Xi was speechless, secretly swearing that once he returned, he must get a life-sized portrait of Ding Ling and hang it in the main hall every day, refusing to believe that with such measures, next time he’d still fail to recognize the real one.
"But the prince, how come he suddenly descended?!"
Zang Ba exclaimed, dubious:
"It’s been five years since we last saw the prince. Can he actually descend from the heavens? Isn’t it said that even immortals have difficulty descending?
"Nonsense."
Changg Xi scoffed:

"The extraterrestrial visitor stated, people from the Upper Realm are just individuals with greater cultivation than us. The prince’s cultivation must have reached a level that even ghost gods avoid, allowing him to descend. Look at Guan Yu, Lü Bu, Zhang Hex, Taishi Ci, Zhang Fei, and others, how many years have they been in the heavens? Have they ever descended? I reckon they lack the ability to descend. It’s only due to the prince’s astonishing cultivation that he’s capable of this feat."
"Indeed."
Zang Ba concurred deeply:
"In just a moment, he vanished without a trace. Such speed is terrifying. It’s truly unimaginable."
"Wouldn’t even dare dream of such speed."

With just a step forward, Ding Ling moved through the shifting space beneath his feet, as stars shifted overhead, and with one stride, he was already two hundred miles away, then with another gentle step, he reached outside Chang’an City.
Looking at the ancient city of Chang’an before him.
Ding Ling felt complicated but also quite joyful.
This was because he was about to meet Diao Chan and others.
After so many years.
Finally, he could see them again!
"Might as well go straight into the city."

To avoid troubles like Changg Xi’s, Ding Ling decided not to enter through the city gate. Instead, with a stride, he appeared as a stream of light from outside the city into it, arriving in the city in an instant.
There was no curfew in Chang’an.
The streets bustled with traffic and pedestrians.

Suddenly appearing on the street, Ding Ling landed beside a charming young maiden, startling her into letting out a "yaa," stumbling and nearly falling, but Ding Ling casually caught her, causing the maiden to lose her balance, making her fall right into Ding Ling’s arms.
She let out another scream.

Next to them, two tall and sturdy men dressed as servants, seemingly the maiden’s guards, saw the scene and assumed Ding Ling was harassing their young mistress, displaying anger and preparing to act.
However, Ding Ling lightly pulled and spun her, returning the maiden to her original stable standing position, steady as before.
Afterwards.
Ding Ling turned and left without looking back.
"Hold on!"
The young maiden blushed, feeling embarrassed, especially thinking about being held by a man in public, worrying about how this would affect her chances of marriage if spread around?
With this thought.
The maiden hurriedly caught up with Ding Ling, ran ahead of him, and stretched out her fair, slender arms to block his way.

"Is the person ahead the First-Rank Prince of the Great Wei Kingdom?"
"First-Rank Prince?!"
Changg Xi glared wide-eyed at the leading general:
"Zang Ba, are you out of your mind!
How could the King of Qi, who has ascended, suddenly appear in our Hu County?!"
The entire Great Wei Kingdom.
Besides Ding Ling, there was no other First-Rank Prince.
Therefore, as soon as Changg Xi heard Zang Ba’s words, he knew he was referring to the King of Qi, Ding Ling!
He was involuntarily shocked.
"I can’t believe it either."
Zang Ba carefully examined Ding Ling, becoming more nervous the longer he looked:
"But, this person truly looks exactly like the First-Rank Prince?
Haven’t you seen the portrait of the First-Rank Prince?
It’s hanging right in my home!"
"Hmm?!"
Changg Xi began to ponder deeply, thinking while observing Ding Ling, and this thought along with the sight made his hair stand on end with shock and fear:
"Your... your honor, is it really, truly the King of Qi?!"
He changed his address to ’your honor.’
Apparently, Changg Xi had some impression of that portrait.
At this moment.
Changg Xi’s heart was full of regret and remorse.

If he had, like Zang Ba, bought a portrait of Ding Ling from an artist in Chang’an City and hung it at home to admire, he surely could have recognized Ding Ling in an instant, rather than foolishly mistaking Ding Ling for an ordinary person!
Now, Changg Xi was the first to unwittingly offend Ding Ling.

"If it is indeed the King of Qi, please forgive Changg Xi for the offense just now.
It was Changg Xi who had eyes but failed to recognize the prince, hoping for the prince’s magnanimity and pardon, I...
I am bowing to you."
Still not sure if Ding Ling was the real one.
Changg Xi was already scared out of his wits.
This demonstrated Ding Ling’s enormous influence in this world.
"So, someone still recognizes me?"

"Changg Xi used the pretext of a curfew to stab passers-by with a long spear, treating a feather as an arrow, I hope General Zang Ba, you can handle this matter properly."
"Rest assured, prince.

"I will surely rectify this area well to ensure your satisfaction, Your Highness."
"Hmm."

After learning this place was Hu County, he took a step west, and in the next instant, he was hundreds of miles away.
In just an instant, like a flash of light, he vanished before everyone’s eyes, disappearing in a way that they couldn’t even discern.
There was not even a sound of the wind.
Nor a trace of flying into the sky.
He just disappeared so suddenly.
Zang Ba and Changg Xi exchanged shocked glances, clearly seeing the astonishment in each other’s eyes.
After a long moment.

"The prince is becoming more terrifying, already at a point where even we mortals can’t catch a glimpse of his silhouette!"

You, you are really lucky to be alive!"

chapters.title: Chapter 768 - 757: Huang Mansion
paragraphs: "You can’t leave."
The young girl admonished.
"Yes, yes, you can’t leave!"
Two guards also ran over and stood by the young girl, glaring at Ding Ling:
"Taking advantage and then wanting to leave. Where in the world is there such a good deal?!"
"What’s your name?"
Ding Ling looked at the young girl, feeling a bit familiar, as if he had seen her somewhere before.
"Hmph hmph!"

The beautiful girl saw Ding Ling so straightforwardly inquiring about her name, and couldn’t help but blush even more. She hummed softly through her delicate nose and couldn’t resist secretly glancing at Ding Ling twice.
Under the illumination of the lanterns on both sides, Ding Ling’s face was clearly reflected in the girl’s eyes.
At this sight.
The girl’s eyes couldn’t help but brighten, her heart began to race, and she exclaimed in her heart, ’Oh my, how can there be such a handsome man in the world!’
Up till now.

Ding Ling’s appearance had evolved to an extremely perfect level, with skin like white jade, eyes like bright stars, a nose like a hanging gallbladder, lips like painted rouge, standing there with elegant demeanor, a divine and handsome presence, and extraordinary grace, he was clearly a peerless handsome man that was rarely seen in the world.
Moreover, his aura was exceedingly unique and eye-catching.
Therefore, the girl couldn’t help but be moved at the first glance.
Heroes love beauties, and beauties also love handsome and upright heroes!
Most of the time, love at first sight in the world is based on ’looks, figure, and aura’!

And Ding Ling’s looks, figure, and aura had already reached the pinnacle of mankind, with few able to compare, which is why the girl’s one glance almost made her sink into infatuation. It wasn’t until Ding Ling lifted his leg and circled past her, disappearing swiftly into the vast sea of people, that she seemed to come back to her senses with an ’ah’, hurriedly chased after, but where could she see his figure?
She felt a bit lost, and the whole person felt uncomfortable.
"Miss."
The two guards caught up.
The young girl glared at the two:
"Why didn’t you stop him?!"
"Couldn’t stop him."
The guards expressed their innocence:
"That person’s speed was too fast, he just zipped right past us, we couldn’t react at all, he just disappeared into the crowd."
"Looks like the other party is a peerless expert."
A trace of excitement and agitation flashed across the young girl’s charming face:
"And with such an extraordinary aura. He must be someone of very high status. I’ll go ask my dad about it. He’ll surely know."
The girl excitedly ran back home.
But it turns out she was from the Huang Mansion.
The girl’s father was none other than the well-known scholar Huang Chengyan.
And she was none other than Huang Chengyan’s daughter, Huang Yueying, who was jokingly referred to as ugly by Huang Chengyan.
Unlike other girls, Huang Yueying had blonde hair and a slightly darker complexion, but even so, it could not hide her captivating beauty.
She was an exceptionally rare blonde beauty.
In the Central Plains, this hair was generally regarded as barbaric, "alien," and Huang Chengyan considered it ugly, which was understandable.

Fortunately, over the years, Huang Yueying had interacted with many players of various kinds, and under their influence, she had a clear understanding of herself, and therefore did not develop any inferiority complex, remaining very confident, lively, and cheerful.
She returned home, calling out ’Dad, Dad’!
"Coming, coming."
Huang Chengyan glanced at Huang Yueying and said helplessly:
"You’re all grown up now. Always in a hurry all day long, do you know you need to be ladylike, ladylike!"
He glared at Huang Yueying:
"You should interact less with those lawless, strange aliens. You haven’t learned anything good, just picked up some bad habits!"

Huang Yueying giggled, pulled Huang Chengyan to sit down, and asked someone to prepare pen, ink, paper, and inkstone. She held the brush, thought for a moment, and quickly sketched out the Ding Ling in her heart.
Her drawing skills were good.
When finished.
A vivid Ding Ling leapt onto the paper.
With just a glance, Huang Chengyan said:
"Why are you drawing the Prince?"
"The Prince?"
Huang Yueying was stunned:
"Which Prince?"
"Who else could it be?"
Huang Chengyan grinned:
"The one who supported Your Majesty, sweeping across the land single-handedly and establishing the foundation of the Great Wei Kingdom, the King of Qi."
"The King of Qi..."
Huang Yueying was surprised and in disbelief:
"Is it the King of Qi, Ding Ling, who ascended to another higher world?!"
"Precisely."
Huang Chengyan chuckled:

"In Chang’an City, many artists make a living by painting portraits of the King of Qi. Throughout Jiuzhou, countless families worship the Prince as a deity. You’ve learned such painting skills too. What? Are you planning to set up a stall to sell artworks?"
In the world of the Great Wei Kingdom, the presence of players was everywhere.
For five years.
The Great Wei Kingdom seemed to have accelerated its development.
Various things were invented, not to mention that the humanities and arts also began to connect with the players, creating an empire that integrated modern and ancient atmospheres!
"It’s actually the King of Qi!!"
Huang Yueying was dazed and muttered:
"Dad, I met the King of Qi."
"...Are you dreaming?"
Huang Chengyan instinctively refuted.
"Really!"
"It seems you haven’t woken up from your dream yet!"
"Dad, I’m not lying to you!!"
Huang Yueying, with a flushed face, retorted in embarrassment and anger:
"I was even, I was even held by the Prince himself. Zhang Tie and Liu Da can testify to this, they witnessed it with their own eyes!"

Seeing Huang Yueying’s serious demeanor, Huang Chengyan couldn’t help but feel suspicious and called the two guards over to question them in detail. After understanding the situation, he took a deep breath, filled with disbelief, and murmured:

"The King of Qi, the King of Qi really descended to the mortal realm?! Wasn’t it said that once ascended, one can’t descend? How is it that the King of Qi, he’s actually returned? And so suddenly too!"
"Is that the main point here?"
Huang Yueying said with a blushing face:
"Your daughter was held by the Prince, don’t you want to seek justice for her?"
"What do you want?"
Huang Chengyan glared at Huang Yueying:
"Do you want to become the Princess Consort of the Prince?!"
Huang Yueying’s face turned red up to her ears, and she coyly kept silent.
"You!"
Huang Chengyan widened his eyes, incredulous:
"You, you, you, you can’t be seriously, seriously..."
But considering Ding Ling’s status, skills, and divine techniques.
Huang Chengyan couldn’t help but feel tempted, pondered for a moment, and thought it seemed more appropriate to marry his daughter to Ding Ling, although he was concerned...
That Ding Ling might not take a fancy to his daughter!
"You really like the Prince? Be honest!"
"Yes, I do."
Huang Yueying murmured.
"Just because he held you once and you saw him once, you’ve fallen for the Prince?!"
Huang Chengyan glared at Huang Yueying:
"You’ve met so many outstanding young men, and none have moved your heart, but why are you so hopeless this time!"
"Perhaps because the Prince is different from other young men?"
Huang Yueying said, with a hint of daze:
"It just feels like the Prince is very special, like a vast ocean, unfathomable, attracting me."

chapters.title: Chapter 769 - 758: Zhou Cang
paragraphs: "That’s it?"
"Not just that, Father."
Huang Yueying blushed:

"The Prince is so handsome, and he even held me in front of everyone. Growing up, besides my parents, he’s the only one who has held me. We’ve already shared an intimate moment. So many people saw it. Father, do you think I should marry the Prince?"
"Absurd."
Huang Chengyan glared at Huang Yueying:
"Just because of that, do you think the Prince will marry you?"
"It doesn’t matter if he doesn’t marry me."
Huang Yueying, catching on, smiled and moved forward to hold Huang Chengyan’s arm, shaking it as she spoke:

"Father, why don’t you give it a try. The Prince has rarely come down to the mortal world, and if I miss this chance, it’ll be missed forever. Your daughter seldom falls for someone. Just grant my wish this once."
"Is this love at first sight, being smitten at the first meeting?"
Huang Chengyan sighed.
There’s no reasoning with love at first sight.
Just like love itself.
Is there reasoning with it?
Although Huang Chengyan thought it was unreasonable and absurd, at Huang Yueying’s pleadings, he still tidied up his appearance and attire, and immediately set out for the Prince’s Mansion.
Whether Ding Ling has returned or not.
It would be best to visit him as soon as possible.
After all, a ’Living Immortal’ from the Upper Realm has returned; how could Huang Chengyan be content without meeting him?
Even just to satisfy his own curiosity, Huang Chengyan would certainly go visit, and now with Huang Yueying’s excuse, it was like water flowing naturally into a channel.

Ding Ling saw Huang Yueying in a daze; with his expertise in the Observing People Skill, he instantly saw through what was on her mind and couldn’t help but shake his head. With one step, he vanished into the vast crowd in an instant.
Ding Ling was aware of his own charm.
So seeing Huang Yueying’s demeanor wasn’t surprising.

Because nowadays, once he appears in public during the day, the screams are especially enthusiastic, particularly from the female players who scream as if tearing the sky open, whether they’re natives or players alike.
Pursuers and those trying to get close to him were countless.
If this was seven or eight years ago, before he got the cheats, being treated this way would have certainly made Ding Ling flustered, blushing, and shy.
But now, whether in appearance, physique, or mental state, he’s undergone profound transformations.
He is still himself.
But no longer who he used to be.
He’s become more mature, skilled, brave, and versatile.
He wouldn’t feel secretly pleased just because a pretty girl likes him, nor would he consider taking her in.
He’s long past that stage.
Everyone grows up.
And over the past seven years, Ding Ling has seemingly pressed the fast-forward button!
His rate of growth is like that of a Ghost God.

Hence, he chose to stay away once knowing a pretty girl fancied him; in the past, he wouldn’t have managed that, much like the first time he met Zhen Jiang, where wild thoughts filled his mind and developed a strong liking and even thought of marrying her because of his long single life.
But now, he certainly wouldn’t think so much.
Times change!
The world is not what it used to be!
Ding Ling’s state of mind had flipped too many times already.
Yet, even so, when truly facing a reunion with close relatives like Diao Chan, Ding Ling’s Heart Lake would still stir with waves.
In one stride, he arrived at the front of the Prince’s Mansion.
The Gatekeepers were unfamiliar with him.
Ding Ling stepped forward, initially being reproached with "The Prince’s Mansion is a restricted area; no outsiders are allowed!"
But when borrowing the lantern light at the entrance to clearly see Ding Ling’s face, the two couldn’t help but freeze, and then were collectively stunned, stammering as they asked:
"Could... Could it really be the Prince?!"
"Indeed."
Ding Ling did not pretend nor conceal anything, smiling slightly as he said:
"Won’t you open the door?"
"Are... are you really the Prince?"
They first instinctually knelt but quickly scrutinized Ding Ling with suspicion:
"Two years ago, the Prince supposedly returned once, but it turned out to be someone impersonating him—nearly costing the Queen her life. Are you not another impersonator?
They soberly drew their swords, staring at Ding Ling with eyes as sharp as knives:
"Unless we can properly inspect you. Otherwise, we won’t let you pass!"
"You both are good."
Ding Ling gazed approvingly at the two and said:
"Once I meet with the Queen, everything will be clarified. Stay here for now."
With those words.
In one leap, Ding Ling vanished from sight.
The marvel of his movement and the speed of his departure.
The two Gatekeepers didn’t notice any irregularity, nor see how Ding Ling disappeared at all.
They froze at first, then a chill climbed through them, looking at each other with wide-eyed shock and horror clearly visible on their faces:
"Zhou Cang, do you think, could... could this really be the Prince?!"
It was a well-built man with remarkable features who asked first.
"You’re overthinking it."
Zhou Cang, a robust man with a dark complexion and crimson lips, iron beard, and silver teeth, glanced around and then towards the deeper parts of the Prince’s Mansion:
"The Prince has Ascended who knows how many years ago. How could he suddenly return with no hint or whisper? It’s too strange."

"That’s true. Although we are in this Lower Realm, we often hear from the Alien visitors about the Prince’s deeds in the Upper Realm. Because of this, the Queens can focus on their cultivation, waiting to ascend and reunite with the Prince. If the Prince had descended, the Alien visitors would be first to know and would definitely sell this information to our Prince’s Mansion. But now? There’s no sign or word from the Aliens! It seems this person might just be another impersonator!"
"If that’s the case, shouldn’t we immediately notify the Queens?"
Zhou Cang and the other quickly reached understanding; one went to report to the inner residence of the Prince’s Mansion, while the other continued guarding the entrance.
Meanwhile, Ding Ling had already stepped into the depths of the Prince’s Mansion’s inner courtyard, arriving behind Diao Chan.
He hadn’t seen Diao Chan for several years.

Her ability had already reached the level of the Celestial Human Realm in this realm; every move bore the blessing of Celestial Might, formidable to the extent ordinary warriors could hardly look at her directly.

Her great strength aside from the dedicated guidance from experts like Wang Yue and Tong Yuan, was also due to the resource-rich Prince’s Mansion. Without such resources, no matter her talent, she wouldn’t have reached this level.

At this moment, Diao Chan was gazing at the full moon in the sky, her expression somewhat dazed and bewildered, lost in thoughts. After a long moment, she sighed faintly, stood tall, and turned around.
In that turn.
She froze.
Because standing in front of her was someone she yearned for day and night!
"The... the Prince?!"

sentences.text: "That’s it?"
"Not just that, Father."
Huang Yueying blushed:
"The Prince is so handsome, and he even held me in front of everyone.
Growing up, besides my parents, he’s the only one who has held me.
We’ve already shared an intimate moment.
So many people saw it.
Father, do you think I should marry the Prince?"
"Absurd."
Huang Chengyan glared at Huang Yueying:
"Just because of that, do you think the Prince will marry you?"
"It doesn’t matter if he doesn’t marry me."
Huang Yueying, catching on, smiled and moved forward to hold Huang Chengyan’s arm, shaking it as she spoke:
"Father, why don’t you give it a try.
The Prince has rarely come down to the mortal world, and if I miss this chance, it’ll be missed forever.
Your daughter seldom falls for someone.
Just grant my wish this once."
"Is this love at first sight, being smitten at the first meeting?"
Huang Chengyan sighed.
There’s no reasoning with love at first sight.
Just like love itself.
Is there reasoning with it?
Although Huang Chengyan thought it was unreasonable and absurd, at Huang Yueying’s pleadings, he still tidied up his appearance and attire, and immediately set out for the Prince’s Mansion.
Whether Ding Ling has returned or not.
It would be best to visit him as soon as possible.
After all, a ’Living Immortal’ from the Upper Realm has returned; how could Huang Chengyan be content without meeting him?
Even just to satisfy his own curiosity, Huang Chengyan would certainly go visit, and now with Huang Yueying’s excuse, it was like water flowing naturally into a channel.
Ding Ling saw Huang Yueying in a daze; with his expertise in the Observing People Skill, he instantly saw through what was on her mind and couldn’t help but shake his head.
With one step, he vanished into the vast crowd in an instant.
Ding Ling was aware of his own charm.
So seeing Huang Yueying’s demeanor wasn’t surprising.

Because nowadays, once he appears in public during the day, the screams are especially enthusiastic, particularly from the female players who scream as if tearing the sky open, whether they’re natives or players alike.
Pursuers and those trying to get close to him were countless.
If this was seven or eight years ago, before he got the cheats, being treated this way would have certainly made Ding Ling flustered, blushing, and shy.
But now, whether in appearance, physique, or mental state, he’s undergone profound transformations.
He is still himself.
But no longer who he used to be.
He’s become more mature, skilled, brave, and versatile.
He wouldn’t feel secretly pleased just because a pretty girl likes him, nor would he consider taking her in.
He’s long past that stage.
Everyone grows up.
And over the past seven years, Ding Ling has seemingly pressed the fast-forward button!
His rate of growth is like that of a Ghost God.

Hence, he chose to stay away once knowing a pretty girl fancied him; in the past, he wouldn’t have managed that, much like the first time he met Zhen Jiang, where wild thoughts filled his mind and developed a strong liking and even thought of marrying her because of his long single life.
But now, he certainly wouldn’t think so much.
Times change!
The world is not what it used to be!
Ding Ling’s state of mind had flipped too many times already.
Yet, even so, when truly facing a reunion with close relatives like Diao Chan, Ding Ling’s Heart Lake would still stir with waves.
In one stride, he arrived at the front of the Prince’s Mansion.
The Gatekeepers were unfamiliar with him.
Ding Ling stepped forward, initially being reproached with "The Prince’s Mansion is a restricted area; no outsiders are allowed!"
But when borrowing the lantern light at the entrance to clearly see Ding Ling’s face, the two couldn’t help but freeze, and then were collectively stunned, stammering as they asked:
"Could...
Could it really be the Prince?!"
"Indeed."
Ding Ling did not pretend nor conceal anything, smiling slightly as he said:
"Won’t you open the door?"
"Are... are you really the Prince?"
They first instinctually knelt but quickly scrutinized Ding Ling with suspicion:
"Two years ago, the Prince supposedly returned once, but it turned out to be someone impersonating him—nearly costing the Queen her life.
Are you not another impersonator?
They soberly drew their swords, staring at Ding Ling with eyes as sharp as knives:
"Unless we can properly inspect you.
Otherwise, we won’t let you pass!"
"You both are good."
Ding Ling gazed approvingly at the two and said:
"Once I meet with the Queen, everything will be clarified.
Stay here for now."
With those words.
In one leap, Ding Ling vanished from sight.
The marvel of his movement and the speed of his departure.
The two Gatekeepers didn’t notice any irregularity, nor see how Ding Ling disappeared at all.
They froze at first, then a chill climbed through them, looking at each other with wide-eyed shock and horror clearly visible on their faces:
"Zhou Cang, do you think, could... could this really be the Prince?!"
It was a well-built man with remarkable features who asked first.
