chapters.title: Chapter 770 - 759: Passing Down the Teachings
paragraphs: Diao Chan’s voice was trembling, and her beautiful eyes were instantly covered with mist:
"Is it really, really you?"
Even though she had been deceived once.
But upon seeing that deeply missed and yearned-for figure again.
Diao Chan couldn’t help but tear up, feeling excited.
"It’s really me."
Ding Ling smiled as he stepped forward, grabbed Diao Chan’s hand, and placed it on his face:
"You can take a good look, a good feel, to see if it’s really me."

Diao Chan rubbed Ding Ling’s face; there was no human skin mask, no makeup. After looking closely at Ding Ling and smelling the familiar scent on him, her eyes turned red, and she called out "Prince" before throwing herself into Ding Ling’s arms:
"It’s really, really you. It’s really you! Prince, I’ve missed you, missed you so much!"
Ding Ling held Diao Chan, sighing in his heart.
His Observing People Skill and acting are at full level, so he naturally knew that this was a true and deep expression from Diao Chan, longing for him to the extreme.
Otherwise, with Diao Chan’s resilient, brave, and unyielding nature, she would never display such vulnerability.
Bang!
A loud thud sounded not far away, and Ding Ling turned towards the sound, only to see Da Qiao covering her mouth, her eyes red, looking at him in disbelief.
A fruit basket had fallen not far from her feet.
Ding Ling glanced at it and understood, he smiled and waved at her, and Da Qiao immediately cried "Prince" and rushed towards him.
Ding Ling opened his right hand to embrace her.
Not long after.
It seemed like the commotion was heard.

Xiao Qiao, Du Qingcheng, Zhen Jiang, Zhao Xiaoyiu, Zhao Bingxuan, and other ladies also ran over one after another, and after seeing that it was really Ding Ling, they couldn’t help but tear up, getting emotional and joyful to the extreme.
Evidently, each one had missed him dearly.
Upon seeing Ding Ling, they couldn’t help but want to hug him.
Ding Ling comforted each woman in turn, and once their emotions settled slightly, Zhao Yun, Wang Yue, and Tong Yuan also arrived.
Seeing Ding Ling, they all froze, dumbfounded:
"You, are you really the Prince?!"
"He is really the Prince."

Xiao Qiao confidently said, after not seeing her for a few years, she had become even more beautiful, breathtaking, with a presence like a phoenix descending to the mortal realm, possessing a tremendous storm of energy, having reached the level of a Super-Elite Fierce General, though not as high as Diao Chan’s Celestial Human Realm, far stronger than a regular First-class Fierce General.
She was all smiles at the moment, speaking crisply:
"I am most familiar with the Prince’s face and aura. It’s undoubtedly him."
"But before..."
Chen Dao was skeptical.
At this moment, Zhou Cang also arrived, was dumbfounded by the scene.
"Though that person was disguised to perfection and almost fooled us, once he got closer, many flaws were exposed, and after being discovered, he became furious and attacked us harshly."
"Indeed."

Da Qiao was as gentle and graceful as ever, but her aura was also extremely deep, clearly having stepped into the level of a Super-Elite Fierce General. At this moment, she couldn’t help but smile and say:
"We know the Prince too well. No matter how good others disguise, getting close to us, they would be revealed by us sisters. So, this time, the Prince is definitely genuine."
’Since the queens say so, there can be no doubt.’
Zhao Yun and others exchanged glances and then all saluted Ding Ling:
"Greetings, Prince!"
"No need for formalities."
Ding Ling smiled slightly:

"You have protected and guided Diao Chan and the others a lot. I should thank you. This time, I deliberately descended to transmit techniques. Now that you are all here, it’s perfect for me to impart the techniques to you."
"Transmit techniques?!"
Tong Yuan couldn’t help but widen his eyes:
"Could it be Divine Skills and Secret Techniques from the Upper Realm?"
"Correct!"
Ding Ling laughed and said:
"I won’t delay, stand well and I will teach you now."
Whether Tong Yuan, Wang Yue, Zhao Yun, Chen Dao, or Diao Chan and others.
They could all be considered Ding Ling’s friends and relatives.
Given Tong Yuan and others wasted as much as five years guarding the Prince’s Mansion for a promise, it showed they were very reliable and trustworthy!
For senior figures like Tong Yuan and Wang Yue, Ding Ling naturally had no reason to be stingy.
He would walk farther in the future.
But he also hoped Tong Yuan, Zhao Yun, and others could go farther as well.
That way, in the future, he would not be too lonely or powerless and would always have people firmly standing behind him!
Clang!
Ding Ling used the Sword Spirit to perform the Demonstration Technique, transmitting techniques.
The Sword Spirit opened its mouth, and the sound was not transmitted outside, yet it could directly enter a person’s eardrums and soul.
This is one of the Exotic Skills in the Martial Dao True Understanding: ’Dharma Transmission Soul Sound.’
This is a Dharma Level technique!
It is a technique synthesized from various Sound Wave Skills, skills related to Soul Skill, and combining secret manuals from the Confucian, Buddhist, and Daoist schools.
It allows the Sword Spirit to directly transmit techniques, reaching deep into the person’s mind and soul.
The effects are extremely impressive.
And indeed, it was so.
Zhao Yun, Chen Dao, Tong Yuan, Diao Chan, and others just listened and watched, feeling a sense of awakening and profound insight.
They unconsciously memorized these techniques and skills.
An hour later.
Ding Ling completed the transmission.
Tong Yuan and others awoke from their state of enlightenment, looking at Ding Ling in shock and disbelief:
"This, this, this..."
"This technique is so powerful."
Diao Chan was more straightforward in speaking, after all, the few women like her had a marital relationship with Ding Ling, so there was no need to avoid suspicion, naturally speaking more frankly:
"It seems we can directly cultivate into immortals?!"
"Indeed, indeed."
Da and Xiao Qiao both widened their almond eyes:

"We thought we were already very strong. But comparing to Martial Arts Grandmasters, we are pathetically weak, not to mention the Grandmaster, Shatterer, and Martial Arts Golden Core powerhouses. It turns out we are just laying the foundation?!"
Previously, they had heard from the Aliens about the strength of Grandmasters, Grandmasters, and Shatterers from the Upper Realm.
But among the Aliens, apart from Ding Ling, there were no characters above the Grandmaster level.
Moreover, the world of the Upper Realm is more stable, often the ’special effects’ of top Grandmasters might be similar to the Celestial Being Realm powerhouses in the Three Kingdoms World.
Therefore, the Aliens could not perfectly describe the strength of Grandmasters, Shatterers, and other powerhouses.
This also led Diao Chan and the others to not have a deep understanding.
Now, with Ding Ling using the ’Sword Spirit Soul Sound’ to transmit techniques, they perfectly and deeply recognized the gap between each realm!
It was this recognition.
That shocked them with the power of this Martial Dao True Understanding!
Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, Du Qingcheng, as Ding Ling’s wives, were extremely moved and touched.

chapters.title: Chapter 771 - 760: Diao Chan’s Rapid Progress
paragraphs: Not to mention Tong Yuan, Zhao Yun, Wang Yue and others.
Each of them was extremely grateful for Ding Ling’s teachings.
"I never expected that the good karma I sowed with Ding Ling back then would yield such great rewards today."
Wang Yue sighed endlessly, his emotions were stirred to the extreme, and he couldn’t help but exclaim:

"A few years ago, when Ding Ling ascended, I gained so much from him, and now he’s descended to provide me with a technique that leads directly to the Martial Arts Immortal Sect. This gift is too heavy!"
"Indeed."

Tong Yuan’s heart was pounding rapidly, but after deeply realizing the power of the Martial Dao True Understanding, he, for the first time, truly realized that he, Tong Yuan, might have a chance at immortality and stepping onto the path to the Celestial Palace.
Just thinking about it.
Tong Yuan couldn’t help but feel dazed, and upon hearing Wang Yue’s sentiments, Tong Yuan was moved and said:
"The return Ding Ling has given us is indeed vast. We must repay this kindness well in the future."
Tong Yuan and Wang Yue understood.
This favor was as heavy as a mountain.
To repay it clearly is definitely not something that can be done in ten or a hundred years.
It might take a thousand years, ten thousand years, or even a lifetime.
However, the two of them were willing, because without Ding Ling, their chances of entering an Immortal Sect and obtaining such a Martial Arts Immortal Technique would be slim.
To have Ding Ling’s Immortal Technique to step into an Immortal Sect, gaining hope for longevity.
This is of extremely significant and extraordinary meaning to them.
Tong Yuan, Wang Yue felt this way.
Chen Dao, Zhao Yun, Pan Feng and others were also filled with emotions, unable to remain calm.
Their gratitude towards Ding Ling was so immense that even the waters of five lakes could not fully express it.
Ding Ling looked at it all, smiled and said:
"Return and carefully ponder and comprehend this technique. If there is anything you do not understand, feel free to ask me. I will stay at the Prince’s Mansion for a while longer before leaving."
It was already late.
Tong Yuan and the others, seeing the appearance of Diao Chan and the others, realized they should not disturb the Prince and the Queen’s marital life, and they all bowed and took their leave.
Zhou Cang naturally was among them.

This time, during his visit to the inner courtyard, he gained an opportunity. Although he did not receive the Martial Dao True Understanding, he was bestowed a Holy Heart Technique! With diligent future cultivation, entering the Shattered Realm was very promising.
He was very excited, and upon returning to the main gate, his companion asked:
"Zhou Cang, what did the Queen say?"
"Earlier, the one speaking with us was actually the Prince."
Zhou Cang, blushing with excitement, looked at the inner courtyard with admiration and said:
"The Prince’s divine skill is unparalleled. I was fortunate to gain an opportunity this time. In the future, I will definitely repay the Prince and the Queen well!"
"It was really the Prince?!"
"Yes."
Zhou Cang, recalling something, scratched his head in slight embarrassment and said:
"Pei Yuanshao, if you had gone to the inner courtyard this time, you might have been the one to gain an opportunity. Now, it was my turn. I’ll treat you to a good meal tomorrow to make it up to you."
Pei Yuanshao, speechless for a moment, said with envy and jealousy:
"To receive the opportunity offered by the Prince, it must be extraordinary. A single meal isn’t enough to satisfy me!"
"Then I’ll treat you to several meals."
Zhou Cang laughed heartily.
Pei Yuanshao could say no more, and only offered his blessing:
"Remember to look after me when you get stronger! We are brothers, after all."
"Rest assured!"
"By the way."
Pei Yuanshao seemed to recall something:
"Huang Chengyan from the Huang Mansion visited recently. Here’s the invitation card."
Pei Yuanshao took out a card.
Zhou Cang said:
"I’ll take it to General Zhao to have a look now."
Starting from this day.
Ding Ling remained at the Prince’s Mansion, guiding Diao Chan and others in cultivating the Martial Dao True Understanding.

With Ding Ling’s Martial Dao True Understanding already at full level, and his realm reaching the high tier of the Saint-Grade Golden Core stage, guiding Diao Chan and the others was more than sufficient.
Furthermore, to help them better forge a foundation.
Ding Ling even infused each of them with a strand of his Saint-Grade Golden Core Martial Arts True Qi.
Since they were spouses with Ding Ling, and Ding Ling had a special technique that only couples could practice, which allowed for complete and perfect mutual support in cultivation.
In their current stage, Diao Chan and the others were too weak to assist Ding Ling.
But after frequent practice of this technique.
Ding Ling’s Martial Arts True Qi also gained a strand of Supreme Yin and gentle Qi, making the operation of Martial Arts True Qi smoother and more fluid!
Attacks and defenses became even more flawless.
The so-called order and union of Yin and Yang wasn’t much more than this.
Seven days passed like this.
Diao Chan, Du Qingcheng, Da and Xiao Qiao, Zhen Jiang and other women, all completed the Foundation Establishment of the Martial Dao True Understanding!
Their True Qi surged immensely.

Within just seven days, they transcended the unranked, third-class, second-class, first-class, half-step Innate, and Innate realms one after another, forcefully stepping into the realm of Martial Arts Grandmaster!
However, Tong Yuan, Wang Yue and others were still exploring, and their Martial Dao True Understanding remained at the unranked stage.
This was the difference between having Ding Ling’s assistance and not having it!
It was easy to understand.
Like a maxed-out account leading a beginner through battles, the upgrade progress was visibly soaring!
Diao Chan and others were all like this.
Had Ding Ling not worried that upgrading too fast would damage their foundation, they would have definitely soared to the Grandmaster level.
It should be noted that Diao Chan and others, without exception, received a strand of Ding Ling’s most refined Martial Arts True Qi.
And a single strand of Ding Ling’s Martial Arts True Qi was enough to easily kill a Shattering Level expert!
This single strand of True Qi could send them into the realm of Grandmasters.
But that would be inappropriate and would lead to a fragile foundation, making it challenging for them to progress in the future.
Ding Ling naturally did not wish for this.
Thus, he slowed their progress repeatedly, ensuring their Martial Arts Foundation was solid and flawless, only then feeling relieved.
Upon reaching the Grandmaster level.
To go further.
It required both spouses to make more efforts.
Regarding this matter.
Ding Ling had no objections.
The technique was harmless, not only aiding Diao Chan and the others but also enhancing himself by refining his Martial Arts True Qi, making it even more complete and perfect.
Therefore, aside from occasional outings to handle some matters, he stayed at the Prince’s Mansion, rarely stepping outside.
He never forgot his purpose.
It was to help Diao Chan and the others grow stronger.
He intended to push forward, assisting Diao Chan and others in breaking into the Grandmaster level, or even the threshold of the Shattering Level.
With this intent.
He could leave more assuredly.
On this particular day.
Chen Dao came to report, saying that the current emperor of the Great Wei Kingdom had arrived.
"Cao Mengde?"
Ding Ling nodded and said:
"Let him wait for me in the main hall."
As for Cao Mengde.
Ding Ling didn’t particularly like or dislike him.
He could only say.
From the start, they were in a relationship of mutual cooperation.
Later on, Cao Mengde felt all sorts of discomforts towards Ding Ling.
Ding Ling noticed this and consciously kept his distance.
The only thing that relieved Ding Ling was that Cao Mengde did not skimp on the resources allocated to the Prince’s mansion.

sentences.text: Not to mention Tong Yuan, Zhao Yun, Wang Yue and others.
Each of them was extremely grateful for Ding Ling’s teachings.
"I never expected that the good karma I sowed with Ding Ling back then would yield such great rewards today."
Wang Yue sighed endlessly, his emotions were stirred to the extreme, and he couldn’t help but exclaim:
"A few years ago, when Ding Ling ascended, I gained so much from him, and now he’s descended to provide me with a technique that leads directly to the Martial Arts Immortal Sect.
This gift is too heavy!"
"Indeed."

Tong Yuan’s heart was pounding rapidly, but after deeply realizing the power of the Martial Dao True Understanding, he, for the first time, truly realized that he, Tong Yuan, might have a chance at immortality and stepping onto the path to the Celestial Palace.
Just thinking about it.
Tong Yuan couldn’t help but feel dazed, and upon hearing Wang Yue’s sentiments, Tong Yuan was moved and said:
"The return Ding Ling has given us is indeed vast.
We must repay this kindness well in the future."
Tong Yuan and Wang Yue understood.
This favor was as heavy as a mountain.
To repay it clearly is definitely not something that can be done in ten or a hundred years.
It might take a thousand years, ten thousand years, or even a lifetime.
However, the two of them were willing, because without Ding Ling, their chances of entering an Immortal Sect and obtaining such a Martial Arts Immortal Technique would be slim.
To have Ding Ling’s Immortal Technique to step into an Immortal Sect, gaining hope for longevity.
This is of extremely significant and extraordinary meaning to them.
Tong Yuan, Wang Yue felt this way.
Chen Dao, Zhao Yun, Pan Feng and others were also filled with emotions, unable to remain calm.
Their gratitude towards Ding Ling was so immense that even the waters of five lakes could not fully express it.
Ding Ling looked at it all, smiled and said:
"Return and carefully ponder and comprehend this technique.
If there is anything you do not understand, feel free to ask me.
I will stay at the Prince’s Mansion for a while longer before leaving."
It was already late.
Tong Yuan and the others, seeing the appearance of Diao Chan and the others, realized they should not disturb the Prince and the Queen’s marital life, and they all bowed and took their leave.
Zhou Cang naturally was among them.
This time, during his visit to the inner courtyard, he gained an opportunity.
Although he did not receive the Martial Dao True Understanding, he was bestowed a Holy Heart Technique!
With diligent future cultivation, entering the Shattered Realm was very promising.
He was very excited, and upon returning to the main gate, his companion asked:
"Zhou Cang, what did the Queen say?"
"Earlier, the one speaking with us was actually the Prince."
Zhou Cang, blushing with excitement, looked at the inner courtyard with admiration and said:
"The Prince’s divine skill is unparalleled.
I was fortunate to gain an opportunity this time.
In the future, I will definitely repay the Prince and the Queen well!"
"It was really the Prince?!"
"Yes."
Zhou Cang, recalling something, scratched his head in slight embarrassment and said:
"Pei Yuanshao, if you had gone to the inner courtyard this time, you might have been the one to gain an opportunity.
Now, it was my turn.
I’ll treat you to a good meal tomorrow to make it up to you."
Pei Yuanshao, speechless for a moment, said with envy and jealousy:
"To receive the opportunity offered by the Prince, it must be extraordinary.
A single meal isn’t enough to satisfy me!"
"Then I’ll treat you to several meals."
Zhou Cang laughed heartily.
Pei Yuanshao could say no more, and only offered his blessing:
"Remember to look after me when you get stronger!
We are brothers, after all."
"Rest assured!"
"By the way."
Pei Yuanshao seemed to recall something:
"Huang Chengyan from the Huang Mansion visited recently.
Here’s the invitation card."
Pei Yuanshao took out a card.
Zhou Cang said:
"I’ll take it to General Zhao to have a look now."
Starting from this day.
Ding Ling remained at the Prince’s Mansion, guiding Diao Chan and others in cultivating the Martial Dao True Understanding.

With Ding Ling’s Martial Dao True Understanding already at full level, and his realm reaching the high tier of the Saint-Grade Golden Core stage, guiding Diao Chan and the others was more than sufficient.
Furthermore, to help them better forge a foundation.
Ding Ling even infused each of them with a strand of his Saint-Grade Golden Core Martial Arts True Qi.
Since they were spouses with Ding Ling, and Ding Ling had a special technique that only couples could practice, which allowed for complete and perfect mutual support in cultivation.
In their current stage, Diao Chan and the others were too weak to assist Ding Ling.
But after frequent practice of this technique.
Ding Ling’s Martial Arts True Qi also gained a strand of Supreme Yin and gentle Qi, making the operation of Martial Arts True Qi smoother and more fluid!
Attacks and defenses became even more flawless.
The so-called order and union of Yin and Yang wasn’t much more than this.
Seven days passed like this.
Diao Chan, Du Qingcheng, Da and Xiao Qiao, Zhen Jiang and other women, all completed the Foundation Establishment of the Martial Dao True Understanding!
Their True Qi surged immensely.

Within just seven days, they transcended the unranked, third-class, second-class, first-class, half-step Innate, and Innate realms one after another, forcefully stepping into the realm of Martial Arts Grandmaster!
However, Tong Yuan, Wang Yue and others were still exploring, and their Martial Dao True Understanding remained at the unranked stage.
This was the difference between having Ding Ling’s assistance and not having it!
It was easy to understand.
Like a maxed-out account leading a beginner through battles, the upgrade progress was visibly soaring!
Diao Chan and others were all like this.
Had Ding Ling not worried that upgrading too fast would damage their foundation, they would have definitely soared to the Grandmaster level.
It should be noted that Diao Chan and others, without exception, received a strand of Ding Ling’s most refined Martial Arts True Qi.
And a single strand of Ding Ling’s Martial Arts True Qi was enough to easily kill a Shattering Level expert!
This single strand of True Qi could send them into the realm of Grandmasters.
But that would be inappropriate and would lead to a fragile foundation, making it challenging for them to progress in the future.
Ding Ling naturally did not wish for this.
Thus, he slowed their progress repeatedly, ensuring their Martial Arts Foundation was solid and flawless, only then feeling relieved.
Upon reaching the Grandmaster level.
To go further.
It required both spouses to make more efforts.
Regarding this matter.
Ding Ling had no objections.
The technique was harmless, not only aiding Diao Chan and the others but also enhancing himself by refining his Martial Arts True Qi, making it even more complete and perfect.
Therefore, aside from occasional outings to handle some matters, he stayed at the Prince’s Mansion, rarely stepping outside.
He never forgot his purpose.
It was to help Diao Chan and the others grow stronger.
He intended to push forward, assisting Diao Chan and others in breaking into the Grandmaster level, or even the threshold of the Shattering Level.
With this intent.
He could leave more assuredly.
On this particular day.
Chen Dao came to report, saying that the current emperor of the Great Wei Kingdom had arrived.
"Cao Mengde?"
Ding Ling nodded and said:
"Let him wait for me in the main hall."
As for Cao Mengde.
Ding Ling didn’t particularly like or dislike him.
He could only say.
From the start, they were in a relationship of mutual cooperation.
Later on, Cao Mengde felt all sorts of discomforts towards Ding Ling.
Ding Ling noticed this and consciously kept his distance.
The only thing that relieved Ding Ling was that Cao Mengde did not skimp on the resources allocated to the Prince’s mansion.

chapters.title: Chapter 772 - 761: Dian Wei
paragraphs: This is also one of the reasons why Ding Ling is willing to see Cao Mengde.
Otherwise.
Ding Ling would most likely choose to directly crush the opponent to death.
Those who dare to bully Diao Chan and others are destined to have a bad end.
The fake ’Ding Ling’ who previously impersonated him to deceive the trust of Diao Chan and others, was probably Zuo Ci, Zuo Yuanfang!
This old guy is really tired of living.
Ding Ling was about to forget the existence of such a person.
But the words of Zhou Cang, Pei Yuanshao, and Diao Chan reminded Ding Ling of Zuo Ci’s early wantonness, unrestrainedness, and arrogance five years ago.
Hmph!
Ding Ling snorted lightly. This time, if he doesn’t pull Zuo Ci out and destroy him, he will never let it go!
For this, he specially stationed Pan Feng and Zhao Yun near the Celestial Ladder, just to prevent Zuo Ci from escaping.

Pan Feng and Zhao Yun are both exceptionally talented, especially Zhao Yun, who, after receiving Ding Ling’s personal guidance for two days, has already stepped into the threshold of the three-stream realm of the Martial Dao True Understanding.
Although the distance to the first-class and grandmaster realm is still far away.

But it must be known that this is the Martial Dao True Understanding, an immortal-level technique, once stepping into the threshold, one can easily kill beyond one’s level. In the world of martial artists, even in a world like Fengyun, most of them are only shattering level magic and skills. Supreme-level masters like the Demon Lord Poxun, Great Sun Buddha, and Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan are merely at the primordial spirit level of magic and skills.
Ding Ling’s Martial Dao True Understanding far surpasses the immortal-level techniques and immortal skills of primordial spirit level!

After Zhao Yun entered the threshold, his entire strength underwent a great transformation, internally and externally integrated, with force penetrating through, his current strength increased more than tenfold, which is quite common.
This is the capability of the Martial Dao True Understanding, capable of amplification, easily raising a person’s potential.
Of course, the issue of durability still depends on the person’s physical quality and the quality and quantity of true qi. The higher and stronger the individual, the greater the durability.

"Refining the essence of many Breathing Techniques such as the Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique, Sword God Breathing Technique, Taiqing Breathing Technique, Medicine King Breathing Technique, Overlord Breathing Technique, Human Emperor Breathing Technique, Shadow Breathing Technique, Confucian Breathing Technique, Charming Fox Breathing Technique, Sleeping Dragon Breathing Technique, etc., into one furnace, the Martial Dao True Understanding has an amplification capability far surpassing that of any Breathing Technique."
Breathing Techniques can also amplify.
But the multiplication factor, duration, and upper limit are far inferior to Ding Ling’s Martial Dao True Understanding.

The Martial Dao True Understanding can easily amplify more than tenfold, and ensures that one’s combat power does not decline too quickly, with a very high upper limit, capable of ascending to the Immortal Sect!
As for the limits of the Breathing Techniques?
Ding Ling estimates that, at most, it’s around the Martial Arts Dharma Aspect, and it’s very difficult to amplify to ten times more.
After all, Breathing Techniques are just a technique for building a foundation, capable of aiding someone in cultivating to the level of Martial Arts Dharma Aspect, which is already quite remarkable.
However, Ding Ling’s Martial Dao True Understanding can assist someone all the way to the level of War Immortal.
This is related to his refining the essence of many Breathing Techniques.
These Breathing Techniques are from the Three Kingdoms World, as well as from the Sui and Tang, Late Qin worlds.
As for the Breathing Techniques from the Sui and Tang, Late Qin worlds, those are naturally provided by those Ascenders and some players voluntarily.
They would provide them in exchange for entry into the Royal Library of the Fengyun World to exchange for more advanced Divine Skill Secret Manuals!
To this, Ding Ling naturally welcomed it.

However many Divine Skill Secret Manuals the Ascenders and players exchange, they cannot compare to his Martial Dao True Understanding! And as long as he refines more magic and skills, he will only become stronger!
This time when Cao Mengde came to meet.
Ding Ling had an idea in his heart.
Clop clop!
Ding Ling only took a step forward, and in an instant, the stars shifted, and he arrived in the Main Hall, seeing Cao Mengde dressed in casual clothes, yet full of dignity.
Two people stood behind him.
Each with broad shoulders and a sturdy build, they were none other than Dian Wei and Xuu Chu.
Their skills were high, and they immediately noticed Ding Ling, slightly surprised, and then they bowed to Ding Ling in unison:
"Greetings, Prince!"
Ding Ling appeared silently beside them.
If it weren’t for Ding Ling deliberately showing himself.
They wouldn’t have noticed at all!

Dian Wei and Xuu Chu were shocked in their hearts, feeling that some of the words of the Alien were untrue. Ding Ling had already become so strong that they couldn’t perceive him at all, how could he be as described by the Aliens?!
But what did they know.
Most players are weak, and the heavens and earth of Fengyun World are extremely solid, and there were almost no players who personally saw Ding Ling shatter islands or defeat the Demon Lord.

Therefore, what players have witnessed are only the shattering level magic and skills of Ding Ling. And in terms of ’special effects’, it seemed almost no different from when Ding Ling borrowed Celestial Might in the Three Kingdoms.
As a result, when players describe Ding Ling’s strength with admiration, Xuu Chu and Dian Wei are instead indifferent, with not much emotion.

That’s because they have often witnessed Ding Ling borrowing Celestial Might to kill enemies, overwhelmingly strong, and his performance in the Upper Realm seemed not much different from the lower realm; even if there were differences, they were not significant, so how could they be too moved.
In their perception, Ding Ling must be slightly stronger than when he was in the lower realm, but not to the point of being absurdly strong.
However.
They found that they were gravely mistaken.
The current Ding Ling is as unfathomable as the abyss, as boundless as the sea, and just looking at Ding Ling gave them a suffocating feeling, let alone getting close or confronting him.
"So strong!"
The more Xuu Chu and Dian Wei sensed, the more shocked they were, and the more respectful their attitude towards Ding Ling became!

Cao Mengde also suddenly looked at Ding Ling; for these years, hearing about all sorts of things from the Upper Realm by the Aliens, he too had developed different thoughts, wanting to ascend, to achieve immortality. Therefore, his cultivation has been no less intense than that of Diao Chan and others.
After not seeing him for a few years.
Cao Mengde was also about to reach the level of a Super-Elite Fierce General.
It was evident that as long as a person does not lack good teachers and resources, and has decent aptitude and makes the effort, they can definitely succeed.
Yet even so.
Facing Ding Ling, Cao Mengde felt as if facing a series of Celestial Palaces, without seeing the end, just looking a couple of times gave him a dizziness and headache.
He was shocked at heart and promptly solemnly greeted Ding Ling with a bow:
"Greetings, Upper God!"
"Your Majesty is too polite."
Ding Ling gestured for Cao Mengde and the others to sit down.
Once they were seated, he then said:
"I wonder what’s the important matter Your Majesty has that brings you here to find me?"
"I dare not assume the title of Your Majesty. Upper God, please just call me by my name."
Cao Mengde, feeling embarrassed, again performed a bow to Ding Ling:

"I have learned much of what Upper God has done in the Upper Realm from the Aliens. The reason I could sit on this throne is all thanks to Upper God’s capability and support. Without Upper God’s selfless aid, I would have no right to sit on the throne."
The thing Cao Mengde has heard the most in the past five years is news about Ding Ling.

chapters.title: Chapter 773 - 762: Cao Mengde
paragraphs: The alien visitor seemed to have a particular understanding of Cao Mengde’s preferences, always finding roundabout ways to send Ding Ling’s various bits of gossip to his Imperial Study.
This allowed Cao Mengde to be the first to learn about Ding Ling’s various exploits.
The more he understood,
the more amazed and respectful Cao Mengde felt towards Ding Ling.
He lamented to Dian Wei, Xiahou Yuan and others more than once:
"If it’s gold, it will shine anywhere!"
Ding Ling was unparalleled in the Three Kingdoms World.

Even when he ventured to other worlds, he acted like a king, even directly ascending the throne as emperor, controlling one world after another, the territories he controlled were far more vast than the Great Wei Kingdom!
After all, Ding Ling was now the founding emperor of several worlds!
If Ding Ling hadn’t been uninterested in claiming the throne in the Three Kingdoms World, how could Cao Mengde ever have had the chance to become emperor?!
It was precisely because he had come to these realizations over the years.
That Cao Mengde became increasingly cautious, naturally not daring to withhold any resources from the Prince’s Mansion; whatever they wanted, he would provide!
He was also afraid that one day Ding Ling might suddenly descend, and at that time, what would Cao Mengde do?!
Cao Mengde originally thought that when Ding Ling ascended to the Upper Realm, he would encounter stronger people, and life would inevitably become more difficult.
But the result was beyond his expectations.
No matter which world Ding Ling was in, he was invincible, no one could oppose him!
Any individual or nation that dared to oppose Ding Ling was destroyed.
And many of these nations were far stronger than the Great Wei Kingdom!

While at rest, just thinking about it, Cao Mengde felt deeply uneasy. Thus, he maintained the good habit of ’being cautious with words and actions’ when dealing with Diao Chan and others in the Prince’s Mansion.
And now.
Indeed, Ding Ling had descended!
When Cao Mengde learned of this news a few days ago, he was almost scared to death.
He found it unimaginable that Ding Ling would actually say he was descending and truly come down!
’It seems you can’t completely trust the words of the alien visitor, it can only serve as a reference.’
The alien visitor had promised Cao Mengde that Ding Ling would never descend!
And it wasn’t just one person who said this.

But the more Cao Mengde understood Ding Ling, the more he feared him, and did not dare to act recklessly. Now it seemed his approach was indeed correct; fortunately, he didn’t fully trust the alien visitor’s words, or else wouldn’t he have been utterly fooled by this group of alien visitors?
Just thinking about it,
Cao Mengde couldn’t help but secretly wipe a cold sweat.
After waiting several days in the Imperial Palace without Ding Ling coming to visit, Cao Mengde could no longer sit still and decided to personally visit Ding Ling at the Prince’s Mansion.
Moreover, he approached with a particularly humble attitude.
Initially, Dian Wei and Xuu Chu were quite indignant about this! They believed that as the emperor of the Great Wei Kingdom, Cao Mengde bowing so low was truly inappropriate!
But when truly faced with Ding Ling, the two fell silent in an instant!
At that moment, they even began to admire the wisdom and foresight of the Emperor of Great Wei!
If Cao Mengde hadn’t been wise and foresighted, if Ding Ling were truly angered, Ding Ling might have been able to extinguish an entire great army with just a breath.
"Too powerful!"

’Standing in front of Ding Ling, I feel like a mere ant, a speck, with the constant possibility of being overturned or destroyed! This feeling is akin to facing the heavens themselves, utterly powerless!’
This was the most direct feeling that Ding Ling gave to Cao Mengde, Xuu Chu, and Dian Wei.
It was also the reason for Cao Mengde’s deep reverence towards Ding Ling.
"Very well."
Seeing Cao Mengde speak in this way, Ding Ling didn’t stand on ceremony, and directly asked:
"I wonder, Mengde, what brings you here to visit specially?"
"Naturally, it’s an important matter."
Cao Mengde replied solemnly:
"An Upper God has come down to earth; if I didn’t come to visit, wouldn’t it seem terribly disrespectful? Besides, I also hope the Upper God can help me with a favor."
"Feel free to speak your mind."
Seeing Cao Mengde being so sensible, Ding Ling didn’t have the intention of making things difficult for him, speaking and acting directly to the point, without any preamble.

"My son Cao Chong was born frail and sickly. Hua Tuo, Zhang Zhongjing and other divine doctors straightforwardly said that my son is unlikely to live past the age of 15. I can’t bear the thought of him dying young. But alas, I’m powerless to do anything. Now that the Upper God has descended, I cannot contain my joy, for I know my son’s chance of survival has come!"
"Oh?"
Ding Ling exclaimed in surprise:
"Cao Chong has already been born?"

"He is already over two years old. He can walk and talk, his intelligence is rare in the world. His aptitude for martial arts is unparalleled. I am truly fond of him. But he has been weak since childhood, and all the examination readings are extremely weak. He cannot practice martial arts, etc. He can only be carefully nurtured, but even so, it is difficult for him to live beyond fifteen years."
Cao Mengde showed a face of deep sorrow:
"I’m afraid my son has been cursed by the heavens!"
Dian Wei couldn’t help but cough dryly on the side.
Cao Mengde came back to his senses, looking at Ding Ling with an apologetic expression:
"Saying my child’s talent in front of the Upper God, it is indeed like wielding an axe before Lu Ban, overestimating myself. I made the Upper God laugh."
Only then did Cao Mengde seem to suddenly remember that Ding Ling himself was a person with extraordinarily terrifying talents.
Saying that Cao Chong is cursed by the heavens in front of Ding Ling!
Where does that place Ding Ling?!
Cao Mengde responded in time, immediately apologizing, but Ding Ling didn’t mind, simply saying:
"Even Hua Tuo and the others have no solution?"
"None."
Cao Mengde shook his head and sighed:

"Hua Tuo, Zhang Zhongjing and other divine doctors have mentioned more than once: if the Prince were here, the Prince might have a solution. This shows their esteem and trust in you. Now that Ding Ling, you have truly descended, it’s like the clouds parting to reveal the sun, I am overjoyed beyond measure!"
"Alright. Then let’s go have a look."
Ding Ling said:
"Just wondering how the Library has fared over these years?"
"Quite a few new Secret Manuals have been added."
Cao Mengde replied with great understanding:
"If the Upper God wishes to see them, I will personally guide the way."
"Let’s go."
A moment later.
The procession exited the door.
And it was morning now.
A great time of day.
Chang’an City was bustling with traffic and bustling crowds.
The appearance of Ding Ling and his group drew a commotion from all directions.
"Ah!!! It’s Ding Ling!"
"Wow, it really is Ding Ling! It’s been years. I’ve finally seen the True Person! Idol, over here, over here!"
"Ding Ling, I love you!"
"Ding Ling, I want to bear your children! Can I get your contact information? How about we meet in real life?!"
There were quite a few people who found out through various rumors that Ding Ling had come to Chang’an City.
And with players, it only takes one to know, and soon thousands, countless people know.
Currently, a message was circulating online, ’Ding Ling has returned to the Three Kingdoms!’

The players who had not ascended in the Three Kingdoms World were in a frenzy, and many traveled thousands of miles to Chang’an City just to catch a glimpse of Ding Ling’s appearance. Of course, most of their minds were focused on how to have a fortuitous encounter with Ding Ling, how to hold onto Ding Ling’s influence, how to get closer to Ding Ling, etc.
These players had been diligently cultivating the Breathing Technique for six or seven years and were veteran players.

sentences.text: The alien visitor seemed to have a particular understanding of Cao Mengde’s preferences, always finding roundabout ways to send Ding Ling’s various bits of gossip to his Imperial Study.
This allowed Cao Mengde to be the first to learn about Ding Ling’s various exploits.
The more he understood,
the more amazed and respectful Cao Mengde felt towards Ding Ling.
He lamented to Dian Wei, Xiahou Yuan and others more than once:
"If it’s gold, it will shine anywhere!"
Ding Ling was unparalleled in the Three Kingdoms World.

Even when he ventured to other worlds, he acted like a king, even directly ascending the throne as emperor, controlling one world after another, the territories he controlled were far more vast than the Great Wei Kingdom!
After all, Ding Ling was now the founding emperor of several worlds!
If Ding Ling hadn’t been uninterested in claiming the throne in the Three Kingdoms World, how could Cao Mengde ever have had the chance to become emperor?!
It was precisely because he had come to these realizations over the years.
That Cao Mengde became increasingly cautious, naturally not daring to withhold any resources from the Prince’s Mansion; whatever they wanted, he would provide!
He was also afraid that one day Ding Ling might suddenly descend, and at that time, what would Cao Mengde do?!
Cao Mengde originally thought that when Ding Ling ascended to the Upper Realm, he would encounter stronger people, and life would inevitably become more difficult.
But the result was beyond his expectations.
No matter which world Ding Ling was in, he was invincible, no one could oppose him!
Any individual or nation that dared to oppose Ding Ling was destroyed.
And many of these nations were far stronger than the Great Wei Kingdom!
While at rest, just thinking about it, Cao Mengde felt deeply uneasy.
Thus, he maintained the good habit of ’being cautious with words and actions’ when dealing with Diao Chan and others in the Prince’s Mansion.
And now.
Indeed, Ding Ling had descended!
When Cao Mengde learned of this news a few days ago, he was almost scared to death.
He found it unimaginable that Ding Ling would actually say he was descending and truly come down!
’It seems you can’t completely trust the words of the alien visitor, it can only serve as a reference.’
The alien visitor had promised Cao Mengde that Ding Ling would never descend!
And it wasn’t just one person who said this.
But the more Cao Mengde understood Ding Ling, the more he feared him, and did not dare to act recklessly.
Now it seemed his approach was indeed correct; fortunately, he didn’t fully trust the alien visitor’s words, or else wouldn’t he have been utterly fooled by this group of alien visitors?
Just thinking about it,
Cao Mengde couldn’t help but secretly wipe a cold sweat.
After waiting several days in the Imperial Palace without Ding Ling coming to visit, Cao Mengde could no longer sit still and decided to personally visit Ding Ling at the Prince’s Mansion.
Moreover, he approached with a particularly humble attitude.
Initially, Dian Wei and Xuu Chu were quite indignant about this!
They believed that as the emperor of the Great Wei Kingdom, Cao Mengde bowing so low was truly inappropriate!
But when truly faced with Ding Ling, the two fell silent in an instant!
At that moment, they even began to admire the wisdom and foresight of the Emperor of Great Wei!
If Cao Mengde hadn’t been wise and foresighted, if Ding Ling were truly angered, Ding Ling might have been able to extinguish an entire great army with just a breath.
"Too powerful!"
’Standing in front of Ding Ling, I feel like a mere ant, a speck, with the constant possibility of being overturned or destroyed!
This feeling is akin to facing the heavens themselves, utterly powerless!’
This was the most direct feeling that Ding Ling gave to Cao Mengde, Xuu Chu, and Dian Wei.
It was also the reason for Cao Mengde’s deep reverence towards Ding Ling.
"Very well."
Seeing Cao Mengde speak in this way, Ding Ling didn’t stand on ceremony, and directly asked:
"I wonder, Mengde, what brings you here to visit specially?"
"Naturally, it’s an important matter."
Cao Mengde replied solemnly:
"An Upper God has come down to earth; if I didn’t come to visit, wouldn’t it seem terribly disrespectful?
Besides, I also hope the Upper God can help me with a favor."
"Feel free to speak your mind."
Seeing Cao Mengde being so sensible, Ding Ling didn’t have the intention of making things difficult for him, speaking and acting directly to the point, without any preamble.
"My son Cao Chong was born frail and sickly.
Hua Tuo, Zhang Zhongjing and other divine doctors straightforwardly said that my son is unlikely to live past the age of 15.
I can’t bear the thought of him dying young.
But alas, I’m powerless to do anything.
Now that the Upper God has descended, I cannot contain my joy, for I know my son’s chance of survival has come!"
"Oh?"
Ding Ling exclaimed in surprise:
"Cao Chong has already been born?"
"He is already over two years old.
He can walk and talk, his intelligence is rare in the world.
His aptitude for martial arts is unparalleled.
I am truly fond of him.
But he has been weak since childhood, and all the examination readings are extremely weak.
He cannot practice martial arts, etc.
He can only be carefully nurtured, but even so, it is difficult for him to live beyond fifteen years."
Cao Mengde showed a face of deep sorrow:
"I’m afraid my son has been cursed by the heavens!"
Dian Wei couldn’t help but cough dryly on the side.
Cao Mengde came back to his senses, looking at Ding Ling with an apologetic expression:
"Saying my child’s talent in front of the Upper God, it is indeed like wielding an axe before Lu Ban, overestimating myself.
I made the Upper God laugh."
Only then did Cao Mengde seem to suddenly remember that Ding Ling himself was a person with extraordinarily terrifying talents.
Saying that Cao Chong is cursed by the heavens in front of Ding Ling!
Where does that place Ding Ling?!
Cao Mengde responded in time, immediately apologizing, but Ding Ling didn’t mind, simply saying:
"Even Hua Tuo and the others have no solution?"
"None."
Cao Mengde shook his head and sighed:
"Hua Tuo, Zhang Zhongjing and other divine doctors have mentioned more than once: if the Prince were here, the Prince might have a solution.
This shows their esteem and trust in you.
Now that Ding Ling, you have truly descended, it’s like the clouds parting to reveal the sun, I am overjoyed beyond measure!"
"Alright.
Then let’s go have a look."
Ding Ling said:
"Just wondering how the Library has fared over these years?"
"Quite a few new Secret Manuals have been added."
Cao Mengde replied with great understanding:
"If the Upper God wishes to see them, I will personally guide the way."
"Let’s go."
A moment later.
The procession exited the door.
And it was morning now.
A great time of day.
Chang’an City was bustling with traffic and bustling crowds.
The appearance of Ding Ling and his group drew a commotion from all directions.
It’s Ding Ling!"
"Wow, it really is Ding Ling!
It’s been years.
I’ve finally seen the True Person!
Idol, over here, over here!"
"Ding Ling, I love you!"
"Ding Ling, I want to bear your children!
Can I get your contact information?
How about we meet in real life?!"
There were quite a few people who found out through various rumors that Ding Ling had come to Chang’an City.
And with players, it only takes one to know, and soon thousands, countless people know.
Currently, a message was circulating online, ’Ding Ling has returned to the Three Kingdoms!’
The players who had not ascended in the Three Kingdoms World were in a frenzy, and many traveled thousands of miles to Chang’an City just to catch a glimpse of Ding Ling’s appearance.
Of course, most of their minds were focused on how to have a fortuitous encounter with Ding Ling, how to hold onto Ding Ling’s influence, how to get closer to Ding Ling, etc.
These players had been diligently cultivating the Breathing Technique for six or seven years and were veteran players.

chapters.title: Chapter 774 - 763: Cao Ang
paragraphs: The old players were all seasoned veterans. After cultivating the Breathing Technique and Martial Arts for seven years, quite a few of them had reached the level of a First-class Fierce General as long as they didn’t lack Great Medicine.
However, these successful players were only a small minority.
The vast majority, seeing no hope of becoming a First-class or Super-Elite Fierce General, abandoned their skills decisively and opted for Ascension to the Upper Realm to cultivate Inner Power.
Of course, some with decent strength retained a portion of their power and went to the Upper Realm.
Besides the players heading to the Upper Realm,

there were also some players in the Three Kingdoms who had settled and established families, feeling that Inner Power cultivation wouldn’t let them reach the level of a First-class Expert. They chose to live here and quietly cultivate the Breathing Technique.
This group constituted quite a few.
Now, Ding Ling’s arrival reignited the passion in the hearts of successful, failed, and laidback players alike!
They all thought that if they could successfully latch onto a big shot,
how many years of struggle could they avoid?
Even a ’bone’ casually tossed by Ding Ling might save them ten years of effort!
Understanding this clearly,
these old players were immensely enthusiastic toward Ding Ling, shouting and roaring with hysteria.
"Ding Ling, Ding Ling!"
"Idol! When are you planning to start a sect in the real world?! I’ll be the first to sign up!"
"Idol, head to the big city early to become a Sect Leader! Don’t hide away every day, making it impossible for us to find you!"
"Ding Ling, I want to marry you!"
Among the players, the male ones strongly urged Ding Ling to start a sect and make money in reality.
The female ones passionately advised Ding Ling to go on dates and fall in love, reminding him not to be addicted to the Game World and marry NPCs, forgetting there are better women in reality?!
"Upper God is still as popular as ever."
Cao Mengde sat in the carriage, glancing around, feeling a deep mix of admiration and envy.
So many people, yet not one called him Your Majesty!
They all shouted: Idol, Ding Ling, Prince, Sword God...
Every title, without exception, was related to Ding Ling.
He, Cao Mengde, the emperor of the Great Wei Kingdom, now standing beside Ding Ling, had become just a backdrop, thinking of it felt somewhat uncomfortable.
On past court days, it was his words that held sway, shining brightly.
But now, he seemed like dust fallen to the ground, unnoticed.
And all of this, just because, next to him, was Ding Ling!
"Indeed."
Dian Wei and Xuu Chu agreed deeply.
Previously, when they traveled, they also had plenty of followers, or as the aliens would say, lots of fans.
But now, with Ding Ling appearing, their brilliance was instantly crushed.
In comparison to Ding Ling,
they seemed like fireflies under the moonlight!
"Ah! Ding Ling, Idol!"
The screams had never ceased from the very start.
Though with many extremely trendy terms among them.
Yet, Xuu Chu, Cao Mengde, and others seemed used to hearing them.
No wonder they could understand.
This game had no taboo topics; anything could be said, and Cao Mengde had long figured out that aliens came from another world.
Only, different from the other ’natives’ of this world and the Upper Realm, aliens seemed to have two shells and also could borrow a special energy to reincarnate in these different worlds.
Therefore,
when aliens called for Ding Ling to start martial arts schools in reality, establish sects, marry, and seek partners,
Cao Mengde, Xuu Chu, and Dian Wei fully understood!

Having had in-depth interactions with aliens for more than seven years, Cao Mengde paid close attention to this group early on, and with even a slight investigation, he uncovered the secrets thoroughly.
He even utilized the alien’s powers to develop what was called high technology.
Previously, Cao Mengde was quite confident in these high-tech advancements.
But after contacting Ding Ling, his heart sunk, realizing these high-tech wonders were nothing in front of Ding Ling, useless.
"Looks like I must cultivate Martial Arts and ascend!"
The so-called high-tech may look great, with impressive power.
Especially the might of the nuclear bomb, described as inhumane by the aliens.
Yet even with ultimate exploration of high-tech.
Can it grant immortality?
In the reality of the alien’s world, no one was immortal, and how many years has the Great Wei Kingdom World been developing high-tech? Expecting immortality from it?
Moreover, high-tech is still an external force!
Unlike Martial Dao, which is genuinely one’s own power!
After interacting with Ding Ling, Cao Mengde’s initial idea became even firmer: ’diligently cultivate martial arts! Climb the Supreme Martial Dao, achieve immortality!’
Every emperor in any world, to the end, desires immortality.
Cao Mengde was no exception.
Moreover, unlike Emperor Qin Shi Huang and other emperors, he had genuinely seen the hope of immortality!
As they stepped into the Imperial City,
there were more people paying respects to Cao Mengde.

Only then did Cao Mengde feel a bit better; in the eyes of that group of aliens, he had become invisible, while over the years, they were extremely passionate towards him — but with Ding Ling’s arrival, they ignored him!
A bunch of fair-weather friends!
Amidst his secret disdain, Cao Mengde saw a heroic young man striding towards him, and his eyes brightened slightly. Pointing at the youth, he introduced:
"Upper God, that is my eldest son, Cao Ang, Cao Zixiu!"
"Cao Ang."
Ding Ling’s sharp eyes took just one look to see through Cao Ang.
He was a First-class Fierce General.
With robust physique, strong will, exceptionally talented person.
"Not bad."
Ding Ling nodded.
According to the original plot trajectory, Cao Ang would have died in Zhang Xiu’s rebellion.
But the Three Kingdoms’ plot had long collapsed into chaos.
Dian Wei didn’t die.
So naturally, Cao Ang didn’t either.

As the son of an emperor, not only did he survive, but with abundant resources, master teachers, and talent, his cultivation rapidly progressed, becoming a First-class Fierce General at a young age. Entering Super-Elite level in the future was not an issue.
"Greetings, Father. Greetings, Prince!"
Cao Ang approached and saluted Cao Mengde and Ding Ling.
Cao Mengde smiled and said:
"Zixiu, the Upper God just praised you."
Saying this, Cao Mengde suddenly changed the topic and rapidly said:
"Zixiu, what are you waiting for? Quick, kneel and become a disciple."
Cao Ang’s eyes gleamed, kneeling without hesitation and kowtowing three times to Ding Ling:
"Cao Ang greets the master, master above, please accept three bows from your disciple!"
After kowtowing,
he began to speak, but it was too late for Ding Ling to stop him.
Ding Ling had nothing to say.
Cao Mengde laughed heartily:

"Good, good, good. My son has found an excellent teacher and should have a grand celebration. Upper God, my son, Zixiu, is steady, earnest, diligent, and generous. His martial arts aptitude is praised by many. I must trouble you to accept him, even if as a mere servant."
Cao Ang looked expectantly at Ding Ling, clearly agreeing greatly with Cao Mengde’s words.

chapters.title: Chapter 775 - 764: Cao Chong
paragraphs: Ding Ling’s eyelids twitched twice.
He didn’t know whether this was a sudden idea from Cao Mengde.
But Cao Ang had already knelt and kowtowed.
Judging by Cao Ang’s expression and eyes, it was indeed sincere, without any falseness.
Ding Ling thought for a moment, then agreed:
"I can take you in. But you can only train with Zhao Yun and the others, I can’t take you with me."
"No problem."
Cao Ang was overjoyed and was about to kneel and kowtow again.
Ding Ling waved his hand, and a surge of Vigorous Qi descended beneath Cao Ang, preventing him from kneeling no matter what.
"Go report to Zhao Yun yourself."
Ding Ling said.
"Yes, Master!"
Cao Ang did not bother to communicate further with Cao Mengde and directly rode off excitedly from the Imperial Palace to the Prince’s Mansion.
The cavalry who came with Cao Ang, riding horses beside him, were either envious, jealous, or dumbfounded.
Among this group of cavalry were two players, who at this moment couldn’t help but start scheming, thinking, "If I also kneel directly like Cao Ang, will Ding Ling accept me as a disciple?"
Becoming Ding Ling’s disciple.
This is the thought of countless players.

On some forums in the real world, the pinned threads somewhat contain contents such as ’How to Strategize Ding Ling’, ’How to Become Ding Ling’s Disciple’, ’How to Marry Ding Ling’, ’How to Win Ding Ling’s Favor’ and so on!
These two players have also looked at these posts.
Initially, they were very confident about strategizing Ding Ling.
But upon actually meeting Ding Ling, they instead felt somewhat lacking in confidence.

Because facing Ding Ling directly, they felt a sense of insignificance as if gazing at the sky and staring at the ocean; not to mention getting close, just making eye contact with Ding Ling made them feel immense pressure!
"So terrifying!"
"Those strategies online, all are rubbish! Those keyboard warriors have the guts to stand before Ding Ling for three seconds without going weak-kneed, I will admire them!"
Ding Ling’s aura exudes the grandeur and boundless spirit of a Deity overlooking the masses everywhere!
Captivating!
Making people dare not approach lightly.
Unless Ding Ling actively dispels this aura, otherwise ordinary people who approach will be like a mouse encountering a cat, instinctively terrified, with hair standing on end, unable to speak!
It feels like a higher-dimensional species crushing lower-dimensional species.
"Why can Cao Ang, Cao Mengde approach Ding Ling?"
Players felt resentful.
But when they considered the status of Cao Mengde, Cao Ang, they figured it out.
At the same time, they guessed why Ding Ling deliberately released this aura; he surely didn’t want to communicate much with outsiders.
Players also knew that recently more and more players have gathered in Chang’an, waiting around the Prince’s Mansion.
If Ding Ling were easy to talk to.
Players would certainly ’ride the slope down the donkey’ and flood the Prince’s Mansion!
It’s known that the player community isn’t much respectful to Cao Mengde, the emperor, acting carefree; how would they be more respectful to Ding Ling?
After understanding thoroughly.
These two players looked at each other and sighed, realizing the chance of clinging to Ding Ling’s leg was almost impossible.
"Seems like we still need to cling to Cao Ang’s leg."
These two players stealthily slipped away after seeing Ding Ling, Cao Mengde, and others enter the Inner Palace, swiftly running to meet Cao Ang.
Cao Ang is Ding Ling’s disciple.
They are Cao Ang’s bodyguards!
If they cling well, maybe in the future, they could obtain some opportunity and fortune?
Thinking this.
These two instantly felt the future seemed much brighter.
And learning of Cao Ang’s successful apprenticeship, other players naturally envied and felt jealous of the chance these two bodyguards had to infiltrate the Prince’s Mansion.
The two felt fortunate for their decisiveness, increasingly realizing Ding Ling’s charisma was simply peerless and unmatched.
"Successfully clinging to Ding Ling’s disciple’s leg, and even that makes them so envious. If we successfully cling to Ding Ling’s leg, won’t they swallow us alive?!"
The two also wanted to become Ding Ling’s disciple.
Unfortunately...
It’s unrealistic!

"Speaking of which, when will Ding Ling establish a sect in reality? If he establishes a sect, I’ll have my family bring out all our savings! Even if it costs a few billion, even if we go bankrupt, as long as we succeed in becoming his disciple, I think it’s worth it!"
"There are too many people who think like you! Unfortunately, Ding Ling apparently doesn’t need money! You want to give, but he’s not willing to take it."

"Indeed. Many years ago, some tycoon wanted to give ten billion to Ding Ling, and Ding Ling refused. Now Ding Ling is even stronger as a deity or demon; without a hundred billion, I estimate Ding Ling won’t even bat an eyelid."
"In reality, how many people can bring out a hundred billion?!"
On this day, the number of people talking about Ding Ling was enough to stretch from Chang’an East City Gate to Luoyang West City Gate.
Everyone’s attention was focused on Ding Ling.
Especially the Aliens.
They were dissatisfied with Ding Ling’s indulgence in games and not establishing a sect or marrying in reality!
They all felt that Ding Ling, as the number one in the game, shouldn’t fail to give back to society!
Of course.
These words, they only dared to murmur in their hearts or discuss privately, letting them speak in front of Ding Ling, they wouldn’t dare.
Faced with Ding Ling, they would scream, shout, wanting Ding Ling to notice them, appreciate them!
Often if Ding Ling gave them a glance.
They would roar excitedly, saying ’Ding Ling just looked at me, he looked at me!’
No doubt.
Ding Ling’s charisma is powerful to this extent now.
His charisma, besides the charm his physique and cultivation technique naturally bring, is also related to his strength, aura, presence, status, rights, etc.
As a player who stands as number one in cultivation, rights, resources, cultivation technique, Divine Weapon, etc., all ranked number one!
He is certainly the favorite of female players!

Over ninety percent of female players want to marry Ding Ling; even those who are extremely reserved express curiosity about Ding Ling upon seeing his portrait, and upon actually meeting him, they would admit having a certain fondness for Ding Ling.
This is the formidable aspect of Ding Ling’s charisma.
Old, female young.
None can resist!
And being charismatic, even when Ding Ling entered the Palace.
He was adored by Cao Pi, Cao Zhi, Cao Zhang, Cao Chong, and the others.
Each chased after Ding Ling, calling ’Prince, Prince’.
Or mimicking Cao Mengde, giggling and calling ’Upper God, Upper God’.
"You sure can reproduce."
Ding Ling looked at this bunch of children, casting a sidelong glance at Cao Mengde.
"Haha..."
Cao Mengde felt no shame, but pride, raising his brows, he proudly said:
"Whether the Cao Family can thrive, it depends on me. This is the sentence my father and others say to me the most. I deeply agree."
Saying this, he paused, pulled Cao Chong over, and said:
"Upper God, have a good look at Chong’er, is there any hope?"
Cao Chong looked very cute, like a carved figure.
He seemed to understand something too, with his large eyes like lacquer dots, looking at Ding Ling brilliantly.

sentences.text: Ding Ling’s eyelids twitched twice.
He didn’t know whether this was a sudden idea from Cao Mengde.
But Cao Ang had already knelt and kowtowed.
Judging by Cao Ang’s expression and eyes, it was indeed sincere, without any falseness.
Ding Ling thought for a moment, then agreed:
"I can take you in.
But you can only train with Zhao Yun and the others, I can’t take you with me."
"No problem."
Cao Ang was overjoyed and was about to kneel and kowtow again.
Ding Ling waved his hand, and a surge of Vigorous Qi descended beneath Cao Ang, preventing him from kneeling no matter what.
"Go report to Zhao Yun yourself."
Ding Ling said.
"Yes, Master!"
Cao Ang did not bother to communicate further with Cao Mengde and directly rode off excitedly from the Imperial Palace to the Prince’s Mansion.
The cavalry who came with Cao Ang, riding horses beside him, were either envious, jealous, or dumbfounded.
Among this group of cavalry were two players, who at this moment couldn’t help but start scheming, thinking, "If I also kneel directly like Cao Ang, will Ding Ling accept me as a disciple?"
Becoming Ding Ling’s disciple.
This is the thought of countless players.

On some forums in the real world, the pinned threads somewhat contain contents such as ’How to Strategize Ding Ling’, ’How to Become Ding Ling’s Disciple’, ’How to Marry Ding Ling’, ’How to Win Ding Ling’s Favor’ and so on!
These two players have also looked at these posts.
Initially, they were very confident about strategizing Ding Ling.
But upon actually meeting Ding Ling, they instead felt somewhat lacking in confidence.

Because facing Ding Ling directly, they felt a sense of insignificance as if gazing at the sky and staring at the ocean; not to mention getting close, just making eye contact with Ding Ling made them feel immense pressure!
"So terrifying!"
"Those strategies online, all are rubbish!
Those keyboard warriors have the guts to stand before Ding Ling for three seconds without going weak-kneed, I will admire them!"
Ding Ling’s aura exudes the grandeur and boundless spirit of a Deity overlooking the masses everywhere!
Captivating!
Making people dare not approach lightly.
Unless Ding Ling actively dispels this aura, otherwise ordinary people who approach will be like a mouse encountering a cat, instinctively terrified, with hair standing on end, unable to speak!
It feels like a higher-dimensional species crushing lower-dimensional species.
"Why can Cao Ang, Cao Mengde approach Ding Ling?"
Players felt resentful.
But when they considered the status of Cao Mengde, Cao Ang, they figured it out.
At the same time, they guessed why Ding Ling deliberately released this aura; he surely didn’t want to communicate much with outsiders.
Players also knew that recently more and more players have gathered in Chang’an, waiting around the Prince’s Mansion.
If Ding Ling were easy to talk to.
Players would certainly ’ride the slope down the donkey’ and flood the Prince’s Mansion!
It’s known that the player community isn’t much respectful to Cao Mengde, the emperor, acting carefree; how would they be more respectful to Ding Ling?
After understanding thoroughly.
These two players looked at each other and sighed, realizing the chance of clinging to Ding Ling’s leg was almost impossible.
"Seems like we still need to cling to Cao Ang’s leg."
These two players stealthily slipped away after seeing Ding Ling, Cao Mengde, and others enter the Inner Palace, swiftly running to meet Cao Ang.
Cao Ang is Ding Ling’s disciple.
They are Cao Ang’s bodyguards!
If they cling well, maybe in the future, they could obtain some opportunity and fortune?
Thinking this.
These two instantly felt the future seemed much brighter.
And learning of Cao Ang’s successful apprenticeship, other players naturally envied and felt jealous of the chance these two bodyguards had to infiltrate the Prince’s Mansion.
The two felt fortunate for their decisiveness, increasingly realizing Ding Ling’s charisma was simply peerless and unmatched.
"Successfully clinging to Ding Ling’s disciple’s leg, and even that makes them so envious.
If we successfully cling to Ding Ling’s leg, won’t they swallow us alive?!"
The two also wanted to become Ding Ling’s disciple.
Unfortunately...
It’s unrealistic!
"Speaking of which, when will Ding Ling establish a sect in reality?
If he establishes a sect, I’ll have my family bring out all our savings!
Even if it costs a few billion, even if we go bankrupt, as long as we succeed in becoming his disciple, I think it’s worth it!"
"There are too many people who think like you!
Unfortunately, Ding Ling apparently doesn’t need money!
You want to give, but he’s not willing to take it."
"Indeed.
Many years ago, some tycoon wanted to give ten billion to Ding Ling, and Ding Ling refused.
Now Ding Ling is even stronger as a deity or demon; without a hundred billion, I estimate Ding Ling won’t even bat an eyelid."
"In reality, how many people can bring out a hundred billion?!"
On this day, the number of people talking about Ding Ling was enough to stretch from Chang’an East City Gate to Luoyang West City Gate.
Everyone’s attention was focused on Ding Ling.
Especially the Aliens.
They were dissatisfied with Ding Ling’s indulgence in games and not establishing a sect or marrying in reality!
They all felt that Ding Ling, as the number one in the game, shouldn’t fail to give back to society!
Of course.
These words, they only dared to murmur in their hearts or discuss privately, letting them speak in front of Ding Ling, they wouldn’t dare.
Faced with Ding Ling, they would scream, shout, wanting Ding Ling to notice them, appreciate them!
Often if Ding Ling gave them a glance.
They would roar excitedly, saying ’Ding Ling just looked at me, he looked at me!’
No doubt.
Ding Ling’s charisma is powerful to this extent now.
His charisma, besides the charm his physique and cultivation technique naturally bring, is also related to his strength, aura, presence, status, rights, etc.
As a player who stands as number one in cultivation, rights, resources, cultivation technique, Divine Weapon, etc., all ranked number one!
He is certainly the favorite of female players!

Over ninety percent of female players want to marry Ding Ling; even those who are extremely reserved express curiosity about Ding Ling upon seeing his portrait, and upon actually meeting him, they would admit having a certain fondness for Ding Ling.
This is the formidable aspect of Ding Ling’s charisma.
Old, female young.
None can resist!
And being charismatic, even when Ding Ling entered the Palace.
He was adored by Cao Pi, Cao Zhi, Cao Zhang, Cao Chong, and the others.
Each chased after Ding Ling, calling ’Prince, Prince’.
Or mimicking Cao Mengde, giggling and calling ’Upper God, Upper God’.
"You sure can reproduce."
Ding Ling looked at this bunch of children, casting a sidelong glance at Cao Mengde.
"Haha..."
Cao Mengde felt no shame, but pride, raising his brows, he proudly said:
"Whether the Cao Family can thrive, it depends on me.
This is the sentence my father and others say to me the most.
I deeply agree."
Saying this, he paused, pulled Cao Chong over, and said:
"Upper God, have a good look at Chong’er, is there any hope?"
Cao Chong looked very cute, like a carved figure.
He seemed to understand something too, with his large eyes like lacquer dots, looking at Ding Ling brilliantly.

chapters.title: Chapter 776 - 765: Divine Body
paragraphs: Ding Ling performed the Bone Touching on Cao Chong.
He meticulously examined him.
After pondering for a while, he said:
"Cao Chong’s pulse has been suppressed by a certain Qi."
"What kind of Qi?"
Cao Mengde was quite nervous:
"Can he be saved?"
"He can be saved."
"Whew."
Cao Mengde let out a sigh of relief and joyfully pulled Cao Chong to perform a grand gesture of gratitude to Ding Ling:
"I knew the Upper God could handle it! Now, it seems indeed. Chong, quickly, thank the Upper God for saving you."
Before the rescue even began, they started thanking.
Cao Chong, being a very clever child, immediately made a polite gesture towards Ding Ling, smiling as he said:
"Thank you, Upper God, thank you, Upper God."
Although he was young, he was clever and articulate, with eyes brimming with spirit, making it clear at a glance that he was undoubtedly a very wise child.
Moreover, what made him very likable was that he was wrapped from head to toe in a unique Qi, much like an Immortal Flower about to bloom, captivating and moving.
However, it was this Qi that was the reason for Cao Chong’s short lifespan.

Upon hearing Ding Ling had arrived, Hua Tuo and Zhang Zhongjing immediately set aside their work and hurried to Cao Chong’s place. They were Divine Doctors granted special privileges by Cao Mengde, free to come and go to see Cao Chong.
So, just as Cao Chong finished his salute with a smile, they arrived.
They first saluted Cao Mengde and Ding Ling before inquiring about the situation.
Cao Mengde, in high spirits, told them about the situation.
Hua Tuo and Zhang Zhongjing exchanged glances, clearly seeing the shock and honor in each other’s eyes.
They were shocked that Ding Ling had just returned and already thoroughly researched a pathology they had failed to understand for many years.
The honor was that Ding Ling could be considered their ’successor’, and this successor surpassed them, which was undoubtedly the most gratifying thing for Hua Tuo and Zhang Zhongjing.
Hua Tuo spoke first:
"We have never been able to understand Cao Chong’s pathology. We truly don’t know the cause."
Hua Tuo and Zhang Zhongjing were not arrogant due to their senior status; they practiced humility to the extreme.
Not only would they ask a top legendary medical expert like Ding Ling, but they would also inquire from ordinary people.
Ding Ling had great respect for Hua Tuo and Zhang Zhongjing, so he had no intention of keeping the truth from them:
"Cao Chong’s constitution is extremely special, somewhat resembling the legendary Sun Divine Body."
"Sun Divine Body?!"
Hua Tuo, Zhang Zhongjing, Cao Mengde, and others were a bit puzzled:
"What does that mean?"
Cao Chong widened his round eyes and looked up at Ding Ling.
Cao Pi, Cao Zhi, Cao Zhang, and other children gathered around Ding Ling, either giggling or listening intently.
Different ages, wisdom, and personalities resulted in different reactions.
But it had to be said that these children, without exception, exuded Spiritual Qi that soared to the sky, each with uncommon roots. If cultivated well, they could become pillars in the future!

Cao Pi would be the future Emperor Wen of Wei; Cao Zhi created the ’Rhapsody of the Luoshen’, and successfully composed poetry in seven steps; ’Boiling beans to burn bean stalks, beans cry in the pot’ became widely known;
Cao Zhang, a mighty general.
Cao Chong weighed elephants.
Each child achieved greatness.
At this moment, Ding Ling spoke more specifically about Cao Chong:
"Indeed. In a certain ancient book from the Wind and Cloud World, I’ve seen records of the Sun Divine Body, which bears a considerable resemblance to Cao Chong’s."
Compared to other Historical Worlds and the Martial World, Wind and Cloud World was a notch higher in all aspects.
The knowledge and heritage it left behind were naturally more complete.

"The so-called Sun Divine Body is one where, at birth, a hidden True Sun Flame is within the body’s bloodline. Normally this True Sun Flame does not manifest. But once truly erupting or activated, it could claim this child’s life."
"Then isn’t this a fatal constitution?"
Cao Mengde was anxious:
"How to treat it?"
"It’s both difficult and simple."
Ding Ling glanced at the group and said:

"As long as Cao Chong can be guided to cultivate the Martial Dao properly, and perfectly assimilate this bit of True Sun Flame, using it for himself, not only can he live for hundreds or thousands of years, but potentially even ten thousand years. At that time, becoming a Sun God is not impossible."
Cao Mengde was both shocked and delighted, and without a word, pushed Cao Chong down to the ground.
Cao Chong was indeed clever; without requiring Cao Mengde to speak further, he immediately bowed, saying with great earnestness:
’Teacher, please accept my three bows as a student.’
Ding Ling originally had no intention of taking on another student.
But seeing Cao Chong act like this, he thought that since he had already accepted Cao Ang, accepting one more wouldn’t hurt.
He wouldn’t teach often personally anyway, so he would have Zhao Yun and Tong Yuan teach them instead.
With this thought, Ding Ling accepted Cao Chong’s three bows.
Seeing Ding Ling not oppose, Cao Mengde was exuberant and also greatly relieved.
He had long learned from the Aliens that people in the Wind and Cloud World could live for thousands of years without dying, and being Detained by duties, surely Ding Ling could live even longer.
Now hearing Ding Ling’s introduction about Cao Chong, it further confirmed this conjecture. His heart was pounding rapidly.
Compared to immortality, even the Emperor’s Seat, power, gold, and silver were passing Fuyun!
What kind of a figure was Emperor Qin Shi Huang?
What kind of prodigies were Zhang Liang and Hann Xin?
A century later, they were still a pile of bones.
He, Cao Mengde, refuses to die! He, Cao Mengde, wants to live for thousands, ten thousand, even a hundred thousand, a million years!
Ding Ling was his hope.
So, in the days that followed, Cao Mengde was almost sycophantic to Ding Ling.
Cao Pi, Cao Zhi, and the other children watched with mouths agape, unable to understand why their father, always revered as a deity, turned into a ’shameless’ ’servant’ in front of a Prince!
Yet they were astute and didn’t expose their father publicly.
Only after Ding Ling walked away with Cao Chong, Hua Tuo, and Zhang Zhongjing did Cao Zhi ask in curiosity.
Cao Mengde sighed deeply:
"Did you believe your father was wrong?"
"Father is remarkably intelligent, born with a Seven-Aperture Exquisite Heart. Surely there is a reason behind this."
Cao Pi replied:
"Is it because the Upper God is an Immortal from the heavens? Does Father plan to follow the Upper God to cultivate immortality?"
"I wish so, but given the situation, the Upper God likely won’t let me follow him."
Cao Mengde glanced at his children and said:
"Remember this: you will become Dragon Children, and your father will become the Emperor because the Upper God has no ambition for the throne and does not want to be disturbed by worldly affairs.
In the Upper God’s eyes, cultivation and longevity mean everything.
I didn’t understand before.
After all, in my view, how can a person, no matter how strong, compete with the heavens? How could one achieve immortality?
Until the Upper God returned to our world.
I was greatly enlightened. When a person reaches the pinnacle of power, even the heavens cannot stop his footsteps!"
