chapters.title: Chapter 777 - 766: Traveling with Hua Tuo
paragraphs: "Do you believe that the cultivation of an Upper God is so profound that with a single breath, they can blow away a group of warriors?"
"Wow."
Cao Pi, Cao Zhi, Cao Zhang, and others exclaimed repeatedly:
"How is that possible?!"
"So powerful!"
Only after Cao Mengde saw that Cao Pi, Cao Zhi, and the others had quieted down did he speak:

"That’s the reality. So, I hope you all can be more diligent and serious in your scholarly and martial pursuits. You must know, Upper God was renowned across the world for being all-powerful from the very beginning. I don’t expect you to be an All-Powerful King, I only hope that you can make some achievements in both literature and martial arts.
Especially in martial power.
You must become strong! Only then can you leap out of this small pond world and venture to higher tiers of existence and broader horizons..."
Cao Mengde spoke slowly.
He revealed some of the secrets he knew to Cao Zhi, Cao Pi, and others.
In the eyes of Cao Mengde.
Cao Pi was already over ten years old, Cao Zhang seven or eight, and Cao Zhi five or six...
They weren’t too young, especially Cao Pi, who had reached the age of understanding.
Thus, Cao Mengde chose today, at this appropriate moment, to disclose some secrets, hoping that his sons could break free from the cage and transcend beyond.
"And what about you, Father?"

"I will also strive to cultivate and aim to transcend. As for the throne? When the time comes, I will follow the example of Upper God, choosing someone capable and responsible to become the emperor. Compared to immortality, glory and wealth are but an empty dream..."
After realizing Ding Ling’s power, the children like Cao Pi, Cao Zhi, and Cao Zhang also wished to become his apprentices.
Especially Cao Pi, Cao Zhi, and Cao Zhang, who had a strong desire, and if not for Cao Mengde’s intervention, would have run to kneel outside the Prince’s Mansion that very day.
Not understanding was one thing.
Once they understood, and knowing that Cao Chong and Cao Ang had already succeeded in becoming apprentices, the fire in their hearts could no longer be extinguished.
Yet Ding Ling was completely unaware of this.
He, accompanied by Hua Tuo, Zhang Zhongjing, and Cao Chong, rode a carriage toward the Prince’s Mansion.
Cao Chong sat obediently to the side, his large, round eyes looking at Hua Tuo, Zhang Zhongjing, and Ding Ling, occasionally calling out gently to his master.
He was very adorable.
Hua Tuo and Zhang Zhongjing seemed to like Cao Chong very much, and more than once expressed to Ding Ling:

"Luckily you descended. Otherwise, ten years from now, this child would likely have died. The trace of True Sun Flame you mentioned continuously burns his life away, and we are helpless. Is the martial dao cultivation you spoke of really useful?"
"We’ll know by trying, won’t we?"
Ding Ling smiled slightly:

"My Martial Dao True Understanding is all-encompassing, with skills and laws in the Dao of Fire. Once I fracture a portion of the True Sun Skill, and if Cao Chong channels the True Sun Flame into his dantian, continually strengthening his foundation and physique, as long as his body and meridians are strong enough to withstand the fire, with time, he will naturally become a Fire God!"
This was Ding Ling’s speculation.
Moreover, his Martial Dao True Understanding indeed contained techniques and laws in the way of fire.
In Ding Ling’s Divine Emperor Fist, there is the skill ’Heaven-Scorching Earth-Burning’, where one punch can send blazing flames that pierce through the sky!
Thus, extracting a portion of the True Sun Skill from the Martial Dao True Understanding is not difficult.
The hard part is making this True Sun Skill reach the Immortal Level.
The Martial Dao True Understanding is only at the Immortal Level, and the fractured True Sun Skill is at most at the Dharma Level.
To make the True Sun Skill reach the Immortal Level, unless the Martial Dao True Understanding advances further to a stronger law.

This is akin to the Everlasting Skill, because its tier is high enough, the fractured Small Faceless Skill, North Nether Divine Skill, and Eight Desolates and Six Harmonies, Only I Am Supreme Skill are extremely potent!
The Sun Skill fractured from the Martial Dao True Understanding follows the same logic.
"If that is truly the case. Ding Ling, you are indeed a man with immeasurable virtue."
Hua Tuo praised warmly:
"When we heard a few days ago that you had returned, we wanted to visit. But because we were too busy, and with so many people around the Prince’s Mansion, we refrained from intruding."
"It’s all my fault,"
Ding Ling replied:
"I should have visited the two of you first."
"You two should stop being so formal with each other."
Zhang Zhongjing laughed heartily:

"We’re all one family. Ding Ling. We won’t be too formal with you. But we are curious if you have brought back any advanced medical techniques or medical knowledge from the Upper Realm. Could you enlighten us?"
"Of course."
Ding Ling replied solemnly:
"Even if the two of you hadn’t asked, I would certainly have presented a Medical Canon."
These days.
Besides jointly cultivating special techniques with Diao Chan and others, allowing their strength to rapidly advance.
He also took the time to write down some secret manuals.
Among them are the ’Medical Canon’, ’Martial Arts Manual’, ’Array Manual’, etc.
The Medical Canon is meant for Hua Tuo and others.
The Martial Arts Manual is prepared for Tong Yuan and others.
The group sat in the carriage, chatting merrily, when cries of ’idol’ and ’Ding Ling’ echoed around them again.
It was the players and natives screaming and shouting.
Clearly, they recognized Ding Ling’s carriage.
Both Hua Tuo and Zhang Zhongjing couldn’t help but be impressed.
Both were medical officials, as well as deans of the medical academy.
In recent years, they’ve gained quite a bit of admiration themselves, often garnering applause wherever they went.
But compared to Ding Ling, it seemed like a small witch facing a great witch.
Sitting beside Ding Ling, they felt more like green leaves, just there for contrast.
And yet, Hua Tuo and Zhang Zhongjing felt no jealousy, but rather pride, grateful to have such a remarkable successor.
Upon reaching the Prince’s Mansion.
The screams and shouts gradually died down.
From start to finish, Ding Ling spoke very little with these players.
Simply because he understood his current influence, and also the nature of the players, who lost all reverence for the natives like Cao Mengde because they knew they wouldn’t die.
Even Ding Ling was regarded more like a celebrity.
If Ding Ling was overly amicable, the consequences would be apparent.
For there is no shortage of those who are insatiable and greedy in this world.
Seeing things clearly.
Ding Ling, therefore, did not engage much with the players.

With the Achievement Medal reaching increasingly higher tiers, Ding Ling now required no money, thus dismissing any thoughts of opening a martial arts school or interacting with large groups in a great city.
His sole purpose now was.
To achieve immortality with Diao Chan, Little Dragon Girl, and others!
Everything else is secondary.
’If it weren’t for the fact that players dying too much would lead to severe consequences like becoming idiots or comatose, they would likely have gone wild. Not even Cao Mengde could control them.’
Precisely because dying too much turns them into idiots, or even leaves them vegetative.
Players dared not overly provoke individuals like Cao Mengde with great strength and high status.
Naturally.
They’re even less inclined to challenge Ding Ling.

"So powerful!"
Only after Cao Mengde saw that Cao Pi, Cao Zhi, and the others had quieted down did he speak:
"That’s the reality.
So, I hope you all can be more diligent and serious in your scholarly and martial pursuits.
You must know, Upper God was renowned across the world for being all-powerful from the very beginning.
I don’t expect you to be an All-Powerful King, I only hope that you can make some achievements in both literature and martial arts.
Especially in martial power.
You must become strong!
Only then can you leap out of this small pond world and venture to higher tiers of existence and broader horizons..."
Cao Mengde spoke slowly.
He revealed some of the secrets he knew to Cao Zhi, Cao Pi, and others.
In the eyes of Cao Mengde.
Cao Pi was already over ten years old, Cao Zhang seven or eight, and Cao Zhi five or six...
They weren’t too young, especially Cao Pi, who had reached the age of understanding.
Thus, Cao Mengde chose today, at this appropriate moment, to disclose some secrets, hoping that his sons could break free from the cage and transcend beyond.
"And what about you, Father?"
"I will also strive to cultivate and aim to transcend.
As for the throne?
When the time comes, I will follow the example of Upper God, choosing someone capable and responsible to become the emperor.
Compared to immortality, glory and wealth are but an empty dream..."
After realizing Ding Ling’s power, the children like Cao Pi, Cao Zhi, and Cao Zhang also wished to become his apprentices.
Especially Cao Pi, Cao Zhi, and Cao Zhang, who had a strong desire, and if not for Cao Mengde’s intervention, would have run to kneel outside the Prince’s Mansion that very day.
Not understanding was one thing.
Once they understood, and knowing that Cao Chong and Cao Ang had already succeeded in becoming apprentices, the fire in their hearts could no longer be extinguished.
Yet Ding Ling was completely unaware of this.
He, accompanied by Hua Tuo, Zhang Zhongjing, and Cao Chong, rode a carriage toward the Prince’s Mansion.
Cao Chong sat obediently to the side, his large, round eyes looking at Hua Tuo, Zhang Zhongjing, and Ding Ling, occasionally calling out gently to his master.
He was very adorable.
Hua Tuo and Zhang Zhongjing seemed to like Cao Chong very much, and more than once expressed to Ding Ling:
"Luckily you descended.
Otherwise, ten years from now, this child would likely have died.
The trace of True Sun Flame you mentioned continuously burns his life away, and we are helpless.
Is the martial dao cultivation you spoke of really useful?"
"We’ll know by trying, won’t we?"
Ding Ling smiled slightly:
"My Martial Dao True Understanding is all-encompassing, with skills and laws in the Dao of Fire.

Once I fracture a portion of the True Sun Skill, and if Cao Chong channels the True Sun Flame into his dantian, continually strengthening his foundation and physique, as long as his body and meridians are strong enough to withstand the fire, with time, he will naturally become a Fire God!"
This was Ding Ling’s speculation.
Moreover, his Martial Dao True Understanding indeed contained techniques and laws in the way of fire.
In Ding Ling’s Divine Emperor Fist, there is the skill ’Heaven-Scorching Earth-Burning’, where one punch can send blazing flames that pierce through the sky!
Thus, extracting a portion of the True Sun Skill from the Martial Dao True Understanding is not difficult.
The hard part is making this True Sun Skill reach the Immortal Level.
The Martial Dao True Understanding is only at the Immortal Level, and the fractured True Sun Skill is at most at the Dharma Level.
To make the True Sun Skill reach the Immortal Level, unless the Martial Dao True Understanding advances further to a stronger law.

This is akin to the Everlasting Skill, because its tier is high enough, the fractured Small Faceless Skill, North Nether Divine Skill, and Eight Desolates and Six Harmonies, Only I Am Supreme Skill are extremely potent!
The Sun Skill fractured from the Martial Dao True Understanding follows the same logic.
"If that is truly the case.
Ding Ling, you are indeed a man with immeasurable virtue."
Hua Tuo praised warmly:
"When we heard a few days ago that you had returned, we wanted to visit.
But because we were too busy, and with so many people around the Prince’s Mansion, we refrained from intruding."
"It’s all my fault,"
Ding Ling replied:
"I should have visited the two of you first."
"You two should stop being so formal with each other."
Zhang Zhongjing laughed heartily:
"We’re all one family.
Ding Ling.
We won’t be too formal with you.
But we are curious if you have brought back any advanced medical techniques or medical knowledge from the Upper Realm.
Could you enlighten us?"
"Of course."
Ding Ling replied solemnly:
"Even if the two of you hadn’t asked, I would certainly have presented a Medical Canon."
These days.
Besides jointly cultivating special techniques with Diao Chan and others, allowing their strength to rapidly advance.
He also took the time to write down some secret manuals.
Among them are the ’Medical Canon’, ’Martial Arts Manual’, ’Array Manual’, etc.
The Medical Canon is meant for Hua Tuo and others.
The Martial Arts Manual is prepared for Tong Yuan and others.
The group sat in the carriage, chatting merrily, when cries of ’idol’ and ’Ding Ling’ echoed around them again.
It was the players and natives screaming and shouting.
Clearly, they recognized Ding Ling’s carriage.
Both Hua Tuo and Zhang Zhongjing couldn’t help but be impressed.
Both were medical officials, as well as deans of the medical academy.
In recent years, they’ve gained quite a bit of admiration themselves, often garnering applause wherever they went.
But compared to Ding Ling, it seemed like a small witch facing a great witch.
Sitting beside Ding Ling, they felt more like green leaves, just there for contrast.
And yet, Hua Tuo and Zhang Zhongjing felt no jealousy, but rather pride, grateful to have such a remarkable successor.
Upon reaching the Prince’s Mansion.
The screams and shouts gradually died down.
From start to finish, Ding Ling spoke very little with these players.
Simply because he understood his current influence, and also the nature of the players, who lost all reverence for the natives like Cao Mengde because they knew they wouldn’t die.
Even Ding Ling was regarded more like a celebrity.
If Ding Ling was overly amicable, the consequences would be apparent.
For there is no shortage of those who are insatiable and greedy in this world.
Seeing things clearly.
Ding Ling, therefore, did not engage much with the players.

With the Achievement Medal reaching increasingly higher tiers, Ding Ling now required no money, thus dismissing any thoughts of opening a martial arts school or interacting with large groups in a great city.
His sole purpose now was.
To achieve immortality with Diao Chan, Little Dragon Girl, and others!
Everything else is secondary.
’If it weren’t for the fact that players dying too much would lead to severe consequences like becoming idiots or comatose, they would likely have gone wild.
Not even Cao Mengde could control them.’
Precisely because dying too much turns them into idiots, or even leaves them vegetative.
Players dared not overly provoke individuals like Cao Mengde with great strength and high status.
Naturally.
They’re even less inclined to challenge Ding Ling.

chapters.title: Chapter 778 - 767: The Crow on the Celestial Ladder
paragraphs: After all, Ding Ling’s reputation precedes him.
For any player daring to offend him, Ding Ling would take ruthless action.
Countless players have been killed by Ding Ling.
In forums of the real world, there are dedicated threads analyzing Ding Ling’s character.
Through countless data analysis, players have generally understood and seen through Ding Ling’s character.
They know that Ding Ling repays kindness, seeks revenge, and is decisive in killing, unwilling to associate much with players.
If it weren’t like this.
Players probably would have swarmed him long ago.
In the following days.
Ding Ling stayed at the Prince’s Mansion, discussing Dao with Tong Yuan, Wang Yue, Hua Tuo, Zhang Zhongjing, and others.
In the evenings, he accompanied Diao Chan and the others practicing the Martial Dao True Understanding.
During the day, he took time out of his busy schedule to guide Cao Ang and Cao Chong a bit.
Ding Ling had also deciphered Cao Chong’s "True Sun Skill" and personally established his foundation.
Due to Cao Chong’s extremely special physique, his body naturally carried a bit of True Sun Flame.
Thus, Ding Ling only needed to guide this bit of true flame to successfully open up Cao Chong’s Eight Extraordinary Meridians.
Yet since Cao Chong was physically weak, opening them all at once could easily lead to the true flame backfiring and causing harm.
Therefore.
Ding Ling opened one meridian for Cao Chong per day.
Like this for eight days.
After the Eight Meridians were all connected.
Ding Ling began guiding Cao Chong in practicing the True Sun Skill.
Initially, there was no need to directly absorb the sun’s fire qi; Cao Chong only needed to face himself, gradually drawing and refining the pure true flame power within his body for his own use.
Once completely absorbed and refined, the foundation establishment was considered successful.
By then, he could attempt to absorb the sun’s fire qi in the sky.
If he could indeed absorb the sun’s fire qi.
Over time, Cao Chong becoming a Fire God was definitely not out of reach.
Everything proceeded step by step.
Diao Chan, Zhen Jiang, and others grew increasingly strong.
Each, with Ding Ling’s full assistance, drew a strand of Martial Arts True Qi and paved their path toward becoming a Grandmaster.
Each one of them now became a Martial Arts Grandmaster.
Moreover, they were Grandmasters who practiced Immortal Level Magic and Skill, with exceptionally stable foundations!
In reverse ascension, they could easily cut down ordinary Shattering Level experts.
But Ding Ling was still not satisfied.
He intended to make a concerted effort to cultivate Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, Du Qingcheng, and others into Shattering Level experts, so he could leave with peace of mind.
However, it was on this very day.
Zhao Yun reported that a crow flew straight into the Celestial Ladder, beyond their pursuit.
"A crow?"
Ding Ling stood with his hands behind his back, looking towards the direction of the Celestial Ladder:
"Is it Zuo Ci?"
’It should be.’

Under Ding Ling’s guidance, Zhao Yun’s Martial Dao True Understanding had already reached entry level. Nowadays, he grew stronger just by walking and eating. Over time, he had completely changed; his aura was particularly intimidating, evident to all as a top expert:

"He briefly exchanged blows with me, was defeated, got injured, screamed, and dissipated into smoke. Moments later, he suddenly reformed into a crow shape in mid-air and rapidly shot toward the Celestial Ladder. I pursued but he escaped. To avoid delaying the news, I reported back to the Prince immediately!"
"I’ll go take a look."
Ding Ling took a step, and in the next moment, he was beside the Celestial Ladder.
Pan Feng was stationed here with his army, and upon seeing Ding Ling, he immediately saluted respectfully.
The other soldiers, with fervent zeal, looked at Ding Ling, loudly cheering "Prince!"

Ding Ling nodded with a smile, and with another step, he ascended the Celestial Ladder, turning lightly, resembling a wisp of smoke, vanishing in front of Pan Feng and the others in the blink of an eye.
Pan Feng and the others were amazed:
"No wonder he is the Prince! That crow may have fled swiftly, but if it were any slower and encountered the Prince, it surely wouldn’t have escaped death!"
Among these soldiers were also players.
Players were convinced that Ding Ling intended to leave this world and would likely step onto the Celestial Ladder.
Moreover, with Ding Ling dispatching Zhao Yun and Pan Feng to guard the Celestial Ladder, something significant must be at hand, prompting astute players to join the guard.
Unsurprisingly, seeing Ding Ling up close, their hearts burned with fervor:
"Ding Ling is much more handsome than I imagined! Also, his aura and charm are extremely high."

"That’s secondary; the most crucial thing is, he is too strong. With a spin, he darted into the clouds. Such speed is indeed just like what those under Zang Ba described, so fast the naked eye can’t catch!
"Ding Ling is already so strong. Do you think a nuclear missile could defeat him?"

"I think not. A nuclear missile is powerful, but Ding Ling seems even faster! Whether an airplane can catch up with Ding Ling is questionable, let alone hitting him. And with such speed, who can guess how high his defense might be? Perhaps Ding Ling could withstand a nuclear missile without a scratch now?"
Players whispered among themselves.
Their envy and jealousy of Ding Ling reached a pinnacle.

Certainly, they also ardently wished that Ding Ling would leave behind some top-notch Divine Skills and Secret Techniques so that they could save much effort, but alas, Ding Ling was high above, like someone from another world, making it incredibly difficult to converse with him, let alone seek his guidance!
"How exactly can we gain Ding Ling’s favor?"
Players worried.

Ding Ling activated the Celestial Patrol Step, covering several hundred miles with a step, like a deity traversing the mortal realm. Before long, he had unknowingly journeyed thousands, tens of thousands of miles.
At the end of the Celestial Ladder, he saw a crow taking flight.
The crow was entirely black as ink, looking rather familiar.
Ding Ling briefly recalled, freezing on a past scene: a crow suddenly appeared on the phoenix tree in the Prince’s Mansion’s front courtyard!
"Zuo Ci."
Ding Ling took a stride, floating out like smoke, reaching the crow’s front in an instant, blocking its path to the ’Gate of Glory’.
"It’s you!"

The crow widened its eyes in horror, its pair of black wings flapping faster. It tried several times to bypass Ding Ling and enter the Gate of Glory, but failed. Desperate, it cawed sharply, suddenly turning into green smoke and disappearing.
Ding Ling’s Seeking Truth Dao Eye activated, his gaze like a torch, in a moment locking onto a position in the void, pointing it out!
Whoosh!
A Sword Qi shot forth, like a meteor, hitting an object with a bang, followed by a scream as a crow fell from mid-air, rolling down the Celestial Ladder.
Ding Ling did not intervene, simply watching it quietly.
He could see that this crow was merely one of Zuo Ci’s incarnations.
Only possessing part of Zuo Ci’s Soul Division.
By now.
Ding Ling’s Martial Dao reached Tongtian, his strength and cultivation compared to the Three Kingdoms era was worlds apart, so he thought slightly.
He pondered through the reasoning and rationale within.
Undoubtedly, Zuo Ci must have divided a soul portion to inhabit a crow’s body, and then, using the Soul-Devouring Skill, devoured the crow’s soul, allowing him to fully control the crow’s body.

chapters.title: Chapter 779 - 768: Sword Realm
paragraphs: The Crow was like this.
The previous old man’s shell must have been the same.
And Zuo Ci’s crow incarnation was pitifully weak.
Ding Ling could extinguish it with a breath.
Even so,

this crow still understood Zuo Ci’s magic and skill, and due to the soul’s alignment with the Celestial Might, the power of the technique was beyond what an ordinary Super-Elite Fierce General could imagine.
Only those with strength at the Celestial Human Realm could contend with and defeat it.
And the old man’s incarnation that Ding Ling defeated in the Three Kingdoms earlier,
had to be killed a full nine times before it was truly dead.
This shows that the ’soul’ split from that incarnation must have been much greater!
At least, according to Ding Ling’s perception and comparison, there was a difference as much as nine times.
Nine crow ’soul divisions’ could barely match one old man’s soul division.
It was clear that Zuo Ci indeed spent considerable effort on that old man’s incarnation.
But many years ago, Ding Ling could already kill the old man’s incarnation, so how could this mere crow incarnation display any power in front of Ding Ling?
Zuo Ci perhaps understood this, which is why he immediately tried to escape, unwilling to engage in a magical battle with Ding Ling.
Unexpectedly, his ability to hide in the void was seen through by Ding Ling at a glance, and then easily broken.
"How can he be so strong?!"
"This is too terrifying!"
The crow that Zuo Ci transformed into wanted to flap its wings and fly, only to find its wings pierced by Sword Qi. A sharp Sword Qi writhed in the wound, impossible to dissipate.
"What is this aura?!"
Zuo Ci was shocked:

"Never before seen or heard of! The aura even the Nanhua Old Immortal unleashed is far inferior to this one by numerous times! Ding Ling has only ascended for about five years! How has his strength suddenly surged to such an unimaginable state!"
Zuo Ci also elevated an incarnation.
That incarnation acquired numerous opportunities, growing ever stronger.
A few days ago.
Suddenly, inexplicably, it connected with the main body.
This allowed the main body to comprehend the incarnation’s experiences, which in turn made him harbor the idea of leaving this world to seek opportunities and creation in other worlds.

Yet, leaving just like that, Zuo Ci was reluctant, simply because his main body was still undertaking a great endeavor, and if successful, it would spare countless years of hard cultivation, making immortality within reach.
Nevertheless, he couldn’t possibly do nothing, so he dispatched the crow incarnation, wanting it to ascend and leave.
Unexpectedly, flying over mountains of obstacles, upon reaching a populated area, it heard news of Ding Ling’s return.
When the crow arrived near Chang’an, as expected,

it saw Pan Feng and Zhao Yun, leading heavy troops stationed near the Celestial Ladder. The crow decided not to force its way through, waiting for the right moment, yet didn’t anticipate Pan Feng and Zhao Yun’s aura growing ever stronger.
Especially Zhao Yun, who gave him an eerie feeling of imminent danger.
Unable to delay further, the crow incarnation chose to force its way through, only to be wounded by Zhao Yun’s spear, resulting in its flying speed slowing down.
Even so, with Celestial Might enhancing it, its speed was unparalleled, comparable to wind, yet was still overtaken by Ding Ling, stopped forcefully in front of the Gate of Glory.
From this, one could imagine how terrifying Ding Ling’s speed was.
Unable to run.
Unable to hide.
After rolling in despair for a moment, the crow incarnation suddenly halted, standing on the ’Horizontal Tier’ of the Celestial Ladder, eyes bright as it gazed at Ding Ling, and shouted:
"Ding Ling, what would it take for you to let me go?"
Its voice was still as hoarse and grating as five years ago, like sandpaper scrapping the ground.
Ding Ling let out a long sigh and waved his hand casually.
The Sword Spirit’s Sword Realm Power suddenly enveloped the crow incarnation.
"That’s indeed useful."
"However, it can only be used on the Celestial Ladder?"
From the moment Ding Ling set foot on the Celestial Ladder,
he sensed an extremely subtle change occurring with the Sword Spirit.
Now, with a slight test,
he discovered that the Sword Spirit, paired with Martial Dao True Understanding, had awakened a kind of ’Martial Arts Realm’ power!
This Domain Power resembled the ’Domain Crystal’ in the Sword Realm!
Possessing part of the Domain Crystal’s efficacy.
However, unlike the Domain Crystal, this was a Martial Dao True Understanding’s Martial Arts Crystal, a crystal solely created by Ding Ling.
At present, this crystal was merely an illusory, hazy aura.
Not yet truly refined.
Even so,
on this Lower Realm Celestial Ladder, through the Sword Spirit, he could unleash the ’Sword of Martial Arts Realm!’
Whether ’Fist of Realm’ or ’Knife of Realm’ will be developed later remains to be seen.

But Ding Ling probably finds little issue, simply because the Martial Dao True Understanding is all-encompassing; thus, the future Martial Arts Realm will naturally be all-inclusive, omnipotent, and immensely powerful.
"Why can’t it be used in the Upper Realm? It can only be used here?"
Ding Ling pondered:
"Could it be because of the co-practice of Mystic Techniques with Diao Chan and others, leading to the evolution of Martial Arts True Qi within the body into a more harmonious and flawless state?"
The co-practice of married couple’s Secret Techniques with Diao Chan and others.
Resulted in a Supreme Yin and softness within Ding Ling’s Martial Arts True Qi.
This aura grew with each practice of the couple’s Secret Technique.
Now,
it has thoroughly integrated into Martial Arts True Qi.
While it didn’t increase the amount of Martial Arts True Qi, it made the quality, level, and True Intent much more flawless.
To put it simply, the original Martial Dao True Understanding was like a big bowl with a tiny crack, now that crack has been patched up.
"Perhaps it also relates to this world being more fragile?"
With the world fragile, Ding Ling could unleash stronger abilities.
But if this power erupted, the world might shatter, hence, Ding Ling could only use the power of ’Sword Realm’ within the space domain on this Celestial Ladder.
Compared to the fragility of the Historical World, the spatial domain on the Celestial Ladder is clearly more stable!
"Just not sure if in the Fengyun World, this kind of Domain Power can be freely used?"
In the Sword Realm, Ding Ling had used this Domain Power, which was truly formidable.
But besides the Sword Realm, nowhere else could it be used.
Now, however, this power permeated every inch of the Sword Spirit’s being at all times, available for free use.
Boom!
The Sword Spirit instantly seized control of the space where the crow resided, confining his body and spirit.
Then.
The Sword Spirit instantly entered the crow’s sea of consciousness, seeing a monster.
It had a human head and a crow’s shell.
Instead, it was a human-headed crow-bodied soul body.
"Ah!"
The human head had regular features and a youthful face with grey hair, appearing quite celestial and dao-like, but at this moment, he screamed without any decorum:
"How can you possibly confine my body and spirit! And how can you enter my sea of consciousness! How did you manage to do this?! You, you, you, have you by any chance become an immortal?!"
As he spoke,
this bizarre soul had already begun trembling uncontrollably.

A sharp Sword Qi writhed in the wound, impossible to dissipate.
"What is this aura?!"
Zuo Ci was shocked:
"Never before seen or heard of!
The aura even the Nanhua Old Immortal unleashed is far inferior to this one by numerous times!
Ding Ling has only ascended for about five years!
How has his strength suddenly surged to such an unimaginable state!"
Zuo Ci also elevated an incarnation.
That incarnation acquired numerous opportunities, growing ever stronger.
A few days ago.
Suddenly, inexplicably, it connected with the main body.
This allowed the main body to comprehend the incarnation’s experiences, which in turn made him harbor the idea of leaving this world to seek opportunities and creation in other worlds.

Yet, leaving just like that, Zuo Ci was reluctant, simply because his main body was still undertaking a great endeavor, and if successful, it would spare countless years of hard cultivation, making immortality within reach.
Nevertheless, he couldn’t possibly do nothing, so he dispatched the crow incarnation, wanting it to ascend and leave.
Unexpectedly, flying over mountains of obstacles, upon reaching a populated area, it heard news of Ding Ling’s return.
When the crow arrived near Chang’an, as expected,
it saw Pan Feng and Zhao Yun, leading heavy troops stationed near the Celestial Ladder.
The crow decided not to force its way through, waiting for the right moment, yet didn’t anticipate Pan Feng and Zhao Yun’s aura growing ever stronger.
Especially Zhao Yun, who gave him an eerie feeling of imminent danger.
Unable to delay further, the crow incarnation chose to force its way through, only to be wounded by Zhao Yun’s spear, resulting in its flying speed slowing down.
Even so, with Celestial Might enhancing it, its speed was unparalleled, comparable to wind, yet was still overtaken by Ding Ling, stopped forcefully in front of the Gate of Glory.
From this, one could imagine how terrifying Ding Ling’s speed was.
Unable to run.
Unable to hide.
After rolling in despair for a moment, the crow incarnation suddenly halted, standing on the ’Horizontal Tier’ of the Celestial Ladder, eyes bright as it gazed at Ding Ling, and shouted:
"Ding Ling, what would it take for you to let me go?"
Its voice was still as hoarse and grating as five years ago, like sandpaper scrapping the ground.
Ding Ling let out a long sigh and waved his hand casually.
The Sword Spirit’s Sword Realm Power suddenly enveloped the crow incarnation.
"That’s indeed useful."
"However, it can only be used on the Celestial Ladder?"
From the moment Ding Ling set foot on the Celestial Ladder,
he sensed an extremely subtle change occurring with the Sword Spirit.
Now, with a slight test,
he discovered that the Sword Spirit, paired with Martial Dao True Understanding, had awakened a kind of ’Martial Arts Realm’ power!
This Domain Power resembled the ’Domain Crystal’ in the Sword Realm!
Possessing part of the Domain Crystal’s efficacy.
However, unlike the Domain Crystal, this was a Martial Dao True Understanding’s Martial Arts Crystal, a crystal solely created by Ding Ling.
At present, this crystal was merely an illusory, hazy aura.
Not yet truly refined.
Even so,
on this Lower Realm Celestial Ladder, through the Sword Spirit, he could unleash the ’Sword of Martial Arts Realm!’
Whether ’Fist of Realm’ or ’Knife of Realm’ will be developed later remains to be seen.

But Ding Ling probably finds little issue, simply because the Martial Dao True Understanding is all-encompassing; thus, the future Martial Arts Realm will naturally be all-inclusive, omnipotent, and immensely powerful.
"Why can’t it be used in the Upper Realm?
It can only be used here?"
Ding Ling pondered:
"Could it be because of the co-practice of Mystic Techniques with Diao Chan and others, leading to the evolution of Martial Arts True Qi within the body into a more harmonious and flawless state?"
The co-practice of married couple’s Secret Techniques with Diao Chan and others.
Resulted in a Supreme Yin and softness within Ding Ling’s Martial Arts True Qi.
This aura grew with each practice of the couple’s Secret Technique.
Now,
it has thoroughly integrated into Martial Arts True Qi.
While it didn’t increase the amount of Martial Arts True Qi, it made the quality, level, and True Intent much more flawless.
To put it simply, the original Martial Dao True Understanding was like a big bowl with a tiny crack, now that crack has been patched up.
"Perhaps it also relates to this world being more fragile?"
With the world fragile, Ding Ling could unleash stronger abilities.
But if this power erupted, the world might shatter, hence, Ding Ling could only use the power of ’Sword Realm’ within the space domain on this Celestial Ladder.
Compared to the fragility of the Historical World, the spatial domain on the Celestial Ladder is clearly more stable!
"Just not sure if in the Fengyun World, this kind of Domain Power can be freely used?"
In the Sword Realm, Ding Ling had used this Domain Power, which was truly formidable.
But besides the Sword Realm, nowhere else could it be used.
Now, however, this power permeated every inch of the Sword Spirit’s being at all times, available for free use.
Boom!
The Sword Spirit instantly seized control of the space where the crow resided, confining his body and spirit.
Then.
The Sword Spirit instantly entered the crow’s sea of consciousness, seeing a monster.
It had a human head and a crow’s shell.
Instead, it was a human-headed crow-bodied soul body.
"Ah!"
The human head had regular features and a youthful face with grey hair, appearing quite celestial and dao-like, but at this moment, he screamed without any decorum:
"How can you possibly confine my body and spirit!
And how can you enter my sea of consciousness!
How did you manage to do this?!
You, you, you, have you by any chance become an immortal?!"
As he spoke,
this bizarre soul had already begun trembling uncontrollably.

chapters.title: Chapter 780 - 769: Nine Tripod Pill Scripture Full Level
paragraphs: The Sword Spirit ignored the strange soul and instead waved his hand. Boom! A surge of overwhelming Sword Intent cascaded out, instantly covering, crushing, and obliterating the soul of the Crow!
Streams of consciousness began to scatter and rampage within the Crow’s Sea of Consciousness.
The Sword Spirit, with piercing eyes, formed seals with his hands and began to extract memories from these streams of consciousness.
Each time he stripped away a portion,
Ding Ling would perfectly grasp that part of the memory.
A moment later.
The Sword Spirit had already stripped away a small half of the consciousness streams.
Just as he was about to continue, boom! The Sea of Consciousness exploded, and even the Crow’s shell began to disintegrate!
The Sword Spirit’s body was protected by Sword Armor, allowing him to escape the Sea of Consciousness unharmed and fly into Ding Ling’s body.
Ding Ling glanced at the Crow, whose head had exploded.
A brief sense, and he understood.
It turns out that the Crow’s frail Sea of Consciousness couldn’t withstand the rampage of the strange soul’s consciousness stream and completely shattered.
"What a pity... just a little bit more and I could have obtained the Heavenly Book of Escape Armor."
What the Sword Spirit extracted was a small portion of the memory.
Only a small portion of secret skills.
[Full Level of Sex Skill]
[Exorcism Skill Full Level]
[Ghost-Intimidating Technique Full Level]
[Nine Tripod Pill Scripture Full Level]
Three skills and one technique.
Upon reaching full level in an instant,
Ding Ling reached into the void and could draw out a strand of Ghost Qi.

"Heaven and earth have Righteous Qi, and there is also Ghost Qi. This kind of Ghost Qi forms from the deceased, especially on the dark side of the world, at midnight, when the Ghost Qi is most dense. Only at this time can one capture Ghost Qi, have the chance to catch a ghost, and then subdue and sign a contract with them for personal use."
If nurtured long enough,

It can even send the ghost deeper into the Underworld Netherworld to lure out a stronger Ghost King. Then use the same technique to subdue the Ghost King, sign a contract, and use it as a Ghost Servant.
"Very impressive Exorcism Skill and Ghost-Intimidating Technique."
Ding Ling was surprised:
"Even the Wind and Cloud World doesn’t have such skills. A mere Historical World actually does! It seems the Historical World is not as simple as I imagined."
Ding Ling thought of the inheritances of Chiyou and the Yellow Emperor.
This Three Kingdoms Historical Plane also has the Yellow Emperor and Chiyou.
Moreover, some of their techniques and laws have been passed down for generations.
Tong Yuan’s Spear Technique inherited a lot from Chiyou.
And the Sword Sect that Wang Yue comes from can trace back to the Yellow Emperor’s era, as the Yellow Emperor himself was once a Sect Leader of the Sword Sect!
And Ding Ling had confirmed one thing.
That is, the Chiyou and Yellow Emperor from this world are entirely different people from those in the Wind and Cloud World.
But regardless.
This Historical World certainly flourished during the Ancient Era.
Otherwise, it could not have left behind so many legendary and outstanding techniques and laws.
"There is Exorcism Skill. There is the Ghost Gate and the Netherworld."
Ding Ling thought of the method recorded in that small portion of memory to go to the Netherworld, and immediately formed seals with his hands!
As the Seal Technique continuously formed,
Mysterious power surged from the Seal Technique, transforming into Ba-Gua diagrams that spiraled ten zhang in front of Ding Ling.
As the power from the Seal Technique erupted completely.
Boom!
A door condensed out of the void.
The door was about two hundred feet tall.
Flickering between reality and illusion!
Like the moon reflected in the water.
Ding Ling activated the Seeking Truth Dao Eye, his eyes bright and piercing, gazing past.
In one glance, he saw through the world behind that portal.
Sure enough, it was a dark, cold Netherworld.
How vast this realm was.
It was still unknown.
But judging by the perpetual darkness and wandering spirits.
This should indeed be the Netherworld of the Three Kingdoms World.
"There’s actually a Netherworld. Could there also be an Immortal Realm?"
Ding Ling recalled an ancient record from the Three Kingdoms World: The Yellow Emperor ascended riding a dragon!
"The Yellow Emperor ascended. So, he must have gone to the so-called Immortal Realm, the opposite of the Netherworld?"
Ding Ling was filled with uncertainty.
But he didn’t know how to enter the Immortal Realm.

He pondered for a moment, then immediately activated a protective shield. The Sword Spirit stepped out of his body, stepping forward like a flash of lightning and diving into the flickering Netherworld Gate!
He wanted to see what was in there.
To see if he could gain anything from it, or unravel some mysteries of this Three Kingdoms World.
Ka-boom!
Just as Ding Ling speculated.
A human body cannot enter this Netherworld Gate, but the Sword Spirit, being just a soul, could freely enter.
With his unmatched skills and fearlessness, he wouldn’t even regard the Ghost General of the Netherworld.
Even so, he still took every precaution he could.
Clang, clang, clang!
The sound of Sword Armor clanging as it clad the Sword Spirit, transforming into an invisible, intangible protective layer.
This protective layer can destroy souls and capture spirits!
Extremely powerful.
This is why Ding Ling dared to enter the Netherworld.
Though the Sword Spirit could not command all the ’skills’ of the Martial Dao True Understanding.
Even just considering the Breaking Sword Skill, he could unravel anything!
Da, da, da!
Ding Ling lightly landed on the ground of the Netherworld, gazing around.
Here.
He saw much more clearly.
The sky was gloomy, with patches of black fog stretching to the world’s end, covering the entire sky, making this world feel extremely oppressive.
Upon entering here,
It was as if he had jumped from an ocean into a pond.
"This realm seems about to overlap."
Ding Ling looked at the sky of this world.
It felt as if it might fall at any moment.
"Has this Netherworld reached doomsday? Or is it inherently this way?"
Ding Ling couldn’t fathom.
He strolled forward.
It was his first time entering this Three Kingdoms Netherworld, so he didn’t know how things stood here.
Thus, he chose to walk cautiously.
Until he captured a ’ghost,’ stripped its memory, and then moved confidently; that would be prudent.
"Being cautious never hurts."
Although Ding Ling was supremely confident.
He believed he was unrivaled, that he could easily cut through the Netherworld too.
Yet, there were always stories of mishaps hidden in shadows.
Ding Ling had also nearly had such a mishap due to overconfidence before.
Learning from past mistakes.
Being careful was undoubtedly wise.
Da, da, da!
Ding Ling’s eyes, sharp as lightning, scanned all around, walking on this shifting land as though treading on clouds, giving him a rather surreal sensation.
Suddenly, a man over eight feet tall approached from the front.
He was clad in black armor, wearing a black mask, revealing only eyes burning with green flames.
"This is a ghost."
A few years ago in the Three Kingdoms World, Ding Ling had killed a ghost over three meters tall.
Compared to that ghost,
The ghost ahead could only be considered weak.

The Sword Spirit activated Domain Power and pointed forward, capturing the man with ease, then crushed his body with a palm strike, boom! The soul exploded, and streams of consciousness rampaged through the Ten Directions Realm.
The Sword Spirit’s Domain Power flared, enveloping the Ten Directions to prevent the consciousness stream from escaping outside the domain.
The Sword Spirit then swiftly began extracting the streams of consciousness, analyzing, and controlling the information within.
Information was decomposed by the Sword Spirit, piece by piece.
A period later,
With thirty percent of the information grasped,
The remaining consciousness streams suddenly dissipated into nothingness.
Time was up.
Those consciousness streams inevitably merged into the Netherworld of Heaven and Earth.

chapters.title: Chapter 781 - 770: Netherworld
paragraphs: The Domain Power of the Sword Spirit can prevent the stream of consciousness from dissipating, but it cannot stop it from merging into the Netherworld.
Compare this with the heavens and earth.
The Domain Power is indeed weak.
But even with only thirty percent of the information,
it gave Ding Ling a general understanding of this Netherworld.
’So this is the kind of world it is.’
The sword light under Ding Ling’s feet flickered unpredictably. In just an instant, he rode the sword light across three hundred miles, arriving at a military camp.
Here,
Ding Ling saw a familiar figure.
He raised his eyebrows slightly and tentatively called out:
"Lei Bo!"
"Huh?! Who’s calling me?"

This person had thick eyebrows and big eyes, a broad back and a robust waist, wielding a large hammer. He was leaning against the pole at the military camp gate, sound asleep. Ding Ling’s voice immediately startled him awake. He glanced sideways, saw Ding Ling, first stunned, then couldn’t help but burst into laughter.
His laughter grew louder and louder.
Until tears seemed to spring in his eyes, bending over, pounding on his chest, laughing uncontrollably, almost out of breath.
As if he had encountered the greatest joy in life.
Laughing so much his mouth couldn’t close, unable to conceal his joy in his heart.
The military camp was vast.
Occupying an extremely extensive area.
But at this moment, the soldiers in the camp seemed to be resting.
Thus, it was very quiet.
But Lei Bo’s laughter woke up many people.
Huff huff!
One by one, either angry or furious, rushed out.
When they saw Ding Ling standing at the gate, they were all stunned as well, then either laughed, cursed, joyed madly, derided, or mocked coldly.
In an instant,
all kinds of voices came to his ears.
But Ding Ling remained unmoved. He glanced around and saw many familiar faces.
Chen Lan, Yuan Yao, Yuan Yin, Le Jiu, Liang Gang, Jii Ling...
"So many familiar faces?!"
Ding Ling was surprised:
"Could it be that after people die, their spirits really ascend to this Netherworld?"
"Indeed."

Jii Ling was taller and more imposing than in the mortal world; it was clear that this world’s limits were higher than the mortal world. Now Jii Ling’s aura was extremely oppressive, nearly reaching three meters tall, no weaker than that Ghost General Ding Ling killed before.
Although height and aura completely differ from the mortal world,
Jii Ling’s face was identical to when he was alive.
Not just Jii Ling.
Lei Bo, Le Jiu, Yuan Yao, and others had all undergone changes in height, even subtle changes in facial features, but Ding Ling recognized them all instantly.
And those people surely didn’t forget Ding Ling’s appearance too. Now that Lei Bo finished laughing, he said loudly:
"Really unexpected, Ding Ling, you also have such a day!"
"Indeed."
Yuan Yao stepped forward, looking at Ding Ling with hatred in his eyes:

"You kidnapped me years ago, causing my untimely death. I’ve remembered this grudge all along. Just waiting for you to die quickly so I can kill you. Hahaha, I didn’t think it would only be a few years, and I already have my chance. Truly heaven helps me too!"
"Indeed."
Yuan Yin nodded in agreement, his gaze at Ding Ling full of killing intent:

"I heard from the later comers that you ascended. I thought my revenge was hopeless. Didn’t expect you actually died too. Heh heh, this time if I don’t dismember you into a thousand pieces, I won’t be able to ease the hatred in my heart."
"Attack!"
Lei Bo swung the giant hammer, stepped forward, and swung it at Ding Ling heavily;
"I’ve wanted revenge for a long time, not just a day or two. Hahaha, Ding Ling, you beast~! Take this from Laozi!"
He was full of confidence.
In the Netherworld, height signifies heroism and power.
The taller one is, the stronger they are.
Compared to their two or three-meter height, Ding Ling indeed seemed skinny and extremely weak!
They looked down on Ding Ling, thinking he’s weak trash, naturally quite normal.
But Ding Ling didn’t quite understand, as the thirty percent of information he obtained was limited and didn’t engrave this, so, facing Lei Bo’s fierce aggressive stance, he was somewhat bewildered.
But his Observing People Skill was full level.
After a brief thought,
he understood everything.
He couldn’t help but chuckle, looking at the giant hammer smashing down with thunderous noise, he casually pointed a finger.
Breaking Sword Skill!
With a finger point, an invisible and intangible Sword Qi shot forth, instantly hitting the giant hammer, and then came a loud boom, exploding the giant hammer!
Turning into strands of black smoke dispersing in all directions.
"What?!"
Lei Bo was shocked, incredulous:
"You’re so much shorter than us, how is it possible?!"
Whoosh!
Ding Ling ignored Lei Bo, with a slight twist of his finger, the Sword Qi that exploded the giant hammer turned in the air, transforming into a stream of light shooting towards Lei Bo again.
Lei Bo seemed to sense something, opening his eyes wide, terrified, but he simply couldn’t believe Ding Ling was this strong, letting out a roar:
"Get him! Kill him!"
Chen Lan, Liang Gang immediately brandished their single blades, dashing forward, chopping fiercely towards Ding Ling.
Both roared as they struck with their strongest blows.
Once struck.
Visibly,

lotuses of blades condensed in the air, descending towards Ding Ling, these blade lotuses were peerlessly sharp, carrying rotational power, once near the enemy, could seem to slice the enemy into pieces, powder.
For this strike.
Liang Gang, Chen Lan were full of confidence.
However, Ding Ling didn’t dodge, merely casually reaching out his finger to touch the blade lotuses.
Bang!
The blade lotuses instantly shattered into fragments.
Ding Ling then pointed toward the positions of Liang Gang, Chen Lan, and both immediately felt a soul-stirring Sword Qi swiftly shooting towards them.
Yet their naked eyes couldn’t see it.
Not just that.
They fundamentally couldn’t avoid it.
"Ah!"
They were terrified, roaring, slashing hard forward, boom!
Boom boom boom!

The invisible, intangible Sword Qi shot through the blade lotuses, blade edges, with a might like breaking bamboo, easily shattering again the blade lotuses they chopped, then in a flash destroying their weapons, then with Ding Ling’s thought, the Sword Qi spun in the void, whoosh! Striking precisely their necks.
The Sword Qi first struck Lei Bo.
Then Chen Lan, Liang Gang.
Swish swish!
Three crisp sounds cut through the sky.
Looking again.
Lei Bo and the three generals were clutching their throats, collapsing dead on the ground, not closing their eyes in death!
Their eyes were as round as balls.
As if incredulous that they had died again!!
And killed by someone ’weaker’, who had just ascended to the Netherworld!!
"How is it possible?!"
"How did you do it?!"
Yuan Yin, Yuan Yao already harbored a psychological shadow because of Ding Ling.
A few years ago, these two were tied and made to walk a long way by Ding Ling.
They somewhat understood Ding Ling’s character.
Witnessing Ding Ling’s outburst again, instantly killing several fierce generals, they were horrified yet couldn’t comprehend, instinctively screaming loudly:

"Your body isn’t covered with the Netherworld’s aura! Obviously a ghost soul newly entering the Netherworld! You just broke into this world, the most vulnerable time, how could you instantly kill three of our fierce generals?!"

"Could it be that after people die, their spirits really ascend to this Netherworld?"
"Indeed."
Jii Ling was taller and more imposing than in the mortal world; it was clear that this world’s limits were higher than the mortal world.
Now Jii Ling’s aura was extremely oppressive, nearly reaching three meters tall, no weaker than that Ghost General Ding Ling killed before.
Although height and aura completely differ from the mortal world,
Jii Ling’s face was identical to when he was alive.
Not just Jii Ling.
Lei Bo, Le Jiu, Yuan Yao, and others had all undergone changes in height, even subtle changes in facial features, but Ding Ling recognized them all instantly.
And those people surely didn’t forget Ding Ling’s appearance too.
Now that Lei Bo finished laughing, he said loudly:
"Really unexpected, Ding Ling, you also have such a day!"
"Indeed."
Yuan Yao stepped forward, looking at Ding Ling with hatred in his eyes:
"You kidnapped me years ago, causing my untimely death.
I’ve remembered this grudge all along.
Just waiting for you to die quickly so I can kill you.
Hahaha, I didn’t think it would only be a few years, and I already have my chance.
Truly heaven helps me too!"
"Indeed."
Yuan Yin nodded in agreement, his gaze at Ding Ling full of killing intent:
"I heard from the later comers that you ascended.
I thought my revenge was hopeless.
Didn’t expect you actually died too.
Heh heh, this time if I don’t dismember you into a thousand pieces, I won’t be able to ease the hatred in my heart."
"Attack!"
Lei Bo swung the giant hammer, stepped forward, and swung it at Ding Ling heavily;
"I’ve wanted revenge for a long time, not just a day or two.
Hahaha, Ding Ling, you beast~!
Take this from Laozi!"
He was full of confidence.
In the Netherworld, height signifies heroism and power.
The taller one is, the stronger they are.
Compared to their two or three-meter height, Ding Ling indeed seemed skinny and extremely weak!
They looked down on Ding Ling, thinking he’s weak trash, naturally quite normal.
But Ding Ling didn’t quite understand, as the thirty percent of information he obtained was limited and didn’t engrave this, so, facing Lei Bo’s fierce aggressive stance, he was somewhat bewildered.
But his Observing People Skill was full level.
After a brief thought,
he understood everything.
He couldn’t help but chuckle, looking at the giant hammer smashing down with thunderous noise, he casually pointed a finger.
Breaking Sword Skill!
With a finger point, an invisible and intangible Sword Qi shot forth, instantly hitting the giant hammer, and then came a loud boom, exploding the giant hammer!
Turning into strands of black smoke dispersing in all directions.
"What?!"
Lei Bo was shocked, incredulous:
"You’re so much shorter than us, how is it possible?!"
Whoosh!
Ding Ling ignored Lei Bo, with a slight twist of his finger, the Sword Qi that exploded the giant hammer turned in the air, transforming into a stream of light shooting towards Lei Bo again.
Lei Bo seemed to sense something, opening his eyes wide, terrified, but he simply couldn’t believe Ding Ling was this strong, letting out a roar:
"Get him!
Kill him!"
Chen Lan, Liang Gang immediately brandished their single blades, dashing forward, chopping fiercely towards Ding Ling.
Both roared as they struck with their strongest blows.
Once struck.
Visibly,

lotuses of blades condensed in the air, descending towards Ding Ling, these blade lotuses were peerlessly sharp, carrying rotational power, once near the enemy, could seem to slice the enemy into pieces, powder.
For this strike.
Liang Gang, Chen Lan were full of confidence.
However, Ding Ling didn’t dodge, merely casually reaching out his finger to touch the blade lotuses.
Bang!
The blade lotuses instantly shattered into fragments.
Ding Ling then pointed toward the positions of Liang Gang, Chen Lan, and both immediately felt a soul-stirring Sword Qi swiftly shooting towards them.
Yet their naked eyes couldn’t see it.
Not just that.
They fundamentally couldn’t avoid it.
"Ah!"
They were terrified, roaring, slashing hard forward, boom!
Boom boom boom!

The invisible, intangible Sword Qi shot through the blade lotuses, blade edges, with a might like breaking bamboo, easily shattering again the blade lotuses they chopped, then in a flash destroying their weapons, then with Ding Ling’s thought, the Sword Qi spun in the void, whoosh!
Striking precisely their necks.
The Sword Qi first struck Lei Bo.
Then Chen Lan, Liang Gang.
Swish swish!
Three crisp sounds cut through the sky.
Looking again.
Lei Bo and the three generals were clutching their throats, collapsing dead on the ground, not closing their eyes in death!
Their eyes were as round as balls.
As if incredulous that they had died again!!
And killed by someone ’weaker’, who had just ascended to the Netherworld!!
"How is it possible?!"
"How did you do it?!"
Yuan Yin, Yuan Yao already harbored a psychological shadow because of Ding Ling.
A few years ago, these two were tied and made to walk a long way by Ding Ling.
They somewhat understood Ding Ling’s character.
Witnessing Ding Ling’s outburst again, instantly killing several fierce generals, they were horrified yet couldn’t comprehend, instinctively screaming loudly:
"Your body isn’t covered with the Netherworld’s aura!
Obviously a ghost soul newly entering the Netherworld!
You just broke into this world, the most vulnerable time, how could you instantly kill three of our fierce generals?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 782 - 771: Full Level Meditation Technique
paragraphs: Yuan Yin, Yuan Yao felt their guts and hearts splitting, truly unable to comprehend how Ding Ling accomplished this.
Even formidable generals like Jii Ling and Le Jiu couldn’t understand.
He clearly looked like a new ghost!
And he wasn’t very tall either.
How could he be so overwhelmingly mighty?! He actually instantly killed Lei Bo’s three generals.
Even Jii Ling couldn’t do that!
"Young Master, run quickly!"
Jii Ling shouted:
"I will hold him off!"
Having said that.
He charged at Ding Ling with the Three-Pointed Two-Blade:
"I shall fight you to the death!"
Ding Ling sighed softly, shook his head, and pointed casually.
Clang!
Sword Qi surged from his fingertip like a bolt of lightning.
In the next instant!
A series of *bang bang bang* sounds erupted.
Everyone, including Jii Ling, Yuan Yao, and Yuan Yin, was hit in their vitals, collapsing dead on the ground.
"Am I cursed?!"
"Dying once, now I have to die again?!"
Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin were filled with unwillingness, annoyance, regret, anger, sorrow, despair:
"This time if I die, I might truly be extinguished forever?! I don’t want to die! I still want to reincarnate and be born as a person again!"
Regarding revenge.
Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin naturally craved it from the bottom of their hearts.
That’s why when they saw Ding Ling again, they were ecstatic, especially noticing Ding Ling was a new ghost which stirred an unprecedented killing intent!
Seize Ding Ling’s weakness! The thought of taking Ding Ling’s life arose naturally!
However...
Once they attacked and sensed Ding Ling’s terrifying power, they each regretted it deeply.
"This guy died yet he’s so much stronger than us! How is that possible?! Is he cheating?!"
"Incomprehensible!"
"Unbelievable!"

"He’s a new ghost! When I was a new ghost, I was extremely weak, and it took years to reach this level. Ding Ling just entered the Netherworld, he should reasonably be very weak, how is he so strong?!"
Jii Ling, Le Jiu, and other formidable generals were stamped with shock, confusion, and bewilderment!
It’s as if their worldview and understanding were overturned.
To put it simply.
In their understanding: Water flows from high to low, newcomers in the Netherworld are inevitably weak!
But now.
Water seemed to flow from low to high!
How could this not leave them bewildered!
Ding Ling’s Sword Realm enveloped all Stream of Consciousness, then began stripping away information.
He chose Jii Ling, Le Jiu, Yuan Yao, and other powerful figures to extract from.
Compared to the human world Yuan Yao.

This Netherworld’s Yuan Yao was nearly three meters tall, extremely formidable, comparable in strength to a grand Celestial Being in the Celestial Human Realm, easily matching an ordinary Grandmaster Peak powerhouse!
Yet even so.
Facing Ding Ling, armed with Flawless Great Perfection, Saint-Grade Golden Core Spirit-empowered Sword Spirit, they stood no chance.
Let alone Sword Spirit forever in the realm state, Jii Ling and these souls had no chance to harm him.
At this moment.
Ding Ling was swiftly stripping the Stream of Consciousness.
Stripping took only an instant.
Less than one-tenth.
The remaining ninety percent merged into the Heaven and Earth.
Though it was less than one-tenth.
This one-tenth of several individuals allowed Ding Ling to obtain many useful techniques and information.
[Qi Cultivation Skill Full Level]
[Meditation Technique Full Level]
[Ghost Soldier Condensation Technique Full Level]
[Ghost Soldier Forging Technique Full Level]
After the four techniques reached full level.

Ding Ling activated the Ghost Soldier Condensation Technique, reached into the void, swoosh! Rushing Ghost Qi swarmed in, shortly a long sword appeared in his hand. As Ding Ling utilized the Ghost Soldier Forging Technique, a mighty intention transformed into huge hammers pounding the sword, and within moments.
The sword was condensed into tangible form.
"Very good techniques. Though somewhat rough, they are sufficient in this world."
Ding Ling observed these techniques closely.
Meditation Technique, Qi Cultivation Skill.
Both related to Netherworld’s Ghost Qi.
Refining Ghost Qi.
Meditating on the Heaven and Earth Creation of this Netherworld.
And Ding Ling, at full level, naturally attracted Ghost Qi as he moved.
This Ghost Qi adhered to the Sword Spirit, refined by Ding Ling’s will.
But due to its small quantity and poor quality.
The assistance to Ding Ling was almost negligible.
This shows Ding Ling’s current level is too high.
Regular Qi offers almost no aid to him.
This Ghost Qi, compared to ordinary Spiritual Vitality and Primordial Qi, is extremely dense and powerful.
Yet for Ding Ling, the benefit is still almost nonexistent.
Unless Ding Ling ascends to a higher world, to absorb purer, higher-quality Spiritual Vitality, his cultivation won’t progress quickly.
Clop clop!
Ding Ling walked into the military camp.
Along the way he saw numerous Ghost Soldiers, Ghost Generals.
Every Ghost General without exception was a familiar face.
"Sui Yuanjin, Chunyu Qiong, Lü Weihuang..."
Ding Ling walked along, killing as he went.
These Ghost Generals each were over two meters tall, nearly reaching three meters.
Evidently.
All had developed quite well.
To Ding Ling’s arrival.
Initially, they were all shouting to fight and kill, but soon they were terrified and fled, unfortunately, none could escape Ding Ling’s sword!
Ding Ling simply swung his ’Ghost Sword’, and a burst of Sword Qi shot out, transforming into a galaxy-like bolt, piercing through each Ghost General.
Instantly killing Ghost Generals as if slaughtering chickens!
As for killing these ’people’.
Ding Ling had no psychological burden.
They were enemies from the start.
If in the future the Netherworld were shattered, each Ghost General here would be akin to a Grand Celestial Being, able to potentially destroy the Three Kingdoms World.
It must be said that these Ghost Generals resented him deeply, eager to kill him swiftly!
Thus...
They could not be spared.
The military camp was vast.
Moreover, this Netherworld is rather unique.
Sound transmission appears weak.
Ding Ling found regular Ghost Soldiers could only hear roars within twenty or thirty meters, Ghost Generals within a hundred meters.
Beyond that, they couldn’t hear.
"No wonder they only noticed once I was close."
Ding Ling understood:
"It appears I can only hear sounds within a thousand meters. Beyond that, I’m unable to. This Netherworld indeed has its peculiarities."
Considering Ding Ling’s strength?
Even he was like this.
Other Ghost Generals even less so.
Ding Ling arrived at the core tent of the military camp.
He saw two extraordinary generals over three meters tall frantically heading toward the West with two companions.
He determined it was west.
Because Ding Ling extracted much from the formidable generals’ consciousness streams, acquiring the method to discern this world’s directions.
With this, Ding Ling could accurately determine the direction in this sunless, extremely dark Netherworld.
Kun!
Ding Ling stepped on Sword Light, with a sound, amidst Star Shifting, resembling a stream of light shot across Heaven’s Edge, the next moment arriving before the four.
"Yan Liang, Wen Chou, Yuan Shu, Yuan Shao."

chapters.title: Chapter 783 - 772: Yan Liang and Wen Chou
paragraphs: Yan Liang and Wen Chou’s strength surpasses Lei Bo, Lü Weihuang, Chunyu Qiong, and others by a large margin!
Therefore, they can hear and see farther.
When Chunyu Qiong was killed.
The two of them, Yan Liang and Wen Chou, heard the commotion. They looked at each other, both feeling incredulous:
"This is a military camp with a hundred thousand elite troops. Who dares to trespass?!"
As they looked on, they saw the scenes of Ding Ling effortlessly slaughtering Chunyu Qiong and other fierce generals, and couldn’t help but gasp.
"Who is that person?! How can he be so terrifying?!"
When they clearly saw Ding Ling’s face, their jaws began to ache uncontrollably:
"How could it be Ding Ling?! Wasn’t he ascended to the Upper Realm?!"
Over the years.
In the Three Kingdoms World, many soldiers have also died, turning into Ghost Soldiers and Ghost Generals, whom they absorbed into their camp.
And from the mouths of these Ghost Soldiers and Ghost Generals, they learned quite a bit about Ding Ling.
For this reason, they felt regret more than once, thinking that avenging themselves was hopeless.

Previously, they thought if they arrived in the Netherworld before Ding Ling, established their powers, and practiced Qi Cultivation Skills, Meditation Techniques, and other Techniques and Laws for decades, they would become incredibly terrifying.
By then, when Ding Ling dies of old age, and his Soul Spirit enters the Netherworld, wouldn’t he be at their mercy?!
That’s what they thought, and that’s what they did.
Yuan Shao and Yuan Shu were killed by Ding Ling, so they greatly supported Yan Liang and Wen Chou’s actions.
Who knew.
It’s only been a few years?

They thought it would be hard to see Ding Ling, but he appeared in the Netherworld so abruptly and broke into their camp as if he were slicing through vegetables, and even fierce generals like Chunyu Qiong couldn’t last a single round against him?!
"How did he do it?!"
"He clearly looks like a new ghost!"
Yan Liang and Wen Chou were incredulous, but their reaction speed was not slow. They rushed into the core tent at the first moment, dragging Yuan Shu and Yuan Shao out:
"Lord, no time to delay, we must run. Ding Ling is here!"
Yuan Shao and Yuan Shu were in seclusion training, only to be rudely interrupted by Yan Liang and Wen Chou, who then dragged them away.
The two furrowed their brows, about to question, but they heard Yan Liang and Wen Chou utter a direct, brief, and urgent sentence.
The two were stunned, then instinctively asked:
"Which Ding Ling? Scaring you like this?!"
"The one who killed us!"
"Didn’t he ascend?!"
Yuan Shu was dazed:
"Why suddenly come to this Netherworld where only souls dare to enter? Could it be that he also died?!"
’Seems like he might have died.’
"Then why are we afraid of him?"
Yuan Shu didn’t understand and even wanted to break free from Yan Liang and Wen Chou’s grip to face Ding Ling:
"We have a hundred thousand elite troops and so many fierce generals, are we really afraid of a new ghost like him?! What a ridiculous joke!"
"He’s here."
Yuan Shao also somewhat agreed with Yuan Shu, but as he looked forward, he suddenly saw Ding Ling standing right in front of them.
Yuan Shao couldn’t help but gasp.
He recalled the scenes of being decapitated by Ding Ling.
He touched his neck, instinctively stepped back, but when he saw Ding Ling’s height and physique, he couldn’t help but laugh:
"He’s really just a new ghost! Yan Liang, Wen Chou, are you stupid? He’s just a new ghost, what’s there to fear?"
"Lord."
Yan Liang and Wen Chou, however, gripped their weapons tightly in fear, their eyes wide open, saying:
"He’s already broken through our camp!"
"What?!"
Yuan Shao couldn’t believe:
"Just a new ghost. We can totally..."
He didn’t finish his sentence.
Clang!
Ding Ling swung his Ghost Sword, and in the next instant, accompanied by Sword Qi rolling like a flying waterfall towards Yan Liang, Wen Chou, Yuan Shu, and Yuan Shao, boom!
The four were instantly blasted a hundred zhang away, each exploding like fireworks one after another in mid-air.
"Becoming ghosts made them stupid?"
Ding Ling felt a slight surprise.
It seemed Yuan Shao’s wisdom had weakened considerably.
Could it be because of the Netherworld?
The specific situation was unknown.

But Ding Ling hadn’t forgotten to collect their Stream of Consciousness. He stepped forward a hundred zhang in an instant, arriving at the center of the exploded souls, expanded his Sword Realm, enveloped the area of several tens of meters, and began to accelerate the stripping of the Stream of Consciousness to acquire memory.
Moments later.
Acquired ten percent of their memory.
The remaining ninety percent of the memory merged into the world.
Though only ten percent, in just an instant, Ding Ling had perfectly assimilated it.
[Swift Wind Lightning Spear Technique Full Level]
[Wen’s Breathing Technique]
This was acquired from Wen Chou.
[Shattered Star Blade Technique Full Level]
[Yan’s Breathing Technique Full Level]
This was Yan Liang’s.
[Human Emperor’s Secret Manual Full Level]
[Ghost-controlling Skill Full Level]
[Soaring Technique Full Level]
[Mid-Level Qi Cultivation Skill Full Level]
This was acquired from Yuan Shao and Yuan Shu.
In total, he acquired dozens of Secret Skills.
All were extraordinary.
Of course, from Ding Ling’s perspective now, these Secret Skills could only be considered the top skills in the Three Kingdoms, with most appearing quite ordinary in his eyes.
Only a small part was considered decent.
Among these, Ghost-controlling Skill, Mid-Level Qi Cultivation Skill, Human Emperor’s Secret Manual were quite impressive.
Ghost-controlling Skill enhanced Ding Ling’s ability to control and drive ghosts to another level.
Mid-Level Qi Cultivation Skill allowed Ding Ling to refine more and faster Ghost Qi. Although its effect on Sword Spirit was still nearly zero, it was also a step up.
As for the Human Emperor’s Secret Manual?

This was a comprehensive manual of the Human Emperor’s Magic and Skill. Upon instantly mastering it, the Human Emperor’s Aura on Ding Ling’s body seemed to have thickened, deepening his understanding of the Human Emperor’s Esoteric Truths, greatly enhancing the power of various Human Emperor paths like fist, sword, and saber techniques.
"These Techniques and Laws can all be integrated into the Martial Dao True Understanding."
Ding Ling chose to integrate these skills into it.
With time.
The Martial Dao True Understanding would absorb the essence of these Techniques and Laws, becoming stronger.
"Let’s continue forward."
After acquiring the memory points of Yan Liang, Wen Chou, Yuan Shu, and Yuan Shao and their party.
Ding Ling’s understanding of this Netherworld increased substantially.
This world surprisingly had four large regions: East, South, West, and North.
Yuan Shu and Yuan Shao occupied the Eastern region and were the kings of this area.
Dong Zhuo occupied the Western region.
Zhang Jiao occupied the Northern region.
As for the South, it was a swampy abyssal region where no undead dared to tread.
"Dong Zhuo, Zhang Jiao..."
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow:
"After death, Dong Zhuo actually became the king of the Western Netherworld. That I did not expect..."
Ding Ling was very curious and more perplexed:
The Netherworld is so vast and boundless!
Since ancient times, so many heroic figures have died.
Why were only the undead of this era left?
Where is Emperor Qin Shi Huang?
Where have Bai Qi, Hann Xin, Liu Bang, Zhang Liang, Fan Kuai, Emperor Wu of Han, Wang Mang gone?!
