Yuan Shu didn’t understand and even wanted to break free from Yan Liang and Wen Chou’s grip to face Ding Ling:
"We have a hundred thousand elite troops and so many fierce generals, are we really afraid of a new ghost like him?!
What a ridiculous joke!"
"He’s here."
Yuan Shao also somewhat agreed with Yuan Shu, but as he looked forward, he suddenly saw Ding Ling standing right in front of them.
Yuan Shao couldn’t help but gasp.
He recalled the scenes of being decapitated by Ding Ling.
He touched his neck, instinctively stepped back, but when he saw Ding Ling’s height and physique, he couldn’t help but laugh:
"He’s really just a new ghost!
Yan Liang, Wen Chou, are you stupid?
He’s just a new ghost, what’s there to fear?"
"Lord."
Yan Liang and Wen Chou, however, gripped their weapons tightly in fear, their eyes wide open, saying:
"He’s already broken through our camp!"
"What?!"
Yuan Shao couldn’t believe:
"Just a new ghost.
We can totally..."
He didn’t finish his sentence.
Clang!
Ding Ling swung his Ghost Sword, and in the next instant, accompanied by Sword Qi rolling like a flying waterfall towards Yan Liang, Wen Chou, Yuan Shu, and Yuan Shao, boom!
The four were instantly blasted a hundred zhang away, each exploding like fireworks one after another in mid-air.
"Becoming ghosts made them stupid?"
Ding Ling felt a slight surprise.
It seemed Yuan Shao’s wisdom had weakened considerably.
Could it be because of the Netherworld?
The specific situation was unknown.
But Ding Ling hadn’t forgotten to collect their Stream of Consciousness.

He stepped forward a hundred zhang in an instant, arriving at the center of the exploded souls, expanded his Sword Realm, enveloped the area of several tens of meters, and began to accelerate the stripping of the Stream of Consciousness to acquire memory.
Moments later.
Acquired ten percent of their memory.
The remaining ninety percent of the memory merged into the world.
Though only ten percent, in just an instant, Ding Ling had perfectly assimilated it.
[Swift Wind Lightning Spear Technique Full Level]
[Wen’s Breathing Technique]
This was acquired from Wen Chou.
[Shattered Star Blade Technique Full Level]
[Yan’s Breathing Technique Full Level]
This was Yan Liang’s.
[Human Emperor’s Secret Manual Full Level]
[Ghost-controlling Skill Full Level]
[Soaring Technique Full Level]
[Mid-Level Qi Cultivation Skill Full Level]
This was acquired from Yuan Shao and Yuan Shu.
In total, he acquired dozens of Secret Skills.
All were extraordinary.
Of course, from Ding Ling’s perspective now, these Secret Skills could only be considered the top skills in the Three Kingdoms, with most appearing quite ordinary in his eyes.
Only a small part was considered decent.
Among these, Ghost-controlling Skill, Mid-Level Qi Cultivation Skill, Human Emperor’s Secret Manual were quite impressive.
Ghost-controlling Skill enhanced Ding Ling’s ability to control and drive ghosts to another level.
Mid-Level Qi Cultivation Skill allowed Ding Ling to refine more and faster Ghost Qi.
Although its effect on Sword Spirit was still nearly zero, it was also a step up.
As for the Human Emperor’s Secret Manual?
This was a comprehensive manual of the Human Emperor’s Magic and Skill.

Upon instantly mastering it, the Human Emperor’s Aura on Ding Ling’s body seemed to have thickened, deepening his understanding of the Human Emperor’s Esoteric Truths, greatly enhancing the power of various Human Emperor paths like fist, sword, and saber techniques.
"These Techniques and Laws can all be integrated into the Martial Dao True Understanding."
Ding Ling chose to integrate these skills into it.
With time.
The Martial Dao True Understanding would absorb the essence of these Techniques and Laws, becoming stronger.
"Let’s continue forward."
After acquiring the memory points of Yan Liang, Wen Chou, Yuan Shu, and Yuan Shao and their party.
Ding Ling’s understanding of this Netherworld increased substantially.
This world surprisingly had four large regions: East, South, West, and North.
Yuan Shu and Yuan Shao occupied the Eastern region and were the kings of this area.
Dong Zhuo occupied the Western region.
Zhang Jiao occupied the Northern region.
As for the South, it was a swampy abyssal region where no undead dared to tread.
"Dong Zhuo, Zhang Jiao..."
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow:
"After death, Dong Zhuo actually became the king of the Western Netherworld.
That I did not expect..."
Ding Ling was very curious and more perplexed:
The Netherworld is so vast and boundless!
Since ancient times, so many heroic figures have died.
Why were only the undead of this era left?
Where is Emperor Qin Shi Huang?
Where have Bai Qi, Hann Xin, Liu Bang, Zhang Liang, Fan Kuai, Emperor Wu of Han, Wang Mang gone?!

chapters.title: Chapter 784 - 773: Dong Zhuo’s Military Camp
paragraphs: Where are Lü Buwei, Zhuangzi, Laozi, Mozi, Sima Qian, Ban Gu, Cai Lun, and the others?
This is something Ding Ling finds very difficult to comprehend.
Logically speaking,
the undead are immortal.
Since they are immortal, where are Emperor Qin Shi Huang, Bai Qi, and those people?
Ding Ling flipped through the memories he obtained.
He couldn’t find an answer.
These memory points are all fragmented.

Even though he had acquired many information points from others and combined them to obtain many useful cultivation techniques and knowledge, there were still many gaps in his understanding of the Netherworld.
"Let’s go see Dong Zhuo."
Ding Ling turned to look at this military camp.
There were still many Ghost Soldiers and Ghost Generals in the camp.
Ding Ling did not pursue them to kill them.
It was pointless.
He killed Yan Liang, Wen Chou, Yuan Shu, and Yuan Shao because they were mortal enemies.
How could Ding Ling allow mortal enemies to grow up?
Now that these important enemies were dead,
Ding Ling naturally would not relentlessly hunt down these ordinary undead.
Whoosh!
Ding Ling stepped out, crossing hundreds of miles quickly.
Along the way,
everything in sight was bleak and desolate.
It compared to the Demon Realm of the Wind and Cloud World.
Only, the Demons in the Demon Realm numbered in the tens of billions!
By comparison, the undead and ghosts in this world were pitifully few, sparsely spread across the Ten Directions Realm.
The only concentration was the hundred thousand elite from the military camp where Yuan Shao once resided.
Elsewhere in the realm, the largest groups were merely a few hundred undead.
In comparison with the scale of the Demon Realm,
this Netherworld was truly vast but sparsely populated!
As he walked along,
Ding Ling sometimes saw some trees, flowers, and grass.
He looked closely at these plants and couldn’t help but marvel silently.
These plants were indeed nourished by Ghost Qi and Soul Qi, rare items that, when picked and used for alchemy, could nourish a person’s soul, allowing it to grow rapidly.
Ding Ling glanced at the flora here, and there were not many.
"I’ll pick them when I return."
The plants here were all illusory and uncertain,
much like a person’s soul spirit.
Ordinary people wouldn’t be able to see these plants at all.
But they truly existed.
"Amazing."
In the Great Thousand Worlds, there is no end to wonders, and this is no exception.

It’s just like how Ding Ling couldn’t understand why Yan Liang and Wen Chou could acquire special secret techniques such as the Meditation Technique, Qi Cultivation Skill, and Ghost Soldier Condensation Technique.
These secret techniques were automatically engraved deep in Yan Liang and Wen Chou’s seas of consciousness when they ascended to the Netherworld; they naturally mastered them.

Perhaps due to their high status before death, Yuan Shu and Yuan Shao obtained intermediate level Meditation Techniques and Qi Cultivation Skills, which were higher than the basic ones others received.
But strangely,
Ding Ling, who was of higher status and power than Yuan Shu and the others,
did not receive any techniques upon arriving in the Netherworld.
"Could there possibly be some secret or trick involved?"
Ding Ling couldn’t figure it out, so he sped up his journey.
Whoosh, whoosh!
Ding Ling rode on the sword light like a meteor cutting across the sky.
Not long after,
Ding Ling had traveled more than ten thousand miles, arriving at the entrance of a military camp in the Western Region.
Perhaps it was a time for rest.
The general guarding the camp was leaning against a pillar, asleep, and he was also a familiar face to Ding Ling: Hu Zhen!
A general Ding Ling had killed in his early days during a cavalry charge on an enemy camp.
He didn’t call Hu Zhen’s name.
He simply walked forward and pointed at his forehead.
In the next instant,
Hu Zhen fell dead to the ground silently.
The Sword Realm enveloped his soul body, starting to strip away his stream of consciousness.
About thirty percent was stripped away.
The other seventy percent merged into the world.
[Array-Breaking Spear Skill Full Level]
He learned several secret techniques.
Among them were Qi Cultivation Skills and Meditation Techniques identical to those he had acquired before.
"So they really are gifts from the Netherworld... Could it be because I didn’t die, so there was no gift?"
Ding Ling pondered.
At that moment, someone finally noticed Ding Ling’s presence - it was Hao Meng!
This was another valiant general Ding Ling had killed early on. Upon seeing him, Hao Meng was first stunned, then shouted in disbelief:
"You, you, you—you’re dead too?!"
After his shock, a wave of delight washed over him, and he laughed heartily:
"Hahaha, there’s a path to heaven, you didn’t take it; you barged into the gate of hell. Ding Ling, oh Ding Ling! I never thought I’d see you here!"
He roared:
"Cao Xing, Song Xian, Wei Xu..." He called out several names: "Quickly come out! Join me in killing this beast Ding Ling. We..."
Poof!
Before Hao Meng could finish, Ding Ling swiftly approached and beheaded him with a single sword strike.
Bang!
Hao Meng’s head dropped to the ground, rolled a few times, and suddenly shattered, dissipating into a mist—streams of consciousness.
Ding Ling’s Sword Realm enveloped it, starting to separate memories.
Meanwhile,
rumble!
From the camp, hundreds surged out.
Leading them were familiar faces of Ding Ling: Cao Xing, Song Xian, Wei Xu, Guo Si...
When they saw Ding Ling, their expressions and reactions were almost identical to those of Yuan Yao and Lei Bo.
First disbelief, then wild joy, followed by lethal intent; they charged at Ding Ling with weapons in hand like bolts of lightning.
They hadn’t seen Ding Ling kill Hao Meng and Hu Zhen.
If they had,
there’s no way they could’ve been so reckless and rushed to attack Ding Ling.
"Mountain Opening Saber Technique!"

Song Xian, towering at nine feet, mighty and fierce, wielded a Mountain-Opening Saber, running the fastest. When he was still seven or eight meters away from Ding Ling, he couldn’t hold back and leaped into the air, soaring over ten meters high. In mid-air, he grasped his saber with both hands and swung down hard over Ding Ling’s head:
"Hahaha, Ding Ling, you wretched beast! You’re finally dead! I, the General, will obliterate you! Die for me!"
Crash!
With a single strike, his explosive Vigorous Qi gathered to form a mighty saber that seemed capable of cleaving mountains and earth.
Following closely, Wei Xu and others also displayed their divine techniques.
In an instant,
they filled the void with blades, arrows, and sweeping sword qi, akin to meteor showers, hurtling towards Ding Ling as if to crush him to dust and utterly annihilate him.
None could wait.
As if acting slowly would leave their vengeance unfulfilled.
Ding Ling shook his head, brandishing his Ghost Sword with a clang!
Breaking Sword Skill!

With one stroke, a torrent of sword qi was born, filled with Spiritual Qi. It moved with the rotation of the blade, agile like a dragon or python, flipping and soaring in the void, shattering Song Xian’s saber light. Then it opened its mouth and devoured the sword qi and arrow rain.
Whatever lay in its path, nothing could stand before it.
In mere moments, it reached Song Xian and the others, boom!
In their shocked, disbelieving eyes, this single sword engulfed, pierced, and obliterated them all.

chapters.title: Chapter 785 - 774: Three-Meter-Tall Dong Zhuo
paragraphs: It was clearly just a swing of the sword.
Yet it seemed like a stab through a river of swords.
Where the sword river surged past, all enemies were utterly pulverized into nothing.
This sword river seemed capable of burying everything, every path, every technique!
No matter what saber light or sword qi was generated from any skill or law, faced with this sword river, it was as if meeting its nemesis; it vanishes in an instant, with no resistance.
"No!"
"He’s a new ghost!"
"How is that possible?!"
"Ah~~ No! I don’t want to die!"
Amid screams, roars, and furious shouts.
Song Xian, Wei Xu, Guo Si, and others were once again annihilated.
Along with the hundreds of troops and horses they led, they were all eradicated within this torrent-like sword river.
"Breaking Technique Sword. As expected, it can shatter ten thousand paths and ten thousand techniques."
Ding Ling was quite satisfied.
Can the Breaking Technique Sword shatter immortal skills and techniques?
He was unsure.
But to break the skills and laws from the historical plane, there was no problem.
Rustle!
The Sword Realm spread like the wind, covering Wei Xu and the others’ stream of consciousness, beginning to peel away their memories.
[Tornado Arrow Skill Lower Volume Full Level]
This was obtained from the secret manual of the divine archer Cao Xing.
Years ago, Ding Ling acquired the upper volume of the Tornado Arrow Skill but regrettably did not get the lower volume.
Unexpectedly, time passed and things changed, and he found it here.
This was beyond Ding Ling’s expectations.
[Mountain Opening Saber Technique Full Level]
[Infinite Spear Technique Full Level]
In one go, he acquired dozens of secret skills.
Ding Ling chose to integrate them into the Martial Dao True Understanding.
These skills were quite impressive.

Extracting their essence could enhance the power of Ding Ling’s skills, like the Tornado Arrow Skill, now with the lower volume, refined into the aspect of ’archery skill’ related to the Martial Dao True Understanding, Ding Ling’s skill level in archery would definitely improve.
Tap Tap!
Ding Ling walked into this camp.
Next.
He encountered familiar faces like Li Jue.
He chose to kill them all.
Finally.
In the central tent, Ding Ling saw Dong Zhuo, sitting in the top seat with a face full of shock and confusion.
"You, you, you..."
Dong Zhuo pointed at Ding Ling, almost unable to believe his own eyes:
"You have no ghost qi on you, and you’re so short, clearly a new ghost! How can you kill Li Jue and the others as easily as slaughtering chickens?! How did you do it?!"
Dong Zhuo was nearly scared to death!
He stood over three meters tall, his physique massive like a small mountain.
He was indisputably the strongest king in the Western Camp!
He alone monopolized sixty percent of the resources in the west!
In this western region, his words carried absolute authority, no one dared to defy him.

He was quite satisfied with this life, even making agreements with people like Yuan Shao, if Ding Ling were to die, they’d join forces to lock down the resources of the Netherworld, blocking Ding Ling!
They would not rest until Ding Ling was dead!
However, Dong Zhuo never imagined that Ding Ling would arrive in the Netherworld a few years later, and with his frail ’body’, reverse ascension, forcefully punching through Dong Zhuo’s camp!
"How is this possible?!"
"This defies logic!"
Dong Zhuo, disbelieving and angry, leapt down from the top seat, smashing his fist heavily towards Ding Ling’s face:

"I am the strongest here! In life, my strength was inferior to yours and got killed by you, but in the Netherworld, despite arduously cultivating secret techniques, I still refuse to believe I cannot kill you, a new ghost!"
Boom!
His fist, like a mountain, seemed capable of collapsing a palace!
Yet Ding Ling merely extended one finger, casually blocking the punch, leaving Dong Zhuo unable to advance, no matter how much strength he exerted!
He stared wide-eyed, his heart shaking with fear, realizing Ding Ling’s strength far exceeded his imagination!
Although he still couldn’t comprehend why Ding Ling was so strong, it didn’t stop him from fleeing!
Swoosh!
Dong Zhuo turned around, stomped heavily on the ground with his feet, and crashed through the tent, racing eastward like a tornado.
Running away at the inability to win was deeply ingrained in Dong Zhuo’s soul.

Especially since he had already died once, he was extremely terrified of death. Initially, upon seeing Ding Ling as a new ghost and much shorter, he wanted to try and see if he could kill Ding Ling, but things didn’t go as he hoped.
Even though Ding Ling was a new ghost, he could crush him.
"Heaven is truly biased!"
Dong Zhuo’s heart was filled with resentment! Unwillingness! Frustration!
He had clearly worked so hard!
Yet he couldn’t even withstand a ’finger’ from such a genius undead as Ding Ling?!
Heaven was blatantly giving Ding Ling an advantage!
Too outrageous!
Swoosh!
Ding Ling’s figure flashed slightly in place, shrinking inches, instantly appearing in front of Dong Zhuo, pointing a finger towards Dong Zhuo’s abdomen, boom!
Dong Zhuo felt like he was struck by lightning, like a meteor crashing into him, sent flying hundreds of feet, heavily landing on the ground, and rolling dozens of times before finally stopping.
Ugh!
He felt a sharp pain in his abdomen, couldn’t help but retch twice, but vomited streams of soul qi, which was the essence of his soul; losing too much might cause the soul to crumble.
His complexion changed drastically, panic-stricken.
He wanted to run, but upon looking up, he saw Ding Ling stepping on the void, looking down at him:
"Are you sure you still want to run?"
Ding Ling’s voice was light, very soft.
But falling on Dong Zhuo’s ears, it resonated like a drum, causing his soul to tremble slightly.
Dong Zhuo was exceedingly terrified.

Facing the domineering and immeasurably powerful Ding Ling, half of his mind wanted to lie down in defeat like a salted fish, yet the other half desperately wanted to survive. Therefore, his expression was very conflicted, distorted for quite a while before he sighed dejectedly:
"Big brother, what would it take for you not to kill me?"
Ding Ling ignored his question, instead asking:

"On my way here, I noticed this Netherworld is vast yet sparsely populated, and it seems there are only undead from our era. I haven’t even seen Emperor Guangwu Liu Xiu who founded the Eastern Han; it’s quite strange. You’ve been here for some years. Do you know why?"
Not even seeing the luck-ridden son of the plane, Liu Xiu.
Others, not to mention.
"I don’t know."
Dong Zhuo was very nervous:
"But I know five years ago, I still saw the Spirit Emperor Liu Hong. Later, for some unknown reason, they suddenly vanished overnight."
"Vanished suddenly?"
"Yes."
Dong Zhuo said:

"I heard reports from my subordinates that one moment they could still see people moving around inside the camp controlled by Spirit Emperor Liu Hong, the next moment, suddenly everyone disappeared completely."
"Sounds very eerie."
"Exactly."
Dong Zhuo deeply agreed:
"I’m actually also quite afraid that one day I might suddenly vanish like Liu Hong, without a trace, nowhere to be found."
"Then do you know where your cultivation techniques are derived from?"
Ding Ling could kill Dong Zhuo, peeling away his stream of consciousness.
But he could only peel two to three parts, not the entirety. Walking along the way, he had peeled quite a few people’s soul streams of consciousness but still hadn’t found the answers he sought.
Hence, he wasn’t in a rush to kill Dong Zhuo, wanting to find out the truth.
"I don’t know. I just knew it upon entering the Netherworld."
Next.
Ding Ling and Dong Zhuo, in a question-and-answer exchange, allowed Ding Ling to understand most of the secrets of the Netherworld.

He was quite satisfied with this life, even making agreements with people like Yuan Shao, if Ding Ling were to die, they’d join forces to lock down the resources of the Netherworld, blocking Ding Ling!
They would not rest until Ding Ling was dead!
However, Dong Zhuo never imagined that Ding Ling would arrive in the Netherworld a few years later, and with his frail ’body’, reverse ascension, forcefully punching through Dong Zhuo’s camp!
"How is this possible?!"
"This defies logic!"
Dong Zhuo, disbelieving and angry, leapt down from the top seat, smashing his fist heavily towards Ding Ling’s face:
"I am the strongest here!
In life, my strength was inferior to yours and got killed by you, but in the Netherworld, despite arduously cultivating secret techniques, I still refuse to believe I cannot kill you, a new ghost!"
Boom!
His fist, like a mountain, seemed capable of collapsing a palace!
Yet Ding Ling merely extended one finger, casually blocking the punch, leaving Dong Zhuo unable to advance, no matter how much strength he exerted!
He stared wide-eyed, his heart shaking with fear, realizing Ding Ling’s strength far exceeded his imagination!
Although he still couldn’t comprehend why Ding Ling was so strong, it didn’t stop him from fleeing!
Swoosh!
Dong Zhuo turned around, stomped heavily on the ground with his feet, and crashed through the tent, racing eastward like a tornado.
Running away at the inability to win was deeply ingrained in Dong Zhuo’s soul.
Especially since he had already died once, he was extremely terrified of death.
Initially, upon seeing Ding Ling as a new ghost and much shorter, he wanted to try and see if he could kill Ding Ling, but things didn’t go as he hoped.
Even though Ding Ling was a new ghost, he could crush him.
"Heaven is truly biased!"
Dong Zhuo’s heart was filled with resentment!
Unwillingness!
Frustration!
He had clearly worked so hard!
Yet he couldn’t even withstand a ’finger’ from such a genius undead as Ding Ling?!
Heaven was blatantly giving Ding Ling an advantage!
Too outrageous!
Swoosh!
Ding Ling’s figure flashed slightly in place, shrinking inches, instantly appearing in front of Dong Zhuo, pointing a finger towards Dong Zhuo’s abdomen, boom!
Dong Zhuo felt like he was struck by lightning, like a meteor crashing into him, sent flying hundreds of feet, heavily landing on the ground, and rolling dozens of times before finally stopping.
Ugh!
He felt a sharp pain in his abdomen, couldn’t help but retch twice, but vomited streams of soul qi, which was the essence of his soul; losing too much might cause the soul to crumble.
His complexion changed drastically, panic-stricken.
He wanted to run, but upon looking up, he saw Ding Ling stepping on the void, looking down at him:
"Are you sure you still want to run?"
Ding Ling’s voice was light, very soft.
But falling on Dong Zhuo’s ears, it resonated like a drum, causing his soul to tremble slightly.
Dong Zhuo was exceedingly terrified.
Facing the domineering and immeasurably powerful Ding Ling, half of his mind wanted to lie down in defeat like a salted fish, yet the other half desperately wanted to survive.
Therefore, his expression was very conflicted, distorted for quite a while before he sighed dejectedly:
"Big brother, what would it take for you not to kill me?"
Ding Ling ignored his question, instead asking:
"On my way here, I noticed this Netherworld is vast yet sparsely populated, and it seems there are only undead from our era.
I haven’t even seen Emperor Guangwu Liu Xiu who founded the Eastern Han; it’s quite strange.
You’ve been here for some years.
Do you know why?"
Not even seeing the luck-ridden son of the plane, Liu Xiu.
Others, not to mention.
"I don’t know."
Dong Zhuo was very nervous:
"But I know five years ago, I still saw the Spirit Emperor Liu Hong.
Later, for some unknown reason, they suddenly vanished overnight."
"Vanished suddenly?"
"Yes."
Dong Zhuo said:

"I heard reports from my subordinates that one moment they could still see people moving around inside the camp controlled by Spirit Emperor Liu Hong, the next moment, suddenly everyone disappeared completely."
"Sounds very eerie."
"Exactly."
Dong Zhuo deeply agreed:
"I’m actually also quite afraid that one day I might suddenly vanish like Liu Hong, without a trace, nowhere to be found."
"Then do you know where your cultivation techniques are derived from?"
Ding Ling could kill Dong Zhuo, peeling away his stream of consciousness.
But he could only peel two to three parts, not the entirety.
Walking along the way, he had peeled quite a few people’s soul streams of consciousness but still hadn’t found the answers he sought.
Hence, he wasn’t in a rush to kill Dong Zhuo, wanting to find out the truth.
"I don’t know.
I just knew it upon entering the Netherworld."
Next.
Ding Ling and Dong Zhuo, in a question-and-answer exchange, allowed Ding Ling to understand most of the secrets of the Netherworld.

chapters.title: Chapter 786 - 775: Yellow Turban Army
paragraphs: Of course, what Dong Zhuo didn’t know, Ding Ling couldn’t find out either.
But Dong Zhuo was sure of one thing:

"Zhang Jiao died first, but he hasn’t disappeared until now, whereas Liu Hong died later yet inexplicably vanished a few years ago. So, if you want to find the answer, perhaps you can go north to find Zhang Jiao! He must know many secrets."
"You’re right."
Ding Ling nodded and pointed a finger at Dong Zhuo’s forehead:
"I should indeed go find Zhang Jiao."
Poof!
A flash of sword light disappeared in an instant.
In the next moment.

Dong Zhuo’s forehead was pierced, and his massive body fell heavily backward like a mountain, his eyes widened looking at Ding Ling, filled with frustration, depression, venomous hatred, anger, and reluctance!
As if saying, ’Brother, you don’t follow Wude! I already laid flat! And you still want to kill me!’
Having spent a lot of time with some alien guests.
It’s normal for Dong Zhuo to speak some modern language.
Cao Mengde also speaks modern language very fluently.

Ding Ling, with his full-level Observing People Skill, seemed to see through Dong Zhuo’s thoughts, but he didn’t pay much attention, merely enveloping him in the Sword Realm, starting to strip Dong Zhuo’s stream of consciousness.
Dong Zhuo and he were mortal enemies.
His previous desire and thoughts of killing him were very straightforward and clear.
Ding Ling couldn’t possibly spare him simply because Dong Zhuo temporarily admitted defeat. There’s no such good thing in this world!
To enemies.
Ding Ling was never soft-handed.

Because he deeply understood, even if he were to show mercy, most of these enemies wouldn’t be grateful, and might stab him in the back when given a chance, knowing that their enmity was irreconcilable!
Such hatred, Ding Ling could not sit and watch as Dong Zhuo kept growing stronger.
After all, who could clearly say what Dong Zhuo might become in the future?
To eliminate future troubles, the simplest way is to kill!
[Advanced Meditation Technique Full Level]
"Hmm."
Ding Ling had stripped away numerous secret manuals and secret techniques.
The most intriguing to him among these was this Advanced Meditation Technique.
With this Advanced Meditation Technique at full level.
Ding Ling slightly closed his eyes.
And his Sea of Consciousness seemed to reflect the general situation of this Netherworld.
’Where there is more ghost qi and soul qi.’
’Where there are ghost generals, ghost soldiers, strange flowers and trees.’
’It can all be perceived clearly!’
With this reflection.
Ding Ling’s perception was instantaneously enhanced by more than tenfold.
"Such a magical technique."
With the help of this Advanced Meditation Technique.
Finding resources, people, etc.
Has become so much easier.
"Dong Zhuo had such strong killing intent toward me."
Ding Ling shook his head; after stripping two-thirds of Dong Zhuo’s memories, the remaining stream of consciousness merged into this world.
And in those stripped memories.
A surge of killing intent and killing mechanisms pervaded everywhere, ubiquitous.
Ding Ling’s Sword Realm was extremely strong, automatically stripping these killing intentions and killing mechanisms, only preserving the essential memories.
Among these memories, there were quite a few worthless ones.
Also automatically discarded, only retaining some useful information points and knowledge points.
"Indeed, two-thirds of the memory points are only fragmented."
Ding Ling looked toward the north.
With the Advanced Meditation Technique at full level.
Ding Ling could now perceive the condition within a radius of thousands of miles.
This is quite astonishing!
"Seems like there are secrets within this Meditation Technique."
The more Ding Ling perceived it, the more he discovered this Meditation Technique was closely related to this Netherworld, as though it’s a part of the thoughts stripped from this Netherworld.
"Is there really such a thing?"
Ding Ling felt uncertain.
But didn’t dwell on it.
Instead, in one step, moved several hundred miles forward.
With the Advanced Meditation Technique enhancing him, Ding Ling moved more smoothly through the Netherworld.
Traveling unimpeded.
In just an instant, traversed over a thousand mountains, flew across ten thousand miles, and arrived in front of a military camp.
This military camp is more extensive and boundless than those of Yuan Shao and Dong Zhuo.
Among them, the crowd is bustling, ghostly horses darting back and forth, making this place seem akin to the earthly realm, extremely lively.
"Completely different from the dead atmosphere of the previous two camps."
Ding Ling was puzzled.
Stepped forward, arriving at the camp gate.
A ghost soldier blocked the way.
Ding Ling said:
"I’ve come to visit the Great Virtuous Master. Please help pass the message."
The ghost soldier was stunned, sized Ding Ling up and down, then sneered:
"Haha, ridiculous! Where did this little ghost come from! Not a speck of ghost qi on him! And he wants to see the Great Virtuous Master?!"
He stepped forward, looked down at Ding Ling, and said coldly:
"Get lost to wherever you came from! If you dare speak nonsense before me again, I’ll tear you apart!"
Ding Ling frowned.
His visit aims to understand the situation in the Netherworld, after all, according to Dong Zhuo, the Spirit Emperor Liu Hong disappeared, but Zhang Jiao is still well, there’s surely a catch.
Aside from being curious and wanting to figure it out, the most important is an intuitive feeling he has: without clarification, there might be potential threats in the future.
This feeling came inexplicably.
But Ding Ling chose to trust it.
Better to believe it than not.
Moreover.

Investigating this can benefit the Three Kingdoms World, and it doesn’t harm him; he doesn’t wish people like Zhang Zhongjing and Hua Tuo living in Three Kingdoms World to meet untimely deaths in the future.
Therefore, it’s necessary to investigate.
But these Yellow Turban Army unexpectedly appeared to be so tough and overbearing, seeming to not welcome new ghosts like Ding Ling?
Or is it due to some other reason?
"What’s the noise about?"
A fierce general nearly two meters nine in height strolled over.
The ghost soldier turned to glance, quickly smiling obsequiously:
"Greetings to Marshal Hex!"
"Hmm."

Marshal Hex nodded, casually glanced at Ding Ling, upon seeing him, couldn’t help but shrink his pupils, instinctually feeling afraid, but soon recovered, suppressing the discomfort within, pointing at Ding Ling, chuckling :
"Stop him, don’t let this little ghost run away!"
Swish swish!
All around, the Yellow Turban Army under Marshal Hex immediately surrounded Ding Ling, sealing all escape routes.
Seeing Ding Ling couldn’t escape.
Marshal Hex then walked forth with hands on his hips, scrutinizing Ding Ling, the more he looked, the more jubilant he felt, bursting into laughter:
"It’s really you! Ding Ling!!"
"Are you Hex Yi?"
Ding Ling vaguely recalled.
"Yes. I am Hex Yi, the one you killed with a Shadow Arrow!"
Hex Yi touched the area by his heart:
"I clearly remember being shot right in the heart by your arrow, sent flying, instant death! I thought avenging myself was hopeless, never expected, I would meet you here. Even more unexpected..."
Hex Yi laughed heartily, speaking with delight:
"This fool came here willingly, delivering himself to death!"
Having said that.
He ruthlessly charged at Ding Ling, aiming a fist at Ding Ling’s face.
"This time, if I don’t properly torment you before killing you, I can’t quell the hatred in my heart!"

chapters.title: Chapter 787 - 776: Zhang Mancheng
paragraphs: Ding Ling was obviously a new ghost.
Moreover, it seemed like he had just died recently, incredibly frail.
To deal with such a new ghost,
Hex Yi didn’t even dare to use his weapon, afraid that he might accidentally kill Ding Ling!
If that happened, how could he torment Ding Ling?
How could he vent his resentment and murderous intent?
So, he prepared to knock down Ding Ling first, then proceed with the torture!
If he didn’t torment Ding Ling to the point of wishing for death, he wouldn’t be called Hex Yi!
However, to Hex Yi’s great surprise, the moment his fist struck out, he was uncontrollably sent flying the next instant.
"What’s happening?!"
Hex Yi was puzzled, but soon, a sharp pain emerged from his chest, and as he lowered his head slightly to look, he saw a hole the size of a bowl!
"Who did this?!"
"When did such a heavy injury appear?"
Bam!

Hex Yi heavily fell to the ground, directly crushing several ghost soldiers. He struggled to get up, only to find his soul power frantically leaking out. Knowing he was doomed, he couldn’t help but wail.
Hearing the wails, other Yellow Turban leaders rushed out crazily. Upon seeing the scene, they looked at Hex Yi in disbelief:
"Who did this?"
Hex Yi didn’t know either, but instinctively pointed at Ding Ling:
"Him, him!"
"And who are you?!"
A huge man standing three meters tall glared at Ding Ling:
"A mere little ghost could actually wound Marshal Hex?!"
He couldn’t believe it and commanded the Yellow Turban Army all around:
"Go, capture him for me!"
Boom!
The Yellow Turban Army swarmed forward, wielding knives and swords, charging at Ding Ling.
Ding Ling casually swung the sword in his hand.
The next instant!

A surging sword river appeared, like the Milky Way plunging straight into the Ninefold Heaven, instantly scattering thousands of Yellow Turban troops. Boom! The Sword River was unstoppable, continuing towards the three-meter-tall warrior with overwhelming momentum.
Seeing the situation, Ding Ling prepared to confront them head-on.
Ethics before arms.
Since ancient times.
If ethics didn’t work,
then arms would have to be used.
Not to mention, this Yellow Turban Army harbored many of his mortal enemies.
There was absolutely no possibility of reconciliation.

Thinking of this, Ding Ling sighed inwardly and strolled forward. Wherever he passed, it was like a fast ship splitting the waves, unstoppable and unimpeded, and in just a moment, he arrived in front of the three-meter-tall warrior.
As the warrior roared, the Sword River suddenly accelerated, engulfing him and piercing him like a sieve.
"How could it be this strong?!"
"A mere little ghost!"
"I, Zhang Mancheng, am a Divine Envoy! How could I die here?!"
The three-meter-tall warrior was Zhang Mancheng, a grand marshal commanding no less than 100,000 elite troops of the Yellow Turban Army, dominating one side with little opposition.
He only took orders from no more than three people, the Great Virtuous Master included.
No one else was qualified to command him.
Yet such a fierce warrior, capable of crushing Marshal Hex and others, just died at the gate of the Yellow Turban Army camp.
"Hiss!"
The remaining Yellow Turban generals gasped, retreating in panic and fleeing, each with eyes full of incredulity and disbelief:
"Clearly no Ghost Qi. Looks like a new ghost! How did he instantly kill Marshal Zhang?! How did he do it?!"
"Marshal Zhang alone could easily contend with 100,000 ghost soldiers! Yet this man killed such a grand marshal?! It’s terrifying!"
"It’s unimaginable how he just casually swung his sword and unleashed a Sword River that could slay Marshal Zhang!"
All the Yellow Turban troops were stunned.
Some ghost soldiers and generals roared for revenge for Zhang Mancheng, while more panicked and fled in fear.
Ding Ling’s Sword Realm unfolded, enveloping Zhang Mancheng’s soul body, starting to strip away the stream of consciousness.
At the same time,
the Ghost Sword in his hand occasionally swung out, Sword Qi streaking through the void like streaming light, with every sweep, bang bang bang! Ghost soldiers and generals shattered like bubbles.
Confronting Ding Ling’s sword,
they seemed made of paper.
This further terrified those ghost generals choosing to flee, making each of them run faster.
[Advanced Ghost Blade Condensation Technique Full Level]
’Hmm?’
’This technique.’

Ding Ling pointed the sword in his hand skyward, and in the next instant, the Soul Qi and Ghost Qi of the slain souls surged wildly towards the Ghost Sword. Visibly, the Ghost Sword continuously refined and strengthened.
From an ordinary weapon state, it began transforming towards a high-quality Ghost Blade state.
When Zhang Mancheng’s Ghost Qi was fully absorbed, clang!
The Ghost Sword advanced to an ordinary Middle Tier Ghost Blade, with its density, toughness, sharpness, all doubling. Clang clang!
Ding Ling lightly swung the sword, a chill radiated to the Nine Void!
With the clanging sound, the Sword Qi emitted from the Ghost Sword became even more brilliant and sharp.
"I didn’t expect Zhang Mancheng to possess an advanced Ghost Blade Condensation Technique; wouldn’t that mean he has an advanced Ghost Blade Forging Technique?"
Ding Ling pondered.
Advanced Meditation Techniques are a hundred times stronger than Ordinary Meditation Techniques, to say the least.
Similarly, advanced Ghost Blade Condensation Techniques surpass Ghost Soldier Condensation Techniques by more than a hundred times.
One can imagine how powerful advanced Ghost Blade Forging Techniques must be.
Ding Ling strolled forward.
Since he had made a killing move,
there was no reason to hold back.
He wielded the sword from time to time.
The Sword River, like a dragon, eroding and covering everything in its path, reducing all to decay and oblivion.
Woosh woosh!

The surging Ghost Qi rushed towards the Ghost Sword like tidal waves. Visibly, the Ghost Sword kept strengthening, and in no time, as thousands were slain, the Ghost Sword evolved once again into an ordinary High Tier Ghost Blade.
At this stage, the Ghost Blade was even bulkier, sharper, and more durable.
In cutting and stabbing, it was no less than a true weapon in the mortal realm!
Clop clop!

With the sound of galloping ghost horses, Ding Ling looked towards the noise and saw an army of no less than tens of thousands of cavalry charging towards his position. At the forefront was a man wielding a long spear, clad in a Taoist robe, with sharp eyes exuding authority without anger.
Behind him, a flag fluttered in the wind.
Inscribed with large characters:
General Ren Gong!
"The third brother of the Great Virtuous Master Zhang Jiao, General Ren Gong Zhang Liang?"
Ding Ling turned his head.
Apart from Zhang Liang,
Ding Ling saw several familiar faces: Heaven-Cutting Yaksha Hex Man, Huang Shao, Liu Pi, Ma Zhong...
Ma Zhong was there too, which Ding Ling didn’t expect.
This man was the strongest assassin in the Three Kingdoms World!
Back then, Ding Ling even had to duel him in acting to kill him.
Now, meeting his enemy,
besides shock, Ma Zhong couldn’t help but show a cruel, pleased expression.
Not just him,
Liu Pi, Hex Man, and others were the same.
"Was it you who made a sudden incursion into our camp and killed Marshal Zhang and the others?!"
From afar, Zhang Liang roared.
Strangely,
compared to the Eastern and Western Regions,
this Northern Region seemed to carry sound further, so more and more people were flocking towards Ding Ling’s position.
The Yellow Turban troops who fled earlier were now swept back into the mix, charging forth involuntarily.

"It’s unimaginable how he just casually swung his sword and unleashed a Sword River that could slay Marshal Zhang!"
All the Yellow Turban troops were stunned.
Some ghost soldiers and generals roared for revenge for Zhang Mancheng, while more panicked and fled in fear.
Ding Ling’s Sword Realm unfolded, enveloping Zhang Mancheng’s soul body, starting to strip away the stream of consciousness.
At the same time,
the Ghost Sword in his hand occasionally swung out, Sword Qi streaking through the void like streaming light, with every sweep, bang bang bang!
Ghost soldiers and generals shattered like bubbles.
Confronting Ding Ling’s sword,
they seemed made of paper.
This further terrified those ghost generals choosing to flee, making each of them run faster.
[Advanced Ghost Blade Condensation Technique Full Level]
’Hmm?’
’This technique.’
Ding Ling pointed the sword in his hand skyward, and in the next instant, the Soul Qi and Ghost Qi of the slain souls surged wildly towards the Ghost Sword.
Visibly, the Ghost Sword continuously refined and strengthened.
From an ordinary weapon state, it began transforming towards a high-quality Ghost Blade state.
When Zhang Mancheng’s Ghost Qi was fully absorbed, clang!
The Ghost Sword advanced to an ordinary Middle Tier Ghost Blade, with its density, toughness, sharpness, all doubling.
Clang clang!
Ding Ling lightly swung the sword, a chill radiated to the Nine Void!
With the clanging sound, the Sword Qi emitted from the Ghost Sword became even more brilliant and sharp.
"I didn’t expect Zhang Mancheng to possess an advanced Ghost Blade Condensation Technique; wouldn’t that mean he has an advanced Ghost Blade Forging Technique?"
Ding Ling pondered.
Advanced Meditation Techniques are a hundred times stronger than Ordinary Meditation Techniques, to say the least.
Similarly, advanced Ghost Blade Condensation Techniques surpass Ghost Soldier Condensation Techniques by more than a hundred times.
One can imagine how powerful advanced Ghost Blade Forging Techniques must be.
Ding Ling strolled forward.
Since he had made a killing move,
there was no reason to hold back.
He wielded the sword from time to time.
The Sword River, like a dragon, eroding and covering everything in its path, reducing all to decay and oblivion.
Woosh woosh!
The surging Ghost Qi rushed towards the Ghost Sword like tidal waves.
Visibly, the Ghost Sword kept strengthening, and in no time, as thousands were slain, the Ghost Sword evolved once again into an ordinary High Tier Ghost Blade.
At this stage, the Ghost Blade was even bulkier, sharper, and more durable.
In cutting and stabbing, it was no less than a true weapon in the mortal realm!
Clop clop!
With the sound of galloping ghost horses, Ding Ling looked towards the noise and saw an army of no less than tens of thousands of cavalry charging towards his position.
At the forefront was a man wielding a long spear, clad in a Taoist robe, with sharp eyes exuding authority without anger.
Behind him, a flag fluttered in the wind.
Inscribed with large characters:
General Ren Gong!
"The third brother of the Great Virtuous Master Zhang Jiao, General Ren Gong Zhang Liang?"
Ding Ling turned his head.
Apart from Zhang Liang,
Ding Ling saw several familiar faces: Heaven-Cutting Yaksha Hex Man, Huang Shao, Liu Pi, Ma Zhong...
Ma Zhong was there too, which Ding Ling didn’t expect.
This man was the strongest assassin in the Three Kingdoms World!
Back then, Ding Ling even had to duel him in acting to kill him.
Now, meeting his enemy,
besides shock, Ma Zhong couldn’t help but show a cruel, pleased expression.
Not just him,
Liu Pi, Hex Man, and others were the same.
"Was it you who made a sudden incursion into our camp and killed Marshal Zhang and the others?!"
From afar, Zhang Liang roared.
Strangely,
compared to the Eastern and Western Regions,
this Northern Region seemed to carry sound further, so more and more people were flocking towards Ding Ling’s position.
The Yellow Turban troops who fled earlier were now swept back into the mix, charging forth involuntarily.

chapters.title: Chapter 788 - 777: General Ren Gong
paragraphs: "It’s him!"
A member of the Yellow Turban Army pointed at Ding Ling, his face filled with fear, and said:
"General Ren Gong, he is the one who killed Marshal Zhang and Marshal Hex!"
’Just a mere little ghost!’
Zhang Liang looked sideways, unable to believe:
"How is it possible?!"
’I would never dare deceive General Ren Gong. If the general doesn’t believe me, he can ask others.’
The ghost soldier said in a panic.
"No need to ask."
Zhang Liang continued riding swiftly, as usual, without stopping. He pointed his long spear at Ding Ling and shouted:

"Just a mere little ghost, with no ghostly aura, yet able to turn the tide against marshals, he must be relying on some kind of Divine Object! The power from that Divine Object must be limited. Charge at him, and once he’s exhausted the energy, he’ll be like a lamb waiting for us to slaughter!"
"Kill him!"
With Zhang Liang’s order.
The ghost generals around him accelerated and charged out.

Heaven-Cutting Yaksha Hex Man charged the fastest. Standing a full three meters tall, he was mightily dominant, raising his iron rod high in laughter as he neared Ding Ling, then brought it down heavily towards him.
"Take this!"
Boom!
The staff was like a Heaven-Supporting rod, and as it slammed down, ripples surged in the void, and whirlwinds sprang into existence, crashing down towards Ding Ling.
Ding Ling didn’t even raise an eyebrow, merely flicked his Ghost Sword lightly.
Clang!

In the next moment, a Sword River struck back with unexpected swiftness, rushing towards the Heaven-Supporting Staff, and in an instant, not only shattered and crushed the giant staff but also pierced through Hex Man’s body and his mount.
Crash!
The torrents of the Sword River where they passed, shattered all ghost horses, ghost soldiers, and ghost generals.
It was like a volcanic eruption, covering the earth with flowing lava, with no person or thing spared.
All perished in this ’calamity’!
Even Hex Man, strong as three meters, and over a dozen other two-meter-tall ghost generals, were instantly crushed and obliterated!
"How is it possible?!"
This time Zhang Liang saw it clearly and was taken aback:
"He clearly is a new ghost!"
His gaze shifted to the Ghost Sword in Ding Ling’s hand, his eyes burning with interest:
"It must be the sword in his hand causing trouble. Charge and take the sword from his hand!"
"Kill him!"
Even though Huang Shao, Liu Pi, and other generals were scared to death, they still gritted their teeth and charged forward.
Ma Zhong, deeply hidden within the army formation from afar, bent his bow and shot a three-foot Shadow Arrow towards Ding Ling!
Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh!

The Shadow Arrow flew silently, wielded by the undead Ma Zhong, it was unfathomable, sharp, eerie, and overwhelmingly powerful. With a swishing sound, the Shadow Arrow flew through the clouds and waves, arriving before Ding Ling in an instant, seemingly about to strike him. As it approached, Ding Ling’s entire body was flickering with sword light.
Crackle!
The three Shadow Arrows struck Ding Ling, but it was like tofu hitting the body of a great mountain, shattering and disintegrating from head to shaft in a flash.
Ma Zhong was dumbfounded and couldn’t comprehend:

"If he truly is a new ghost, how can he have such strong Protective Qi! Could it be that he too has been dead for a long time?! But that’s impossible. Just a year ago, there was a member from the Black Mountain Army who joined the Northern Camp and mentioned that Ding Ling had already ascended! He wasn’t dead, and was thriving in the Upper Realm! Given this, how can he as a new ghost be so strong?!"
Ma Zhong couldn’t figure it out.
Yet he dared not approach Ding Ling, staying at a distance to take stealthy shots.
Clang!
Ding Ling walked forward casually.
He swung his sword again and again.
Sword rivers surged forward, flowing towards Liu Pi and the others, covering them.
"Ah!"
"No!"
Amidst screams, shouts, and roars.
These people were devoured and obliterated by the Sword River.
Ding Ling’s Sword Realm spread, peeling away at the ghost generals’ stream of consciousness.
[Heaven-Supporting Staff Technique Full Level]
[Advanced Ghost Blade Forging Technique Full Level]
Ding Ling obtained over a dozen excellent Secret Skills.
Among them, the Advanced Ghost Blade Forging Technique, combined with the Advanced Ghost Blade Condensation Technique, instantly caused a fundamental transformation in his Ghost Sword.
Whoosh!
The spectral energy from the deceased Hex Man, Liu Pi, and others was devoured and forged by the Ghost Sword.
The Ghost Sword visibly grew stronger.
It became increasingly thinner.
The more it was forged, the thinner it became.
But its weight and quality only grew heavier.
As if compressed a thousand layers deep.
Once the tens of thousands of ghost soldiers and generals charging in were devoured and refined clean by his Ghost Sword.
The Ghost Sword ascended another level.
It upgraded to the Divine Weapon Initial Tier Ghost Blade.
Reached the Divine Weapon Stage.
The Ghost Blade honed its edge, its power more evident! With any casual slash, the damage and destruction to the undead increased more than tenfold!
"Not bad."
Ding Ling was quite satisfied, as he looked towards Zhang Liang.
Zhang Liang was also watching him, his face changing from rosy to pale, and then to ashen, a testament to the intensity of emotion:
"Who are you really?!"
Zhang Liang shouted.
"Ding Ling."
"Ding Ling?"
Zhang Liang recalled:
"Could it be the Guardian God of the Great Wei Kingdom, the First-Rank Prince?! That Alien Ding Ling who ascended to other worlds and still remained king and overlord?"
"Indeed."
"Are you dead?"
Zhang Liang asked uncertainly.
"Whether I’m dead or not is not important."
Ding Ling sighed and said:
"I originally didn’t want to be an enemy of the Great Virtuous Master, but alas, alas..."
He swung a sword towards Zhang Liang.
"Ah!"

Zhang Liang, standing four meters tall, was much stronger than Hex Man. His ghostly steed was mountain-like. Now seeing the attack coming, alarm bells rang in his heart, and all the hair on his body stood up uncontrollably as he witnessed the torrent of the incoming Sword River.
Zhang Liang felt an extremely strong and clear sense that: He couldn’t stop it!
"I don’t believe!"
Zhang Liang roared, slashing a blade towards Ding Ling’s direction!
Yellow Heaven Technique!
A Dream of Spring and Autumn Cut!
With the slash, an illusory blade light entwined with two strange spiral qis—neither alive nor dead—rushed towards the Sword River.
Boom!
Very soon, the Sword River and blade light collided, yet the expected clash of equals did not occur; in an instant, the blade light was breached by the Sword River.
"Even the Yellow Heaven Technique has failed!"
Zhang Liang was filled with dread, eyes wide, and without hesitation, leaped into the air, stepping on the void, turned around, and fled.
He realized the absolute gap between himself and Ding Ling.
Though unsure where the problem lay, he felt certain that to continue would mean death.
And this death surely meant his soul would disperse.
Zhang Liang did not want to die, nor did he dare die!
Crash!
The Sword River, like a Galactic waterfall, cascaded down from the heavens, engulfing tens of thousands of ghost generals and soldiers.
"Ah!"
"Run!"

chapters.title: Chapter 789 - 778: Full Level Wind Summoning Skill
paragraphs: Screams, shrieks, curses...
The sounds continued endlessly, loud and uproarious!
But only for a moment.
All the sounds ceased.
They all died.
Woo woo!
Rolling ghost qi surged forth, injecting into the Ghost Sword, refining, strengthening, and elevating the Ghost Sword once again.
In just a short while.
The Ghost Sword upgraded to a middle tier Divine Weapon.
The power to enhance Sword River became even stronger.
The lethality against Ghost Generals and Ghost Soldiers doubled yet again.
Ding Ling’s efficiency in killing enemies naturally increased.
"Unexpectedly, the Advanced Ghost Blade Forging Technique combined with the Advanced Ghost Blade Condensation Technique has such miraculous effects."
While marveling in secret, Ding Ling’s Sword Realm descended, choosing to peel away the memories of those skilled Ghost Generals.
As for the weaker Ghost Soldiers, he chose to ignore them.
Firstly, there wasn’t enough time, he couldn’t peel away all Ghost Generals’ stream of consciousness, how could he bother with weaker Ghost Soldiers?
Secondly, Ghost Soldiers were weak, their knowledge limited.
[Night Battle Eight Directions Blade Technique Full Level]
[Nine Techniques of Mountain-Beating Tiger Full Level]
Various Secret Skills were instantly learned by Ding Ling and reached full level.
Undeniably.
Peeling away others’ stream of consciousness was far faster than reading a book.
Reading required flipping pages.
This peeling allowed instant mastery of dozens of Secret Skills, and upon gaining them, they all reached full level.
Ding Ling chose to integrate all these Secret Skills into the Martial Dao True Understanding.
Believing that after some time.
His Martial Dao True Understanding would strengthen further.
Swiftly!
Since he had torn down relations with the Yellow Turban Army, Ding Ling had no intentions to hold back.
He stepped on sword light, moving swiftly, catching up with the frantically fleeing Ma Zhong in an instant, swinging his sword down, splattery!
A flash of sword light passed, a huge head soared into the sky, covered by Sword Realm, Ma Zhong’s stream of consciousness began to peel away.
To the very end, Ma Zhong was bewildered!
How is Ding Ling so fast, so strong?!
"Clearly, I could fight evenly with him when we were in the mortal world! If it weren’t for being deceived by Ding Ling’s performance, I might have killed Ding Ling.
Times changed, now Ding Ling can easily kill me?! I don’t believe it; this must be a dream!"
The disparity was too immense!
Too transformative!
It was normal for Ma Zhong not to believe, not to imagine.
Keep in mind, he had practiced for years in the Netherworld, incredibly strong, blending in flawlessly with his assassin’s skills, nobody dared provoke him.

He was powerful, even contemplating establishing his own faction, but after witnessing the sudden disappearance of Spirit Emperor Liu Hong, he was terrified, joining the mysterious Great Virtuous Master faction without hesitation to live longer here.
Originally thinking, with his means and abilities, he would ascend to the peak of the Netherworld sooner or later.
Unexpectedly, Ding Ling suddenly came to kill, and effortlessly counter-killed him and Hex Man as a new ghost.
His methods were so fierce and terrifying, unheard of, unseen!
Simply put.
Like seeing aliens suddenly one day for modern people.
His worldview shattered to pieces.
Ma Zhong now felt this.
After Ding Ling peeled away Ma Zhong’s stream of consciousness, he somewhat perceived, shook his head thinking:
"Ma Zhong was indeed a talent, but unfortunately a mortal enemy with me. He can’t be allowed to continue living."
[Foot-Stepping Meteor Secret Technique Full Level]
[Soaring Body Technique Full Level]
[Assassin’s Secret Technique Full Level]
Another dozen Secret Skills were mastered by Ding Ling.
Ding Ling was rather satisfied.
Ma Zhong, in life, provided him excellent martial arts like Shadow Arrow Skill, and after death as an undead still offered so many Secret Skills, dying rightly.
Gaining Ma Zhong’s Assassin’s Secret Technique, his form became eerie, appearing and disappearing, difficult for others to detect.
He walked through the Yellow Turban Army camp, like a meteor cutting through the sky, deity passing through, everything perishing.
Woo woo!

Ding Ling swiftly caught up with Zhang Liang, amidst his horrified desperation, swung his sword, swish! The Sword River surged northward, like light and electricity, instantly engulfing Zhang Liang and his guards.
"Ah!"
"I’ll fight you!"

Zhang Liang roared furiously, trying to counterattack, but as the Sword River pierced his body, the raised saber fell powerlessly to the ground, his entire self began dissipating into clouds and mist.
"How could this be so strong?! I was clearly the strongest in this Netherworld besides big brother and second brother. Why am I so effortlessly killed by Ding Ling?!"
Confused, clueless.
Leaving this world filled with regret, anger, resentment, curses, despair.
Ding Ling’s Sword Realm extended over.
In just a short while.
[Yellow Heaven Technique Full Level]
[Taiping Sutra - Peaceful Breathing Method Full Level]
[Taiping Sutra - Talisman Making Skill Full Level]
[Taiping Sutra - Medical Canon Full Level]
[Taiping Sutra - Wind Summoning Skill Full Level]
Peeled about two percent of the stream of consciousness.
The remaining eighty percent of Zhang Liang’s consciousness fused into this world.
Making Ding Ling quite moved was the numerous skills and techniques Zhang Liang knew.
Yellow Heaven Technique included various worldly secret skills, with skills like blade, sword, fist, palm.
And Taiping Sutra was truly a Primordial Spirit level skill and technique beyond imagination.
"Such history plane, to have something at the Taiping Sutra’s level, inconceivable."
After mastering all related Taiping Sutra skills, Ding Ling merely said two words ’call wind’!
Next instant.
Mighty winds arose out of nowhere, sweeping towards the Yellow Turban Army before him.
These winds seemed like chilling winds descending from the heavens, capable of freezing souls, everywhere they went, ghost soldiers froze to the ground, only powerful ghost generals could escape.
Ding Ling didn’t mind, just sensed a while, shook his head, thinking:
"Though this Wind Summoning Skill is extraordinary, it isn’t comparable to my Breaking Technique Sword, much less my Martial Dao True Understanding."
Not a legendary Immortal Skill.
Only counted as a Primordial Spirit level skill.
Though strong, to Ding Ling, it merely enhanced his foundation, providing more attack and defense methods.
Even so.
Ding Ling was quite satisfied.
After all, these techniques and skills were extraordinary, integrating into Martial Dao True Understanding would allow continuous transformation and elevation.
"With Martial Dao True Understanding at full level, now any breathing technique can instantly be full level."
Previously, to reach breathing technique full level was very restrictive.
But now none remained.
It could be full level directly.

Moreover, after breathing technique reached full level, it could automatically integrate into Martial Dao True Understanding, purifying and strengthening the essence of breathing technique within Martial Dao True Understanding.
"However, Zhang Liang’s Taiping Sutra seems incomplete."
Ding Ling continued walking forward.
He didn’t wield his sword again, merely uttered ’call wind’ two words.

[Taiping Sutra - Wind Summoning Skill Full Level]
Peeled about two percent of the stream of consciousness.
The remaining eighty percent of Zhang Liang’s consciousness fused into this world.
Making Ding Ling quite moved was the numerous skills and techniques Zhang Liang knew.
Yellow Heaven Technique included various worldly secret skills, with skills like blade, sword, fist, palm.
And Taiping Sutra was truly a Primordial Spirit level skill and technique beyond imagination.
"Such history plane, to have something at the Taiping Sutra’s level, inconceivable."
After mastering all related Taiping Sutra skills, Ding Ling merely said two words ’call wind’!
Next instant.
Mighty winds arose out of nowhere, sweeping towards the Yellow Turban Army before him.
These winds seemed like chilling winds descending from the heavens, capable of freezing souls, everywhere they went, ghost soldiers froze to the ground, only powerful ghost generals could escape.
Ding Ling didn’t mind, just sensed a while, shook his head, thinking:
"Though this Wind Summoning Skill is extraordinary, it isn’t comparable to my Breaking Technique Sword, much less my Martial Dao True Understanding."
Not a legendary Immortal Skill.
Only counted as a Primordial Spirit level skill.
Though strong, to Ding Ling, it merely enhanced his foundation, providing more attack and defense methods.
Even so.
Ding Ling was quite satisfied.
After all, these techniques and skills were extraordinary, integrating into Martial Dao True Understanding would allow continuous transformation and elevation.
"With Martial Dao True Understanding at full level, now any breathing technique can instantly be full level."
Previously, to reach breathing technique full level was very restrictive.
But now none remained.
It could be full level directly.

Moreover, after breathing technique reached full level, it could automatically integrate into Martial Dao True Understanding, purifying and strengthening the essence of breathing technique within Martial Dao True Understanding.
"However, Zhang Liang’s Taiping Sutra seems incomplete."
Ding Ling continued walking forward.
He didn’t wield his sword again, merely uttered ’call wind’ two words.

chapters.title: Chapter 790 - 779: Great Virtuous Master
paragraphs: Words Accompanied by Law.
The moment the two words "Call Wind" were uttered, a fierce wind, either transforming into a tornado storm descending from the sky or morphing into a spiral cold wind, swept forward.
Where Ding Ling passed, everything blocking his way, people or objects, were frozen, blown away, shattered, or destroyed.
In Ding Ling’s hands, the Wind Summoning Skill was unleashed with such power that it was far beyond the likes of Zhang Liang.
It’s much like the simplest Arhat Fist technique, yet when Xiaoo Feng uses it compared to a regular person, the effect is, naturally, worlds apart.
Similarly.
In Ding Ling’s hands, the Wind Summoning Skill could, of course, be pushed to its greatest potential.
"Wind Summoning Skill!"
A clear shout suddenly echoed from ahead.

Immediately after, Ding Ling saw a similar tornado storm carrying cold currents sweeping toward his direction! Boom! The tornado storm launched by Ding Ling and the incoming storm collided in the air, holding stalemate for a brief moment before mutually neutralizing into nothingness!
Ding Ling turned his gaze, and saw at a hundred zhang forward stood a middle-aged man with an immortal aura, a long beard floating, dressed in a Taoist robe, and holding a long sword.
He carried an extraordinary presence, standing out like a leader-level figure.
Ding Ling was about to speak, but the newcomer spoke first:
"Who the hell are you, and why are you slaughtering in my camp?!"
"Who are you then?"
"I am Zhang Jiao, the leader of the Yellow Turban Army!"
With a movement, Zhang Jiao rode the wind, swiftly arriving near Ding Ling, his eyes sharp like an eagle, fixed on Ding Ling:
"You seem young, with no trace of Ghost Qi, yet able to rampage through my Yellow Turban Army, you certainly aren’t ordinary! Who exactly are you?"
"So you are the Great Virtuous Master."
Ding Ling responded irrelevantly, continuing to speak his own mind:
"Why do you think figures like Wang Mang, Liu Xiu, Bai Qi don’t exist in this world? And how exactly did Spirit Emperor Liu Hong disappear?"
Zhang Jiao’s face slightly changed:
"Is this really what you came for?"
"Seems like you indeed know something."
Ding Ling said:
"Can you tell me the truth first?"
"Dream on!"

Before Zhang Jiao could respond, a burly man similar to Zhang Jiao in appearance came rushing from afar, over four meters tall, even stronger than Zhang Liang. At this moment, the man yelled angrily and mournfully:
"Brother, it’s him who killed Third Brother!"
"It was indeed your doing!"

Zhang Jiao, as if struck by Five Thunders, his five-meter tall body trembled, his face turning blue and then white. After a brief pause, he took a deep breath, and his alms-bowl-sized eyes shot out a fountain of substantial anger:
"I’ll never forgive you!"
His words hadn’t even landed.
Boom!
Rumble! Along with the explosive clap of thunder, streaks of lightning flashed in the void and transformed into shapes like dragons and pythons, and in a thunderous fury, surged towards Ding Ling!
At the same time.
Another four-meter tall man launched a fierce attack toward Ding Ling.
He sent out a breathtaking saber arc toward Ding Ling, precisely the A Dream of Spring and Autumn from the Yellow Heaven Technique!

This man’s saber technique was sharper, more perfect compared to Zhang Liang, with one swing seeming to cut through even the ages of spring and autumn. Ripples appeared in the void, accompanied by those streaks of lightning, and the saber arc swiftly drowned Ding Ling.
"Huff Huff."

The man panted heavily. That one blow was with all his might, nearly exhausting all his Soul Power. Knowing the opponent was a master who killed his third brother, he dared not underestimate Ding Ling, giving his all from the start.
Not just him.
Zhang Jiao thought the same.
"Brother, is he dead?"
The man, precisely the Earth God General Zhang Bao, seeing Ding Ling engulfed in saber arcs and thunder, couldn’t help but turn to ask.
"What? He, he actually isn’t dead."

Zhang Jiao initially breathed a sigh of relief, thinking Ding Ling surely dead, for his Thunder and Lightning Manipulation Technique was known to be the bane of ghosts and gods. Any Ghost General facing this move would dissolve like snow meeting the sun!
But upon carefully sensing with the Taiping Sutra, he felt a formidable and vital Soul Power. This represented something obvious.
"Retreat!"
Zhang Jiao shouted.
But it was already too late.
Boom!

Ding Ling, treading on sword light, charging ahead with Divine Ghost Sword in hand, with a thought, "Clang!" The Ghost Sword shot into the air, splitting from one to two, two to four, four to eight, and in moments filled the sky with a dense Sword Rain.
As Ding Ling pointed forward.
Ten thousand swords dropped like meteors from the sky!
The speed was unparalleled! Hard for regular eyes to see!
Clang clang clang!
In a fierce clangor resonating through the Void Nether, when looking again, Zhang Jiao and Zhang Bao had both been pierced through their towering bodies by ten thousand swords.
Of course, they tried to resist.
But how could they be opponents of Ding Ling who had used ’Breaking Sword’s Thousand Swords Flying Stream’?
Although the Breaking Technique Sword had few moves.
But each one was extremely powerful.
The River of the Breaking Sword, unleashed with one move, could destroy and annihilate all.
Thousand Swords Flying Stream, could instantly materialize thousands of swords, like thunderbolts shooting out, instantly killing the adversary!
This move focused on speed, urgency, ferocity, strength, and intensity!
Impossible to block, unattainable to evade.

Even though Zhang Jiao and Zhang Bao are formidable, Zhang Bao could even rival masters at the Shattering Level, when facing Ding Ling empowered by the Martial Dao True Understanding, Saint-Grade Golden Core, and Flawless Sword Spirit, they still fell short.
In an instant, they were severely struck and fell to the ground.
[Obtained D-level Achievement Medal: Intimidate Zhang Jiao.]
[Obtained D-level Achievement Medal: Intimidate Zhang Bao.]

[Note: After their deaths, the souls entered the Netherworld, gaining supreme opportunity, and their power skyrocketed, within just over ten years, they both stepped into the Realm of Ghosts and Gods!
They shepherd others and suppressed the north. Without intending to dominate the Netherworld, otherwise, Dong Zhuo and Yuan Shao wouldn’t be opponents at all!
They thought they would remain safe like this, believing no undead could be their match, but your appearance utterly shattered their established beliefs and perceptions!]
Zhang Bao’s strength is at Grandmaster Peak Level.
Zhang Jiao is at Shattering Initial Tier Level.
Their Achievement Medals are both D-level.
Previously Zhang Liang was also D-level.
Along the way, a considerable number of Achievement Medals were collected.
This was something Ding Ling didn’t expect.
[Obtained E-level Achievement Medal: Intimidate Dong Zhuo.]
[Obtained E-level Achievement Medal: Intimidate Yuan Shao.]
Even the Achievement Medals of Dong Zhuo and others were successfully accumulated.
It proves that the Achievement Medals can be repeatedly collected.
It just requires a few years?
Exactly how many years.
Even Ding Ling is unsure.
But on the Historical Plane, it shouldn’t exceed five years.
And the Achievement Medals of Cao Mengde and others, Ding Ling hasn’t collected again, indicating they’ve surely been collected by other players.
And since Dong Zhuo and others are in the Netherworld, no player can enter, hence impossible to collect again.
This facilitates Ding Ling’s collection.
On his journey, Ding Ling collected so many Achievement Medals he’s lost count.
Roughly counting, at least several hundred.
All that’s to say.
Many people have indeed died, and they all gather in clusters, making it convenient for Ding Ling’s collection.

chapters.title: Chapter 791 - 780: Thunder and Lightning Manipulation Technique
paragraphs: Ding Ling stepped forward, looking at Zhang Jiao, and seeing his face mixed with disbelief, anger, and a curse-like expression, he realized that getting the truth through questioning might be difficult.
He abandoned the idea of asking, and directly pointed a finger.
Poof! Poof!
Two sword lights flashed by.
In the next instant.
Two hollow pits appeared on Zhang Jiao and Zhang Bao’s foreheads.
"They died just like that?!"
Scenes from the past flashed in Zhang Jiao and Zhang Bao’s minds, finally freezing on two figures.
One was ethereal and god-like, tinged with eeriness and darkness.
The other was grand and majestic, with a hint of dominance and unrivaled strength.
One of the faces was that of an elderly person with white hair and a youthful complexion;
The other was none other than Ding Ling.
"Both of them are strong; how does this young man differ completely from the other one?!"

"Moreover, this young man has no ghost aura; he’s a newcomer to the Netherworld, yet he’s overwhelmingly powerful! I’ve already reached the supreme of this realm, yet I’ve been defeated? This, this, it’s incredible! Is he an envoy from the Immortal Realm?"
Such a thought suddenly popped into Zhang Jiao’s mind, shortly before being engulfed and shrouded by endless darkness.
He truly perished.
[Taiping Sutra Rain Summoning Skill Full Level]
[Thunder and Lightning Manipulation Technique Full Level]
[Divine Meditation Technique Full Level]
[Divine Ghost Blade Forging Technique Full Level]
[Divine Ghost Blade Condensation Technique Full Level]
The Sword Realm encompassed them.
It began to strip away Zhang Jiao and Zhang Bao’s consciousness information flow.
In just a moment.
Ding Ling had gained mastery over hundreds of various techniques and laws.
He was quietly shaken.
Because among these techniques and laws, remarkably, three tenths, over twenty of them, were above Martial Arts Golden Core Level.
The Taiping Sutra even reached the Primordial Spirit level!
"Incredible."
Ding Ling praised.
That there were Primordial Spirit level techniques and laws in the Historical Plane was beyond Ding Ling’s imagination.
"From Zhang Jiao’s memories, it seems his Taiping Sutra was indeed taught by an elderly man."
Ding Ling meticulously reviewed about two-tenths of the consciousness information flow.
He obtained some fragmented information.
Zhang Jiao was known to be a genius.
His talent in practicing magic was considered exceptional by his generation.
Only few knew about it.
Yet Nanhua Old Immortal somehow learned of Zhang Jiao’s excellence, found Zhang Jiao, and bestowed upon him a scroll of the Taiping Sutra.
The techniques and laws recorded in the Taiping Sutra were so heaven-defying and extraordinary.
No matter how formidable Zhang Jiao was, he could not cultivate them to the Perfect Realm.

Because the barriers and restrictions of the Historical Plane were extremely powerful, hence if Zhang Jiao used them forcibly, the likelihood of heavenly retribution he might face was without a doubt.
Zhang Jiao’s death, without a doubt, was caused by the frequent use of these heaven-defying techniques and laws, being cursed and counterattacked by the Heavenly Dao.

"However, Zhang Jiao found himself thriving in the Netherworld, simply because the upper limit of this Netherworld was exceedingly high, making it more than adequate to accommodate one at Shattering Level. Zhang Jiao’s cultivation of the Taiping Sutra here naturally surged, achieving more and more each day."
Just after Zhang Jiao had entered this Netherworld.
The Divine Ghost Blade Condensation and Forging Techniques were already carved into his mind.
Along with Divine Meditation and Divine-level Qi Cultivation Techniques.
So-called Divine Level.
In truth, it reached Martial Arts Golden Core Level.
Achieving such level in Meditation and Qi Cultivation Techniques was extremely frightening.

Ding Ling slightly activated the Meditation Technique, and the land within twenty thousand miles in the Earth Realm reflected into the Sea of Consciousness, making the Divine Meditation Technique at least twenty times stronger than the Advanced Meditation Technique!
Similarly with the Divine-level Qi Cultivation Technique.
So much that every breath Ding Ling took, he could absorb ghost qi from within a hundred miles.
Ding Ling tossed the Ghost Sword in hand into the void.
Activating the Divine Ghost Blade Condensation and Forging Techniques.
In an instant.
Whirling ghost qi surged toward the Ghost Sword.
The quality of the Ghost Sword rapidly escalated before the eyes.
In a moment.
It reached High Tier Divine Weapon.
In another moment, it achieved Divine Weapon Perfection Level.
It completely devoured the shattered soul qi and ghost qi of Zhang Jiao, Zhang Bao, and others, thus allowing it to advance so rapidly in a short time.
After reaching this tier of the Ghost Sword.
It was no weaker than the Snow-Drinking Saber.
"Unbelievable."
Ding Ling was moved.
This combination of Divine Ghost Blade Condensation and Forging Techniques was simply like having a cheat code.
"Who invented them?"
Ding Ling once again searched through the memory points.
And found some clues.
"It turns out all the secrets are buried in the South."
"Also, in Zhang Jiao’s memory, there is a persistent, eerie, dark figure imprinted."
"Who is the protagonist of that figure?"
Ding Ling’s gaze shifted southward.
"Seems I need to take a journey to the South."
With a rapid shift, Ding Ling was out of the Yellow Turban Army’s camp, heading straight to the South.
Until he was far away.
The chaotic Yellow Turban Legion camp finally seemed to regain some tranquility.
All ghost generals and ghost soldiers were looking at each other, their faces filled with shock, bewilderment, fear, and helplessness:
"The Great Virtuous Master is dead. What do we do?!"
"Terrifying guy. He’s called Ding Ling? The one people often speak of as the Sword God, Guardian, First-Rank Prince of the Great Wei Kingdom?!"
"Horrifying! How can such an irregular character exist in the world? The Great Virtuous Master was instantly killed! This, this, the world is far more terrifying than we imagined!"
Ding Ling’s massacre within the Yellow Turban Army camp.
Made these ghost generals and ghost soldiers unable to recover or forget Ding Ling, this man who seemed like a god or demon!
Furthermore, as time went on.
Whenever they saw a similar silhouette. These ghost generals and ghost soldiers would flee in terror.
Making these ’true new ghosts’ completely lost and bewildered.
Yet they could not know that they were blessed by Ding Ling!
In the mind of Ding Ling, the Divine Meditation Technique operated constantly.
The scenery within twenty thousand miles was vivid and distinct.
Soon.
He understood the general situation in the South.
A scene of darkness and desolation, like a bog, and more like a stagnant pool!
Only this Southern region occupied areas ten times wider than all the areas combined in the North, East, and West.
"This Netherworld is huge!"
Ding Ling’s Divine Meditation Technique reached its peak.
Various detailed situations reflected in the Sea of Consciousness.
Ding Ling saw it more clearly.
There was a giant serpent, large enough to devour the heavens and obscure the sun, continuously gathering ghost and soul qi in the Netherworld. With each breath, the serpent seemed to grow stronger.
And each time it grew stronger.
The sky of the Netherworld darkened a degree, simultaneously sinking a little.
"Hmm?!"
Ding Ling was shocked, transfixed:
"Could it be this ghostly thing causing trouble?"
He approached for a closer look.
This glance.
Also made him gasp.
Because this giant serpent was actually composed of densely stacked mountain ranges.
Upon closer inspection.
No serpents were visible.
Only a sight of towering mountain ranges.
Only with some distance.
Using the Divine Meditation Technique, could he sense and see the serpent.
"Is the Divine Meditation Technique a self-saving act of the Netherworld’s Heavenly Dao and Earth Dao, thus engraved into all new ghosts’ Sea of Consciousness?"
