What do we do?!"
"Terrifying guy.
He’s called Ding Ling?
The one people often speak of as the Sword God, Guardian, First-Rank Prince of the Great Wei Kingdom?!"
"Horrifying!
How can such an irregular character exist in the world?
The Great Virtuous Master was instantly killed!
This, this, the world is far more terrifying than we imagined!"
Ding Ling’s massacre within the Yellow Turban Army camp.
Made these ghost generals and ghost soldiers unable to recover or forget Ding Ling, this man who seemed like a god or demon!
Furthermore, as time went on.
Whenever they saw a similar silhouette.
These ghost generals and ghost soldiers would flee in terror.
Making these ’true new ghosts’ completely lost and bewildered.
Yet they could not know that they were blessed by Ding Ling!
In the mind of Ding Ling, the Divine Meditation Technique operated constantly.
The scenery within twenty thousand miles was vivid and distinct.
Soon.
He understood the general situation in the South.
A scene of darkness and desolation, like a bog, and more like a stagnant pool!
Only this Southern region occupied areas ten times wider than all the areas combined in the North, East, and West.
"This Netherworld is huge!"
Ding Ling’s Divine Meditation Technique reached its peak.
Various detailed situations reflected in the Sea of Consciousness.
Ding Ling saw it more clearly.
There was a giant serpent, large enough to devour the heavens and obscure the sun, continuously gathering ghost and soul qi in the Netherworld.
With each breath, the serpent seemed to grow stronger.
And each time it grew stronger.
The sky of the Netherworld darkened a degree, simultaneously sinking a little.
"Hmm?!"
Ding Ling was shocked, transfixed:
"Could it be this ghostly thing causing trouble?"
He approached for a closer look.
This glance.
Also made him gasp.
Because this giant serpent was actually composed of densely stacked mountain ranges.
Upon closer inspection.
No serpents were visible.
Only a sight of towering mountain ranges.
Only with some distance.
Using the Divine Meditation Technique, could he sense and see the serpent.
"Is the Divine Meditation Technique a self-saving act of the Netherworld’s Heavenly Dao and Earth Dao, thus engraved into all new ghosts’ Sea of Consciousness?"

chapters.title: Chapter 792 - 781: Scattering Beans into Soldiers
paragraphs: Ding Ling speculated accordingly.
Otherwise, there’s no way to explain this situation.
"The heavens and earth of this world are about to merge. Could that serpent be the Doomsday Python?"
Ding Ling couldn’t comprehend, it was unimaginable.
Even though he had experienced the Demon Realm, Divine Realm, and time travel in the Wind and Cloud World.
This was also the first time seeing such a terrifying thing.
A gigantic python capable of devouring even the Celestial Palace and Earth Dao.
"Was it naturally occurring? Or man-made?"
"Who is the protagonist of that silhouette in Zhang Jiao’s memory? Could it be Nanhua Old Immortal?"
Ding Ling was lost in thought.
After a brief appearance in the Three Kingdoms, Nanhua Old Immortal vanished.
Some say he went to the Immortal Realm.
Others say he died; some think he might be hiding in a corner of the Three Kingdoms World, overlooking all beings.
What is the truth?
It’s hard to know.
But if the Netherworld is swallowed by this python?
The consequences might be unimaginably terrifying.
With one step, Ding Ling covered hundreds of miles, with the Divine Meditation Technique and Qi Cultivation Skill empowering him, and various Full Level Taiping Sutra techniques at his disposal.
As Ding Ling advanced, wind, clouds, thunder, and lightning accompanied him, and in a flash, he covered over a thousand miles.
Incredibly fast!
"Indeed, these techniques can empower oneself. It’s just surprising that they increased the speed of the Sword Spirit several times, which I didn’t expect."
Thunder and Lightning Manipulation Technique.
Wind-and-Rain Summoning.
Scattering Beans into Soldiers.
Paper Cutting into Humans.
Various exotic techniques could be used freely by Ding Ling.
Instantly reaching full level.
Allowing Ding Ling’s understanding of these techniques to reach an extremely advanced level.
He flew over the depths of the swamp, looking at the towering mountains, and thought:
"I need to find Shekou and see what’s really going on."
The Sword Spirit is immortal.
This was Ding Ling’s confidence in exploring.
Of course.
If he encountered a terrifying being capable of destroying the Sword Spirit, Ding Ling would have to admit defeat.
So, he thought for a moment and picked up some mud from the ground, kneading them into beans.
Then the Divine Meditation Technique mapped out a twenty-thousand-mile radius.
"Found it."
Ding Ling soared a thousand miles into the cloud sea, overlooking the lower realm, and saw Shekou below.
The amount of Ghost Qi and Soul Qi being expelled from Shekou was extremely massive.
Standing here and seeing it up close.
The feeling was clearer.
Ding Ling for a moment felt as if he might be sucked in at any moment.
"Go!"
Ding Ling flung the ’beans’ in his hand.
Whoosh whoosh!
The beans fell toward Shekou like raindrops, and then transformed into powerful puppet soldiers.
These soldiers stood eight feet tall, wearing earth-colored armor, their expressions solemn and commanding, and under Ding Ling’s control, they wielded long spears, clattered their way into Shekou.
Ding Ling used his mind to control these soldiers.
As the soldiers passed through.
He could roughly sense the situation inside Shekou.
This was the heaven-defying effect produced by ’Scattering Beans into Soldiers’ combined with the Divine Meditation Technique.
Just relying on the Divine Meditation Technique made it impossible to sense the inside of Shekou.
Though this Divine Meditation Technique could sense a vast range, it could only perceive the surface, not the inner details.
Whereas the soldiers from Scattering Beans could charge into Shekou.
And they were infused with Ding Ling’s thoughts.
When Ding Ling moved his thoughts, the Divine Meditation Technique could be activated.
Thus each of these soldiers was equivalent to a weakened version of ’Ding Ling’.
Clatter clatter!
The soldiers ran quickly, in a moment they reached the depths of Shekou, seeing two main paths.
Ding Ling decided to divide the soldiers into two groups.
One group ran to the left, the other ran to the right.
The hundred soldiers on the left ran quickly, but never seemed to reach the end.
The path seemed to become wider as they ran.
As if reaching the depths of a mountain path.
While the hundred soldiers on the right ran for a full half-hour, finally arriving in an extremely vast space.
This space was vast, resembling a Grotto Heaven World, with an expanse of seemingly hundreds of miles in length and width!
The overall impression was: a deep green with a hint of blood red.
Through the soldiers, Ding Ling perceived using his mind.
He saw clearly that the blood-red object was actually an ’Alchemy Furnace’.
This Alchemy Furnace hung in mid-air, continuously refining unknown gases.
Each strand of gas refined.
Deepened the green.
The blood-red became more vivid, as if it might come alive at any moment.
Ding Ling controlled the soldiers to leap over a deep ravine, wielding spears, boom! Striking the Alchemy Furnace.
The Alchemy Furnace rattled, shaking twice.
But didn’t fall.
Ding Ling kept controlling the soldiers to strike it.
A hundred soldiers took turns attacking, moments later, the Alchemy Furnace fell down, flipping over on the ground! Whoosh!
The gas within the Alchemy Furnace spilt out.
The gas washed over the soldiers.
The soldiers seemed to receive immense fortune, quickly growing and towering, soon, all hundred soldiers rose to over two meters tall.
Not only became more imposing and strong.
Their armor and equipment also became shinier, sturdier, and synchronized with the heavens and earth.
Their eyes seemed more lively.
Ding Ling was utterly astonished.
Controlling these soldiers became exponentially more challenging, his control difficulty soared over a hundredfold.
"Are these soldiers about to come alive?"
"How is this possible?"
Ding Ling decided to have these soldiers return.
Of course, carrying the Alchemy Furnace back.
The soldiers hadn’t truly come to life yet.
Still puppets.
So under Ding Ling’s mind control, they obediently divided into three groups, each carrying one ’foot’, lifting the Three-legged Tripod out of the area.
Ding Ling let ninety-nine soldiers return first.
Leaving one soldier to stay in the Grotto Heaven World.
Instinctively.
Ding Ling had a premonition.
This Grotto Heaven World, without the Alchemy Furnace, was bound to undergo a massive change.
Sure enough.
As the Alchemy Furnace moved farther from the Grotto Heaven World.
This Grotto Heaven World began to shrink and collapse.
After only a brief collapse.
It stopped.
Upon sensing again.
The Grotto Heaven World astonishingly shrank from being a hundred miles in length and width to fifty miles.
A fifty-mile area collapse and shrinkage.
"Just missing a furnace!"
"Yet it changed so much."
It seems this furnace contained Heaven and Earth.
Ding Ling used his mind to control the soldier to search for an exit within the Grotto Heaven World.
Discovering only the original path was open, other ’entrances’ were all sealed.
"There are paths."
But seemingly not paths for ordinary people to break in through.
Ding Ling thought for a moment, deciding to have the soldier return as well.
All these soldiers had absorbed a bit of the special gas from the Alchemy Furnace.
Ding Ling intended to study what this gas really was.
To make each mud puppet soldier transform so dramatically was simply incredible.
Clatter clatter clatter!
The other hundred-man team was still racing in the mountain path, seemingly never reaching the end.

chapters.title: Chapter 793 - 782: Growing Bones
paragraphs: Another team has already carried the Alchemy Furnace out of Shekou.
Da da da!

Soldiers are traveling through the air, and they stepped into the sea of clouds before the sky, placing the Alchemy Furnace before Ding Ling, who grabbed it in mid-air, meticulously sensing and examining it.
The material of this furnace is exceptionally extraordinary.
Neither truly real nor truly false.
Even with Ding Ling’s eyesight and knowledge, he couldn’t see through it.
"A mere historical plane..."
Ding Ling was speechless, moved.

When he descended upon this Three Kingdoms World again, he felt he could easily tear the void apart and topple the mountains, as in front of him, the world of this historical plane was fragile to the extreme.
But coming to this Netherworld.
Time and again, it opened his eyes!
The upper limit of power in this Netherworld reached the Primordial Spirit Level!
The Sword Spirit here can unleash all its energy!
This point is extraordinary, even far stronger than the Wind and Cloud Human World.
"Besides, what exactly is this pill within this furnace?"
Ding Ling levitated and took out a pill from inside the furnace.
The pill was green all over with a touch of red, looking quite mysterious.
Ding Ling was skilled in alchemy and pharmacology.
In all planes, he was regarded as an unparalleled Divine Doctor, far surpassing Hua Tuo and Zhang Zhongjing.
His alchemy skill had reached a pinnacle, comparable to immortals.
Yet even so.
Looking at this pill, he was still utterly bewildered.
"Should I eat it?"
Ding Ling remembered scenes where only wisps of air from the furnace caused massive changes to the mud-like soldiers.
He gritted his teeth and threw the pill into his mouth.
After all, he had a Sword Spirit Body.
Even if it broke down.
He still had his true self!
But if this pill indeed caused the Sword Spirit to undergo a world-shaking transformation, then undoubtedly it would be a huge gain.
Of course.
It was primarily because Ding Ling hadn’t sensed any ’toxins’ from this pill. So, he dared to try eating it.
Whoosh whoosh!
As the pill entered his stomach.
The aura of the Sword Spirit began to change at an extremely fast pace.
The body became increasingly refined.
Even internally, it started to grow translucent sword bones!
Each of these sword bones resembled a Divine Weapon! Sharp and extremely durable!
As the entire pill was refined.
The Sword Spirit had already grown a body full of sword bones.
Every supreme sword bone symbolized the potential of the Sword Spirit to reach the Sword Dao Venerable Realm in the future.
With a body of supreme sword bones, how far can the Sword Spirit go in the future?
No one knows.
Ding Ling regained consciousness, carefully sensing the Sword Spirit’s condition, and was deeply moved:
"This pill seems to be a World Pill. It seems like the creation of a world was melted into it, and I just ate a world?!"
Ding Ling was suspicious, looking towards Shekou, deep in thought:
"Could it be that this Alchemy Furnace inside Shekou is refining this Netherworld?"
If that’s really the case.
Then everything can be explained clearly.
"In this case, the pill in the Alchemy Furnace would be a supreme Treasure Pill!"
The Sword Spirit has integrated the creation of a world.
Its natural gift has become unbelievably powerful; it wouldn’t be an exaggeration to call it inherently a Sword Dao Venerable.
He looked at a hundred Puppet Soldiers beside him.
This time.
He found he could easily control them.
"It seems the mind control power of the Sword Spirit has also increased by no less than a hundredfold!"
Ding Ling was very satisfied.
Letting these soldiers once again leap into Shekou, to explore other realms.
Da da da!

These soldiers got a wisp of the pill’s gifted creation, yet compared to their original creation, they were now ten times stronger, as such, each speed like the wind or electricity managed later to catch up to the first group of one hundred soldiers within half an hour.
Then they continued to sprint forward.
After some time.
These over a hundred soldiers stepped into an even larger Grotto Heaven World.
Here.
Likewise, they saw another Alchemy Furnace.
This Alchemy Furnace was larger, more solid.
But these over a hundred soldiers were stronger than before, thus after bombing for some time, this Alchemy Furnace also fell out of the void, collapsing to the ground, whoosh whoosh!
Wisps of pill Qi poured out.
These soldiers passively absorbed some.
Each of them rose again in height, nearly reaching three meters.
More robust and formidable.
The toughness of their armor also elevated another tier.
Ding Ling followed the usual pattern, choosing to let three soldiers carry this Three-legged Tripod back.
Then let the other soldiers continue moving forward.
This time.
He chose not to let the soldiers stop.
Because he sensed that the moment the Grotto Heaven World collapsed, the originally closed path suddenly opened.
But it only opened for a moment before beginning to close slowly.
Therefore, he must seize this opportunity.
Fortunately, his mind control power had greatly increased.
These puppet soldiers became stronger again, each of their eyes more lively, yet unable to break free from his control.
Under Ding Ling’s control, they dashed forward, at the moment the world collapsed, boom boom boom!
Each smashed through the barrier of a pathway and entered a narrow passage.
They continued to dash forward.
And the huge space just collapsed by half alongside.
The first batch of over a hundred soldiers was still running.
The three tall soldiers carrying the Three-legged Tripod brushed past them on their way back.
The three tall soldiers looked at them, their eyes revealing a hint of unusual emotion.
As if pitying the ones originally similar to them.
Ding Ling sensed it, secretly amazed:
"Indeed, they are about to come alive. Few more strands of pill Qi, perhaps they will all become living beings!"
The Sword Spirit itself lived because of Ding Ling.
Thus, the Sword Spirit can be said to be Ding Ling.
This is why the pill Qi didn’t work on bringing the Sword Spirit to life.
Instead, it worked on growing sword bones, blood, etc., for the Sword Spirit.
"It seems the effect of this pill is extraordinary, even soldiers rolled out of clay can come alive, what if I used better materials?"
Ding Ling thought about it but did not ponder deeply.
If he used better materials.
The difficulty of these soldiers’ transformation could suddenly increase by a hundredfold, a thousandfold?
In this world, who can tell all reason?
Da da da!
Three soldiers carried the Three-legged Tripod out of Shekou, moved through the waves, da da da, ran atop the sea of clouds, and delivered the Three-legged Tripod to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling grabbed it and took out a pill from inside.
The pill was indeed larger, and the Qi inside it was stronger.
Ding Ling swallowed it without hesitation.
The Sword Spirit’s body once again underwent changes.
Starting to grow meridians.
Once this pill was thoroughly digested.
Meridians spread all over the Sword Spirit’s body.
Making the life force on the Sword Spirit stronger.
Moreover.
Ding Ling’s mind control power again accumulated strength, raising his abilities exponentially.

"The techniques and laws the Sword Spirit can use are not many. Thus, it is weaker than the true body. But as it continues to devour such pills, the Sword Spirit is growing stronger and more terrifying. Consume a few more, it may catch up to the true body’s advancements."

Ding Ling’s mind control power again accumulated strength, raising his abilities exponentially.
"The techniques and laws the Sword Spirit can use are not many.
Thus, it is weaker than the true body.
But as it continues to devour such pills, the Sword Spirit is growing stronger and more terrifying.
Consume a few more, it may catch up to the true body’s advancements."

chapters.title: Chapter 794 - 783: Sword Blood
paragraphs: Ding Ling clicked his tongue.
This pill.
Let’s call it the World Pill.
Each one contains all the Heaven and Earth Creation of a world, truly extraordinary.
Who is conducting the alchemy?!
To actually refine such Heaven-defying Pills.
"No wonder the Netherworld is getting closer to the earth."
Ding Ling was relieved.
As the giant serpent continuously devours ’Primordial Qi’, over time, the destruction of the Netherworld is only logical.
"As I’ve swallowed two pills, my resistance against this giant serpent has also strengthened considerably."
Previously, Ding Ling dared not approach the giant serpent.
It was because when drawing closer,
there was a strong crisis of being devoured by the giant serpent, losing all Primordial Qi and Soul Qi at any moment.
But the soldiers created by Scattering Beans into Soldiers,
being shaped from clay, needn’t worry about having their souls consumed by the serpent.
"Looks like the serpent has grown weaker, and I have grown stronger."
Ding Ling looked down upon the giant serpent in the Lower Realm and thought;
"But it’s best not to approach it now, rather wait until I retrieve all the alchemy furnaces, then check inside its body."
Ding Ling commanded the three puppet soldiers to continue rushing into Shekou towards the previous pathway.
Meanwhile,
The first batch of over a hundred puppet soldiers had already reached the previous Grotto Heaven World but couldn’t leap within.
It was filled with various raging and terrifying air current storms.
Upon nearing.
The puppet soldiers would be damaged.
Compared to the second batch, which had evolved with Pill Qi, the first batch was relatively weaker.
Ding Ling continued to control the second batch of ninety-seven soldiers to rush through the corridor.
The second batch of ninety-seven soldiers had evolved twice, now comparable to powers like Jii Ling, and previously had broken through the corridor membrane together, entering a narrow passage.
At this moment, they had reached a crossroads.
The left side of the crossroads was also a Grotto Heaven World.
The other side wound forward, leading to another unknown passage.
Ninety-seven soldiers leapt into this Grotto Heaven World and indeed saw an alchemy furnace.
They followed the pattern and took down this alchemy furnace.
Each absorbed strands of Pill Qi, Kaza-kaza! Their height increased again, this time breaking the shackles, reaching three meters!
At this level of the soldier, they were already not weaker than Dong Zhuo!
Comparable to an area’s overlord!
Power was also around the Initial Tier Grandmaster.
The speed of evolution was far quicker than Ding Ling personally guiding Diao Chan!
Ding Ling, speechless, nevertheless commanded the three soldiers to rush back carrying the alchemy furnace.
While the other ninety-four soldiers once again flew towards another fork in the road!
This time, the three soldiers running back met with obstruction.
They shattered a layer of membrane, then fell into the collapsed other half of the world, in turbulent air currents, their bodies beginning to fracture, crumble.
Under Ding Ling’s control, they exerted all their might, with a roar, flung the alchemy furnace into the remaining intact world.
Kohng!
The alchemy furnace rolled on the ground several times, rolling to the front of the first batch of a hundred soldiers.
Perhaps the pill inside the alchemy furnace vibrated a few times.
And shook out strands of Pill Qi.
These Pill Qi were absorbed by the hundred soldiers.
Each began to evolve, rising high.
Growing to two meters in stature.
Only then could they step into the stormy current.
The intact half-world’s turbulent currents compared to the collapsed half-world’s turbulent currents could be said to have a Celestial Abyss difference.
The collapsed world’s turbulent currents could easily damage and destroy Grandmasters.
While the intact world’s turbulent currents could only destroy ordinary puppet soldiers, evolved puppet soldiers couldn’t be destroyed.
Ding Ling dispatched three to carry the alchemy furnace and run back.
While the other soldiers continued to guard in place, waiting.
As for the three soldiers that previously flung out the alchemy furnace, they had already crumbled into a pile of dirt.
Born a pile of dirt.
Dead also a pile of dirt.
The puppet soldiers initially hoped to evolve into people, but this time, in the collapsed world’s turbulent currents, they were smashed to pieces.
Before dying,
Their eyes appeared even more lively, seemingly having infinite longing for this world.
Ding Ling felt it clearly.
Couldn’t help but be moved with compassion, thinking: "Is it really proper to send them to death as puppets?"
Soon.
Ding Ling didn’t think much more.
The soldiers created by Scattering Beans into Soldiers are indeed for the master’s service.
Their value lies in precisely this.
If they could evolve several times, resisting the corrosion of the collapsed world’s turbulent currents, that would be ideal.
"See what luck you have."
Thus thought Ding Ling.
Patiently waited.
A period later.
The three puppet soldiers carrying the alchemy furnace arrived at Ding Ling’s side.
Ding Ling grabbed the alchemy furnace, took out the pill, and swallowed.
Whoosh whoosh!
Blood began to flow within his meridians.
Each drop of blood seemed to contain the essence of a Grotto Heaven! Extremely extraordinary.
Once the pill was fully digested.
Blood flowed rapidly, gurgling with sound.
Ding Ling clenched his fist.
He now had an exceedingly clear feeling that this Sword Spirit seemed to have reached the Initial Tier of Saint-Grade Martial Arts Golden Core.
"Remarkable."
"So the Sword Spirit evolves like this?"
The Sword Spirit in the Wind and Cloud World was already at Great Perfection Form.
A Sword Spirit of that form can compare with Shattering Great Perfection strong ones.
Subsequently, Ding Ling grew stronger several times.
Though the sword spirit also grew stronger, the power of skill became more powerful, yet it was ultimately not as strong as the original.
Yet this time.
The sword spirit gave birth to the Heaven-Reaching Supreme Sword Bone, meridians, blood; its power unknowingly reached the Saint-Grade Golden Core Realm.
"Bone is Sword Bone. Meridians are also Sword Meridians, blood even more so is Sword blood!"
Every drop of the Sword Spirit’s blood contained countless tiny swords!
A drop of his blood could easily shatter countless Grandmasters!
Was exceptionally stronger compared to before.
"Very good."
Ding Ling was immensely satisfied;
"This time truly is immense creation. I could never have thought of encountering such an astonishing chance in this Netherworld!"
His perception and control strength increased further.

Even as the ninety-four soldiers rushing deep within the giant serpent evolved thrice, becoming more agile and spirited, they remained under Ding Ling’s control. This time, the ninety-four soldiers traveled for a while, indeed reaching a new fork in the road.
Again, the soldiers saw a Grotto Heaven World.
Inside was likewise an alchemy furnace.
This alchemy furnace was similar in size and aura to the first.
Ninety-four soldiers cooperated, easily took it down.
Plop!
The alchemy furnace fell to the ground, releasing aura.
Ninety-four soldiers evolved again.
This time each grew to four meters!
Became as strong as Zhang Bao.
Split into three carrying the alchemy furnace back.
Ninety-one soldiers continued exploring for the Grotto Heaven World.
Tap tap!
After this evolution.
Their speed became extremely quick.

chapters.title: Chapter 795 - 784: The Heavenly Dao Has a Spirit
paragraphs: The three soldiers carrying the Alchemy Furnace easily sprinted to the previously collapsed world, and this time, they could survive in the chaos for a longer period.
They once reached the edge of the turbulence.
But ultimately, they couldn’t hold on.
They exerted themselves to throw the Alchemy Furnace outward.
Splash!
The Alchemy Furnace rolled in front of the first batch of Puppet Soldiers.
Pill Qi overflowed.
They were able to evolve once more.
Under Ding Ling’s control, three Puppet Soldiers were separated to carry the Alchemy Furnace back.
After a while, the Puppet Soldiers carrying the Alchemy Furnace arrived in a sea of clouds.
Ding Ling continued to swallow the Pills from the Alchemy Furnace.
This time, he grew Sword Flesh!
Every inch of flesh.
Contained astonishing Sword Intent, Sword Qi.
Perhaps because the flesh required more ’World Qi,’ one pill down.
Ding Ling only managed to condense the flesh of his upper body.
Even so.
Ding Ling felt the Sword Spirit had become much stronger again.
As time passed.
The Grotto Heaven Worlds discovered by the other puppets kept increasing.
After devouring three more Pills.
The Sword Spirit also began to develop blood, skin.
The whole person, from head to toe, already resembled a True Person.
In that instant of becoming a True Person.
Ding Ling even felt a strong rejection from this Netherworld.
Fortunately, the Sword Spirit and a True Person are different.
He, after all.
Even after developing blood, bones, and veins, is still a Sword Spirit!
Moreover, although the Netherworld rejected him, it also seemed to appreciate him, as threads of Celestial Might inexplicably blessed him, causing the strength of the Sword Spirit to surge again!
It already reached the limit that this Netherworld could accommodate.
"Indeed, is this the Heavenly Dao having a spirit?"
Ding Ling had long realized a fact.
That besides the Three Kingdoms World having the blessing of Celestial Might.
Neither the Wind and Cloud World nor others have such a blessing!
The Three Kingdoms World is very special!
Now thinking back.
It must be due to the Heavenly Dao having a spirit.
"A Heavenly Dao with a spirit will specially look after some of the strongest. Why is this?
Ding Ling was previously puzzled.
He thought it was purely due to reaching a certain level of strength.
Now it seems the Heavenly Dao wants to find strong people to help it get rid of the ’devouring’ of the giant serpent!

"Even the Divine Meditation Technique and the like might have been spontaneously inscribed in the Sea of Consciousness of these strong ones by the Heavenly Dao for self-rescue, hoping they would grow to ’eliminate’ this giant serpent. Unfortunately, this giant serpent is too powerful. Although the Heavenly Dao has a spirit, it seems like a muddled spirit, just an instinctive survival spirit?"
The specifics are.
Hard to know.
But after the Sword Spirit achieved a flesh and blood form, it no longer feared the devouring attribute of the giant serpent.
This is because the soul of the Sword Spirit was encapsulated by the body, making the giant serpent’s devouring ability ineffective!
Moreover.
Seven Alchemy Furnaces were seized.
The giant serpent’s abilities continually declined and weakened, and now the threat to Ding Ling is almost equal to zero.
Ding Ling stepped on a sword light, descending from the sea of clouds, stepping into Shekou.
Unlike controlling the march of the Puppet Soldiers.
Ding Ling witnessed and experienced personally, and that sinister, dark feeling was more obvious and clearer.
"Even after seizing seven Alchemy Furnaces, it’s still like this."
Ding Ling treaded on sword light, moving like lightning.
The Puppet Soldiers couldn’t keep up, left behind in his wake.
Quickly.
He arrived in the first collapsed Grotto Heaven World.
He walked in the turbulence, seeing the blocked passageway, pointed with a finger, and boom! Dense Sword Qi converged into a Sword Dragon, instantly piercing through the passage.
Ding Ling entered inside, continuing to move like lightning.
Soon, he caught up with eighty-two Puppet Soldiers who had evolved a full seven times.
Their strength had reached the Shattered Realm, slightly stronger than Zhang Jiao.
Each of them had extremely lively eyes.
Upon seeing Ding Ling, they immediately knelt and saluted:
"Greetings, Master!"
The Puppet Soldiers, both male and female, stood five meters tall, extremely massive, and at this moment, when kneeling to salute, they appeared like small mountains prostrated on the ground.
Ding Ling sighed deeply, gesturing with a wave of his hand to indicate not to be overly courteous, then transformed into an electric light and vanished in front of them.
He truly did not expect.
The group of Puppet Soldiers he casually molded would eventually each become beings with intelligence and Soul Qi.
He reckoned it must be those Pill Qi causing trouble.
The Pill Qi devoured the entire Netherworld, consuming copious Heaven and Earth Creations, enough that the sky was falling.
And the Netherworld was filled with Soul Qi.

These Pill Qis leaked from the Alchemy Furnaces refining the Netherworld, indicating that Pill Qi is absolutely superior to Soul Qi. It’s understandable that these puppets would evolve into puppets with spiritual essence after absorbing seven occurrences of Pill Qi.
Perhaps it was because Ding Ling’s artistic talent had reached the full level.
The Puppets he casually kneaded.
Were handsome and debonair for males, charmingly cute for females.
All of them were extraordinary and full of charm.
Facing such a group of artwork-like Puppet Soldiers, Ding Ling was momentarily taken aback, thinking if these Puppet Soldiers went to the outside world, they would absolutely shock countless people.
Of course.
The Puppet Soldiers did not know this. In their eyes, Ding Ling was their heaven and earth, their sacred father!
They sprinted, keeping up closely with Ding Ling.
In the time following, Ding Ling.
Discovered three more Grotto Heaven Worlds.
Each Grotto Heaven World.
Contained an Alchemy Furnace.
He took the Alchemy Furnaces away.
And directly swallowed the Pills inside.
After swallowing three pills consecutively.
The Sword Spirit developed a pair of Spiritual Eyes and a single Heaven-Reaching Ear.
The Spiritual Eyes could see through everything in the Netherworld.
No Netherworld Ghost could escape these Spiritual Eyes.
The Heaven-Reaching Ear could hear sounds from any corner of the Netherworld, which was extremely marvelous.
Not only that.
His strength grew stronger again.
The Domain Crystal within his Dantian shattered, forming a blurry Halo Sword Realm.
The Sword Realm, much like a Grotto Heaven World, had not yet fully manifested.
It was evidently still growing.
Ding Ling took a deep breath and continued forward.
He had already figured out the mystery of the placement of these Alchemy Furnaces.
"The five viscera and six bowels."
"A total of 11 Alchemy Furnaces."
The first Alchemy Furnace was located in the lungs of the giant serpent.
Afterwards, the stomach and various other places.
Now only the last place remains.
Ding Ling traversed with the sword light.
With a swoosh, he arrived at a somewhat warm Grotto Heaven World.
This was where the heart of the giant serpent was located.
He also saw an Alchemy Furnace.
In a flash, he reached beside the Alchemy Furnace, tilted it over, reached out to take the Alchemy Furnace, and swallowed it.
The Halo Sword Realm, as if receiving nourishment, began to furiously condense, expand, grow, and sublimate.
In less than two breaths, the Sword Realm formed a small elliptical Grotto World Structure.
The strength of the Sword Spirit’s aura.
Was no weaker than the original!
Especially now with the blessing of Celestial Might, it could be said that even the original body was hard to surpass.

chapters.title: Chapter 796 - 785: Drastic Upheaval in the Mortal Realm
paragraphs: Unlike the frailty of the Human Realm.
The Celestial and Earthly Dao of the Netherworld are still quite strong.
Their blessings upon the Sword Spirit are naturally quite powerful.
This makes the Sword Spirit, in terms of strength, even more formidable than its original form.
"...How long has it been, and already a strong entity has been created. The creation here is indeed extraordinary."
Ding Ling marveled.
This is why he came.
If it were an ordinary person, even knowing that there is creation within the python, they wouldn’t be able to obtain it.
Simply because the python can devour soul spirits and Primordial Qi.
People like Dong Zhuo and Zhang Jiao coming here would just be delivering food to it.
Furthermore, the Netherworld is extremely repellent to people, only soul spirits can generally set foot here.
Thus, this python can be said to be invincible in the Netherworld.
But Ding Ling’s Sword Spirit is special, and combined with his knowledge of the Full Level Taiping Sutra, it facilitates his extraordinary abilities.
"I’ve obtained all eleven places of opportunity. Time to leave."
Ding Ling realized that this python was actually an Odd Array set up by a Great Cultivator.
The purpose was to refine the heavens and earth of the Netherworld.
But now Ding Ling has taken these eleven Alchemy Furnaces, thus disrupting this person’s plan.
Who knows if this person will come looking in the end?
Though Ding Ling was somewhat uncertain, he was not afraid.
After all, the world’s limitations are here.
He has the Celestial Might as his blessing.
Who can do anything to him?
"It’s a pity that I still cannot clearly know where Liu Xiu and Bai Qi went."
Ding Ling still wished to meet these predecessors.
Many say Wang Mang is a transmigrator.
If they could meet here, the mystery would be solved, but unfortunately, even Spirit Emperor Liu Hong suddenly disappeared, not to mention the others.
Rumble!
Just as Ding Ling was about to leave, the various Space Worlds within the python’s body suddenly began to collapse and shatter violently.
Chaotic Storms swept across the Ten Directions Realm, and in an instant, engulfed Ding Ling and the eighty-two Puppet Soldiers following him.
"Master!"
The Puppet Soldiers screamed in agony, reaching out towards Ding Ling’s position.

Yet the chaotic storm created by the collapse of the entire internal space, with such great power, was akin to heaven and earth collapsing, birthing black holes out of thin air, into which several Puppet Soldiers were sucked on the spot.
Ding Ling, with formidable strength and protected by the Celestial Might, remained unscathed even amid the storm.
But the Puppet Soldiers could not withstand it.
Seeing this, Ding Ling immediately waved his hand.
The four Alchemy Furnaces behind him flew out, forming the Four Symbols Array, which stabilized the chaotic current in all directions.
In doing so.
The remaining seventy-six Puppet Soldiers were immediately sheltered.
They looked around in terror, then knelt and kowtowed to Ding Ling in gratitude.
"Thank you, Master."
Ding Ling waved his hand, standing above the Four Symbols Array, watching this world crumble, collapse, and be destroyed.
Boom!
As if a nuclear bomb had swept through, with a thunderous sound, the Grotto Heaven Worlds began to collapse and explode, everything inside vanishing into ashes.
The Divine Meditation Technique oversaw the realm for thousands of miles.
Ding Ling saw it all clearly.
Mountains were toppling and shattering.
The python was going to die.
"Indeed, the eleven Alchemy Furnaces are the core. Taking them away has destroyed this Odd Array. Naturally, the Doomsday Python can no longer survive."
The Doomsday Python seemed alive.
But in reality, it was an infinite monolith made of stacked mountains.
If this python had swallowed the Netherworld.
Perhaps this Doomsday Python could really come to life.
Simply because Ding Ling felt the surging and intense Soul Qi and Spiritual Qi within the Pills in the Alchemy Furnace.
If these Pills were eventually all absorbed into the python’s head.
The python would come to life, understandable indeed.
Just like the Puppet Soldiers, who came to life merely by absorbing some Pill Qi.
The potency of these Pills can be clearly seen!
Rumble!

The Meditation Technique illuminated the Ten Directions, and Ding Ling saw the first batch of Puppet Soldiers fleeing in panic, but in the end, they were still engulfed, shattered, and destroyed by the Doomsday Storm.
He sighed.
Those soldiers were too far from him, and he was powerless to save them.
He could only choose to save these seventy-six Puppet Soldiers.
Fortunately, outside the python world, six more Puppet Soldiers were guarding the seven Alchemy Furnaces and did not come along.
Adding this up.
There were still eighty-two surviving Puppet Soldiers.
"Huh!"
Ding Ling suddenly sensed great changes in the Human Realm.
His original self saw clearly that a black cloud appeared in the sky realm of the Human World, as the black cloud passed, the heavens collapsed, and the Great Sun seemed to be swallowed.
The Celestial Dao of the entire Human Realm seemed to utter a mournful cry at that moment.
"What’s happening?!"
Ding Ling was moved.
Without much thought.
He let out a clear whistle.
Pointing forward with his hand.
The Ghost Sword behind him instantly split into seventy-six large swords.
The swords landed at the Puppet Soldiers’ feet, carrying them through the storm, closely following Ding Ling as they surged into the sky.
Swoosh swoosh swoosh!
Ding Ling forged a path with the Sword River, unstoppable wherever it went.
Even mountains could not block him.
He easily broke through them.
And the four large Alchemy Furnaces rapidly spun around the Puppet Soldiers, protecting them from being swallowed or eroded by the storm, chaotic current, or black holes.
Boom!
As Ding Ling completely broke through the layers of mountains, bursting out of the python’s enormous body, flying to the sea of clouds.
Rumble! The python seemed to reach its limit, with towering mountains that pierced the clouds beginning to collapse and fall, creating a scene of doomsday.
Rumble!
The Celestial Dao wailing, the Earth Dao trembling.
The collapse of the python caused immense damage to the Netherworld as well.
But this python, like a huge tumor within the body of the Netherworld, being removed now. It is foreseeable that the Netherworld will definitely get better and better in the future.
Rather than declining all the way until it completely vanishes.
Whoosh!
Ding Ling’s speed was like lightning.
In the space of a breath, he traveled hundreds of miles.
Even carrying several large Alchemy Furnaces.
It still did not take him long to reach his previous resting place.
Whoosh whoosh!
The eleven Alchemy Furnaces gathered together, whoosh whoosh, suddenly began to merge automatically.
And with lightning speed, in a colorful, dazzling light, they instantly combined into one furnace.
This furnace resonated with a trembling sound, suddenly soaring into the sky, seeming to escape into an unknowable, nameless dark tunnel.
The present-day Ding Ling’s strength is second to none.

Moreover, with the assistance of the Celestial and Earthly Dao of the Netherworld, his power was unbelievably mighty, in an instant he sensed that unfathomable strange tunnel, just as the furnace was about to escape into the tunnel, he took a step, Shrinking Inches, arriving in front of the furnace, grabbing hold of it.
Clang clang!
The furnace trembled violently, struggled, and even emitted waves of strong repulsive force, as if trying to shake Ding Ling off.
If it had been before entering the Netherworld.
The Sword Spirit would not have been able to withstand this vast and overwhelming supreme power.
But not now.
Ding Ling stood firm like a mountain, no matter how the furnace’s power surged, he remained unmoved.
"Such powerful force. Is someone remotely controlling this furnace?"

The Celestial and Earthly Dao of the Netherworld are still quite strong.
Their blessings upon the Sword Spirit are naturally quite powerful.
This makes the Sword Spirit, in terms of strength, even more formidable than its original form.
"...How long has it been, and already a strong entity has been created.
The creation here is indeed extraordinary."
Ding Ling marveled.
This is why he came.
If it were an ordinary person, even knowing that there is creation within the python, they wouldn’t be able to obtain it.
Simply because the python can devour soul spirits and Primordial Qi.
People like Dong Zhuo and Zhang Jiao coming here would just be delivering food to it.
Furthermore, the Netherworld is extremely repellent to people, only soul spirits can generally set foot here.
Thus, this python can be said to be invincible in the Netherworld.

chapters.title: Chapter 797 - 786: Three Mortal Realms
paragraphs: Thinking about the upheavals in the Mortal Realm.
Ding Ling dared not delay any longer.
With a thought, he notified the eighty-two Puppet Soldiers to set up a Nine Palaces Bagua Array.
Then Ding Ling used the Ghost Sword as the core to suppress and seal this Alchemy Furnace.
The Ghost Sword also gained considerable fortune.
Comparable to the Snow-Drinking Saber.
Moreover, each Puppet Soldier was not weaker than a Shattering Level expert, and more than seventy of them were far stronger than Zhang Jiao.
And their auras were connected, born from the same source.
The power of over eighty individuals gathered into one! Using the Nine Palaces Bagua Array as support, suppressing the Alchemy Furnace for a period was no issue.
All of this.
Happened within two breaths.
As the ’Creator’ of the Puppet Soldiers.
Ding Ling communicated with them extremely conveniently, with a single thought, they could understand Ding Ling’s intentions and quickly cooperate and position themselves.
Thus, after the furnace was suppressed, the Sword Spirit formed seals, opened the Netherworld Gate, and walked out.
Qong!
A two-hundred-foot high Netherworld Gate manifested before his true form.
In the next instant.
The Sword Spirit walked out, slipped into his true form’s shell.
Boom!
An immensely powerful aura surged from Ding Ling’s shell into the sky.
This was the Sword Spirit’s feedback.
"The Sword Spirit is stronger than my true form now."
Ding Ling was astounded:
"Now the Sword Spirit and I are merged. The Sword Spirit’s tactics and abilities can all be utilized by me."
"Moreover, the Celestial Might of the Netherworld Heavenly Dao has mysteriously been bestowed onto me."
Ding Ling could feel a strange power from the depths of the void empowering him.
This is Celestial Might!
Compared to the Power of Celestial Might in the Mortal Realm of the Three Kingdoms.
The Celestial Might of the Three Kingdoms Netherworld was even stronger.
The Celestial Might of the Mortal Realm and Netherworld, in terms of level, true intent, and power, were worlds apart, completely not on the same tier.
Ding Ling looked down on the Mortal Realm’s Celestial Might.
But the Netherworld Celestial Might’s empowerment was still very beneficial to him.
With a single step, he could traverse over a thousand miles.
With the merging of the Sword Spirit and the empowerment of Celestial Might.
Ding Ling now was unbelievably powerful.
Not at all weaker than a First-grade Middle-stage Spirit expert.
At this level of proficiency.
Overturning a normal Historical World was as simple as rolling off a log.
Within a few breaths, he descended the Celestial Ladder.
"Greetings, Prince!"
Pan Feng and the other leaders once again greeted Ding Ling.
Ding Ling waved his hand to indicate exemption from formalities.
"Prince, do you know what has happened to this world?"
Pan Feng asked anxiously, pointing towards the celestial direction:
"Why has the northern Earth’s sky suddenly caved in, and the sun seems to be devoured? I feel the world is shaking violently, this world seems unable to hold on!"
"Possibly."
Ding Ling replied:
"Go back and let Diao Chan and the others come to the Celestial Ladder first. Even if the world is destroyed, the Celestial Ladder won’t be."
The Celestial Ladder is a matter beyond the specifications of the world.
It can almost withstand any disaster.
"Yes, Prince!"
As Pan Feng had just responded, he looked up, but where could he see Ding Ling’s figure?
"Where’s the Prince?"
"He flew away."
A player said with a face full of envy and admiration:
"With just a flicker, he disappeared without a trace, so fast."
The strength of Ding Ling.
The players had long sensed it.
But each time they witnessed it firsthand, they would still be shocked, their jaws dropping and their limbs going cold.
Although they’re all veteran players.
Why is Ding Ling so mighty like a Ghost God, while they are all still at the level of Third-class Generals?!
Comparing oneself to others.
Really can be maddening!
Ding Ling cast the Flowing Light Escape Skill, and in a flash, arrived at the world’s edge, the top of the sky.
He passed through the atmosphere, reaching beyond the Three Kingdoms World.
Here, he could witness the broad circumstances firsthand.
Ding Ling looked around.
He could only see three golden ladders breaking through layers of black fog.
Other than that.
He could only see not far away that enormous black mass covering the sky.
He couldn’t see clearly.
So he activated the Sword Spirit’s Spiritual Eye and Heaven-Reaching Ear.
At the same time, the Divine Meditation Technique reflected the Ten Directions Realm.
He now saw more clearly.
He was standing on a sphere.
This sphere looked very much like Earth!
On the left and right of this sphere were two identical ’Earths’!
Above each Earth sat a golden ladder.
The ladder pierced through layers of dimensional worlds, heading to that unknown height!
"That’s the Celestial Ladder.
Ding Ling realized:
"It’s no surprise, the two worlds on the left and right should be the Late Qin Dynasty and Late Sui Dynasty, two new Plane Worlds."
Without realizing it.
Ding Ling had grown powerful enough to pierce through the clouds, stand in the cosmos, and looked afar at the extent of the two other Plane Worlds.
But because the distance was too far.
Ding Ling couldn’t go to the two other Plane Worlds either.
It seemed nearby.
But Ding Ling’s Spiritual Eye saw clearly, who knows how many dimensional layers separated them, a single dimension could mean a difference of a million miles, ten million miles.
Dense strands of dimensional lines embedded in between, like an insurmountable Celestial Abyss.
Ding Ling had no intention of going to other worlds.
He continued to watch.
Above the sphere were a large and a small glowing sphere.
One is the sun.
One undoubtedly, must be the moon.
These two spheres were as if crafted from Magical Treasures, wrapped in layer upon layer of Grand Arrays.
Currently, the sun was slowly being eroded by a strange creature.
And in front and behind the sphere were endless expanses of dark realms.
It felt empty, dead, bleak, black, silent.
"Is this the first layer of the Game World?"
Ding Ling was moved.
It looks very much like a man-crafted world.
Ding Ling looked towards the ’big fish’ furiously attacking the Three Kingdoms World.
"Is that the Kunpeng?"
Flat and wide, unknown how many thousands, tens of thousands of miles across.
But under the reflection of the Divine Meditation Technique, coupled with the Spiritual Eye, Ding Ling still roughly perceived the creature’s circumstances.
It looked very much like the ’Kun’ recorded in the ancient history of the Three Kingdoms!
"A fish dares to act recklessly!"

Ding Ling feared not whether this fish was the Kunpeng from the Primordial Era, as he watched the Celestial Palace of the Three Kingdoms World collapse more than half, a piece of an unknown substance crashing down like a meteor shower onto the land, not knowing how many perished.
Ding Ling was enraged and charged upward.
At the same time.
A ’nuclear bomb’ storm arose suddenly in the northern part of the Three Kingdoms World!
Where the storm passed.
Everything was destroyed.
Flowers, grasses, trees, people, birds, beasts... countless species were obliterated in these waves of attacks.
Ding Ling’s Spiritual Eye saw very clearly.
Whenever the Kun struck down.
Thousands of families would be destroyed, many children still playing outside were consumed and destroyed by this storm.
Ding Ling saw many players, humans frantically fleeing for their lives.
Some players were even scared dumb, didn’t know to log off; or perhaps, they had settled down in this world, reluctant to part with their wives, children, desperately escaping with their families.
But how could they escape such a calamity-level disaster?
In just an instant.
They were engulfed and obliterated by the storm and fire rain.

chapters.title: Chapter 798 - 787: Kun
paragraphs: In the face of such a terrifying heavenly calamity.
The power of mortals appears so insignificant! Vulnerable to a single blow!
It cannot be resisted at all!
Even if you run, you can’t escape.
Ding Ling was extremely furious because he saw everything clearly.
It’s just because there are many historical figures he is familiar with in the northern earth realm, and under this wave of attacks, they were all obliterated.
Ding Ling charged forward, using his hands as a saber, slashed outwards!
Celestial Cry Saber Technique!
Three Reincarnations!
As the saber struck, a sword qi carrying the true meaning of reincarnation shot towards the Kun like an electric flash!
The Kun opened its mouth wide, swallowed the sword qi, and then quickly expelled it from its air pores, whoosh!
The sword qi rushed back towards Ding Ling at an even faster speed.
"Hmm?!"
Ding Ling’s eyebrows twitched, the body-protecting sword armor activated, and he caught the sword qi with his hand.
Peng!
The sword qi struck the sword armor.
Ding Ling was unharmed, and with a backhand, he slashed out another stronger Three Reincarnations.

This time, the Three Reincarnations was slashed out with ten times the power amplification using the Martial Dao True Understanding, its power strong enough to instantly kill an Initial Tier of First-Grade Primordial Spirit expert!
Thus, when the Kunpeng opened its mouth again to swallow the sword qi, trying to expel it from its air pores, it found it couldn’t, and instead, it uncontrollably shrank rapidly, in just an instant.
It transformed from its huge form of several tens of thousands of miles to the size of a mere elephant.
"Wuwu!"
The Kun’s pair of massive eyes were filled with disbelief, it looked at Ding Ling full of fear, and suddenly raised its head and roared sharply as if calling for help.
Seeing this, Ding Ling frowned, accelerated his speed, and struck with a lightning-fast saber.
Three Reincarnations!

This time, the saber was also slashed out with ten times amplification, in less than half a blink, it enveloped the Kun, and the Kun’s form changed again at a rapid pace, turning into a fish the size of a palm, then leaped into the void, transforming into a butterfly fluttering in the air.
The butterfly transformed again.
Turning into a bubble, it suddenly disappeared.
Ding Ling was stunned:
"How did the Kun turn into a butterfly?!"
He couldn’t understand.
Turning into a fish was still plausible.
It actually became a butterfly!
"Kong!"
The sound of a dimensional tear suddenly arose.
Ding Ling looked in the direction of the sound.
He saw, above the Earth of the Three Kingdoms World, a hundred feet away in front of him, a hundred-foot-tall golden portal suddenly appeared.
The portal seemed to be formed by condensed liquid gold.
Shimmering with light, it seemed to reflect one ancient world after another.
Accompanied by the sound of something piercing through water, Ding Ling clearly saw a person walking out of the portal.
This person’s immortal aura was mixed with a hint of darkness and grandeur, akin to the king of ghost gods.
With one glance.
Ding Ling recognized him.
"Nanhua Old Immortal!"
It was the image of Nanhua Old Immortal from Zhang Jiao’s memory fragments!
"You recognize me?"
The old man glanced sideways, surprised:
"Who are you? Why don’t I have any impression of you."
"Who I am doesn’t matter."
Ding Ling stood in the void, his clothes flapping in the wild wind, he was dignified and imposing, looking sharply at Nanhua Old Immortal, exuding the aura of a grandmaster:
"Was it you who released the Kun?"
"That’s right."
Nanhua Old Immortal looked around, not seeing the Kun, turned to Ding Ling:
’I heard the Kun’s wailing, asking for help. Did you kill the Kun?!’
He seemed somewhat incredulous:
"How could such a divine being be born from a mere Mortal Plane? Did you come from the Upper Realm?!"
"What about you?"
Ding Ling activated his full-level acting, sneered:
"You surely also come from the Upper Realm, right? You are clearly an expert from the Upper Realm, yet you come to this lower realm to do as you please! Where is your conscience?!"
"Hehe."
Nanhua Old Immortal sized up Ding Ling with a sneer:

"Look at your aura, it’s clearly the Martial Arts Golden Core Realm, yet you can kill the Kun. You must have some secret skills. But even so, it’s quite remarkable. Which Immortal Family from the Upper Realm do you belong to?! How dare you inquire into my Nanhua Old Immortal affairs?! Truly ridiculous!"
Ding Ling’s heart was stirred, perhaps this lower realm was not as peaceful and safe as he had seen in the past, but his full-level acting was always activated, making his appearance flawless:
"The Netherworld’s swallower of the heavens incident, the disappearance of Liu Xiu, Bai Qi, and others, you must be the culprit, right?"
"So what if I am."
Nanhua Old Immortal looked at Ding Ling with eyes sharp like knives:
"I recently sensed chaos in the Netherworld, it turned out to be your doing! Did you consume the Heaven and Earth Pill I refined?!"
His eyes flared, then he understood:

"No wonder the Kun was furious, I had promised it long ago to give it the Heaven and Earth Pill. You consumed its pill. How could it not be angry? The Mortal World suffered this great calamity. It’s all your fault. What’s your name? I’m going to send you to the real Netherworld, let you meet King Yama and have him judge you!"
Ding Ling did not answer, but his heart was in turmoil.
At this moment.
He confirmed a few things.
Nanhua Old Immortal indeed came from the Upper Realm, and apparently, he knew King Yama?!
As for which world of the Upper Realm Nanhua Old Immortal came from?
How did he descend to the mortal world?
Ding Ling didn’t know.
He also probed Nanhua Old Immortal, but Nanhua Old Immortal was a cunning old being, after several confrontations with Ding Ling, he realized Ding Ling was eliciting information, and became furious:
"You little brat, you’re courting death!"
Boom!
He pointed his finger at Ding Ling, generating thunderbolts out of thin air, transforming into dragon pythons, rumbling towards Ding Ling.
Ding Ling was fearless, countering with a saber slash!
Dealing with Nanhua Old Immortal, Ding Ling didn’t dare to slacken in the slightest.
In one move.
He went all out.

Not only did the power of the sword spirit’s sword realm augment him, the Divine Meditation Technique was continuously activated, reflecting the Ten Directions Realm, and the Power of Celestial Might from the Netherworld was also activated to the maximum.
At the same time, the thirteen times power amplification of Martial Dao True Understanding was fully initiated.
With one slash.
Celestial Cry Saber Technique!
Six Paths of Annihilation!

As soon as this saber emerged, six different paths arose in the void, each seemingly capable of devouring souls and spirits, spreading along with the direction of the saber light, piercing straight ahead, wherever it passed, thunder stopped, gales disappeared, the entire world seemed to pause at this moment!
Nanhua Old Immortal was astonished, his body hair stood on end:
"How could this kind of sword skill appear in the hands of a mere youngster!"
He couldn’t believe it.
Gathering all his power, he struck a palm towards the sword qi.
As the palm was unleashed, it transformed into a giant palm seemingly capable of shattering heaven and earth.
Yet it was useless.
The Six Paths of Annihilation with all sorts of amplifications were overwhelmingly powerful, even able to withstand a High Tier of First-Grade Primordial Spirit!
Nanhua Old Immortal’s palm power clearly hadn’t reached the High Tier of Primordial Spirit, thus his palm power was instantly pierced through and annihilated by these six paths.
"How is it possible?!"
Nanhua Old Immortal was shocked, retreated violently, and dove into the golden-shimmering portal.

The power of mortals appears so insignificant!
Vulnerable to a single blow!
It cannot be resisted at all!
Even if you run, you can’t escape.
Ding Ling was extremely furious because he saw everything clearly.
It’s just because there are many historical figures he is familiar with in the northern earth realm, and under this wave of attacks, they were all obliterated.

chapters.title: Chapter 799 - 788: Players in Heated Discussion
paragraphs: The next instant.
The portal began to flicker uncertainly, as if it might disappear at any moment.
Ding Ling performed the Shrinking Inches technique, reaching the gate in an instant and then stepping through it.
Almost as soon as he entered, the portal made a clapping sound and vanished without a trace.
The raging winds began to subside.
The cataclysm started to calm down.
Players fleeing frantically with their families looked up at the Celestial Palace with lingering fear:
"What on earth happened?! What was that giant beast in the sky just now?!"
A beast that could easily destroy the heavens and the earth.
This monster, existing only in novels and films, was witnessed and experienced firsthand.
This left many players, living in the Historical Plane and ready to take a passive role, utterly bewildered.
Especially players whose families died and were revived, who stood before their devastated homes in a daze, filled with both anger and sorrow!
Some players even cursed loudly:

"Damn it, playing a game where leveling up is already hard enough. I planned to be a lifestyle player, making this my second world to cultivate. Out of nowhere, a meteor shower destroyed me and my home! Where do you even go to complain about this? I’m going to file a grievance against this lousy game!"
No one knew exactly what had happened.
But as a piece of news spread across the internet.
The players realized one thing, that the cataclysm might have been quelled by Ding Ling.
Especially players who were waiting by the Celestial Ladder, swore about Ding Ling’s actions and words before he disappeared, making many players firmly believe.
They were shocked and lamented:
"We’re all humans, how is the gap getting wider and wider!"

"I’ve been cultivating martial arts for seven or eight years. I’m still just a Second-class General, and the threshold for becoming a Super-Elite General is still far out of reach for me. But Ding Ling? Flying and earth escaping, there’s nothing he can’t do. He’s too powerful, too admirable!"

"Indeed. Deserving of being my idol! I heard that Zhao Yun and others, who are close to him, have received supreme opportunities. Each of them is becoming stronger at a pace far exceeding the past. It shows that Ding Ling is indeed very reliable. Unfortunately, I know him, but he doesn’t know me!"
The internet was in an uproar!
Simply because there were indeed quite a few veteran players in the Three Kingdoms World.
These individuals were either determined to cultivate to become a Super-Elite General;
Or they had already settled in the Three Kingdoms, married, and had children, unwilling to abandon their families to ascend to the Upper Realm;

Or they were completely passive, thinking that even if they went to the Upper Realm, cultivating Inner Power wouldn’t likely make them a First-class Expert, so they’d rather slowly cultivate the Breathing Technique in the Three Kingdoms. At least this way, they wouldn’t have to start over in the Upper Realm, forcing them to abandon years of hard work and start anew, which was a difficult decision for them;
These people made up a considerable proportion.
At this moment, they voiced their opinions online, creating a tidal wave on the internet!

"Ding Ling is too powerful. Whoever marries him would surely become an Empress in no time! Even Little Zhao has been cultivated by Ding Ling into an Empress. There’s no reason us players can’t do the same!!"
"How can I get close to him and capture his heart?!"
Ding Ling’s strength, mystery, and unparalleled nature inspired admiration and respect among female players, and even male players greatly idolized and revered him!
The inherent human nature of admiring the strong.
Especially for many men, the desire to become a strong person, one who stands above others, is almost an instinct imprinted in their bones.
Only when feeling utterly powerless would they choose to take a passive approach.
And Ding Ling’s various extraordinary feats along the way left them feeling unattainable, astonishing, and concurrently made them develop a sense of reverence from their hearts.
This feeling, as Ding Ling’s grand deeds became well-known, was elevated to an extraordinarily fearsome level.

Especially the fact that the cataclysmic beast capable of destroying the heavens and the earth in the Three Kingdoms World was swiftly defeated by Ding Ling, became a topic of endless discussion among all players.

Some ad companies and others publicly extended their invitations once more, offering all kinds of endorsements to Ding Ling, expressing: they were sincerely inviting Ding Ling to be their spokesperson, willing to let him set the terms, and they would provide annual dividends! All Ding Ling had to do was drop by and take a photo!
Advertisers were humbling themselves to this extent.
Yet Ding Ling showed no intention of appearing.
This further evoked sighs among the players:
"Ding Ling is definitely someone who doesn’t lack money!"

"He’s simply the dream man for every female player! Height, temperament, appearance, wealth, cultivation, divine weapons, etc., all top-tier in the world! Such a perfect man, it seems he’s still single in the real world! Anyone who marries him is really hitting the jackpot! Too bad I’m a man; if I were a woman, I would have chosen to marry him too!"
The real world was abuzz with discussions about Ding Ling.
Some news channels even started broadcasting related news segments at 7 PM and 10 PM, among other times.
The host sat upright, saying seriously:

"According to related sources: our country’s top mythic gamer, Master Ding Ling, saved countless families in the Three Kingdoms World yesterday... Here are the clips from our station’s investigation. Please watch the video...
Meanwhile, foreign broadcasters could only begrudgingly express:
"Master Ding Ling belongs to the world. He doesn’t belong to just one country! We ask that the hosts from certain countries note: World-class Master Ding Ling..."
The real world was in a swirl of activities and turbulence.
Simply because many individuals had deduced an extremely terrifying fact:
That Ding Ling was highly likely no longer afraid of nuclear bombs!
He might not even be hurt by them!
Even if everyone else in the world perished.
Ding Ling likely wouldn’t.
When this conclusion was reached.
All organizations were shaken by it!
Then related leaders issued an urgent order:

"At all costs, form a friendship with Ding Ling. Whoever can uncover the secret to Ding Ling’s rapid empowerment will be the country’s great benefactor. All of us will be grateful to him and will focus on nurturing him!"

"If you can’t get close to Ding Ling, then find a way to obtain those Unparalleled Techniques and opportunities. Only this way, will we have a chance to catch up with Ding Ling. Otherwise, we would only be trampled under his feet."

When some organization leaders realized that Ding Ling could easily crush nations, manipulating the whole world as if it were in the palm of his hand, they couldn’t sit idly by anymore and prepared to employ every possible strategy.
In this regard.
Ding Ling knew nothing.
Even if he did know, he wouldn’t care.
He had already become so powerful that he wasn’t afraid of nuclear bombs anymore, how could he care about the thoughts of some strangers?
When he followed Nanhua Old Immortal through the glowing golden portal, he arrived in a new world.
Here, at a glance, the sky was clear, the water was blue, flowers were blooming in profusion, and it all presented a serene and gentle landscape.
Ding Ling stood on the green grass, watching as Nanhua Old Immortal vanished into thin air in a flash, leaving no trace.

chapters.title: Chapter 800 - 789: Enemy of the World
paragraphs: Ding Ling was about to pursue further, but suddenly noticed the grass beneath his feet turning into small snakes, winding around his ankles. Even the flowers not far away began to release strange fragrances, attempting to confuse and poison him.
Ding Ling pointed down with his finger.
Clang!
The Sword River erupted from his fingertips, transforming into a Sword Dragon that spun around him. Wherever the Sword Dragon passed, all grass and flowers were crushed to nothingness.
Ding Ling carefully observed this world.
He saw peculiar peaks a hundred miles away swaying like people, as if trying to encircle him;
The very air of this world began to slowly draw out, giving Ding Ling an increasingly suffocating sensation.
Not only that.
When Ding Ling tried to fly upwards, he inadvertently went underground.
Attempting to move left, he found himself uncontrollably moving right instead.
"The order of Heaven and Earth is completely reversed."
"What kind of world have I entered? How can Nanhua Old Immortal vanish without a trace?"
Ding Ling was puzzled.
Fortunately, his Body Refining had reached the Immortal realm.

Whether it was the War God Technique or the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill, Ding Ling had cultivated to Full Level previously, and had also absorbed numerous Great Medicines and divinities, making the War God Technique and others reach Great Perfection, birthing Divine Form and the War God Spirit Body.
The War God Spirit Body was akin to Ding Ling’s second soul.
As long as this spirit body remained unscathed.
Ding Ling could remain unharmed even if beheaded.
And afterward.
With the advent of the Martial Dao True Understanding.
The War God Spirit Body underwent a transformation, becoming the Martial Arts Spirit Body.
This Martial Arts Spirit Body emerged from the Body Refining Skill within the Martial Dao True Understanding.

And the Body Refining Skill was an essence merged from Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill, War God Technique, World-Ending Demon Skill, Golden Bell Shield, Iron Cloth Shirt, and other Body Refining techniques.
Extremely formidable, it can directly reach the Martial Arts Battle Immortal Realm! Achieving the Martial Arts Immortal Body!
Of course.
Currently, Ding Ling’s Body Refining Skill could only be considered Golden Core Level.
But even so, its extraordinary nature allowed Ding Ling to easily withstand dismemberment without dying.
Thus.
Even as the air here became thinner, until eventually nearly all was drained away.
Ding Ling could still walk freely in this world, fiercely combating with flowers, grasses, and trees.
Bang!
The Sword River roared like a dragon, annihilating everything in its path.
Ding Ling moved swiftly, cutting through the vast grassland, sweeping away all obstructing plants and trees.
He smashed through the peculiar peaks.
Forcing his way from one part of the realm to the world’s edge.
Of course.
By now, Ding Ling had grasped some understanding.
"The entire world is opposing me."
"Flowers, grasses, and trees attempt to strangle and bind me. Peculiar peaks intend to crush me. Vast waves try to drown me. Even the air seeks to suffocate and poison me..."
Ding Ling was at a loss for words.
"How could it be like this?!"
He was somewhat baffled.
"This defies common sense. How did Nanhua Old Immortal manage it?!"
"Unless..."
Ding Ling ignored the entwining vines threatening to strangle him, looking at what was supposed to be the world’s edge, he circled around only to return to the starting point.
The so-called world’s edge is endless.
This seemed to be a sphere!
To confirm his suspicions.
Ding Ling swept all the way from the left to the furthest right;
Again from the front to the furthest end.
Several intersecting sweeps.
Erasing countless obstructing plants and trees, collapsing unknown numbers of mountains, overturning river after river...
Ding Ling understood:
"This is Nanhua Old Immortal’s internal world!"
Unexpectedly, Nanhua Old Immortal had cultivated an entire world.
I haven’t even achieved this!
Ding Ling was shaken.
Previously, he hadn’t considered this possibility at all.
Because he sensed Nanhua Old Immortal’s cultivation was just around the Middle Tier of First-grade Primordial Spirit, a rank above Kun, several ranks above him.
But his Martial Dao True Understanding could cheat fate, Reverse Ascension!
Combined with the Sword Spirit’s support, the blessings of the Netherworld’s Heavenly Dao.

Therefore, although Ding Ling’s current cultivation was only at the High Tier of Saint-Grade Golden Core, his overall strength was capable of contending with the High Tier of First-Grade Primordial Spirit!
Being so powerful himself.
But he had only cultivated an oval-shaped Grotto World Structure.
Let alone becoming a world.
Not even a grotto heaven.
Because he hadn’t even touched the border of creating a world, Ding Ling wouldn’t have thought in that direction.
But now faced with reality, he couldn’t help but consider it.
"No wonder this world is against me at every turn."
"That’s why it was me who came. Any ordinary Golden Core expert coming here would only meet death."
An ordinary Golden Core expert couldn’t survive without breathing while fiercely battling.
Moreover, this is a battle against an entire world.
A fight against air, plants, trees, mountains, rivers, and everything else.
A single mistake.
Like drinking a sip of water could choke you to death!
Taking a step could make you trip and fall to your death!
Only Ding Ling’s body, being Immortal, has no fear of falling, striking, drowning, or suffocating...
An ordinary Golden Core expert, lacking Ding Ling’s Body Refining standard, would likely perish upon arrival—a harsh reality.
"So, Nanhua Old Immortal, realizing he couldn’t defeat me, plans to trap me to death?"
Over time.
Facing an entire world, indeed, one might die from an unexpected misstep.
For the air inhaled was all poisonous.
Luckily, Ding Ling was Immune to All Poisons!
"Fortunately, I am versatile. Had there been any weakness, surviving this time would leave me crippled."
Ding Ling pondered:

"That old fox Nanhua Old Immortal is certainly extraordinary. But where exactly does he come from in the Upper Realm? What’s his secretive, sneaky move in the Lower Realm for? Just to refine the Heaven and Earth Pill for Kun?!"
Ding Ling was skeptical.
Nanhua Old Immortal had descended several times, imparting Immortal Techniques to others, for what purpose?!
How did Nanhua Old Immortal descend to the Lower Realm?!
This was what Ding Ling couldn’t fathom.
He was rewarded after clearing the game as a king, allowing him to descend.
Could it be...
"Is Nanhua Old Immortal also a game player, rewarded similarly?"
Ding Ling was uncertain.
He stopped overthinking and prepared to wreak havoc on this world.
"Since it’s confirmed to be Nanhua Old Immortal’s Inner Heaven and Earth world, to get out, I must shatter Heaven and Earth."
Ding Ling held his breath.
Ignoring the air’s toxicity,
the strangling flora,
the crushing mountains looming imminently;
the rivers sweeping over,
the earth’s pitfall, the lightning strikes from the sky...
He fixed his gaze on a single direction, beginning to slash unceasingly.
Celestial Cry Saber Technique!
Heaven and Earth Shattered!
With one strike, a thousand-foot long saber glow slashed the void, and a deep ravine appeared in the ground, so Ding Ling continued to slash downward.
Continuously hacking at the furrow, the ravine!

The Sword River erupted from his fingertips, transforming into a Sword Dragon that spun around him.

Ding Ling carefully observed this world.

The very air of this world began to slowly draw out, giving Ding Ling an increasingly suffocating sensation.
